Greater elemental.title: Greater elemental

infobox.title: Greater elemental
infobox.Alternate Translation(s): Greater spiritHigh-level elementalHigh-level spiritSuperior elementalSuperior spirit

Appearance: Greater elementals, unlikelesser elementalsand most medium elementals, possess rational thought and firm wills that allow for the development of personality and individuality. The development of their personality leads to them developing unique and typically humanoid appearances, usually heavily influenced by the element they represent.
Characteristics: Greater elementals, just like other elementals, come in the variety of eight different types depending on their element. Depending on their element, there are shared "names" used to refer to all greater elementals of that element, all greaterfireelementals are referred to asIfritfor example. This does not qualify as beingnamed. The power that greater elementals wield is immense and usually reaches the realm of Special A. Unlike Lesser and medium elementals, greater elementals are significantly more fickle in who they wield their power to. Just being liked by other elementals of that element isn't enough, if your personality isn't to the liking of a greater elemental, it won't lend you power. In addition to their elemental power, greater elementals are renowned as some of the best users ofaspectual magic, with their ability to cast magic and control magicules being compared to that ofgreater daemons.
Pseudo greater elementals: RimuruandCieldeveloped a method to artificially create greater elementals whom they callpseudo greater elementals｢擬似上位精霊,giji jōi seirei｣. It is done by combininglesser elementalsviaDegenerateinto one being and implanting an artificial personality. Only three are known to have been made: one ofEarth, one ofSpaceand one ofWater-Wind.[1]
Trivia: According toTreyni, greater elementals are capricious.[2]

Appearance: Kaede is a large, beautiful, canine-eared woman with waist-length white hair. In her youth, her white hair – much like her daughter – faded to red at the tips, but as she aged, it turned completely to white. Her attire consists of a yukata with dark geometric patterns.
Personality: Kaede, as the elder of the Tengu, is a strong-willed and graceful person. As a mother, she is loving and slightly playful, teasing her daughter in matters concerning romance. She preaches to Momiji that a good woman is one who "makes her sweetheart turn back toward her". Due to nearing the end of her lifespan, she worries greatly about the future of her daughter and urges her to find a partner.
Background: Kaede was originally anAngelthat fell to theCentral Worldand came to incarnate within the corpse of anOkami, becoming the progenitor of a brand new race called the Tengu.

Some time after obtaining a physical body, Kaede roamed the land and eventually encounteredByakuya Arakiin the village of theOgres, becoming his apprentice and learning the ways of the sword alongside his unnamedgrandsonwho was younger than her. Byakuya grew old and passed away over the years, leaving his grandson who became a master of the sword that grew to surpass Kaede in technique. Smitten with him, Kaede confessed her feelings under a large maple tree, and the two consummated their love over a night together. She left the village afterwards, unbeknownst to the ogre that she would carry his child.

Kaede gave birth to the ogre's child after 300 years and named her Momiji, draining most of her remaining power in the process and leaving her weakened. Unable to continue in her duties as chief, Kaede passed on the role to her daughter who was the most powerful and capable of her children.

Demi-material life-form.title: Demi-material life-form

Background: WithinThat Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime, there exist three different types of universes orworlds: spiritual worlds, material worlds, and demi-material worlds, divided by the nature of the natural laws they follow. Those that are bound by their flesh and follow completely material laws arematerial life-forms, while their counterparts that reside within demi-material worlds are considered demi-material life-forms.
When a material life-form crosses into a demi-material world, theirbodyperishes and they're reconstructed into a demi-material life-form.[2]
Properties: Demi-material life-forms, unlike material life-forms, possess some spiritual qualities. This is what allows them to do things like manipulatemanaand storeenergywithin their bodies.
Just like material life-forms, however, they are still completely bound to their material body, relying on things like biological functions and being subject to lifespan.

Appearance: Treyni has the appearance of a full-grown young woman with green hair and blue eyes along with well-defined facial features. She is an ethereal beauty whose body takes on a semi-transparent state. She wears a full-length aqua colored dress with white sleeves and goes barefoot.
Personality: As the overseer of the forest, Treyni possesses a certain dignity and level of grace befitting the role. She is well-spoken and intelligent, able to mediate between multiple parties with ease. Beneath that exterior, however, is a childish and emotional person, much like her master,Ramiris. Whenever she's around Ramiris, she tends to show her true self and spoils her excessively, greatly stressing outBeretta– the only sense of reason within the trio. Her personality is virtually identical toRimuru Tempest, as commented by him, except she's way more skilled in avoiding commitments and passing on any troublesome responsibilities to others.
Due to her past as a refugee, Treyni is empathetic towards the suffering of others and is willing to provide her aid to those who come under her protection if they ask for it.
Background: Over a thousand years ago, before ever settling in the Jura Forest as a Dryad, Treyni was once a fairy serving under the Elemental Queen, Ramiris. She parted ways with the then Elemental Queen who reached the end of her lifespan, believing that the next queen succeeding her would be a wholly different person from the previous queen that only inherited her name. She came to the Jura Forest for refuge along with other fairies and were given permission to reside there by Veldora. To thank him, Treyni offered her services and became the overseer of the forest, meting out punishment to those that threatened its residents.
Trivia: InThe Slime Diaries, Treyni is shown to have a fondness for potatoes. She also said that Dryads are born from potatoes leading to the obvious joke that Treyni might be a cannibal due to her near constant consumption of potato chips.

Treyni is shown to have awareness ofVeldorabeing eaten byRimuru, long before Rimuru himself shared the details with his friends and allies. In episode 12 of season 1 of the anime, she even said Rimuru has Veldora'sDivine protection.

Despite being a Dryad, she is shown to have a deep understanding between civilization and nature, and always gives her insight to best handle development ofRimuru City, and later, theDungeon. Because of this, despite Rimuru City becoming highly advanced, the city layout is one with the natural surroundings and doesn't dominate the land.
She is one of the few monsters to already have a name at the time of her introduction.
Her laidback attitude and increasing tendency to involve herself with the affairs of Rimuru has been a point of envy towards her two younger sisters.

As Ramiris' assistant, she also has a strong fascination with technology and entertainment and helps to bring those and more to Tempest. She helps develop complex traps within the Dungeon. Upon hearing about video games from Veldora, she was shown to have an interest in trying to bring a form of it to her world. This could be seen as ironic, since Dryads are typically depicted in other media as tree spirits who're impartial to the flow of time. However, Treyni is always living in the moment mindset and strives to enrich her life every day.

Personality: Muese was very ambitious and overconfident, having desired to become one of the Five Elders and was certain that he had the talent required to do so despite only being a moderate schemer. In the end, however, his ambition and overconfidence proved his undoing, as he was so certain he hadTempestin a bind that he was completely unprepared for the possibility they would actually be able to pay all the merchants he'd rallied, and was so confident of his success that he even got openly involved in the incident, ultimately exposing his involvement in it to the public when his plan fell through, causing him to greatly lose face.
Story: Muese showed up at the end of theTempestFounder's Festival and intervened in a dispute betweenMjöllmileand some of the merchants who helped with the event. The merchants, acting upon Muese's orders, were instructed to only accept dwarven coins as payment. His intention was to put pressure on the nation and swoop in at the last minute to pay off the tab and thus have Tempest become indebted to the Five Elders. However,Rimuru,Shion,Benimaru, andDiablowere very well aware of his scheme and his offer was declined as Rimuru already had dwarven coins that he got fromElmesia. As a result, he left in utter defeat.
Following his departure, Rimuru hadSoueiinvestigate his origins as well as his connections, but the Five Elders quickly caught on and had him assassinated.
Relationships: Rimuru Tempest: Muese schemed to make Rimuru's nation indebted to him, but failed due to the latter seeing right through his plan.

Diablo,Benimaru, andShion: Like Rimuru, they too were very well aware of his plan, which was indicated by Benimaru's shady response to him for thinking that the coins that Rimuru received from Elmesia are fake and when Diablo smirked at him before he, Shion, and Rimuru left the room.

Granbell RossoandMariabell Rosso: He worked for them. After he failed to carry out his orders, they expressed disappointment of him, especially because they were so certain he won't fail them. He is later eliminated byGlenda Attleyunder Mariabell's orders after outliving his usefulness.
Elmesia El Ru Sarion: Although they never interacted, she indirectly foiled his scheme by giving Rimuru the money he needed to pay the merchants.

infobox.title: Myrd
infobox.Anime: Episode 4:In the Kingdom of the Dwarves

Appearance: Myrd, like mostdwarves, possesses a short stature and brown skin, along with a muscular build. In contrast to his brothers, he sports a bald head, beady eyes, a bushy beard adorned with a thin mustache, and is often seen wearing a white handkerchief. His typical attire consists of a greenish shirt paired with bluish pants, secured with tape around his ankles, and brown boots.
Personality: Myrd, much like his brother, has a penchant for clumsiness in everyday tasks and has never been known for his skill in weaving lies. He tends to communicate through non-verbal cues, often responding with nods, which occasionally irks Rimuru. Myrd also harbors a somewhat lascivious nature, sharing his brothers' interest in designing attire for young women. However, his dedication to his work is unwavering, and the rare moments he does speak typically occur when engaging in conversations with beautiful women.
Background: Just like his siblings, Garm and Dord, he possessed a remarkable talent. Myrd was known throughout the kingdom for his intricate craftsmanship, demonstrating remarkable skill in creating intricate and finely detailed works. His handiwork extended to various forms of art, earning him a reputation as a true artisan. However, despite their individual talents, the trio had a significant weakness—they lacked the aptitude for practical matters, such as managing a business or establishing a successful career. They were easily taken advantage of, which led to unfortunate circumstances, including losing their shop to a conniving individual and facing bullying from the government due to a failed ministerial request.

In their time of need, they turned to their old friend Kaijin, who had been like a fourth brother to them in their youth. Kaijin regretted that they hadn't sought his assistance earlier, but he was determined to help them. He offered them a place to stay and a chance to contribute to his business, even though he primarily dealt in battle gear and had little immediate use for their unique talents. To keep them occupied while he continued his business as usual, Kaijin assigned Myrd and his brothers to oversee a team of laborers involved in mining for essential materials. This temporary role allowed them to lie low and support themselves while their future prospects remained uncertain.

One fateful day, while Myrd and his brothers were deep in the mine, they faced a formidable threat: anArmorsaurus. This creature attacked viciously, leaving them severely injured. Fortunately, a rescue team arrived in the nick of time. Administering a life-saving potion, generously provided by aslimenamedRimuru Tempest, saved Myrd and his brothers from death's grasp. This marked the start of their connection with Rimuru and the extraordinary events to come.

As unexpected events unfolded, Myrd and his brothers were exiled from their homeland. However, Rimuru, along with their friend Kaijin, joined forces with them. Together, they embarked on a remarkable journey, aiding and contributing to the development of the once humble goblin village, which would become the thriving Jura-Tempest Federation.
Trivia: InThe Slime Diaries, Myrd says "Mom, we're home" along with his 2 brothers.
The Sky Queen Frey miraculously enabled Myrd to speak, though the method she used remained uncertain.

Background: Strictly speaking, the members of the Dragon Faithful willingly choose to worship and obey her commands before they become her official subordinates. Milim's domain, which is known as theCity of the Forgotten Dragon, is inhabited by a population of under a hundred thousand people who live in harmony with nature, relying on the land for sustenance.

The Dragon Faithful, residing within the City of the Forgotten Dragon, number less than a hundred thousand in total. They lead their daily lives as a cooperative community without a centralized government. Although they may not be known for their combat prowess, it should be noted that all of them areDragonewts, humanoid beings withDragonlineage. Unlike theirLizardmencounterparts, they are descended from dragons who chose to adopt a moreHumanform and interbred with humans. They appear almost indistinguishable from ordinary humans, except for their inherently stronger physiques. Almost none of them can revert to their original draconic form.

Alongside their remarkable organizational skills, each adult has the strength and prowess to nearly reachC-rankstatus. Their pacifist nature might have obscured their true potential, but in reality, they form an incredibly formidable group of warriors.

Among them, theWarrior Monk Priestsstand in a league of their own. Carefully selected from the region's finest individuals, only a hundred or so were chosen. Even among the priests, individuals likeStella, who possess an ability to transform such asDragon ChangeorDragon Bodyare extremely rare.

As some advanced to the level ofMiddrayorHermes, they even became formidable enough to be able to spar with Milim.

Appearance: She has the appearance of a youthful elf with green eyes and long green hair usually tied in a braid. Her appearance is considered identical to Elmesia to the point where even family members cannot tell them apart.

Her typical outfit consists of a sleeveless red dress and jean shorts in addition to brown gloves and boots. She accessorizes with two white bracelets embedded with green jewels around her wrists and a large black ribbon in her hair.
Personality: Sylvia is a whimsical and unceremonious person who tends to do whatever she wants when she wants, preferring to seclude herself from the public eye and lead a carefree lifestyle of research and recreation instead of bearing any responsibilities. She rarely reveals herself to other people, to the point that some of her family members have never knowingly seen her face-to-face. Her personality and inability to read the room make her unsuited for political matters, unlike her much more competent daughter.
Background: Sylvia, as anElemental, was originally a disembodied spirit. She was eventually summoned by Twilight Valentine who proceeded to incarnate her into a physical body using Twilight's own flesh as a base. Sylvia, along with others such asJahil,Luminous, andGuran Dwargo, was taken in as one of Twilight's disciples. Her existence served as the basis of the rest of the elven race, which along with many other races created by Twilight, began to populate the world in accordance toVeldanava's wishes.

At some point in time, she fell in love with and married an elven hero namedSarion Grimwaldand eventually became with child. Mere months afterwards, the Great Sorcerous Nation Of Soma that the elves called home was destroyed byMilim Navadue to the foolish actions of Jahil, who had possessed the high-elven king in secret. This resulted in Milim awakening as a True demon lord, causing her petElemental Dragon, who was killed by Jahil, to transform into the ruinous Chaos Dragon. Sarion went to the battlefield to fulfill his duty as aChosen heroand subdue the rampaging Chaos Dragon but never returned, and was eventually declared missing.

In the aftermath of the Somas destruction, various noble elven houses spread out across the world to form their own kingdoms, while the elves that stayed loyal to theRoyaltystayed behind and becamedark elves, later forming thePuppet Nation of Jistav. The kingdoms founded by the remnants of the elven nobility were eventually united and reformed into the thirteen kingdoms of theSorcerous Dynasty of Sarionby Sylvia's newly born but genius daughterElmesia.
Trivia: The name Sylvia is of Latin origin and means "Spirit of the Woods".

Spiritual life-form.title: Spiritual life-form

Properties: Spiritual life-forms are an almost godlike existence that need only their mind to remain alive. They're a step abovedemi-spiritual life-formsand have transcended thebodyentirely, making them effectively immortal. They are capable of thinking and existing with just theirsoulandastral bodyalone, making them immune to mind control outside the astral body and allowing them to retain their memories for as long as their soul remains intact.[2]This allows them to resurrect even from the destruction of theirspiritual bodyover a long enough period of time. There are only two reliable methods of killing spiritual life-forms, those being the destruction of their soul —corebreak｢心核破壊,koa bureiku｣— and total deprivation of energy —energy loss｢魔素消失,enerugī rosuto, lit. "magicule loss"｣. Any other form of defeat is only temporary and they'll be reborn again somewhere else in the world eventually, though with potential loss of memory or personality.

Due to being existences of pure will, they innately possess an extremely powerful will above that of any lesser being. It is this willpower that makes them extremely resistant to mind control abilities such asSpiritual Domination, though it isn't impossible for them to be affected under the right conditions.[3]A notable example of this would be the poison used byDamradaandYuuki Kagurazaka, which not only damages the spiritual body but is capable of driving spiritual life-forms with weaker wills insane. This immense willpower they possess is also what allows them to potentially obtainultimate skillsand use them properly.

As psychic beings, the beliefs that spiritual life-forms hold about themselves are extremely important. Not only is their appearance dictated by their own self image, the abilities they develop and manifest can also be said to be the reflections of their desires and minds. As beings heavily influenced by their minds, just the act of perceiving an opponent as superior is enough to lower their performance in combat. Insecurities or emotional instability, either from within oneself or from outside sources such as taunts, can also change the tide of battle. The moment they truly acknowledge they can't win against an opponent and stop trying means they have lost.[4]For spiritual life-forms, merely acknowledging the actual possibility of defeat, is the same as being defeated.[5]
Divine natures: If a powerful spiritual life-form possesses amaterial bodyand undergoes the process ofawakening, it is possible for them to achieve divinity.
Digital natures: Digital natures are spiritual life-forms that are capable of temporarily existing purely in information form, allowing them to transfer between and exercise exceptional control overinfons.
Metal life-forms: Spiritual life-forms with liquid metal bodies are referred to as metal life-forms.
Trivia: Spiritual life-forms whose very existences are ultimate-level are calledultimate spiritual life-forms｢究極の精神生命体,kyūkyoku no seishin seimei-tai｣such as True Dragons[4]orultimate life-forms｢究極生命体,kyūkyoku seimei-tai｣. The only ones to have been called ultimate life-forms areZelanus[6],Dagruel[7]andJahil.[8]

Since they have a yellowauraabout them,Rimurudecided tonamethem all, except theOrc Disaster'sson, based on the color along with a number. Thus, the famous Yellow Numbers were born. Summary: SPIN-OFF CONTENTThis article covers spin-off creations that are not found in the light novel series.
Appearance: Stella is a young girl characterized by her striking blue hair, which she ties into thin twintails, and her matching blue eyes. She typically adorns herself in blue attire, akin to the clothing worn by other members of the Dragon Faithful, a group devoted to the worship of the Demon Lord Milim. Additionally, she often wears a hairband as a part of her ensemble.

While Stella possesses a humanoid form, she has the ability to partlytransforminto a draconic form, revealing her draconic features such as wings and horns. This transformation showcases her connection to thedragonlineage and emphasizes her affinity with the draconic nature.
Personality: As a follower of Milim, Stella is deeply devoted to the Demon Lord. Her personality reflects her loyalty, as she can be brash and direct in her interactions with others. She frequently expresses her admiration for Milim and holds her in high regard.

Despite her initial brashness, Stella exhibits a more diligent and humble side of her personality when it comes to learning culinary skills. She demonstrates a willingness to work hard and improve in this area.

In battle, Stella shares similarities withMiddray, another member of the Dragon Faithful. She disapproves of dishonorable tactics and prefers a fair and honorable approach to combat. Stella remains composed and level-headed, even when faced with challenging situations. This is evident when she helped Phos regain her composure by offering guidance and reason in the face of anger.

Stella holds a strong aversion to the prejudiced attitudes of the soldiers fromFalmuth, who harbor biases againstmonsters. This reveals her disdain for discrimination and highlights her compassionate nature.
Background: Stella hails from the Dragon Faithful, a devout group that reveres the Demon Lord Milim Nava. When news of Milim's planned visit to the city of Tempest reached the ears of the Dragon Faithful'sHead Priest, he entrusted Stella with the important task of personally experiencing the city. Aware of Stella's unwavering dedication and desire to be in the presence of Milim, the head priest deemed her the ideal representative for their faith during Milim's visit.

This significant assignment presented Stella with a unique opportunity to deepen her connection with Milim and further strengthen her unwavering faith. As she embarked on her journey to Tempest, Stella carried with her the hopes and aspirations of the Dragon Faithful, eager to witness firsthand the presence of their revered Demon Lord and to partake in the festivities and revelations that awaited her.
Trivia: Stella has made several cameo appearances inThe Slime Diaries: Ch. 23, Ch. 24, Ch. 25, Ch. 29, Ch. 35, Ch. 41, Ch. 43, Ch. 47, Ch. 50, and Ch. 52, Ch. 58, Ch. 59 and the original manga:Ch. 59
Stella is the only one out of the three protagonist, Phos and Nemu, to not been sent as a spy from her homeland.

Archdaemon: Black hair with streaks of red and gold, as well as golden eyes with red pupils and black sclera, Noir was finely dressed in garments like that of a prince. Other than that, he looked like a normal human, though he was able to unfold wings as well.
As aDaemon, he has the characteristic horns and claws of his race, but since he usually keeps them hidden it is unknown how they look like.
Daemon lord: Diablo's change in appearance is possibly the least drastic after any evolution, with only his princely garments being replaced by a Butler outfit, with a red chain tucked in, reflecting his wish to serve Rimuru. Despite that, however, his dignity did not decrease, but rather increased instead.
His appearance doesn't change after his evolution into adevil lord.
Personality: Diablo is whimsical but also very calculative when he wants to be. He also holds to a high level of etiquette and respect and is very curious with a desire to learn and experience new things. He rarely displays much distress, or indeed emotion in general, instead carrying a relaxed air. This, however, masks a ruthless and cold nature he exposes to enemies in battle and a fervent loyalty to his master and those he has respect for. His loyalty to his master Rimuru is truly extreme, to the point that the only thing that truly terrifies him is to be dismissed by Rimuru. Whenever anyone insults Rimuru, Diablo's polite exterior instantly turns into one of cold malice as he proceeds to punish the "sinner" in the most excruciating way imaginable, unless it goes against Rimuru's orders. However, when one has a good relationship with Rimuru, Diablo usually treats them in an amiable way, though that does not mean he won't manipulate them for his own ends, "his own ends" usually referring to being close to Rimuru more often.

Diablo follows Rimuru's orders down to the letter. When tasked with increasing the difficulty ofFramea's test as a guard for guests to Tempest, Diablo had summoned a moderately strong monster. Upon seeing Framea's will to fight despite being paralyzed by the creature's goo, Diablo sent the creature away and returned to report back on her actions. Should there be any "grey areas" in his instructions, Diablo has the freedom to carry out his orders how he sees fit.

The greatest show of Diablo's loyalty to Rimuru was recruiting hundreds of other daemons, including the last three Primordials, to serve his master; the creation of the Black Numbers, who became the de facto strongest fighting force inTempest.

Diablo also despises owing a debt, even to someone who has already passed on. Shizu's replacement,Tissattempted a desperate summon to save Shizu's Students from aPhantom, only for the unnamed Diablo to offer his aid for what was practically a pittance of a price by forbidding her from mentioning his involvement, and proceeded to slaughter theaggressorin a truly horrific fashion, thus fulfilling his debt.[1]
Background: Thought of as strange by the other Primordials, Noir only acted on his whims and very rarely showed any regular behavior, to the irritation of some of the other Primordials. Due to that, he one day stopped pursuing power as his power efficiency became so high that any fights were too easy for him, causing him to remain as anArchdaemondespite having enough power to evolve into aDaemon lordalready.

One day when he personally answered a Demon Summon of theSilver Wingson a whim, he had a chance encounter withShizue Izawa. During a confrontation where Noir was about to finish her off, he was repelled by Shizue'sAnti-magic Maskinstead, making Noir realize that the mask had an incomprehensible nature. After those events, he returned to the Spiritual World and continued observing Shizue and the mask in secret. When he saw that the mask broke and lost its power when the mask came into Rimuru's hands, Noir came to the conclusion that Rimuru is connected to that power of the mask that surpasses time itself as he witnessed and that Rimuru is, therefore, the key to the "truth of the world."
He tried to get summoned when Rimuru performed aGreater daemonSummoningwithin The Dungeon. He failed becauseBeretta, his own descendant, answered the summon first much to his chagrin.

Finally, when Rimuru did another Greater daemon Summoning to catch the hidingRazen, Noir managed to answer the call alongside two of his Greater daemon followers. After some further events, Noir finally received thename"Diablo" from Rimuru and evolved into a Daemon lord.
Trivia: Rimuru named Diablo after the SupercarLamborghini Diablo. Another reason he chose this name is because Diablo is the Spanish word for "devil."

Due to Diablo's nature as a primordial daemon,Elmesiahas voiced a concern that he may go berserk at some point, which would prove disastrous to the world. However, considering his fervent loyalty to Rimuru, this is extremely unlikely to ever happen.

Within the sphere of the Western Nations, the common sense regarding archdaemons is that it's impossible for anamelessdaemon to be an archdaemon. The only way for archdaemons to come into existence is supposedly the case where a strong greater daemon gets named, evolving into an archdaemon. Hence, a common question when dealing with daemons is "does it have a name?" to ascertain whether the daemon in question could be an archdaemon. However, this common belief is completely wrong. Any daemons with sufficient strength, even for a "modern" species, can become an archdaemon without a name.
It is also possible for a greater daemon to become an archdaemon just from "the public" unintentionally naming them based on a legend or tale.
Properties: Archdaemons possess an immense amount of power, comparable to that of aDemon lord seed. They, unlikelesser daemonsand most greater daemons, possess an almost entirelyhumanappearance. Their only non-human features possessed are the iconic claws, horns, and wings found on all members of the daemon race, though these can easily be hidden at their discretion. Their appearance, like that of allspiritual life-forms, is dictated entirely by their self-image. Archdaemons might be influenced by abodythey previously inhabited or developed their own appearance naturally without the influence of other individuals.

Archdaemons all belong to a specific color lineage, with their color being apparent in their appearance. The color of a daemon's sclera will usually match their lineage and, although not always, other parts of their body match this color as well. Examples include, but are not limited to, hair color, iris color, and skin color. The color of their clothing usually also reflects the color of their lineage.
Divine boars are beings of monstrous power. As divine beings, they possess immortalmaterial bodiesthat will never age.
Divine wolves are beings of monstrous power. As divine natures, they possess immortalmaterial bodiesthat will never age.

Appearance: Kirara had the appearance of a young and petite Japanese girl with light brown hair that went down to her shoulders and brown eyes. She normally wore a special military uniform, but she wore civilian clothes while infiltrating Tempest in the Manga and Anime.
Personality: Kirara was originally a carefree girl with a gal-like personality, caring very little for studying and only about hanging out with her friends. She was selfish, but she had loving parents who didn’t overly stress her out about it.

After being abducted to another world by a sorcerer namedRazen, she became increasingly unstable. Bullied and treated poorly by her captors and those around her, who looked down on her, she eventually suffered a mental breakdown. After her usefulness as a weapon was discovered, Razen lied to her, saying that he would send her home to her family someday if she proved her usefulness. This caused her to completely dissociate from reality, viewing the whole world and everyone around her as unreal. She repressed all of the guilt she felt for killing people and pushed all the blame and responsibility onto others, her immature and childish mind being unable to handle the burden.
Background: Kirara was originally just an ordinary fifteen-year-old high school student back in Japan, with loving parents and she even had a boyfriend. However, she was eventually whisked away to theCentral Worldagainst her will by a sorcerer named Razen, who placed aLocking Curseon hersoul. Afterwards she was forced to explain herUnique skill, but struggled to understand it and explained it poorly due to the language barrier. This resulted in her being deemed a failure and she was treated poorly by her captors afterward.

The bullying she endured from those around her, combined with the frustrations of being forced to study a brand new language, eventually resulted in her having a mental breakdown after a few months, which ended with everyone around her committing suicide due toBewilder's ability. Afterwards, she was trained as a weapon and became unable to use her Unique skill unless ordered to.

Background: Twilight Valentinecreated this race by hybridizingHumanswithMagic beasts, enabling them to transform into their respective beasts. The lifespan of lycanthropes is not significantly different from that of humans with some exceptions, except for their extended youth, which lasts from 30 to 50 years. However, as they start to age, their bodies quickly weaken, and they typically succumb within two weeks with some exceptions. The Beastmen, as a race, thrive in battle and eagerly embrace strong adversaries.

Additionally, several other Demi-human races, includingOrcs,Rabbitfolk, andKobolds, originated from Lycanthrope tribes that gradually lost the ability to shift completely from a human form to a beast form. This resulted in a permanent fusion of their human and beast traits.
Types: Lycanthropes can be broadly classified into seven different groups based on their animal characteristics:Canine｢犬,inu｣Types (e.g., Wolves and Foxes),Feline｢猫,neko｣Types (e.g., Lions, Tigers, and Panthers),Primate｢猿,saru｣Types,Bear｢熊,kuma｣Types,Serpent｢蛇,hebi｣Types,Avian｢鳥,tori｣Types, and "Large" Types (e.g.,Elephants｢象,zō｣). Among these types, Avian and Large types are considered the rarest, with a significantly smaller population compared to other groups. On the other hand, the 'Lion' within the feline tribe is renowned for its exceptional strength, making it widely regarded as the most powerful lycanthrope overall.

Kurobe.title: Kurobe

Ogre: He looks like an grey looking muscular Ogre.
Kijin: He looks like a pretty-average middle-aged man after being named, whichRimurucomments on and manages to feel some level of kinship to given his past life.
His appearance mostly remains the same for his subsequent evolution.
Personality: Despite his fierceOgreappearance and muscular build, he tends to be soft spoken, kind and polite. He was a former smith in the Ogre village with an obvious love for the Forge. Among the six ogres that joined Rimuru, Kurobe felt lost and unneeded until a chance meeting with the dwarfKaijinworking a forge nearby, and was immediately entranced and befriended him. Upon becoming aKijinthe next day, his whole personality shifted again from stoic to downtrodden to happy and hopeful, and swore to Rimuru to forge him the best weapons he could make.
Background: Kurobe stated he comes from a family of blacksmiths.[1]

Before theOrc War, Kurobe was the master blacksmith in the Ogre village. After the Orcs devastated the village, he was among the six survivors who journeyed through theGreat Jura Forestuntil they encountered Rimuru. Seeing him with a magic mask, recalling anindividualwith a similar presentation, the Ogres attacked seeking to avenge their slain brethren. Despite aiding his friends, Rimuru halted his advance withParalyzing Breathand he was out of commission until the fighting ended. Thankfully, Shuna's diplomacy convinced everyone to stop fighting and Rimuru proved his innocent of any correlation to their village's destruction.

With the Ogres invited to stay in Rimuru's village, Kurobe wandered the location for a time in a depression until he met Kaijin, and the two developed a fast friendship with both being blacksmiths. The following day, Rimuru granted him the nameKurobeand he evolved into a Kijin, with his evolution altering his physical form. As Rimuru recovered for a few days after naming the six newly evolved Kijin, Kurobe spent time with Kaijin in the forge developing materials and equipment for thehobgoblins, greeting his master upon his awakening. Kurobe later participated in the war room discussion about the advancing Orc Army, and was present when theDryad,Treyni, petitioned Rimuru to intercede on her behalf, and Kurobe equipped theGoblin Riderswithgear and weaponsfor their battle.
Trivia: There is a franchise-wide running gag involving Kurobe where he is never featured on the cover of the light novels or manga, including spin-offs. Even in the anime, he is never shown in the openings aside from one shot that shows him in the background while walking, though even in that case his face happens to be hidden by a tree branch that prevents the audience from seeing his face. In various manga short stories he even complains about not being on the covers with one occasion where he shows up on back cover of one manga volume.

Many of his works have reached Legendary status in such a short time, that many people call him the "Legend Forge-Talker." But upon hearing of this moniker, Kurobe mistakes it for someone else and makes a personal pledge to 'beat him' in forging things, not realizing that he is hearing of his own renown.

A constant gag in the series and spin offs is that he and Kaijin often spend hours talking about Blacksmithing, with gusto and passion, much to the bored onlooker; usually Rimuru, but occasionally others who are just trying to find a way to leave politely.

Despite being the weakest Kijin; his physical strength and stamina are ludicrous, often surprising other characters when he single handily brought thirty tons of metal a kilometer away to his forge with his hands alone. He has no fighting spirit, or is particular good at much else, but he is a master of the forge.

Another recurring gag is of him forging ridiculously well-graded common items or overworking and making an eldritch sword of excellent caliber. Things that he made a little too good include: a Garden Hoe, a Kitchen Knife, a Butter Knife, as well as a Fork and Spoon set forVeldora-- who was scooping up some ice cream and took half the table with it.

The ends of his limbs are now covered in green socks, which are divided into sections roughly the same size as one another, leaving his paws exposed. He also gained the ability to control his size which enables him to shrink  similar size to that of a normal direwolf, even to a size of a regular dog.

Towards outsiders, he comes across as a scary, ferocious beast. He is very blunt with outsiders and does not show any form of politeness. He tends to appear annoyed and suspicious of outsiders. He has a friendly rivalry with Shion for his master's affection.

Reproduction: Because humans are naturally weak and rarely possess much magicules, it doesn't cost them magicules toreproduce. That means they can have as many children as their bodies can handle. As a result, they often have a lot of kids. These traits are all common among other short-lived species, as well.
Characteristics: Humans, compared to most other races, are extraordinarily fragile and ungifted. Theirinnate poweris extremely small, and they don't gain strength fromnaming. The lack of racial proclivity leads each of them to seek their own path to become stronger. The pathway ofmagicis often abandoned by humans, since their low tolerance for magicules makes the path of becoming amagea long and difficult one. Most of them instead choose to focus on training theirbodiesand learning how to manipulate theiraurato performartsin theBattlewill family. The small amount of magicules that humans do have tends to be expended in the acquisition ofskillsto supplement them in physical combat.

Human's lifespans are relatively short compared to most species, barely reaching 100 years at best. Thus, they become aged long before they reach that point, which also sets them apart from other, more gifted races. Barring the process ofmajinization, magic can only extend their lifespan to around three hundred years. Because humans are a weak and short-lived species, and because life is short and youth is fleeting, they usually find a partner early. They generally don’t have problems giving birth to numerous offspring, but compared to species specialized in mass reproduction likegoblinsandorcs, their reproductive capabilities are fairly modest.
Evolution: There are two mainstream evolutionary paths available to humans,enlightenmentandmajinization. There is a third in the form of awakening the power dormant in ones bloodline and returning to a purer form of their subspecies or even becoming afairy, but this is only normally available to certaindemi-humansubspecies and only during special circumstances.

Enlightenment only occurs as the result oflong and arduous training that ends with the person in question breaking through a mental barrierand becoming ademi-spiritual life-form, allowing them to think with theirspiritual bodyand partially sublimating their flesh to a higher existence.Enlightened, even Human ones, enjoy a high tolerance and capacity towards magicules as well as physical and mental capabilities along with lifespan inconceivable for normal humans.

Majinization occurs due to a mutation brought on by high magicule exposure, magic rituals, or other unique circumstances. Humans who undergo this process have becomemajinand are labeled asdemonoidsfor the sake of convenience. Humans who undergo this process possess a large store of magicules and a long lifespan. Like allmonsters, have a constitution reliant on magicules. Becoming a majin comes with an innate affinity for casting magic as well as an extremely high tolerance towards magicules and magic, incomparable to that of their previous self. However, by becoming magical beings, they become susceptible to thepurifyingeffects ofholy magic.
Demi-humans: Demi-humans｢亜人族,demi hyūman｣are the result of cross-breeding and genetic experimentation performed on the human genome by Twilight Valentine. There are a variety of subspecies of humans, with most of them possessing much greater powers and lifespan than their ordinary human cousins. Due to them genetically being human, it is possible for demi-humans to cross-breed with "regular" humans and any other race of demi-human, although the animosity between them makes this a rarity. In particular, the high tolerance to magicules and high aptitude for magic that most demi-human races possess resulted in them being wrongfully called monsters for most of human history, causing them to not be considered part of the human race until the events ofConflict Between Saints and Monsters.
Otherworlders: Otherworlders｢異世界人,isekaijin｣are the result of a human successfully crossing over to theCentral Worldfrom another universe. The process involves crossing the gap between dimensions and, if they originate from a purely Material World, having their bodies reconstructed intoDemi-Materialform. Those who survive the conversion from Material to Demi-Material have theirsoulsinfused with a large amount of magicules as a result. The magicules within their souls almost always manifests itself in one or more skills, with around 75% of such otherworlders going on to developunique skills. Due to this, many nations performed illegal summoning rituals in secret, with the dual purpose of obtaining powerful body guards for royalty and upper nobility, as well as hoping for one of the summoned to become achosen hero.

Appearance: Clayman had the appearance of a wealthy noble. He had a slim, oblong head topped with pale lavender hair; a face with a sharp chin and defined jawlines, and a pair of pointed ears on either side and thin eyebrows. He sported a slender figure, and his eyes with red irises exuded intelligence even as they suggested he was rather high-strung.

Clayman wore expensive and elegant clothes sharing an overall white motif – a long white tailcoat, grey vest, white shirt, slim white trousers and white shoes, alongside black bow-tie. In his inner pocket of his tailcoat, he kept a gold-plated pocket watch with an engraving on its lid, the chain of which could be seen.

In his combat form, his skin was darker, his entire figure changed - four more prosthetic arms and a tail emerged. In place of his elegant tuxedo was a wrought-iron breastplate, codpiece, and spiked pauldrons and armor for his legs. When he donned his mask and acted as the "Crazed Clown," he seemed more like a mad beast instead.

After his Pseudo-Awakening following him being severely wounded byShion, his appearance drastically changes. In this form, his dismembered arms are replaced by arms made of energy in purple color, with the upper additional pair of arms being large and long while the lower pair of arms being longer in length. His eyes also glow with a flamingaura.
Personality: Clayman was a cunning and manipulative Demon Lord, who preferred to operate from the shadows rather than engage in direct conflict himself. His expertise lay in intelligence gathering, utilizing his abilities to perfect his schemes and gain more power.[3]

In his interactions with subordinates and those he considered beneath him, Clayman displayed a disdainful and abusive attitude. He discarded individuals who were no longer useful to him and coerced others into submission using hisunique skill.[4]His force of will was so strong that he could make almost anyone follow his orders.

Furthermore, Clayman was known for his stubbornness and pride. He refused to acknowledge his mistakes, even when confronted with evidence of his involvement in various plots. Most Demon Lords were already aware of his conspiracy to become atrue demon lord, yet he remained tight-lipped about his opinions of his fellow Demon Lords. This cowardly side of Clayman was evident when he believed he had full control overMilim, and only then did he start insulting her and expressing his personal disdain, showing his cowardice.

When things appeared to go according to his plan, Clayman's arrogance and overconfidence became evident. He made tactical errors in his attempts to manipulateRimuruandTempest, such as assuming he had successfully mind-controlled Milim, despite her reputation for being uncontrollable. He also believed thatFreywas solely loyal to him and underestimated Rimuru and Shion, thinking he could overpower them due to his supposed control over Milim. This arrogance was a prevailing trait noted by bothKagaliandLaplace, despite their warnings for him to adjust it.

However, it's worth considering that Clayman's brainwashing byTatsuya Kondoumay have contributed to his overconfidence and poor decision-making. This behavior was unlike his cautious and cunning nature.

Despite his manipulative and power-hungry tendencies, Clayman, like his creator, displayed gentleness and consideration towards those he considered his friends and comrades, such as theModerate Harlequin Alliance.[4]He also demonstrated absolute loyalty to his superiors and followed their orders.[5]This loyalty was evident in his final moments, where he refused to reveal any information about his superiors or comrades during his confrontation with Rimuru, even when faced with the threat of complete eradication of his soul.Raphaelcalculated that it would be extremely challenging to make Clayman talk.

Clayman was known to be a highly cautious Demon Lord, always having backup plans for various situations and reinforcing those plans with additional backups. This preparedness was apparent on multiple occasions, particularly during Walpurgis, where he initially fought Shion using a sword and swiftly transitioned to usingMarionette Dancewhen the sword was destroyed. He resorted to his trump card, theDemon Marionettecurse, only after his initial tactics failed and ultimately transformed into the Crazy Pierrot form to take matters into his own hands.

However, upon transforming into Crazy Pierrot, Clayman's calm demeanor was reversed, seemingly becoming more aggressive. It's important to note that this transformation allowed him to restrain his enemies, granting him the freedom to attack and neutralize them more effectively.

Clayman took great pride in his position as one of the Ten Great Demon Lords and cherished his title. This pride was evident when he transformed into his Crazy Pierrot form in response to Shion calling him an unworthy Demon Lord. He believed that, as a Demon Lord, he should dispose of his enemies with elegance and style.

InClayman Revenge, after experiencing a second time loop, his personality changed. He became more cautious and alert, treating his underlings better, such as returningMjurran's heart. He also dedicated himself to training and becoming stronger in order to avoid his demise at the hands of Rimuru Tempest in the future and prevent the events leading to Rimuru becoming a Demon Lord or, at the very least, avoid making Rimuru his enemy. This implies that he fears Rimuru after having been defeated by him twice before.

During his loop, Clayman also slowly begins to earnestly appreciate his underlings and begins to trust his allies, willing to hear out their opinions, even if he attempts to uphold his pride before them. Ultimately this causes Clayman to become much kinder and appreciative of his new bonds to where in spite of the problems they may cause, he becomes enraged when believingChronoahad killed his companions. Clayman is also cautious of dying another time due to being uncertain if he can repeat another loop or faces a true demise and losing all he acquired.
Background: Clayman was created by Kazalim as aDeathmanmany years ago to be part of the Moderate Harlequin Alliance, known as The Crazy Pierrot.[5]Kazalim himself personally designed Clayman to be a tactical commander and a schemer, similar to himself and created him for the expressed purpose of turning him into a Demon Lord.

300 years ago, he became one of the Ten Great Demon Lords[6]with Kazalim's help, in order to increase his own influence in theDemon Lord council.[5]The moment he became a Demon Lord, he began hunting downmajinand monsters to steal their hearts (literally). Making them swear loyalty to him, he inscribed a curse onto their hearts, making them his eternal servants.[4]That's howFive Fingerswas born, containing cursed petNinehead, Immortal KingAdalmann, top lieutenantYamza, witch Mjurran, spy and intelligence collector harpyPirone.

Eventually his master was killed and replaced byLeon Cromwellon the Demon Lord council. With Kazalim gone, Clayman had to take over his domain, thePuppet Nation of Jistavand all of his remaining forces. Clayman hadn't received any words from him for a long time, but still considered himself to be the subordinate of Kazalim. He still continued working on his goals, while still waiting for his master's return.

Clayman wished to get rid of Leon in retaliation for Kazalim's demise. In order to achieve this, he hired many mercenaries, however, they all failed to carry out the task, instead getting slain by Leon's entourage each time.

Clayman, alongsideCarrionand Frey, were considered the new generation of Demon Lords, so they would work together in order to expand and increase their influence and power base. Their goal was to bring the gap of power between them and the older generation Demon Lords. Being one of the active Demon Lords, his name was greatly known among humanity and other nations, though much more infamously due to his manipulative tendencies. Clayman was close enough to taking over the entire world, and it was all through his trading relationships, which, generally most Demon Lords won't do. He was the wealthiest among all the Demon Lords, owning several extremely valuable art pieces, most notably a large mural created byBismarck. His wealth did not only come from trading but from the artifacts that were buried beneath the ruins of Amrita which ultimately made him a powerful foe politically and economically.Damradastates that Demon Lord Clayman was a valuable trading asset for theEastern Empire.

At some point, he met amysterious patronwho offered Kazalim's resurrection in exchange for the Moderate Harlequin Alliance's help in taking over the world so he can make it into a peaceful place. Clayman agreed to this request.[5]
Trivia: The "Clay" from Clayman comes from the word "Klei", which means string or wire. Thus his name can be inferred to mean "Stringman".
To keep his mind sharp on a daily basis, Clayman regularly played chess.

In the special catalog created to celebrate the tenth anniversary of the franchise,TenSura X, Clayman takes second place in the In-Universe Rankings in the category of the best at painting, betweenRainandHakurou, who are placed in the first and third places respectively.
Clayman was the only one among his fellow Jesters who was unable to meet his master, Demon Lord Kazalim, in person after she assumed the form of Kagali, Yuuki's secretary.

Due to being brought up in later volumes as a benchmark to describe the strength/energy amount of new characters, the author jokingly mentioned that Clayman effectively became a "combat strength measurement unit".

Appearance: Twilight has an appearance almost identical to that of their other-selfLuminous Valentine. Their short silver hair shines a lustrous silver and their eyes are a glowing red-blue heterochromia albeit opposite of Luminous' eyes. While Luminous is notable for being female, Twilight is genderless and lacks sexual characteristics. They are however noted as looking more masculine than feminine at a glance.[1]
Twilight wears an unbuttoned bright red business suit, with a blue turtleneck in place of a shirt and stylish white shoes with golden trim.
Personality: Though originally a person with a pure and curious personality, after a certain incident transpired Twilight became warped. The current Twilight could best be described as a mad scientist who is the epitome of selfishness, conducting numerous experiments regardless of the ethics or consequences purely out of idle curiosity.

As part of their experiments, they had theirheart corefrozen by Velzard. As a result of this, Twilight is no longer capable of growing as an individual and has locked their warped personality in place.

However, notably, Twilight isn't truly evil; they are simply theultimate egoist｢究極の利己主義者,kyūkyoku no egoisuto｣, who would do anything for themself, regardless of whether it is a good or bad deed. They do not have any desire to either rule or destroy the world, only caring about their experiments and satiating their greed for knowledge.
Background: In the early days of the world, during the age of myth, Veldanava created Twilight as one of the earliest beings. Twilight was supposed to populate the world with immortals, but lacking the ability to reproduce they took to experimenting on their ownbody. As the fruit of this research, thehigh humansand Vampires were born, strong but imperfect lifeforms that were incapable of fulfilling Veldanava's wishes.[2]

Continuing with their research, diversity began to increase. Humans, Demi-humans, and all other matter of life began to populate the earth. With Veldanava finally satiated, humanity was spread across various dimensions[3]and various kingdoms soon arose led by Twilight's "children", thePupils of the Ancestor.[4]

At some point after this, a certain incident occurred and Twilight's personality became corrupted and twisted. Their curiosity was replaced with an insatiableGreedfor knowledge and they began conducting various in-humane experiments in pursuit of perfection. Twilight became infatuated with the karmic fates of surpassing their parent and killing god. To this end, they teamed up with Velzard and faked their death, aiming to surpass the True Dragons and dwelling inside Velzard. Eventually Twilight evolved and became a being of pure information, a Manas.[1]

Appearance: Geld is a large orc that usually wears loose pants, a large black cloak, and a necklace that is decorated with what resembles three teeth. His most notable trait, unlike most of his Orc brethren, is a mohawk-like hairstyle.
Personality: Geld is among the most serious and hardworking of Rimuru's subordinates. He felt responsible for theOrc Lord Incident,to the point that he beggedBenimaruto kill him and spare the rest of the orcs so that they could alleviate their hatred and works hard in order to pay for his people's sins.[1]He has endured drought, famine and bitter winters alongside his father, giving him a resilience to the elements and experience with the feeling of hopelessness. He retains a strong will to become a worthy leader but tends to undermine his own leadership skills at times. With Rimuru's support and the support of many of his own tribe, he begins to work on his self-doubt and becomes more relaxed as the series goes on. He is known to have a stubborn streak, and believes in Rimuru who saved his people, but differs in his devotion then most other followers. He sees Rimuru as a kind, carefree and just leader, and as a normal person. He has a habit of burying himself in work, to the point where Tempest's other residents worry he's not taking care of himself.

Geld was shown to be in a rut when dealing with the PoW (prisoners of war) laborers from Clayman's war campaign. Since they were not orcs themselves, he questioned if it was right of him to treat them badly. He disliked the lazy and incompetent and the lack of communication from them, but Rimuru reminded him of his viewpoints and how he should just treat them as his own people, reasoning that he wouldn't accept that behavior from his tribesman. Seeing the hypocrisy and the behavior he realized he was treating them like outsiders, when in fact, since they also had no place to go or no master to serve, they in a sense were in the same place the orcs themselves where in not long ago. Because the orcs once almost went extinct due to starvation, Geld tries to make sure that none of Tempest's residents ever went hungry.[2]

In battle he is relentless in taking down his opponents as shown in his battle withShogo Taguchi. Geld is gentle towards friends and family, but absolutely merciless to enemies. He shares Rimuru's conviction to never betray a friend, considering it to be the biggest sin of all.

Geld is also kind and loving towards children, being quite popular with them. He is often seen playing with them and carrying at least one child with him, showing a very paternal side about himself. He has a vindictive side, shown with his interactions to theModerate Harlequin Alliance, more specificallyFootman. He seems to get to have a brotherly streak towardsPhobio, treating him with the same sense of comradery that he has a hard time showing to new allies or friends.
Background: Geld was the right-hand man and son of thedeceased Orc Lord. During the orc invasion of Jura Forest, he served as an Orc General. As the last surviving Orc General after the invasion ends, he acted as the representative of orcs during the post-war meeting.
Trivia: His name may be a shout-out to theGerudopeople fromThe Legend of Zeldavideo game series. One of them,Ganondorf, often appears in his pig-headed demon formGanon. However, a Japanese transcription of the German first nameGerd, the pet form ofGerhard, may also be possible.
Gelmud(ゲルミュッド) derived the name "Geld" (ゲルド) from his own name, by taking out a single syllable.

In the movieScarlet Bond, Geld seen to waver and even accepting his death in the hand ofHiirobecause of his immense shame and internal conflict with what he and his tribe have done to the Ogre Village, making Benimaru to defending him instead. He's seen close to tears and bows respectfully towards the Kijin.

Story: Originally, Lacua was ordered byVioletto observe the Raja royal family, and inform her when the Tiara’s power has finally created a perfect vessel for her. Over time, however, Lacua grew impatient and took matters into his own hands. AfterRimuru Tempestinterfered with his scheme, he decided to manipulateHiirointo helping him.

Believing that his master would save him when things went south, he was shocked to hear Violet scold him for his latest actions, which had violated her original contract with Raja's royalty, forcing her to terminate the contract and spoiling her fun, before leaving him at the mercy of Rimuru. In a last-ditch effort, Lacua swallowed aCurse Orband attempted to useNuclear Flameto reduce Raja to ash, only for him and his attack to be devoured by Rimuru'sBeelzebuth.

Appearance: Cyrus is a somewhat average looking man with gruff features and short brown hair. His ears are pierced with several golden earrings and he carries a sword on his back.
Cyrus's attire, for most of the story, consists of a mixture of leather and plate armor, befitting an adventurer.
Personality: Cyrus is an earnest individual who always looks beyond his own personal needs in favor of the needs of the people.

It isn't to the point of being a genius, but Cyrus possesses all the right qualities to be an excellent king, so much so that his younger brother, Helios, was scared of Cyrus stealing the throne back due to his capabilities, despite Cyrus' lacking magical ability, and thus support from the nobility.
Cyrus takes excellent care of his subordinates, enough to instill their true loyalty in him for life.
Background: Cyrus was born as the first prince to the kingdom of Malukshure. As the eldest son, he was expected to become the crown prince… but when he displayed zero talent for magic even as he got older, he was forced to give up the position to his younger brother, Helios. Cyrus eventually decided to leave the castle, taking his most loyal subordinates and deciding to help the citizens as much as possible as an "adventurer".
Even though Cyrus's mother and father loved him dearly, there was little they could do for him other than protect him as much as possible from behind the scenes.

Cyrus, accompanied byGlaiveand co, utilized the swordsmanship andBattlewillhe'd been learning from a young age to quickly rise through the ranks, becoming an A-ranked adventurer the people outside the capital could rely on as a symbol of strength.

Background: Sauzer was born as the First Prince of the Coleus Kingdom to his father King Tedron and his first wife. He was raised around his many siblings, with his similarly frail sister Zenobia holding a special place in his heart. Three years before the events ofVisions of Coleus, Sauzer becomes a pawn in the schemes of his father who had used forbidden magic to summon and incarnate theArchdaemonsKarl and Gustav. Gustav used his position as the Court Physician to lend his power to Sauzer, returning him to perfect health and making him strong, while also making his sister Zenobia become so sick that she was left blind and bedridden. Karl and Gustav continued to act behind the scenes, pushing a wedge between Sauzer and his younger brother Aslan in an attempt to make the two brothers kill one another while Zenobia was prepared as a vessel and offering toViolet, all while usingLuminous Valentine'sproxyas a scapegoat. Thanks to the efforts ofRimuruand Luminous, the plot that had riled the kingdom into chaos had been settled. With the mysterious death of his father, Sauzer ascended to the throne and became king.

Background: Elementals, as the name suggests, are beings who embody a specificelement. They come into being from either a large gathering ofnatural energy｢自然エネルギー,shizen enerugī｣or as offshoots born from a higher elemental. Theirspiritual bodiesare capable of taking magical energy and transforming it into natural energy in the form of their respective element which, unlike regular magic, fully obeys the laws of physics.
Evolution Line: The vast majority of the race is made up of low-tierLesser elementalswhich have knowledge and sentience but near nonexistent personalities. They'll lend their power to almost anyone, but in turn the power they offer is minimal.

Beyond lesser elementals areMedium elementals, lesser elementals who have lived long enough and gathered enough natural energy to evolve into a higher species. Medium elementals take on a proper appearance and have much more present personalities (sometimes even able to hold conversations) and can fight properly, making them a much more useful ally in battle when summoned than lesser elementals, who can only lend you their power.

Greater elementalsare the highest stage of elementals that one is likely to ever see in their lifetime. They take on a much more humanoid appearance and have firmly established personalities. The power they wield is immense and usually well within the realm of Special A, making summoning one the most reliable option to fightArchdaemons. The caveat to this power is that they're highly fickle beings who only lend their power to people who they find both exceptional and that they like on a more personal level. Gaining the support of a greater elemental, much less being able to summon one, is something that only happens on rare occasions and such people tend to go down in history as legendary heroes.

At the farthest end of the elementals' normal evolutionary path areElemental lords, legendary beings that are more common in fairy tales than actual historical events. Elemental lords are immensely strong beings comparable to Disaster-Class threats such asDemon Lordsand lend their power on extraordinarily rare occasions, usually only in the form of contracts made withElemental magicrather than in summoned form.
Beside their normal evolution path, they can incarnate into vessels and becomefairies. Every species of fairy has its own path of evolution.

At the very top of the elemental hierarchy lie theGreat Holy Spirits— powerful, but egoless, elemental forces that have been around since the dawn of creation. TheElemental Queenis a unique individual who wields all eight elements and rules over all elementals.
Fairies: Fairies are elementals who have incarnated into physical form, usually by pure chance. Examples includepixies, such asRamirisin her "child" form, anddryadssuch asTreyniand her sisters.
Daemons & Angels: Although rarely talked about, bothdaemonsandangelsare species derived from elementals,darknessandlightelementals respectively. They have a three-way dynamic in which elementals are strong against daemons, daemons are strong against angels, and angels are strong against elementals.
Chosen hero: Chosen heroes are individuals who have been chosen by either an elemental of light or an elemental of darkness and are blessed by the Elemental Queen. They form a symbiotic relationship with their respective elemental and dedicate themselves to the betterment and protection of mankind.
Known Types: Elementals come in eight different elements, put into two different categories. The "lesser" elements ofspace,earth,water,wind, andfire, as well as the "greater" elements of light, darkness, andtime. Although it is rare, it's possible for elementals to gain more than one element, such as the wind-water elementalRimurugave toRyota Sekiguchi, or Charys who gained the wind element due toVeldora's influence.
Trivia: Despite having a racial advantage against daemons, elementals have yet to win a single fight against daemons in the series. In fact, all elemental vs. daemon battles ended in the elemental's instant defeat due to being matched against the ridiculously strongprimordials.

Story: Count Guratolsits next to his bedridden wife, Ulamuth. He had arranged to get a medicine for her illness, but thieves had stolen the caravan carrying the medicine. He solemnly apologizes that he is powerless to relieve her wife's burden.

The medicine ended up being used by the thieves. Learning that the medicine is a Full Potion like the onesRimurucreates, Count Guratol andJeffasks Rimuru if he has any and he confirms that he has. Sometime later, she and her husband take part in Tempest's festival.

Dagruel.title: Dagruel

Appearance: Dagruel has the appearance of a middle-aged man with blue eyes and slicked-back blue hair. He has three tattoos on his face resembling long teardrop-like lines: one at the center of his forehead, and two below his eyes running over his cheeks in the direction of his sideburns. He is over 2 meters tall while at rest, and up to ten times larger while in combat.[2]
His prodigious height and well-toned body, plus his tendency to never mask hisauragive him the appearance of someone capable of shattering mountains with his bare hands.
Personality: Dagruel possesses keen observational skills and defies expectations by demonstrating a more composed demeanor than his intimidating appearance would suggest. While he exudes a quiet confidence in his formidable strength, he remains astutely aware of the deceit prevalent among his fellow Demon Lords.

Rather than harboring aggression, Dagruel exhibits a deep respect for the power wielded by others. His numerous encounters withVeldora Tempest, culminating in draws each time, attest to his willingness to engage in fierce battles. However, his territorial boundaries often clash with those ofLuminous Valentine, leading to frequent confrontations.

Despite his epithet as the "Earthquake", there are indications that Dagruel possesses genuine concern for those dear to him. For centuries, he has generously providedDinowith free accommodation in his home, showcasing a sense of compassion. Recognizing the weakness of his three sons, Dagruel astutely sent them to train inTempest, knowing thatRimuru's benevolent nature would likely spare their lives. In a strategic move, he instructed his sons to engage in a non-lethal skirmish in Tempest's capital, enabling them to assess their opponents' combat capabilities. Ultimately, their defeat at the hands ofShion, who prevailed without weapons, inspired them to seek her tutelage.
The revelation ofClayman's betrayal deeply offended Dagruel, highlighting his disdain for the act of Clayman eliminating subordinates.
Background: A long time ago, in the age of myth, anevil giantemerged from the depths of the earth, wreaking havoc wherever it went. Eventually,Veldanavaintervened and managed to defeat the giant, splitting it into three separate entities: Dagruel and his two brothers,FennandGlassord. Over time, Dagruel and Glassord renounced their malevolent ambitions and strived for redemption, while Fenn clung to his wicked ways and was subsequently sealed away. As a reward for his change of heart, Veldanava granted Dagruel a parcel of land and entrusted him with the duty of guarding theHeaven Towerto prevent Fenn's release.

During his time at the Heaven Tower, Dagruel encountered a talented individual namedTwilight Valentine, and the two developed a close friendship. Twilight often boasted about their most treasured creation, Luminous. Intrigued by Twilight's tales of Dagruel,KisaraandBasarawho were alsocreations of Twilight, challenged Dagruel to a battle. Following their defeat, Kisara and Basara became Dagruel's disciples.

However, Dagruel's relationship with Luminous deteriorated significantly after she killed Twilight. A fierce power struggle ensued between the two, which temporarily subsided when Dagruel and Kisara married. Together, they had three sons:Dagura,Liura, andDebura. Unfortunately, Kisara passed away while in childbirth with the three, leaving Dagruel devastated. In his grief, he was forced to seal Basara, who had fallen into a rampage, away for everyone's safety.

Dagruel's territory became embroiled in a fierce conflict betweenMilim NavaandGuy Crimson, pushing it to the brink of destruction. In order to mitigate the damage, Dagruel expelled the generated energy into another dimension, containing the aftermath. However, the residual energy leaking from a dimensional crack transformed the land into a deadly desert, giving rise to a massive sandstorm that devastated everything in its path. To secure food resources, the giants sent their young men and women across the treacherous desert. This incident fueled Dagruel's desire for Luminous' territory, as it offered a solution to the food shortage. Consequently, Dagruel joined the ranks of theDemon Lord council, and he and Luminous commanded the largest factions within the group.

Throughout his long life, Dagruel formed deep friendships with Dino and Veldora. He invited Dino to live in his home, and the two became inseparable companions. Additionally, Dagruel engaged in numerous sparring sessions with Veldora, with neither emerging as a clear victor. Nonetheless, their battles earned them mutual respect and admiration for one another.
Trivia: Dagruel and his two brothers used to bea single beingknown as the Wicked God, who rampaged in ancient times.

Slime Form: In their normal form — referred to asslime form｢スライム形態,suraimu fōmu｣— Rimuru takes the appearance of a spherical — sometimes amorphous — mass of slightly blue and translucent ooze. Rimuru's initial slime form has a diameter of around 40 cm and it increases as they get stronger across the series, becoming around 80 cm after reincarnating into an ultimate slime.

When using theBody Armorskill, Rimuru's slime form takes on ametallic slime｢メタルなスライム,metaruna suraimu｣[3]appearance; while theirdemon slimeform sometimes takes the appearance of agolden slime｢ゴールドスライム,gōrudo suraimu｣[4]though in the anime they remain the same color as usual.
Human Form: Rimuru's facial features inhumanform are nearly identical to those ofShizu, but the long silver-blue hair and deep golden eyes give off an otherworldly divine beauty that sets the two apart. Rimuru can also occasionally be seen wearing Shizu's mask or donning draconic wings.
Initial: Rimuru's initial human form before consuming theOrc Disasterwas that of a child that looked no older than six or seven. It had short hair and was typically dressed in a simple outfit made of pelts before switching to the more iconic shirt, pants, and leather jacket combination.
Demon lord seed: After consuming the Orc Disaster Geld, Rimuru gains another 10 cm in height and significantly longer hair, giving the appearance of a child around the age of nine. The primary outfit in this time period consisted of loose black pants and a white and gold shirt both woven from silk mixed withSteel Thread. Over this, they wore a thick black (blue in theanimeandmanga) jacket and a fur scarf both made from the pelt of theDirewolf Boss.
True demon lord: After theHarvest Festivaland evolution into a demon slime, Rimuru gains another 10 cm in height, giving the appearance of a child around the age of twelve or thirteen. During this period the primary outfit consisted of black pants, a black and gold shoulderless shirt, a fur scarf, and a black haori with white accents down the sleeves.
Ultimate slime: After evolving into aTrue Dragonand subsequently reincarnating into anultimate slime, Rimuru's human form is that of an androgynous albeit girly 15 to 16 year old adolescent. The main outfit from this point consists of black pants and a black sleeveless long shirt accented with white boots and white stripes respectively. The arms have black detached long sleeves with golden ornaments at the top as well as a golden collar piece around the neck. The white rope-like belt has a metal loop at the back for the purpose of tying the scabbard of a sword. They can also occasionally be seen wearing a cloak over top of this outfit.
Additionally, Rimuru has been seen wearing a more casual version of this outfit with a more simple pair of overly baggy black pants and a white shirt.
Personality: Rimuru is an eccentric and childish person by nature but this shouldn't be mistaken for immaturity and naivety. Underneath the surface, Rimuru is constantly analyzing, planning, and weighing the pros and cons of their actions, taking the smart move in the long term over more rash and emotional decisions. In betrayal of this composed and calculative demeanor, Rimuru is ruthless when it comes to handling people who have aroused genuine fury inside of them. They'll go as far as acts of brutal torture and murder without so much as batting an eye if it can be gotten away with, and they use more subtle methods like intimidation and blackmail when those cards are off the table.

Rimuru is also highly intelligent and takes a great deal of care with their personal image by playing manipulative games, such as lying on official accounts,[5][6]erasing memories,[7]tricking their opponents with staged results or false information, and creating forged historical documents to make them appear as a more kind and benevolent person than they are in reality.[8]Despite Rimuru's often selfish and nefarious tendencies, they do deeply care for their subordinates, viewing them as something like a family or collection of children. Due to the memories of Satoru Mikami and Shizu, Rimuru has access to a robust set of human ethics to rely on when their more cruel monster self isn't up to the task.
Rimuru's goal in life is to create a convenient world where they can kick back and lazily enjoy entertainment similar in quality to what is found on Earth.
Trivia: Rimuru's unofficial birthday is February 20th, as it was when the first chapter of the original web novel was released.

A possible origin for Rimuru's name can be found inJapanese wordplay. The three characters making up Rimuru, "リムル," are all represented by the number six in Goroawase. Thus, if you use Goroawase on Rimuru, you get thenumber of the beast, "666."
Like their previous incarnation, Rimuru has a fetish for female elves that are buxom.

In the main Light Novel series, the Masked Hero mentioned a failed timeline whereRimuru Tempestended up fell into despair and go on a destructive rampage, this version could be that one or an adaptation of it.
After beingnamed, Rimuru might have inheriteda part of personality (lost love)｢人格の一部（失われた愛）,jinkaku no ichibu (ushinawareta ai)｣of Veldanava.[9]

The color of a daemon's sclera will usually match their lineage and, although not always, other parts of their body match this color as well. After Shizu left him and the other members of Class S, they drove off any replacement teachers before they were eventually put under the tutelage ofRimuru Tempest. Rimuru challenged all of them to a spar, and come Ryota's turn, he showed off his berserker skill before being quickly taken care of.
