Appearance: Youm has a well-toned physique, bronzed by the sun. He stands at an average height, neither tall nor short. His demeanor suggests that he is always vigilant and alert. Far from being unattractive, he possesses a rather handsome face. Following his ascension as both a Hero and a king, he now carries himself with a dignified and regal air.
Personality: Before meeting Rimuru, Youm exuded the aura of a natural leader among outlaws, yet hidden beneath his exterior was a heart of gold. However, after encountering Rimuru and earning thetitleof Hero, this dynamic undergoes a transformation. He emerges as a heroic figure to the world, while inwardly he still maintains his preference for a more casual approach. Despite his reluctance, Youm embraces his role as a husband with pride, doting on hiswife, and revels in the joy of being a devoted and indulgent father. Although he may not perceive himself as a kingly figure, he instinctively carries out his responsibilities and duties, embodying the essence of a true leader.

Youm's personality shines through his unwavering loyalty and steadfastness, always standing up for what he believes is right. He possesses a strong sense of justice and empathy, willing to go to great lengths to protect those he cares about. While he may possess great strength and prowess, his humility remains intact, never seeking recognition or accolades. Despite his notable achievements, Youm cherishes his connections and friendships, valuing genuine bonds over superficial titles or status.

Additionally, Youm's casual demeanor and down-to-earth nature make him approachable and relatable to others. He has a charming and infectious smile, capable of lifting the spirits of those around him. Despite the weight of his responsibilities, he possesses a lightheartedness and a penchant for finding joy in the simple pleasures of life.
Background: Youm's life took a dramatic turn when he found himself imprisoned within CountNidol Migam's Territory in theKingdom of Falmuth. However, his fortunes changed when the Count assigned him a crucial mission; to lead the newly formedFrontier Expedition Force, a group of 30 skilled individuals, to scout the movements of theOrc Lordwithin theGreat Jura Forest. WhileRommelwas tasked with overseeing Youm's group and reporting their demise back to the Count, Youm cleverly utilized his wit and charisma to intimidate Rommel and convince him to dissolve the contractmagicbinding Youm and most of his comrades. Remarkably, he even managed to win Rommel's unwavering loyalty and commitment to their shared cause.[2]

As Youm and his expedition force ventured deeper into the Jura Forest, they stumbled upon the extraordinarytownofTempest, where they encountered the enigmatic Rimuru Tempest. Rimuru, desiring to elevate the reputation of hismonster-inhabited town, sought someone to take credit for vanquishing the Orc Lord. Recognizing Youm's potential, Rimuru nominated him as a candidate for this pivotal role. Initially hesitant, Youm's doubts dissolved as he interacted with the warm-hearted residents and witnessed firsthand the harmonious community of diverse creatures that comprised Rimuru's town. Enthralled by the prospect of reshaping his destiny, Youm wholeheartedly embraced Rimuru's plan to become a Hero, and from that fateful day onward, his life would be forever altered.
Trivia: Youm was so focused on surviving that he never really had any dreams for the future, but this changed after he met Rimuru, now wanting to have fun hanging around with his friends.[4]

Female Form: She is a fifteen or sixteen year old-looking girl having an imperfect yet complete beauty, as if she was trapped in the very moment when she matured from a girl to an adult. She also enjoys classy food and entertainment, so much that she asked for a musical exchange after watching the concert inTempest's opening festival.
Background: Luminous, born as a remarkable creation of the brilliant Divine AncestorTwilight Valentine, was hailed as their masterpiece. However, as time passed, Luminous grew weary of her creator's capricious behavior, and with a display of extraordinary power, she ended Twilight Valentine's life using a potentDisintegrationspell. Seizing control of the remaining vampire forces, Luminous subjugated Valentin, a formidable and bloodthirsty Vampire. Yet, Valentin's constant antagonism towards her other subordinates posed a significant problem. To maintain order, Luminous made the difficult decision to split Valentin into two distinct beings:LouisandRoy.

In due course, Luminous encounteredGunther, who pledged unwavering loyalty and served as her noble assistant, fulfilling the role of a personal butler. Recognizing Gunther's invaluable contributions, Luminous elevated him to a position of great importance, and he became an instrumental figure in her rule.

Through her indomitable prowess, Luminous earned a coveted position as the fifth member of the esteemed Demon Lord council. However, her vampire domain, known asNight Rose｢夜薔薇宮,naito rōzu, lit. "Night Rose Palace"｣, met its demise at the hands ofVeldora, set up by theTrinity Wisemen. With the timely warning fromChloe, its inhabitants were able to evacuate. Undeterred by this setback, Luminous turned her attention towards a new endeavor: establishing Lubelius, where she ruled from the shadows. To govern Lubelius, Luminous entrusted the role of ruler to Louis Valentin, while she herself assumed a hidden presence. To maintain her influence within theTen Great Demon Lords, Luminous arranged for Roy Valentin to take her place, attending the Walpurgis Banquets incognito as one of Roy's two aides. Her sudden disappearance from the public eye and replacement among the ranks of the Demon Lords led many to believe she was dead.[1]She was able to keep this ruse for 1,500 years before her cover was inadvertently blown by Veldora andMilim Nava.

Throughout these tumultuous years, Luminous forged deep bonds of friendship with Chloe andHinata. When Chloe and Hinata's younger selves ventured into theCentral Worldand vanished from Hero Chloe's body, Luminous took measures to safeguard it by sealing it away, preventing any potential chaos instigated byChronoa.
Trivia: She addresses herself as "warawa," which is an archaic pronoun used by women in samurai families. The author admitted that he intended to paint her as a haughty noble this way, not knowing that it's actually a self-deprecating, humble pronoun.[2]
Luminous appears to be a lesbian or sexually attracted to women in general, as she shows lust towards the sight of Hinata's naked body and cuddles theHoly Arkcontaining Chloe's naked body.

While theWestern Holy Churchoriginally deemedRimuruandTempesta threat, Luminous herself apparently never thought ill of them.In fact, she is one of the Demon Lords who forms a good relationship with Rimuru. Majin.title: Majin

Majinization: Majinization｢魔人化,majin-ka｣orMonsterizationis the process of a non-magicule-based lifeform becoming a Majin/Monster. It occurs when a being is exposed to more magicules than it can handle,magicrituals, or other unique circumstances. While too much magicule exposure would normally just result in death, individuals occasionally adapt and are reborn as monsters.
Reproduction: Most Majin have reproductive ability, but usually only within their own subspecies.[3]In their upper social castes exist Greater Majin such asGiants,Vampires,Harpiesand other longer-livedspeciesall equally capable of having offspring, although they rarely do so, since their immense Magic Power causes them to be nigh-immortal, obviating the need to leave descendants. Additionally, reproduction, similar tonaming, risks a great loss ofenergyand may even kill one of the parents.
Demonoid: Demonoid｢人魔族,demon'noido, lit. "Human Monster Tribe"｣is a generalized term used to refer to Majin who were originallyHumans, but have had their body mutated bymagicto become monsters.
Greater Majin: Greater Majin｢上位魔人,jōi majin, lit. "High-Level Demonic Person"｣is a general term used for Majin who are Over ARank. They hold power unimaginable to a normal person, usually being found in service to oneDemon Lordor another as part of their elite troops. In some areas, they are even worshipped as Local Gods.
Examples includeGelmudbefore his naming spree andGeldin hisOrc Lordstate.
Sub-Demon Lord Level: Sub-Demon Lord Level｢準魔王級,jun maō-kyū, lit. "Quasi Demon Lord-Class"｣is a general term given to Majin who have surpassed simple Greater Majin in power and reached Special-A Rank. Although their strength is still a far cry from Demon Lord Level, they're powerful pawns for the Demon Lords, with them usually taking thorough preparations in order to either take them down or bring them to their side. For Majin of this level it isn't strange for them to have powerful minions in the form of Greater Majin andGreater daemonsassisting them in their schemes, allowing them to potentially take down an entire nation with thorough preparation.
Examples include theOrc DisasterGeld and theThree Beastketeersprior to receiving gifts fromCarrion'sHarvest Festival.
Demon Lord Level: Demon Lord Level｢魔王級,maō-kyū, lit. "Demon Lord-Class"｣is a term used to refer to Majin that have strength comparable to a Demon Lord but aren't themselves officially recognized Demon Lords. Majin of this level usually have one or more Sub-Demon Lord Level subordinates and dozens of Greater Majin under their control. It isn't unusual to find them in control of a large area of land comparable to a small nation.
Examples includeRimuru Tempestprior to undergoing the Harvest Festival and joining theOctagram.

Veldanava.summary: He was initially presumed dead for most of the series, having been killed along with his wife in a terrorist attack. However, it was ultimately revealed that he had in fact revived and kept himself hidden while recovering his power. It was revealed that Lucia's death grief-struck him to the point he became disillusioned with the world, culminating in an attempt to "reset" all worlds beforeCielrevived Lucia to make him stop. He met his permanent end byIvaragé, his sentient other-self, when she devoured him and the revived Lucia to becomeLuvelgé.

Summary: He was initially presumed dead for most of the series, having been killed along with his wife in a terrorist attack. However, it was ultimately revealed that he had in fact revived and kept himself hidden while recovering his power. It was revealed that Lucia's death grief-struck him to the point he became disillusioned with the world, culminating in an attempt to "reset" all worlds beforeCielrevived Lucia to make him stop. He met his permanent end byIvaragé, his sentient other-self, when she devoured him and the revived Lucia to becomeLuvelgé.
Human Form: When Veldanava assumeshumanform, he takes the appearance of an androgynous man of modest stature with black hair and blue eyes. His long hair is littered with white specks that make it resemble the night sky.[1]
Dragon Form: Veldanava is a largedragonwith cyan scales similar in appearance toVeldora. He has four legs, two large wings, and smooth spines going down his neck and onto his back.
Personality: Veldanava is a whimsical being, having abandoned his almightiness and created everything to sate his boredom. Due to this dislike of boredom, he likes the imperfection and the unknown that comes after abandoning his omnipotence, often times seeking and even striving to be one himself, which would be fulfilled after his marriage and the birth of his child.

As the Creator, he naturally has an innate interest and care for all beings, especially the intelligent ones or even beings that have the potential to be intelligent likeIvaragé. Despite this, he almost never directly interferes with matters of any kind, dumping responsibilities onto others as much as he can.

After his rebirth following the terrorist attack, the death of his wife Lucia left him grief stricken and disillusioned with the world. He came to see his creations as failures, admitting if it was just him that was killed he wouldn't mind but Lucia was where he drew the line. He would do what it takes to revive Lucia planning to sacrifice all worlds to do so.
Background: Before anything and everything, “it” was drifting in the World of Death, a world with no beginning nor end. Fearing change, it slumbered as if dreaming.[2]Then a Will was born, a will without any form or body. It was Omnipotent and Omniscient, as much as a dreamer inside their own dream. As the Will had not taken any form, it was essentially the world itself, Perfection, Completeness, lacking absolutely nothing.[3][4]

However, a part of that will soon grew bored of the unchanging world, a world where it could perceive everything. And so diversity was born, created by two conflicting Wills. One sought freedom and to perceive change, another ought to bear the loneliness, too afraid of the changing world. Thus these wills separated, manifesting as Ivaragé and Veldanava, Destroyer and Creator, Yin & Yang.[2]Their dreamlike sense of Omnipotence was gone, replaced by the forever changing "World".[4]

In the beginning, nothing else existed besides Veldanava. He had the all-powerful ability,Nihility Collapse, but he also had loneliness. Bored with that world of emptiness, he chose to create theCentral Worldand foundation for it throughMiracle｢神業,mirakuru, lit. "Divine Work"｣:Beginning Eden｢楽園開闢,biginingu eden｣. During this process, the otherTrue Dragonswere also born. Once the number of True Dragons became four, the Chaotic World stabilized and Order was established. It was also this process due to which Veldanava lostNihility Collapse, but that was also what allowed him to successfully descend into the foundation he had created, arising in thePalace of Beginnings.

To manage this Order, Veldanava derived theSeven Angels of Originfrom theGreat Holy SpiritofLightand established laws in this stabilized world. Thus, the Central World became firmly anchored and Veldanava was no longer alone, yet the loneliness in his heart did not fade. The World was too immature to replace theOmnipotence｢万能,ban'nō, lit. "All-Powerful"｣he had renounced. At some point, he also created various other Dimensions and the Worlds inside them, along with the various laws that governed them.

Veldanava then waited patiently, and eventually the Primordial GodLuminous Twilight Valentinewas born, and the world underwent change. From the various lifeforms created by the Primordial God, intelligent life were born eventually, who after a long time developed into Humanity, the vessel of Souls. Veldanava, whose heart was filled with loneliness, came to love this species more than anything else, even dreaming of becoming a part of their world.

Yet there was still a problem. Humans had free will, and that very ability to assert their own will gave birth to different ideologies and forms of righteousness, stimulating each other with unpredictable actions, which eventually lead humanity to its own end through endless war. Various worlds had branched off from theCentral World, yet the same results could be seen in all of them. The cause of this was emotions, Veldanava had granted them Wisdom, Desire, Joy, Anger, Sorrow, and Pleasure because he thought it was necessary for their development. Emotions acted as the seeds of conflict, and more often than not, the humanity that possessed these emotions held on to their own sense of absolute justice in the face of conflict, rather than solving the problems rationally through discussion. Yet if humanity were to be completely controlled, new emotions would not rise and fall and free will would not exist, everything would be foreseeable, which was no different from the Void that Veldanava was bored with.

Veldanava, pondering over this, accepted that necessary evil must exist to some extent for the greater good, and regarded the world as a training ground for the Souls, believing that the fundamental good in human heart will eventually lead them to thePromised Land. He then made several adjustments across variousParallel Worlds｢並列世界,heiretsu sekai, lit. "Parallel Universe"｣of other Dimensions, finely tuning the details and allowing them to undergo different paths of evolution.

At the center of it all was theCentral World, which Veldanava planned to populate with powerful andimmortal spiritsbearing flesh, a race ofgodly men. To facilitate the upbringing of this race of immortal men, Veldanava first created a founding being by granting a physical body to the Primordial GodLuminous Twilight Valentine, who became the Divine Ancestor, the one who will create and prosper civilizations. There, however, rose a problem. The Divine Ancestor was a perfect being who lacked any concept of gender and was incapable of traditional reproduction. To solve this, they used their powerful intellect and created twospeciesbased on their ownbody. Thehigh humansand thevampires. The High humans possessed mortal but lengthy lifespans and an innate capacity for knowledge andmagic… but their massive egos and self-destructive tendencies made them failures. The Vampires had the immortality that Veldanava sought, but their reliance on blood and intolerance to sunlight made them unsuited for populating the world. During this process, while he was creating his High Disciples, he experimented on himself by dividing into two entities,onethat had his body, powers and the majority of his memories, and theotherwho possessed only his personality, and sealed the memories of their true identity inside theOrigin Blood. Twilight then returned to the drawing board and eventually created humans and their many derivatives — later known asdemi-humans— which, while not being immortal like Veldanava wished, were enough to satisfy his desires and made him overjoyed.

The Humans that Twilight created were spread across the numerous parallel worlds of other dimensions to ensure variety in the cultures they developed, while Veldanava ordered his first and foremost subordinateFeldwayto eliminate threats to humanity and ensure they could thrive.[5]Veldanava then set various individuals as overseers and mediators, such asGuy Crimson,DinoandRamiris, and with their help along with help from variousothercollaborators, successfully created the ideal environment. A system of eternal recurrence was established in the form of theSamsara｢輪廻,rin'ne, lit. "Cycle of Reincarnation"｣, allowing Souls to circulate in all Dimensions and all Worlds.

With an abundance of different races and cultures quickly populating the entire worlds, the gears of fate began to be put in motion. Veldanava isolated parts of his divine authority over creation into seven powerfulUltimate skillscalled the Seven Virtues and started to divvy them up to those he considered worthy, passing the rest into the cycle of reincarnation to choose their own masters while leaving onlyMichaelfor himself.[6]

At some point, he came into contact with the royalty of theKingdom of Nasca, taking in their crown princeRudraas his disciple and training him to be aChosen Herowho could stand equal with theDemon LordGuy, even giving him Michael so he could better fulfill his dream of a unified world. Eventually, Veldanava and Rudra's sister Lucia fell in love and consummated their relationship, conceiving Milim Nava in the process. The birth of Milim resulted in most of Veldanava'senergyand powers left being taken away and his body destabilizing. Veldanava used the last of his old body's power to create a sibling for Milim, ababy dragonthat would serve as her companion so that she never had to be lonely as he had. With almost all of his energy drained, Veldanava's subsequent reincarnation was rather weak. His new body, for all anybody could tell, was essentially "human". It didn't possess the near-invulnerability of his previous draconic body and it would even eventually die of old age, bearing a mortal lifespan.

Having left all of his responsibilities to others, Veldanava was free to enjoy a simple life with his wife and children, no longer bored or lonely with them at his side. The only wish that was left, was for Milim to "surpass her parent", and for her to grow up healthily and happily. However, during one of Rudra's trips to the north to fight Guy, a group of fighters from a rival nation assaulted the capital of Nasca. Both Veldanava and his wife Lucia perished in the resultingterroristattack, leaving Milim and the Baby Dragon orphaned and Rudra in a deep depression. Of course, as a True Dragon, no matter how much of his power he lost or how much damage he took, he could always resurrect at full power whenever he wished… but when he chose not to do so even after many centuries, his followers were left to come to their own conclusions.Onebelieved that he had grown disappointed with his creations and decided to abandon them,anotherbelieved that he had decided to leave everything to his daughter, andthe otherbelieved that he was simply enjoying his creation from afar and that he would return at the end of time.

No one exceptone, however, knew that Veldanava had already been reborn, but his personality had shifted completely, seeking only to destroy all worlds and recollect the fragments of hisbeloved. Veldanava, who had never imagined that there would be someone foolish enough to boast about "slaying a god" that had lost all of its power and become a mere man, finally came to question himself when that same blade reached his beloved wife. He could return to merely observing the world as he had done before, or he could reset it all. And the choice Veldanava made would be the judgement of existence. Veldanava, who had lost the love he once held for his creation, made the worst possible choice from the perspective of his creation.
Trivia: His human form is completely identical toFeldway's with the exception of their hair color.[1]
After beingnamed, Rimuru might have inheriteda part of personality (lost love)｢人格の一部（失われた愛）,jinkaku no ichibu (ushinawareta ai)｣of Veldanava.[7]

Appearance: She is an alluring lady with waist-long white hair and crimson red eyes. She usually wears a black military uniform with baggy pants, while her formal attire is a teal-colored dress. Out of the 3 Primordials recruited by Diablo, she is the tallest.[2]
As aDaemon, she has the characteristic horns and wings of her race, but since she usually keeps them hidden it is unknown how they look like.
Personality: Testarossa embodies the traits typically associated with a stereotypical noblewoman, evident in both her appearance and personality. Among the three Primordials recruited by Diablo, she displays the most mature demeanor but also exudes an air of haughtiness. While she carries herself with gentleness and elegance, she also harbors the inherent cruelty and battle hunger commonly found among daemons. In terms of political machinations, Testarossa's skills are on par with, if not superior to, Diablo's.

Her intolerance for subordinates speaking out of turn is apparent, as she is willing to resort to severe measures, such as cutting offMoss's ear, to enforce discipline. She also holds disdain for individuals who lack independent thinking or exhibit foolish behavior. On the other hand, Testarossa develops a sense of respect for those who demonstrate critical thinking, as shown by her admiration forHinata's keen observation and foresight in understanding her master's plans.

Despite her formidable nature, Testarossa is capable of forming genuine friendships with others. For instance, after fulfilling her part of the contract withBlanche, she refuses to claim the payment of Blanche'ssouland instead ensures a proper burial, signifying the depth of their bond.

Although equally perplexed as Ultima and Carrera regarding Rimuru's intention of granting them a day off for leisurely activities, Testarossa appears to intimidateFrameathe least. This indicates that she does not hold misunderstandings against others and adapts to unfamiliar situations. Additionally, as adaemon, Testarossa is unaccustomed to the concept of having time off from her master's assigned tasks.
Background: Blanc, like her primordial brethren, was born during the dawn of time before the creation of heaven and earth. She and the other primordials were demonic counterparts to theSeven Angels of Origin, split from theGreat Holy SpiritofDarkness. They ruled Hell undisturbed for an eternity, withRougeas their overlord. WhenBleuandVertwere resurrected and became completely loyal to Rouge after their failed attempt to overthrow him, Blanc,Violet, andJaunemade a pact to never engage in direct combat. Instead, they preferred to outsmart each other in games and vie for the opportunity to incarnate in thematerial worldfirst.

In ancient times, Blanc selected Silberia as her realm and forged a pact with its ruler of that era. This ancient pact declared that she would safeguard the land and foster its prosperity until an heir with the capacity to be the perfect vessel would arise. The distinctive red eyes of the Silberia royal family served as evidence of her blessing, granting them the ability to perceive beyond ordinary limits. Their bodies were dedicated to accumulatingMagicules, harnessing a potent source of magical energy.

One day, Blanc approached her ideal vessel, the princess of Silberia, then known as "Blanche Nam Silberia", as she stated in the pact, she would grant the girl's wish for thebodyto be hers. However, she was left puzzled when the girl's wish turned out to be a desire for friendship. Despite her confusion, she decided to embrace the opportunity and attached herself to the girl, taking on the role of guide and mentor, nurturing their relationship over the course of several years. However, nefarious individuals caused theEastern Empireto invade the Kingdom of Silberia. Blanc's powers were still developing, preventing her from stopping the invasion. In a desperate act, Blanche forcibly terminated their contract, allowing Blanc to gain control of her body. Grief-stricken for the first time, Blanc became enraged. She unleashed a forbidden spell, indiscriminately claiming the lives of both innocent and guilty, resulting in the infamous "Lake Shore Dyed Scarlet Incident."

After seeking vengeance against the main culprit, Blanc cunningly pretended to be defeated by theImperial Guardiansof the capital. She abandoned her host body, severing ties with the physical world as a farewell gift to Blanche. To ensure her flesh would remain untouched, preserving its immortal beauty, Blanc cast a special seal, burying Blanche beneath the land.
Trivia: She was named after theFerrari Testarossasupercar; ironically the name "Testarossa" can be translated from Italian to English as "Red Head" or, less literally, as "red-haired"
She briefly appears inThe Ways of the Monster Nationspin-off manga in chapter 42 and in short comic by the end ofLight novel volume 13drawn by Taiki Kawakami himself.
Rimuru described the tea she made as "one of the best he had tasted."

Physical Traits: Elves are well known for their unusual longevity. As descendants of fairies, they have much larger naturalmanareserves than those ofhumansand an average lifespan of between five hundred and eight hundred years. There are even those said to have lived far longer, coming closer to a fairy-like existence. Outwardly, their bodies stop aging in their early 20s; even elderly elves still look the same as they did in their youth. As they approach the end of their lifespan, however, they start aging rapidly, and after roughly twenty or thirty years, they become infirm like elderly humans.
Background: In the distant past, prior to the formation of theSorcerous Dynasty of Sarionwhere many of the current elf population reside, there was once an elven superpower known as the Great Sorcerous Nation Of Soma. It presumably at one point held the entire world's elven population, andKagaliwas its princess. Due to the foolishness of her father, the King (who had been possessed byJahil), the kingdom fell overnight toDemon LordMilim's wrath. The surviving elves split apart and pursued different paths: some followed Kagali and createdJistav; others settled elsewhere and eventually formed the foundation for what would become Sarion; and the rest took shelter in forests, hiding away their settlements with illusory barriers.

Appearance: He has long platinum gold hair, blue narrow eyes, a well-defined face, and skin so white that it is almost transparent. He is so beautiful that he is often mistaken for a woman at first glance. Despite his young appearance, he is three hundred years old.
Personality: Due to his inability to express himself properly, he is often seen as cold and cruel. In truth he is actually quite kind but his one-track-mind tends to create distance between him and the people around him. For hundreds of years, he's been extremely obsessed withChloe Aubert, his childhood friend, to the extent of willing to commit various atrocities just to reunite with her.

He always shows a proud, cold and calculative personality around other people, even when he's with much more powerful beings likeGuyorVelzard. However, his personality drastically changes whenever Chloe is involved, becoming a hotheaded and overprotecting brotherly figure.

Leon is wise enough to give up on his plans when he knows they won't benefit him further. Rimuru saved theotherworlderchildren and was disgusted with human nations summoning people against their will; not to mention Rimuru soon after ascended to Demon Lord. All this was enough for Leon to give up on trying to use proxies to summon Chloe; knowing full well that Rimuru would use his influence and political connections to end the practice.

A source of irritation for Leon is Guy Crimson; theDaemonconstantly hits on him and offers a sexual relationship. Leon flatly turns Guy down repeatedly, considering the daemon as a male even if Guy swapped genders to fit Leon's orientation.
Background: Leon came to theCentral Worldalong with Chloe through a dimensional distortion, but immediately afterwards, Chloe disappeared. In his search for her, Leon entered a contract with anElemental of lightand became aChosen hero.

Leon eventually proclaimed himself a Demon Lord and antagonizedKazalim, and prevailed in a life-or-death battle with him. Leon took Kazalim's place on theDemon Lord counciland was officially recognized as a Demon Lord.

Over two centuries passed since coming to the Central World, and during his attempts tosummonChloe back to his side, he secretly spread the method of (incomplete) summoning around the world, which resulted in many otherworlder children being summoned, Leon summonedShizue Izawaout of the Tokyo firebombing and hadIfritpossess her, both in order to save her, but also to find a vessel for Ifrit. Due to Leon's cold exterior, Ifrit's mistaken judgement calls and Shizu's rejection of the world she got summoned to, they were unable to bond properly, culminating in the deaths of Pirino and Pizu, which strained their relationship severely. Ultimately Leon decided to leave Shizu in the care of theMasked Chosen herowho appeared at his castle, while Leon himself moved his base over to El Dorado.
Trivia: Rimuru remarked that Leon is the opposite ofMasayuki— all his actions are usually interpreted in a bad light.
He usually address himself with the more formal"watashi"(私), but will revert to the informal"ore"(俺) when emotionally charged.

Leon's surname, Cromwell, is derived from the two Old English words "Crumb" and "Well", which together mean “bent stream”.  This surname hails from Nottinghamshire and West Yorkshire in England.  Two of the most famous people to have borne this surname wereThomas Cromwell: chief minister ofKing Henry VIIIof England from 1534 to 1540, and his great-nephew,Oliver Cromwell: Puritan leader and commander of the Roundheads during the English Civil War, and subsequently ruled the British Isles as Lord Protector from 1653 until his death in 1658.

Although it is unknown if this is intentional by the author or not, Leon displays many personality quirks and social issues that might indicate he falls somewhere on the autism spectrum or is otherwise neurodivergent.

Characteristics: Orcs are typically a race that won't attack those stronger than themselves, but they can be less cautious when they feel superior in numbers and have a strong leader. With sufficiently high numbers, they can become quite a formidable force. Most orcs are less intelligent than the average human, but they compensate for it with their strong bodies and numerical superiority. They are a race bursting with life, renowned for their high reproductive abilities, able to rapidly become hyper-fertile in response to environmental stress and capable of producing entire litters of children from a single pregnancy. They live anywhere from 40 to 50 years on average.
Trivia: The orcs shown as anthropomorphic pigs similar to other anime/manga series is probably due to being modelled by the ones in the Dungeon and Dragons franchise as that's how they were originally portrayed as.

Hakurou.title: Hakurou

infobox.title: Hakurou
infobox.Manga: Chapter 12:Mighty Foes in the Forest of Jura

Ogre: As an Ogre, Hakurou was a short old man, contrary to the general Ogre physique, with aged silver hair and two white, ivory-like horns protruding from his forehead. His hair was gently wavy and has two bangs dropping from the far side of his horns, and a ponytail tied with a string. He also had pointed ears and has black eye lines on his lower eyelids. Similar to the other Ogres, in the Anime, his skin had averysubtle silver tint to go with his color scheme - a tint so subtle that it's only noticeable if compared to his Kijin form side by side.

His attire consisted of an off white robe with thick black outlines, fastened by a pale brown ribbon on his waist. This whole was also covered another similar robe which was kept unfastened. Finally, he wore a thick pale brown scarf that always covered his mouth, a pair of loose white pants, wooden sandals, black fingerless gloves that attached only to his middle finger over the back of his hands, and a plain looking thin Japanese sword.
Kijin: Similar to all evolutions, Hakurou went from a shabby (but sharp) old man to a middle-aged man in his prime.

His hair became more full and sharper (less droopy) and his skin lost its silver tint. His horns shrunk a lot, and perhaps the biggest change he had was his facial structure going from a stubby to one having really sharp and well-defined jaws and chin. Moreover, unknown if he had one in his Ogre stage, he got a long silver goatee (short in the Manga).
His new attire consists of a white overcoat, which in turn was covered on the shoulders and neck by some kind of overwear as well. In the Manga and Light Novel, however, he wears a scarf.
His appearance mostly remains the same for his subsequent evolution.
Personality: Hakurou is usually calm. Although he's at the age to be someone's grandpa, his spirit is clearly years younger. He's able to correctly identify the skills Rimuru uses to incapacitateKurobe,Shion, andSoueiand themonstersthey originate from just by seeing them used once. He trains Tempest warriors (including Rimuru himself) in swordsmanship and is notoriously strict at that. He also believes in teachingArtsas well, showing an understanding that monsters tend to rely too much on their skills.

However, he hates being called "old man". If someone violates this, he'll usually respond by slightly draw his katana and threatening them to "increase the exercise load" or "death", along with a sharp but deadly look. He tends to be analytical in combat, showing his knowledge of skills, magic and even can pick up on deadly intent. Many allies trust his wisdom, since he is renowned as the "Sword Savant".

After learning that he has adaughter, Hakurou has become very doting on her and is quite overprotective with her, even encouraging her to "win"Benimaru's heart and is visibly annoyed when he doubts on taking her as his wife.
Background: Hakurou is the grandson of the master swordsmanByakuya Araki. He was the Ogre Tribe's martial instructor and the strongest swordsman of their royal guard. He is also the one that trainedGazel Dwargoin his swordsmanship 300 years ago. Despite Ogres only having an average lifespan of about 100 years, Hakurou miraculously managed to live for over 300 years as an Ogre, before meetingRimuruand extending his lifespan through evolution into a Kijin.
Trivia: In the Light Novel, when planning the attack of the west Crystal barrier placed by Falmuth, it's Rigur who tries to ease Rimuru's worries. In the anime, the one who speaks is Hakurou.

Appearance: Bernie, despite being over 45 years old, maintains the youthful appearance of an 18-year-old. He possesses a striking auburn mane of hair and is often seen sporting stylish glasses that enhance his intellectual aura. His demeanor exudes an air of a long-suffering lackey, asRimuruhas aptly described.

When Bernie assumes the guise of an Imperial Guardian undercover, he undergoes a remarkable transformation. He ditches his glasses and adopts an asymmetrical haircut. In place of his typical meek countenance, he wears a perpetual scowl, presenting a stern and imposing presence. His attire consists of a resplendent Legend-Grade Armor, with a vibrant yellow hue.
Personality: Bernie consistently served as the voice of reason within the party, always prioritizing the team's welfare and offering invaluable advice to Masayuki. His ability to resist Masayuki'sChosen Onestemmed from aUnique skillhe possessed, but he held great respect for Masayuki despite this remarkable resistance.

However, after his true identity as an Imperial Guardian was exposed, Bernie revealed a more formal and serious side of himself in his military role. In battle, he showcased a degree of vanity, displaying confidence in his abilities, which came as a shock when he was defeated byBenimaru. This stark contrast in his behavior from his time traveling with Masayuki left Rimuru astounded, betraying the initial impression of Bernie as nothing more than Masayuki's "long-suffering lackey." Bernie himself described his behavior while traveling with Masayuki as his true self.

Although Bernie initially regarded Masayuki as a mere imposter who bluffed his way through life as aChosen herousing his Unique skill, he gradually developed a deep respect for him over their extended time together. After reconciling with Masayuki and witnessing Masayuki's coronation as the new Emperor, Bernie vowed to protect him with unwavering loyalty.
Background: Bernie, born in the United States of America forty-five years ago, was initially just an ordinary, freedom-loving student. However, his life took a drastic turn when he found himself in a different world, a place whereGadradiscovered him. He was then taken under the wing ofDamrada, a seasoned mentor who taught him the art of combat. This training boosted his self-assurance, eventually leading him to believe he was among the world's elite fighters.

One day, Bernie received the distinct honor of being escorted to the emperor's palace by Damrada, further fueling his aspirations. As a lover of freedom, he loathed the concept of an emperor dominating every facet of people's lives. He held onto the foolish dream of overthrowing the emperor if he ever got the chance. However, this dream was replaced by fear when he metMarshalfor the first time, succumbing entirely to her overwhelming presence. Damrada then assigned Bernie the mission of protecting Masayuki, who bore a striking resemblance to EmperorRudra. Bernie constructed a cover story, claiming to be a graduate ofFreedom Academyand an otherworlder underYuuki Kagurazaka's protection. He originally only spoke English upon his arrival in this new world, making communication with Yuuki utterly impossible. He turned tomagicto bridge the language gap and became captivated by it, aspiring to study at the academy. Bernie's relatively recent entry into the world of adventuring led him to search for companions, ultimately leading him to joinMasayuki's party.

The party rapidly gained notoriety, earning the nickname "Lightspeed" within a mere six months. DespiteJinrai's officialrankas C+, his strength matched that of a Rank B, and with Bernie's magic support, they adeptly handled any quest they attempted. During the war with theEastern Empire, Bernie andJiwuwere exposed as secret agents of Rudra, sent by Damrada to guard Masayuki. Under the orders ofTatsuya Kondou, they were dispatched to assassinateRimuru. However, they were defeated and killed in the ensuing battle with Benimaru andChloe. Utilizing Resurrection Bracelets, they managed to escape theDungeonbut were relentlessly pursued and defeated byDiablo. Rimuru eventually resurrected them, albeit in a weakened state. The duo reconciled with Masayuki and protected him while he was pursued byCornu. Bernie and Jiwu returned with Masayuki to the Eastern Empire, taking on the role of his escorts in his new regime as emperor.

Appearance: A skinny man in his forties who wears an eyepatch over his left eye and has a thin mustache, and black hair slicked back. He wears the standard issued Imperial military uniform reserved for commanders or higher – a long black coat mixed with gold, and white gloves.
Personality: Although he can hold himself in a fight, he's more of a strategist. He's particular about his strategies and won't act unless victory is certain. At times his greed can get the better of him, making him gullible to manipulation, likeYuukiandGadra's scheme to lure him into attacking theDungeon. As the commander of the strongest divison, Calgurio holds great pride in his role and constantly seeks opportunities to prove his worth to theEmperorand advance even further. To that end he can be quite ambitious, sometimes too much to his own detriment.

After suffering a crushing defeat to Tempest's forces, he reflected on his foolish actions up to then and deeply regrets them. He feels guilty for all the lives under his command which were lost and couldn't be spared, and seeks to atone and pay backRimuru's kindness by working hard to restore the Empire and establish friendly relations with Tempest. He's turned over a new leaf for the better.
Background: Originally a low-class noble, Calgurio took advantage of the Empire's strong policy on absolute meritocracy and worked his way up the military ladder through his own talent, accruing experience and eventually landing the spot of commander. He was entrusted with leading the Armored Corps.

Calgurio was born a commoner and married into the family of a baron as a knight. After his father-in-law passed away, he was betrayed by histhen-wifeand drugged, blinded in his left eye, and driven out. These events were the impetus that drove him to seek status.
Trivia: Calgurio was one of several subjects expected by the Emperor to awaken duringthe Imperial Invasion, along withMinitz,KanzisandKrishna.

After the defeat of Geld, Kojuroku, like the rest of his Orc brethren, was granted a name and accepted into the Jura-Tempest Federation. He evolved into a High orc in the process and was assigned to work a wheat field alongside his wife and son.

Appearance: Ultima takes the appearance of a cute and beautiful girl. She has middle length purple hair tied into a side ponytail, as well as purple fingernails. When she's off the clock she wears a variety of purple-colored dresses as casual wear and when she's serious she wears a black skirted military uniform with an armband on her left arm.

As aDaemon, she has the characteristic horns and wings of their race, something she usually keeps hidden. She has six bat-like wings on her back that she can freely shapeshift into whatever she desires.
Personality: Ultima, on the outside, appears to be a simple-minded and carefree princess-like person; but on the inside, she's an extremely calculative and scheming person who's always planning her next move. Befitting a Daemon, she's extremely cruel towards her enemies, preferring to capture their souls and torture them rather than outright kill them, which she gets a sadistic pleasure from doing. Despite this, she doesn't approve of her mischief being messed up and will cut ties with or sometimes kill her subordinates if they decide to take matters in their own hands against her orders. She does not care about her admirers, as she killedGustavwithout hesitation after he did not complete his goal correctly.

Though Ultima takes joy in the suffering of others, she feels an even greater pleasure when those she tortures or observes struggling, overcome their adversity. She's fond of such individuals, and is even willing to reward or lend a hand to them out of gratitude for entertaining her. One notable instance of this is when she revivedTowaas a sort of apology for the actions of hersubordinate, who violated the terms of their contract and ruined her game.

She is equally perplexed as Testarossa and Carrera regarding Rimuru's intention of granting them a day off for leisurely activities, since, as adaemon, Ultima is unaccustomed to the concept of having time off from her master's assigned tasks.
Background: Violet, like her other primordial brethren, was born during the dawn of time before the creation of heaven and earth as the demonic counterparts to theSeven Angels of Originsplit from theGreat Holy SpiritofDarkness. Her and the other primordials ruled Hell undisturbed for an eternity withRougeas its overlord. WhenBleuandVertwere resurrected completely loyal to Rouge after their attempt to overthrow him, Violet,Blanc, andJauneagreed to never fight each other directly, instead preferring to outsmart each other in things like games and who could incarnate in thematerial worldfirst.

Many centuries before the start of the story, after having countless failed incarnation attempts, she was summoned by the then Queen ofRaja. The queen, mistaking her for a goddess, asked for a way to save her people. Violet in turn gave the queen a tiara that could be used to perform miracles, but whenever it was used, it would drain the user's life force and stain their skin in the color of her magic. The two formed a contract where Violet would win the game should the queen or any of her descendants be completely stained in her color, while the queen would win if that didn't happen. Violet's intention was to claim the body of whoever became fully stained as her vessel and sentLacuato observe the kingdom's royal family, but after Lacua defied her orders to not interfere, she is forced to end her game and severe ties with him.

In theKingdom of Coleus, her admirerGustavintended to create a vessel for her using PrincessZenobia. Despite interference, he initially seemed successful, only for Violet to scold him as the task she set him was to give her material form, when instead he just forced her to manifest within Zenobia of her own power and in front of the Demon LordLuminous Valentine, whom she could not defeat since they are equally matched and is a witness to the truth of Gustav's scheme. Violet kills Gustav for messing up on their scheme. She then leaves Zenobia's body to search for a more suitable vessel.

One day Violet was approached by her fellow PrimordialNoir. Noir, now going by the name Diablo, "coerced" Violet into serving his newmasteralongside him. Violet went along with it, only intending to half-heartedly lend her strength for some years until she got bored, only to discover that Diablo's new master was indeed someone worth pledging her allegiance to. With that, Rimuru officially gave Violet the name "Ultima".
Trivia: She was named after the Ultima GTR supercar.
She addresses herself with "boku（僕）", a somewhat childish pronoun that is more commonly used by young boys.
She has a history of getting into spats withLuminous Valentine, and still has an intense, albeit strangely friendly rivalry with her.[1]

Appearance: Rudra had medium length golden-blonde hair and bright blue eyes, with a face that could be called a mix between Russian and Japanese.[1]He wore expensive clothing made of silks, interlaced with solid gold thread.

Though he kept a sword at his side, he rarely used it, instead remaining mostly immobilized due to the strain caused by Michael. This resulted in him being seated in his room or on his throne for most of the day, relying on an ornate golden wheelchair to be moved from place to place[2]and moving himself only when absolutely necessary.[3]
Personality: Rudra once held pure and idealistic dreams of creating a perfect world where disputes could be settled with words rather than violence.[4]The man with these naïve ideals was slowly corroded away over time as Michael's control took control over his mind, his exhaustedsoulbeing chipped away by repeated rebirths only serving to exacerbate the problem.[5]Eventually nothing more remained than an echo of his former self,[5]a complete thrall to Michael that was imparted with the harsh ideologies of absolute justice and might make right.

This version of Rudra was completely corrupted to the path of evil, willing to use any means necessary to win the game againstGuy Crimson. He had no qualms about turning his own citizens into effectively serfs without much in the way of human rights, even willing to sacrifice them by the millions to suit his purposes.[6]He had no concept of compassion, offering those that opposed him only one chance to surrender and ruthlessly slaughtering them with his armies if they refused.[7]
Background: Rudra was born millennia ago as a prince of the Kingdom of Nasca, with the naïve ambition to unite the entire world and bring peace to all. He eventually arose as the firstChosen herowith the backing of his mentorVeldanavaand became rivals with theDemon LordGuy, resulting in the creation of their game to decide who gets to rule the world.[4]

After the deaths of his sisterLuciaand Veldanava, Rudra's mental state took a downward spiral and ultimately resulted in the loss of his innocence, leaving only his game with Guy to give him a reason to live. The will that resided inside ofMichaelhad similarly become distraught, taking advantage of Rudra's compromised mental state to wage war in his psyche. The end result of this was wear and tear on his body, brought about by the stress of containing Michael's will and its power. This forced Rudra to repeatedly undergo a special ritual of rebirth to inherit his will and abilities into the body of his own offspring on their conception, allowing him to live on and continue the game.[8]

Over time Rudra's cycle of rebirth continued without stop, resulting in the wearing down of his soul from their frequency. This ultimately resulted in Rudra losing his sanity and falling under Michael's dominion, turning him into a merciless totalitarian that opposed the concept of free will. Then Michael finally took complete and total control over his body, resulting in what remained of his soul shattering into pieces and being blown to the interdimensional winds of reincarnation.[5]

Appearance: Nemu is a harpy that has the appearance of a young girl with short olive hair, and green eyes. As a member of the harpy race, she has their characteristics such as wings, and bird-like legs, although she can hide her wings and turn her legshuman.  She wears an overall green attire with what appears to be a black tight suit underneath, with stirrup leggings to allow her to both use her human feet and Harpy claws.
Personality: Nemu lives up to her name as she embodies a laid-back nature, often opting for slumber and seeking out cozy spots to rest. This attribute also reveals her absent-mindedness, as she frequently carries out tasks at her own leisurely pace, occasionally forgetting her directives from Frey to keep tabs on Tempest. This aspect of her personality reflects her carefree disposition, which is befitting of a harpy.

Nemu also holds a progressive view on relationships, advocating for polygamy by highlighting that harpies traditionally have multiple husbands. She has an innate intuition towards the true nature of those around her, so much so that acertain catcommented on it. She is well loved by many high ranking harpies and even more so by those who personally know her nature. When she says things like I did so and so without sleep or naps; it often surprises others, unbeknownst to her. She also loves baths and is often found in the hot springs or bathhouses if she isn’t lazily loafing around.
Background: Nemu was raised in the Harpy Queendom of Fulbrosia. Shortly afterEurazaniaforms an alliance with the Jura-Tempest Federation, she is sent by Frey to secretly investigate the capital city of Tempest,Rimuru City, but appears to have forgotten her mission.
Trivia: Nemu's name means sleep in Japanese, which expresses her overall personality and desire to sleep.
Nemu has made numerous cameo appearances inThe Slime Diaries: Ch. 24, Ch. 25, Ch. 29, Ch. 35, Ch. 41, Ch. 47, Ch. 50, Ch. 58, Ch. 59 and in the main manga inCh. 59.

Nemu's mother Frey is a Queen-type among the largely female populated Harpy race and therefore has the ability to reproduce through Parthenogenesis or Virgin Birth, where she is able to have children without the need of a partner. As such, Nemu and her older sisters have no biological father.

Story: The party was first formed when Masayuki defeatedJinraiand earned his company.Bernie, who was looking for a party back then, was introduced to Masayuki byYuuki Kagurazaka. After Bernie was introduced to them, they formed a three-man squad and progressed at an overwhelming rate. In only about half a year, the squad was already given the nickname "Team Lightspeed".

Their fame caught the attention ofJiwu, who then came to their party to check out on them. Initially she called Masayuki a scumbag that waved around the name of "Chosen hero", but for some reason she began to worship Masayuki over time. Thanks to the incredible buff and luck provided by Masayuki'sUnique skillChosen One, they became nigh-invincible and rose to A rank in an unprecedented speed.

Yuuki later asked them to take down the criminal organizationOrthrusin the Kingdom of Ballachia. During their time there,one of Orthrus's mentried to frame Masayuki for a murder, but his party foils this plan and expose their plot to the king. After destroying Orthrus's operations, the king asks them to take the formerelfslaves back to theJura Forest, which has now become the territory ofDemon lordRimuru Tempest. Though they want to fight Rimuru, Masayuki doesn't, so Rimuru has them take part inTempest's upcoming tournament and promises to fight them if they win. Masayuki reluctantly agrees and he and Jinrai compete in the tournament. Though Jinrai ensures that Masayuki would win, his leader decided to forfeit as he still does not want to fight Rimuru. After Masayuki became Rimuru's subordinate, the team took part in taking on the Dungeon. After this event is over, they decided to remain in Tempest. They later try the Dungeon again and managed to clear the 30th floor.
Abilities: Although Jinrai was ranked C+, his strength was comparable to that of a Rank B. With the additional aid of Bernie'smagic, they were able to safely handle any quest they attempted. Jiwu'selemental magicandrecovery magicfurther improved the party's performance. Most importantly, "Hero's Blessing" from Masayuki's unique skill allowed them to easily prevail in combat. Overall, the party's performance is more than enough to be A rank adventurers.

Background: Originally created byLuminous Valentineas a division of the general forces among the Holy Knights, she handpicked the strongest fighters with the greatest potential for evolution with the intention of encouraging the creation ofheroesunder her command. The role of theClerics of the Seven Luminariesor Seven Luminaries for short, on the other hand, was to act as mentors to train this potential to the fullest.
Organization: The Church is further subdivided into two big groups: the Crusaders;  Holy Knights under the direct command ofHinata Sakaguchi, and theRook Geniuses; under the direct command of theHoly Emperor, with the top Three among their ranks being the Three Battlesages. The line between the two was blurry, especially as the Holy Emperor tended to not give any orders that would interfere with the Crusaders.
To further prevent misunderstandings and friction, a meeting is held once a month between all members of the group to discuss events and clarify actions.

Hinata Sakaguchi, being the strongest fighter, not only held the title of Chief of the Crusaders, but also defeatedSaareand took his title as Head Knight of the Rook Geniuses. This made her the de facto leader of both subdivisions, effectively unifying both groups so long as she was in charge.
Trivia: All of them were shown in the first opening, despite the fact that Hinata wouldn't have a role untilSeason 2aside from a cameo inSaved Souls, with the rest not even appearing untilSeason 3.

Appearance: He is a hobgoblin of below-average height, but taller than Gobta. He has black eyes and gray hair. After being named by Rimuru he gained some weight.
Personality: Gobzo is a little naïve, but he is also gentle and incapable of lying to others. He can't hold a secret, and often ends in trouble. He also can easily get embarrassed too.
Background: At the start of the story, he and the other goblins met Rimuru. Once he was named, he evolved into a hobgoblin. He continued to serve Rimuru after he became the ruler of the Jura Tempest Federation from the rest of the story. He also got involved in the war against Falmuth's army.
After being revived he became member of the Yomigaeri.
Trivia: Gobzo's English Voice Actor,Clifford Chapin, also voices asYuuki Kagurazaka.

Appearance: Tiss is an adult woman with short dark blond hair and purple eyes. She wears two red hairpins on the left side of her hair.
Personality: Information to be added later on.
Story: Tiss,Jeff, and other teachers enter the teacher's room. SeeingRimuruthere, Jeff comments that there is upcoming outdoor training and that his students won't be participating. Not knowing about it, Tiss explains it’s a yearly event where the students can gain practical experience. Rimuru decides his students to participate as well and Jeff asks Tiss to explain him the event. Tiss explains there are two events with the first being an escort mission. The students need to escort their teacher in 5 to 7 days from school to the town of Guratol. The teachers evaluate their performance during the mission and gives them scores, but are forbidden to help the students. The second event is a training expedition in a man-made caves in the outskirts of Guratol. The students need to fetch the certificate of conquest from the depths of the cave. Also the teacher of the winning class gets ten gold coins. Tiss is assigned to accompanyClass S, who are given acamping carby Rimuru that is pulled by a tamedBeast Gnome. She was astounded to see how well behaved they are. Tiss enjoyed her trip with Class S and once they traveled to the caves to retrieve stolen medicine, they are attacked by thieves. Class S managed to defeat them, but are faced with aSpecter, who is too powerful for them. He then tries to have Tiss enslave one of the students and then kill the others, but thePrimordialNoirsaved them at the last second; however, he warns her to not tell anyone else about him. After returning to school, Tiss learns that Rimuru is leaving forColeusto handle an issue there. Sometime after Rimuru's time at the school is over, she takes over as Class S's new teacher.

She also takes part in Tempest's festival and upon learning of Rimuru's true identity, she was so shocked that she was unable to get out of bed. She eventually recovers and watches the martial arts tournament alongside Class S. They later had a meal during a break from the competition.
She and Rimuru later watch Hinata teach class.

Appearance: Middray has the appearance of a tall, muscular bald man garbed in priest robes. A significant trait of his is the mole on the middle of his forehead.
Personality: Middray is a simple-minded battle maniac. He doesn't like to think too hard about complicated topics, and is quick to anger. However, in certain situations he's been shown to be capable of holding his cool, such as when he dealt withYamza's unreasonable demands. A firm believer that all ingredients should be served raw and uncooked as he stubbornly insists that's the perfect offering for Milim. UnlikeHermes, he's foolishly oblivious to why Milim hardly shows up to eat their food - and on the rare occasions when she does, he fails to take note of the deadpan expression she puts on while eating it.

As the Head Priest, Middray cares for his subordinates and will not forgive anyone who tries to hurt them. He takes pride of being a Dragon Faithful and does not hide his joy of showing his inner strength. He also enjoys fighting against a strong opponent, just like he showed in his fight againstSuphia. He holds great respect for his fellow fighters, giving compliments for their efforts.

Havinggrownpowerful enough to actually spar with Milim, Middray has come to truly believe that any strategy can be surpassed and defeated with sufficient brute force; biased as he is, he fails to realize that such a feat is impossible for anyone who isn't as ridiculously powerful as he is.
Trivia: Middray is the oldest known dragonewt in the series. In fact, given that thedragons, from which the dragonnewts diverged, are known to have only come into being centuries at most before Middray's birth, he may very well be one of the first dragonewts to have ever been born, if not the very first.

Due to his extreme narrow-mindedness, Middray was originally against trying the food at the Tempest founding party, only relenting atShuna's overwhelming insistence. This prompted his first bite of genuinely cooked food, which brought him to tears. After hearing Shuna's explaination that just like how individuals grow stronger through cooperation, the ingredients only get more delicious when mixed, and seeing how much Milim was enjoying the food, in contrast to her bland reaction to the raw offerings he always gave her, Middray finally realized the error of his narrow-minded ways.

Rain.title: Rain

infobox.title: Rain
infobox.Base of Operations: Frost Palace,Ice ContinentPuppet Nation of Jistav(Clayman Revenge)

Appearance: Rain wears a deep-red maid outfit with blue long sleeved gloves. She has medium-length blue hair, blue eyes, and is considered very beautiful.
As aDaemon, she has the characteristic horns and wings of their race, but since it is something she keeps hidden it unknown how it looks like.
Personality: While she may seem to be a composed beauty on the surface, Rain does not like working, she leaves most tedious tasks to Misery and usually complains when she is forced to work. Her internal thoughts appear to be somewhat carefree and bubbly. She is absolutely loyal to Guy to the extent of rejecting an offer of freedom in favor of continuing to serve him.

Despite having an incredibly lazy disposition that hates working, she is almost paradoxically an absolute believer in following the rules, standing for law and order.[1][2]However, she will exploit any loopholes or gaps in the laws or her orders to her own benefit, being the type that does exactly what she is told to the letter.

She has a quirk of only being able to exert sixty-percent of her true potential under most circumstances, only able to bring out her full potential when she's motivated—something that almost never happens.[3]
Background: Eons ago Rain teamed up withMiseryin a bid to removeGuy Crimsonfrom the throne of hell. They were easily beaten back and their cores were crushed into dust at Guy's hand. When they revived they accepted the absolute fact that Guy was their better and pledged to serve him for all of eternity as his faithful servants.

When Guy was brought into the material plane he summoned Rain and Misery, giving them bodies of flesh and ordering them to slaughter the nation that had summoned him. When the task was complete Guy observed the rain falling from the sky and decided that it would serve well enough as her name.

After that point Rain and Misery followed Guy as they roamed the earth. They learned how to do various chores such as cooking and cleaning, and learned various arts such as music and dancing all to keep their lord and master entertained.
Trivia: Rain was calledHirariin the original web-novel.
In some illustrations, her eyes are green.

Ogre: As an ogre, he had a tall, burly build. He had flame-like lightly wavy crimson hair from which two large jet-black horns protruded. He has a pair of iconic tear-like red markings that flow down from the bottom of his eyes over his cheeks, which persists throughout all his evolutions. His eyes are incredibly sharp and fierce-looking and has orange-red iris. He wore black clothing with a thick woolen collar, covered by armor (matching his color scheme) that the Ogre tribe had learned to wear from ahumanwarrior who visited them a couple of centuries ago. He also carried a Japanese-style katana.
In the anime, his skin tone has a reddish tint as a sort of color scheme matching his hair, and his canines are large enough to peek out from his mouth.
Kijin: After evolution Benimaru's build shrunk to a height of 185 centimeters and had the appearance of a lean young man in his early twenties or younger. His hair turned less wavy and more straight and pointy. His horns also shrunk slightly and became more narrow, glowing more brilliantly than obsidian. His eyes became more laxer, making him look both more confident and laid back at the same time. Furthermore, his skin tone changed to that of a human, meaning, if his horns and drastically increasedaurawas hidden, one may not be able to distinguish him from humans at all either.

Thanks toShunaand the team of weavers (goblinasand thedwarves), Benimaru and everyone else received new clothing, weapons, and armor, his being a kimono that turned blood red to match his aura and a new katana.
His appearance mostly remains the same for his subsequent evolutions.
Personality: Benimaru has a carefree personality, that of an excited and confident man. Even so, he is actually really cautious and cunning as well. He has no interest in serving anyone who he doesn't deem worthy, however, he doesn't belittle those weaker than him either.

Benimaru felt hesitant when faced with the responsibility to take over the position of the Ogre Tribe village chief. Thus, he is content with his current position with Rimuru as the Lord he serves. As the military commander, he merely wishes to rampage to his heart's content. Had he become chief, he could not ride off to battle, but now it was different. He can participate without any concerns.

He was originally a very hot-headed person but after taking the role of general of the army under Rimuru he becomes more rational and calm in decision making. He is a battle maniac, challenging others who are stronger than him to see where he stands in the world.
Background: Benimaru was originally a nameless ogre born into the ogre village's ruling family as its sole prince, set to one day take over the duties of the chief. He grew up receiving combat instruction from theSword Oni, alongside the many other ogres around his age.

One day, without warning, his village was razed by an army of Orcs, forcing him to flee with a small company of other survivors, including hissister. While seeking refuge in the forest, he encountered a masked majin and immediately attacked them alongside his brethren, assuming them to be affiliated with the perpetrators behind the slaughter of his people. The ogres were met with overwhelming resistance from the majin and forced to acknowledge they were outclassed. Still hellbent on seeking revenge, Benimaru mustered the resolve for one last act in exchange for his life, but was stopped by his sister who sensed they may have falsely accused the majin. Benimaru listened to the majin plead their case one last time, and after seeing the error of his ways, apologized, bringing the situation to a close.

The majin, who introduced themself as Rimuru Tempest, offered refuge to Benimaru and his companions, to which he acquiesced. They formed a temporary alliance with the majin as his mercenaries and receivednamesfrom him, resulting in all the ogres evolving intokijin. After the defeat of the orc army, Benimaru and his brethren offered their permanent loyalty to the majin, going on to serve important positions in the slime's nation of monsters.
Trivia: The name "Benimaru" meanscrimson, deep red｢紅,beni｣andround, circle, pills, purity｢丸,maru｣.
Benimaru doesn't like carrots.
Benimaru is Rimuru's right-hand man.

Appearance: Shogo had the appearance of a young Japanese man with spiky black hair and dark brown eyes. He typically wore a special military uniform, but wore civilian clothes while infiltrating Tempest in the Manga and Anime. His face was often twisted into an arrogant sneer.
Personality: Shogo had an extremely prideful and self-centered personality, believing himself to be better than everyone else due to his immense strength. His crude attitude and lack of manners resulted in him struggling in most social situations, something that he didn’t make an effort to change even in-front of a king. This resulted in Razen implanting a trigger that would force him to remain silent with just a word.
Background: Back in Japan, Shogo was a delinquent high school student in a bottom-ranking school. The environment around him was extremely conducive towards violence, creating or amplifying Shogo’s violent tendencies. At the age of seventeen, Shogo was summoned to theCentral Worldto serve the Kingdom of Falmuth against his will by a sorcerer named Razen.

Razen placed aLocking Curseonto Shogo’s soul but not before Shogo managed to kill all thirty of the assistant sorcerers that performed the ritual. Afterwards, Shogo was forced to learn their language and was placed on a training regiment that had him facing off against the nation’s knights on an almost daily basis. His powerfulUnique skill—Berserker— combined with the Karate he’d practiced since he was a child and the training he received turned Shogo into that nation’s most powerful living weapon.

Kaijin.title: Kaijin

infobox.title: Kaijin
infobox.Former Affiliation(s): Armed Nation of DwargonDwarven Engineering Corps
infobox.Anime: Episode 4:In the Kingdom of the Dwarves

Appearance: Kaijin, akin to his fellowdwarves, possesses a diminutive stature coupled with a robust, muscular physique. His distinct features include rich brown skin, accompanied by a luxuriant, bushy beard that frames his countenance. His piercing blue eyes exude an air of determination. Adorning his form, he dons a resplendent ensemble: a pointed, earth-toned hat embellished with perched goggles atop, while a regal purple shirt, embellished with fur pelts at the sides, graces his upper body. A cloth of complementary hue conceals his waist, and sturdy brown boots complete his ensemble with finesse.
Personality: Despite his seemingly gentle exterior, Kaijin is, in fact, an exceedingly prudent and wise elder. His dedication knows no bounds, as he diligently contributes to Rimuru's ambitious undertakings without a hint of complaint. Confident in his blacksmithing prowess, he remains resolute and unwavering. An affinity for his craft is evident in his animated discussions with fellow blacksmiths likeKurobe, engaging in protracted conversations about weaponry and related matters.

Kaijin's character possesses intriguing facets, including a playful and slightly mischievous side. His mischievous tendencies are unveiled through his consideration of constructing a mixed-gender bath with an ulterior motive of voyeurism, an idea promptly quashed byShunaand other females. He also partakes in recreational activities like visiting an elven hostess bar, exemplifying his inclination to relish life's pleasures.

However, one of his most commendable traits is his commitment to honoring his promises. This virtue becomes evident in his pact with Rimuru to contribute to the village's establishment, contingent upon crafting ten magical swords within a specified timeframe. Even in the face of adversity, such as when he was unjustly blamed for the artificial magic soldier project's failure—a responsibility that rightfully lay with Vesta—he never harbored resentment. Despite being removed from the Dwarven Engineering Corps, he bore no grudges.

Furthermore, his protective nature over his friends shines brightly. His fierce reaction to insults thrown at his comrades was evidenced when he confronted Vesta after the latter disrespected Rimuru. This protective streak showcased his willingness to stand up for those he cares about, regardless of rank or authority.
Background: Kaijin was born a commoner but thanks to having made it up to the position of a commanding officer, he was granted the status of a semi-baron. He eventually joined the Dwarven Engineer Corps alongside Vesta, with the two being bitter rivals since their time in the military. This relationship continued even when as fellow researchers.

Without having produced a single technological innovation, the dwarven engineer corps were resigned to being the least evaluated corps. The engineer corps was split into two factions, Vesta's and Kaijin's. Vesta's faction insisted that considering that their country is the founding nation of technology, the engineer corps should be the star of the knight order. Kaijin's faction refuted, instead advocating that they should steadily advance their research, as they had done up till then. The arguments of both sides only resulted in a clashing of opinions, and their meetings never ended in a conclusion.

And it was during that period of struggles, that one elf engineer had initiated a joint development plan that was named, the "Magic Soldier" project. Vesta had wanted to make that project succeed no matter the cost, all in order to redeem the honor of the engineer corps once and for all. Although Kaijin had pointed out that Vesta was being too impatient, he had paid no heed at all, because the warning was given by a superior of commoner's descent. At that time, only the best engineers had assembled to participate in the project. But as a result of his over-eagerness, Vesta caused the rampage of the "enchanted soulstone," and the project was brought to a standstill. And it was in this way, that the "Magic Soldier" project met its demise.

At the end of the day, Kaijin was the one to take full responsibility for that failure and was forced to leave the army. This was because Vesta, on top of pushing all blame onto Kaijin, had even bribed the upper echelons of the army to prepare false evidence.

Kaijin and his company were reluctantly banished from Dwargon by Dwarf KingGazel. That happened after his altercation with Vesta, who had insulted the newcomer slime Rimuru, an honored guest and savior of his compatriots. In truth, however, he wanted to work under Rimuru as his expert blacksmith in the growing nation of Tempest rather than face Vesta again. It was thanks to him and the other dwarves with him that Tempest became a proper civilization.

Lizardman.summary: Lizardmen live anywhere from 50 to 70 years on average.[1]

Summary: Lizardmen live anywhere from 50 to 70 years on average.[1]
Appearance: Overall, Lizardmen resemble anthropomorphic lizards, including a lizardlike head and tail. They have scaly skin that exhibits a range of shades of green, which varies among individuals and is often inherited from their parents. Their scales are tough enough to provide them with physical protection.

Lizardmen also have webbed feet that enable them to navigate through marshes and swamps with exceptional speed and agility. This adaptation allows them to move more efficiently than other races in these challenging terrains, granting them a distinct advantage when maneuvering through muddy or watery environments.

Interestingly, some Lizardmen display a peculiar trait of growing hair. While uncommon among their kind, these individuals exhibit tufts of hair that can be seen in various lengths and styles. This unexpected feature adds further diversity to their appearances and reflects the subtle variations within the Lizardmen population.
Lifestyle: The Lizardmen live off the lake's fish, they have an abundance of food. They make use of windows designed withmagicto light their houses.
Abilities: The Lizardmen, known for their carnivorous nature, possess a diverse range of combat abilities. On an individual basis, they are typically classified as C+ in terms of their combat proficiency. However, their skilled warriors have the potential to attain a higher ranking of B-, and there are exceptional individuals among them who can even achieve a formidable B-rank status.

One notable advantage the Lizardmen possess is their exceptional maneuverability, particularly in muddy or swampy terrains. They have developed remarkable agility and adaptability, allowing them to navigate these challenging environments with ease. This mobility gives them a significant advantage when engaging in battles or traversing their natural habitat.

In terms of their overall battle prowess, the Lizardmen's abilities are highly regarded. When they effectively coordinate and fight as a unified force, they can rival the military might of a small human nation. With a total troop count of ten thousand, which constitutes half of their entire population when mobilized for war, they pose a formidable threat to their adversaries.
