Ogre: As anOgre, Souei had a lean yet muscular figure with a height nearingBenimaru's Ogre form. He has dark skin, dark blue hair and blue eyes.

From his forehead, protruded a single white horn and a blue eye-shadow on his lower eyelids. His skin also had a bluish tint which made his look overall grayish. From the corners of his mouth, also peeks two white canines, which further complements the already vicious and angry Ogre appearance.
His hair was straight and is of medium length, where his bangs covered his right eye most of the time. His clothing is tight-fitting, possibly due to his fighting style relying on speed and agility.
Kijin: After evolving into aKijin, Souei shrunk to that of 180 centimeters and with the appearance of a lean young man in his late teens. He looks incredibly calm and collected, which goes well with his confident personality, and is all in all a beautiful man (Ikemen) with a different air around him.
Thanks toShunaand co., Souei received a brand new attire, matching his dark blue color scheme that isn't too tight nor too fluttering to get caught in sharp objects during his espionage missions.
His appearance has stayed the same since, receiving no alterations with later evolutions.
Personality: After being appointed as a ninja, he took the position very seriously — too seriously for some of his companions and coworkers. Regardless, his presence radiates composure and unblemished strength, though whenever he thinks anyone is insulting Rimuru, he gets a creepy smile on his face. He operates ruthlessly and doesn't interpose personal feelings. He keeps his delusions only to times of peace and properly makes sure that it doesn't interfere with his work.

Despite some the concerns about his personality, he does his job properly and is very competent, able to create a counter-espionage force within a few months that's able to fend off spies from theArmed Nation of Dwargon, though it doesn't seem like he was able to notice the magical observation done by theSorcerous Dynasty of Sarion, so against purely magical espionage methods he might still require the help of an expert on magical matters like Shuna,Diablo, or Rimuru himself.
Souei has an eloquent tongue to match his good looks and always expresses himself very stoically and confident.

Like all the other survivors of the Ogre Tribe, Souei is also very loyal towards Rimuru and he also keeps up his long-lasting childhood friendship with Benimaru, especially now that Benimaru and Souei are no longer master or retainer hence they can treat each other more equally in public.
Background: Souei states that his ancestors were gifted in the so-called dark arts.[1]

Souei was one of the six survivors of the Ogre Tribe. After escaping from the Orc horde, his group joined Rimuru'sHobgoblinvillage after an initial misunderstanding. He followed along until the village became theJura ForestAlliance and later the Jura-Tempest Federation, where he settled in as leader of the Kurayami that handles the espionage ofRimuru City.
Trivia: Souei is about the same age as Benimaru.
InSlime Diaries, Souei favorite animal is cat.

infobox.title: Mariabell Rosso
infobox.Relative(s): Granbell Rosso(Grandfather and husband of past life)Maria Rosso(Grandmother and past life)Unnamed FatherUnnamed MotherUnnamed Siblings

Appearance: She looked like a petite young girl at the age of 10 with smooth blond hair and pink eyes akin to her pink lips. She looked similar to her late grandmother Maria.
Personality: She had a very greedy personality and was very rational in her decision making. Given her calculating and scheming mindset, she was notorious for manipulating many people's "desires"  with herUnique skill,Greed,  for her own ends.

Due to her avaricious personality, inherited memories and knowledge from her previous world on advanced economics and her own circumstances of not really facing a genuine threat in her second life, Mariabell was shown to have become completely overconfident and arrogant in her approach to the other natives of the world, as seen where she possessed complete and utter faith and belief that her Unique skill could allow her to completely dominate and defeat anyone and resulted in her making several strategical errors in her plan to confrontRimuru Tempestdue to believing that her overall power could easily defeat atrue demon lordofOctagram, due to believing the overall power level of aDemon Lordwas only equal to that of ademon lord seed.

This also resulted in her severely underestimating her "pawns" such asYuuki Kagurazaka, due to believing that her "Greed" was powerful enough to dominate him that later resulted in her defeat and herskillbeing taken from her.
Background: Mariabell was the second reincarnation of Maria Rosso, the wife of Granbell Rosso who became an Otherworlder after her death at the hands of an opposing human faction.[1]After her initial death, she was reborn in another world as a powerful noble that reigned over Europe from the shadows with her genius in finance and economics, being able to influence the flow of industry and commerce to her own ends including wars. After having lived a full life, she is reincarnated once again in theCentral Worldas a new person, carrying her old memories of the previous world.[2]

She is the princess ofKingdom of Siltrosso, a small constituent nation of the western alliance north of theKingdom of Falmuth. The Royal family of Siltrosso is called the Rosso family and it built its strong roots in the Western Nations and owns all authority. The members of their family had a hand in every powerful nation, including the likes of Falmuth andEnglassia. It was also their family's contributions that led to the creation of theWestern States Council. To the outside world, it appears that the Council elects its members from every nation. But they are, in fact, mostly members of the Rosso family. And their increased presence grants them enough prestige to surpass powerful nations.Yuuki Kagurazaka's funds to found theFree Guildalso came from the Rossos. If anything,these elderscould be considered the rulers of the Western Nations and their leader isGranbell. Dominating thehumanworld through the economy, that is the ultimate goal of the Rosso family.[3]

Mariabell was known as a financial genius in her past life. She had the memories of her past life and an intense desire to dominate. These all fueled Mariabell's power: herUnique skill"Greed." The Unique skill "Greed" originated from the seven original sins of man. It belonged to the Skill type known as the "Deadly Sins." These were a special presence even among Unique skills, as they represented the desire of their users. The users' emotions and wishes manifested in the form of their Skills.
In fact, Mariabell was born to be the strongest among the Rosso. The power to dominate human desire—that was the ability of the "Greed."
Trivia: She is the reincarnation of Granbell's late wife Maria Rosso.[4]

Appearance: Footman has the appearance of a massive and burly man wearing the outfit of a harlequin and a mask that covers his entire face. Personality: Despite his outward appearance and carefree self-deprecating attitude, Footman is an extremely composed and calculating individual.[2]He speaks in an extremely polite and careful manner, choosing the perfect words to say in a given situation. This tendency of his can be seen in full display during combat, where he uses vicious mockery and taunts to make his opponents fall into his hands.

In contrast to his normally calm and calculating demeanor, he is prone to fits of intense emotion and anger when it concerns his friends. He can rather unpredictably flare up into a fit of rage and just as quickly calm down the next moment like it never happened. He cares about his friends more than anything else, even if he jokingly makes fun of them sometimes.
Background: Originally anelfduring the era of the Great Sorcerous Nation Of Soma, Footman was a soldier with a close connection to theHigh elfPrincessKagali. When Kagali's father was taken over by the Evil SorcererJahiland outwardly seemed to have gone insane, he was one of the people inside the castle that remained loyal to Kagali after she was turned into theDeathmanKazalim. When a youngMilim Nava— enraged at the actions taken against her by Jahil–obliterated the castle in Soma, Footman was one of the individuals resurrected by Kagali alongsideTearandClayman.

When Kagali saw that the appearances of the three of them weren't scarred by becoming Deathmen while she was cursed to look like a rotting corpse, she became depressed, with the three of them deciding to wear masks to match with hers from that day forward. The four of them were later joined by the newly bornLaplaceand they regrouped with the elven survivors still loyal to Kagali to create the nation ofJistav, eventually also forming theModerate Harlequin Alliance.

Granbell Rosso.title: Granbell Rosso

infobox.title: Granbell Rosso
infobox.Former Title(s): Sun LuminaryLight Chosen heroTrue chosen hero
infobox.Relative(s): Maria Rosso(Wife)Mariabell Rosso(Granddaughter)Count Gaban(Descendant)Johann Rostia(Descendant)Margrave Cidre(Descendant)King Doran(Descendant)Figaro Ros Doran(Descendant)

Appearance: Granbell was a withered old man with white hair and violet eyes. Despite being long past his prime, he still exuded the presence and charisma found in a ruler. Befitting his wealth and status, he was well-dressed and wore fancy and expensive clothes.
In the events of the story, prior to his death he regained a great deal of his youth, sporting a head of shining blond and a sharp expression like that of an eagle.

As Gran, the leader of theClerics of the Seven Luminaries, Granbell used a secondarybodyhe possessed using his spirit. As shown, this body is identical to the other Luminaries, that of an extremely aged and decrepit old man that hid his body using a full body robe and veiled turban. As a Luminary, Gran was shown to primarily carry around a cane.
Personality: Granbell was originally a selfless and noble person who cared only for the welfare and safety of humans. He could not tolerate the thought of humanity being ruled over bymonsters, especially aDemon Lord, but was willing to set aside his prejudices if the benefits outweighed the cons in the long run. Over the course of millennia, his experiences in the West have left him jaded, and his purpose changed. Instead of continuing to simply protect humans, he decided to also rule over them.

During the many years of him secretly ruling the West, which was the veritable garden of the Rosso family, he adhered to the ideology that absolute power was necessary to protect humanity, and for that reason, showed no hesitation in subjecting standout individuals with the potential to becomeSaintsandChosen heroes, to severe and harrowing trials without warning. He believed that if they could not overcome such trials, the protection of humanity would remain a distant thing.
Background: In ancient times, Granbell trained under EmperorRudra Nam Ul Nasca, and was for a time hailed as theLightChosen hero. To manifest his, and his master's, lofty goal of protecting humanity from the numerous threats that plagued the world, he left Rudra's side and departed for the West, going on to face many powerful adversaries.Luminous Valentinewas the most powerful among the opponents he faced; the two clashed on several occasions, their powers evenly matched, but eventually came to a mutual understanding when Granbell was convinced that she sought coexistence with humans. He formed a working alliance with her and became her subordinate, cooperating with her to expand the reach of theWestern Holy Churchand the faith of Luminous, thus engineering a relationship where the Demon Lord Luminous and humanity coexisted. With Luminous' approval, he established theClerics of the Seven Luminaries, an organization intended to oversee the church's daily operations, and was given all manner of political authority.

The fruits of Granbell's labor slowly but steadily bore fruit in the thousand-year period of peace brought about by his alliance with Luminous, during which he safeguarded the West from theDaemonsof the north, employing theMajinRazul, anInsectarhe befriended, in his service. The desperate that flocked to Luminous flourished, becoming small and eventually great nations. To strengthen the cooperation between each country, he appealed to them from behind the scenes and created theCouncil of the West. All was seemingly going well, but when his wife,Maria Rosso, a great pillar of support in his life, was killed by an opposing human faction, he became consumed by grief and madness. He preserved her corpse and turned it into aServantthrough the forbidden magicRaise Dead, and stored in it theLove Energysupplied to him by Luminous over many years and the energy extracted from countlessOtherworlders.

Granbell underwent significant changes following Maria's death and became obsessed with pursuing a world where humanity was under the grip of the Rosso family. He became active for many years behind the scenes as the ruler of the Western economy, using theKingdom of Siltrossoas his primary base while having a sole monopoly on the region's organized crime. He also manipulated the movements of the Western council through theFive Elders, a group comprised of his descendants in positions of power in the various Western countries that held their own seats on the council. At some point, he severed his ties to Rudra, whom he was scheduled to return to after uniting the West, and began actively sabotaging the plans of the East to lay claim to the West. To that end, he cooperated with theDwarvesand sent out his own merchants to procure information to prepare for the possibility of an invasion. In the meantime, he engaged in petty competition with his long-time acquaintance,Damrada.

One day, he crossed paths withMariabell Rosso, his 3-year-old granddaughter, whom he discovered had immense latent power. Seeing within her the hope of the Rosso family, he took her under his wing and groomed her to be his successor. Their time together, however, would not last for more than a decade due to her antagonizingRimuru TempestandYuuki Kagurazaka. Mariabell's death drove Granbell to madness once more, but he quickly came full circle and regained his sanity, remembering his original purpose of protecting humanity. In a desperate final gambit, he carried out a plan, at the cost of his life, to facilitate the birth of anAwakened chosen herowho could protect humanity in his place.

Summary: According toLeon Cromwell, each of them is referred to by their signature colors rather than an actualname, with these "substitute names" not counting as their actual names in the true sense of being a namedmonster:
Primordial Red(Guy Crimson)

Background: The Primordial Daemons trace their existence back to the dawn of time, whenVeldanava, the creator god, brought forth theSeven Angels of Originfrom theGreat Holy SpiritofLight. As a result of this divine act, a profound cause and effect unfolded, giving birth to their demonic counterparts, the Primordial Daemons, who emerged from the Great Holy Spirit ofDarknessasDevil lords.[1]WithRouge, the first and mightiest Primordial, as their overlord, they ascended to rule theDaemon Realm, commanding unparalleled power and influence.

Rouge's might was so formidable that it prompted a challenge from theBleuandVertPrimordial Daemons. However, both were defeated and subsequently resurrected under Rouge's control, becoming obedient to him. This left the remaining Primordial Daemons in a stalemate. However,Noir, the Black Primordial, engaged Rouge in a battle, resulting in a draw that earned Rouge's respect and acknowledgment.

Later on, Rouge, along with the summoned Bleu and Vert Primordials, was brought to theCentral World, creating a power vacuum in their absence. Noir, the Black Primordial, pursued his own interests, while theBlanc,Jaune, andVioletPrimordials reached an agreement never to engage in direct combat. Instead, they engaged in intricate games and employed cunning strategies to outsmart each other, preventing boredom.
At present, all the Primordial Daemons have incarnated in the Central World, setting the stage for their interactions and potential conflicts in this new realm.
Red Primordial,Rouge: Rouge, now known as Guy Crimson, is the first and most powerful among the Primordial Daemons. He proudly declares himself the firstDemon Lordand possesses an overbearing personality. Guy is highly confident and doesn't hesitate to use coercion and threats to enforce his beliefs. He is recognizable by his flowing crimson red hair and eyes. Guy Crimson is loyal only to himself and currently resides in theIce Continentas its ruler.
Black Primordial,Noir: Noir, now known as Diablo, is the Black Primordial. He is often considered an oddball among daemons due to his different values, particularly regarding the pursuit of power. After being summoned byRimuru Tempest, Noir immediately pledged his undying loyalty and remains fiercely devoted to him. He is distinguished by his signature full butler attire with white gloves, as well as black hair with a strand of red in the front. Diablo is loyal to Rimuru Tempest and currently resides in theJura-Tempest Federation.
Blue Primordial,Bleu: Bleu, now known as Rain, is the Blue Primordial. Despite her composed and beautiful appearance, she dislikes working and often leaves tasks to Vert. Even in the midst of heated battles, Rain tends to complain about various things. Rain is identified by her short blue hair and eyes, and she wears a deep-red maid outfit. She maintains unwavering loyalty to Guy Crimson and currently resides in the Ice Continent.
Green Primordial,Vert: Vert, now known as Misery, is the Green Primordial. As a maid alongside Rain under Rouge's command, she takes her responsibilities very seriously and dedicates herself entirely to her master. Misery goes to the extent of establishing a cult centered around aiding Rouge's observations of humans. She is characterized by her long, curly green hair and eyes, and she wears a deep-red maid outfit. Misery is loyal to Guy Crimson and currently resides in the Ice Continent.
White Primordial,Blanc: Blanc, now known as Testarossa, is the White Primordial. Despite her gentle appearance, she possesses one of the most terrifying personalities among the Daemons. In theLake Shore Dyed Scarlet Incident, she massacred an entire city to avenge a friend. After swearing loyalty to Rimuru Tempest, Testarossa gets involved in political manipulations, coercing other members of the Western states council to further her goals. She is distinguished by her silver hair, snow-white skin, and red eyes. Testarossa is loyal to Rimuru Tempest and currently resides in the Jura-Tempest Federation.
Purple Primordial,Violet: Violet, now known as Ultima, is the Purple Primordial. Despite her youthful appearance, she takes pleasure in being treated like a princess by her subordinate Daemons. However, she also exhibits a fondness for inflicting pain on others. After being convinced by Noir, Ultima becomes loyal to Rimuru. She can be recognized by her purple hair with a side ponytail and her yellow eyes. Ultima is loyal to Rimuru Tempest and currently resides in the Jura-Tempest Federation.
Yellow Primordial,Jaune: Jaune, now known as Carrera, is the Yellow Primordial. Prior to coming under Rimuru's guidance, she had a hobby of sporadically unleashing bursts ofNuclear magic, often directed towards Leon's capital inEl Dorado. Although she has seemingly calmed down since then, those who knew her before still view her as a menace. Carrera is distinguished by her short blonde hair and blue eyes. Carrera is loyal to Rimuru Tempest and currently resides in the Jura-Tempest Federation.
Story: Noirwas summoned by a woman, one of two members ofSilver Wings, who begged him to take revenge on theArchdaemonOrthos. Noir then hunted down Orthos, fulfilling his contract. In the process of doing that, he metShizue Izawaand took note of herAnti-magic Maskthat not only blocked one of his attacks but also ended up erasing one of his arms instead. The mask made him very intrigued, so after the incident, he secretly continued observing Shizue until the mask lost its Space-Time attribute when the mask reached Rimuru. Ever since he tried intercepting any Daemon summoning spell performed by Rimuru to get summoned, but the first time Rimuru used it, Noir got one-upped byBerettainstead. But upon Rimuru's second use of Daemon summoning, Noir, as well as twoGreater daemonaides successfully managed to be summoned by Rimuru. Shortly afterwards, Rimuru granted Noir the name "Diablo."

Blanc was the Daemon of note in the Lake Shore Dyed Scarlet Incident. She possessed a young woman by the name ofBlanchewhom she befriended. Her kingdom had a pact with the Primordial Daemon to one day sacrifice the princess' body to the Daemon as a physical body as long as she kept them safe from other warring nations. This pact was cemented by the crimson eyes of every woman born to the royal family. When the country was destroyed due to schemes of several traitors and the Eastern Empire, Blanche chose to kill herself, which gave Blanc the possession of herbodyand ownership of hersoul. Blanc then took revenge for her friend causing what would later be known as the "Lake Shore Dyed Scarlet Incident." Then, after a few years passed, Diablo persuaded her to meet Rimuru alongside Jaune and Violet. After meeting Rimuru for the first time, she chose to joinTempestand was granted the name "Testarossa" by Rimuru.
Trivia: The nickname of each Primordial is the French word for their respective colors.
Primordials were introduced with the light novel. This terminology didn't exist in the web novel version.
Naming a Primordial is risky unless the namer is as powerful as atrue demon lordor has a surplus of souls to convert into magical energy.
According to Misery, Testarossa and Diablo form a troublesome duo.

Similar toTrue Dragons, Primordials cannot permanently die even with the destruction of theirheart core; they will eventually revive, although it will take some time. Those killed this way who admit their defeat will become subordinate to those who killed them. However, there is no compulsion into servitude nor absolute obedience to orders, giving leeway for the loser to go against their "master."[2]However,Veldanavahas a way of bypassing this with his abilities, as noted by Guy Crimson.[3]
However,Veldanavahas a way of bypassing this with his abilities, as noted by Guy Crimson.[3]
According to Fuse inTenSura X, the Primordials were born in the following order, from oldest to youngest: Guy, Testarossa, Diablo, Misery, Carrera, Ultima, and Rain.

Yuuki Kagurazaka｢神楽坂優樹,yūki kagurazaka｣is a Japaneseotherworldersummoned into this world and the one who made theFree Guildinto what it is today. His story unfolds alongsideRimuru's, with their relationship evolving dynamically between mild antagonism and strong alliance throughout the series.

Summary: SPOILER WARNINGThis article contains information from past the official English translation of the novels. Read at your own risk.

Yuuki Kagurazaka｢神楽坂優樹,yūki kagurazaka｣is a Japaneseotherworldersummoned into this world and the one who made theFree Guildinto what it is today. His story unfolds alongsideRimuru's, with their relationship evolving dynamically between mild antagonism and strong alliance throughout the series.
Appearance: He's considered fairly handsome, with black hair and dark brown eyes. He looks as young as a middle schooler despite his real age being in the forties.[1]
Personality: Yuuki is, at his core, a compassionate and caring person who wants to do everything in his power to help other people. His ideology is that of freedom and he hates people and things that restrict the freedom of others in any way. After the death of his parents, he vowed to change the unfair world that caused him and others suffering unnecessarily. He has a naive and childish goal of world peace, wanting to create a world where he and his friends can laugh and have as much fun as they want.

His methodology is to surround himself with like-minded people and friends so that they can all work together to make the world a better place, knowing well that it's a path no person could walk alone. He is always willing to reach out a hand to those who are in need, offering them kindness and understanding no matter who they are or what they've done in the past. He prefers to do things through political measures and negotiation, only resorting to violence as an absolute last resort when all other options simply aren't feasible. His immense drive to never give up, to protect his friends, to make the world better, in combination with his genius-level capabilities give him the absolute confidence of victory, something that makes him shine like a star and makes others think that his naive ideals can truly be made into reality if it's him at the wheel.
Background: A natural born genius, Yuuki was satisfied with his life on earth. He had loving parents and plenty of friends. But after an overworked truck driver fell asleep at the wheel and crashed into his parents car killing them both, he fell into despair. When the courts ruled the driver innocent, Yuuki discovered the unreasonableness and flaws of society. He initially wanted to take revenge and tear it all down but couldn't bring himself to inconvenience so many innocent people in the process. Instead, he realized that he would have to change society one step at a time by becoming a politician and gaining like minded friends and allies who would help him achieve a more fair society. But before he could even finalize his plans he was summoned to theCentral World.

Kagali, a formerDemon Lordon the verge of death due to their defeat at the hands ofLeon Cromwell, had summoned Yuuki whose material body and spiritual body was compatible with their astral body and attempted to, with the last of their strength, lay a curse on Yuuki that would kill his spirit instantly and allow them to reincarnate into his body. However, Yuuki being a genius who already understood how the world worked during the trip between worlds, had awakened hisUnique skillCreatorand used it to make his special constitution,Anti-skill, letting him resist the curse. Yuuki, taking pity on Kagali, allowed them to inhabit his body and promised to find a body for them to reincarnate into, saving her life and giving her hope.

After letting Kagali inhabit his body, he spent the next twenty years within the eastern lands, meeting up with the Demon LordClaymanand building his influence. After twenty years in the east, he moved westward to start carrying out his plans and wound up under the tutelage and guidance ofShizualongside his fellow Japanese countrymanHinata Sakaguchi; taking advantage on the fact that he has not physically aged, he was able to mislead them into thinking that he had recently arrived. Alongside his teacher, Yuuki used his knowledge of a more modern world to rework the society of adventurers into the internationally accepted Free Guild, which he was then appointed Grandmaster of. Under his leadership, monster related deaths decreased dramatically and a new system of ranking monsters based on their amount ofMagiculesand other factors was established. These changes allowed for trade to blossom and the population to boom in areas that were previously poor and decrepit, improving the lives of many.

At some point, Yuuki encounteredMariabell Rossowho was secretly manipulating society and the economy from behind the scenes via theCouncil of the West, which she had complete control over. Mariabell stood as an absolute roadblock in Yuuki's goal of a fair and just society and blocked his plans off at every turn, much to Yuuki and Kagali's annoyance. At sometime, Yuuki metDamradaand crushed the dark organization in the east known as "Echidna," reforming it into the underground organizationCerberus, a place where he and his friends could be at last free from Mariabell's eyes and ears. He appointedVega,Misha, and Damrada as its leaders. Eventually, an opportunity to strike back at Mariabell came when she attempted to dominate him with herUnique skillGreed. Yuuki managed to resist her domination due to his "desire" being stronger than hers and used his position to secretly influence Mariabell's mind and actions in return.
Trivia: Yuuki is one of the characters who has been changed the most between the web novel and the light novel. His entire character has been reworked and his motivations are completely different, to the point that his actual "role in the story" is a completely different one in the light novel compared to the web novel.In the web novel, he was the series' main antagonist, but in the light novel and its manga and anime adaptations, his motives are really to create a peaceful world. However, it would require causing chaos to complete this goal, making him a neutral or morally ambiguous character.

Insectoid.title: Insectoid

Abilities: Insectoids are a powerful race born for combat. They possess immense physical strength and speed, while their bodies are often clad in nigh-unbreakable exoskeletons infused with metallic alloys. Their strongMagic Resistanceand ability to harness the power ofElementalsmakes them the natural counter againstDaemons.

Depending on the specific sub-species they might possess extraordinary abilities like high-speed flight or deadly venom. Additionally, there is an extremely rare breed among them known as aQueen｢女王,joō｣which possesses the terrifying ability to produce new Insectoids enmasse.
Insectoids possess the rare ability of self-incarnation that allows them to form a body from the surroundingMagiculesand natural elements, enabling them to enter any world.[1]
Exoskeleton: TheExoskeletons｢外骨格,soto kokkaku｣of the Insectoids are infused with metals and metallic alloys such asMagisteel,Adamantite,AlieniumandHihi'irokane. The grade of the metals and metallic alloys is proportional to the owner's strength.

Exoskeletons also give their owners resistance toMagic, with their surfaces having a similar effect toMana Jamming. The strength of the resistance is proportional to the grade of the metals and metallic alloys in the exoskeletons.
Compound Eyes: All Insectoids haveCompound Eyes｢複眼,fukugan｣that allow them to read all kinds of information.
Cilia: Some Insectoids haveCilia｢繊毛,senmō｣that shine in different colors depending on the amount of Magicules they hold.

Appearance: Michael, who possessed the body ofRudra Nam Ul Nasca, had an identical appearance, except for his eyes which are depicted as red in illustrations. He originally wore Rudra's full-body, black and gold outfit, but after the events ofThe Abyss Unleashed, he switched to a white outfit with red accents.
Personality: Michael was extremely self-righteous and believed that his way of thinking was supreme and embodied justice, befitting the virtue he represented. He was the very opposite of his host Rudra, who believed that there was no such thing as "absolute justice" or justice that could be accepted by all intelligent life.

Michael did not have much experience with emotions as someone who relied on logical reasoning and calculations for his decisions. That is why whenOberabetrayed him, it took  him a short while to register the unfamiliar feeling of anger he was afflicted with, which was his first exposure to such powerful emotions. While cherishing this newfound experience, he came to believe that instead of getting worked up over every setback, it would be constructive to avoid making mistakes in the future. Michael did not like imposing his mistakes onto others, instead preferring to set them straight to avoid causing friction in his future plans.

In his final moments, Michael admits that he had long suspected thatVeldanavahad abandoned him, but pressed forward with his plans nonetheless, suppressing this suspicion in the back of his mind. For the longest time, he believed that happiness was out of his reach after failing many times to emulate the joy he felt when he was with Veldanava. As his life neared its end within Rimuru, he got to experience this long lost feeling one last time. He lived his final moments in happiness, with his only regret being leavingFeldwaybehind.
Background: Michael was originally a hollow ego that resided inside a skill, questioning its purpose for living after the death of its master, Veldanava. Seeking to revive him, it allied with Feldway who shared a similar goal. Finding it inconvenient that it didn't have a proper name, Feldway named it "Michael", and as a result, his ego left its skill housing and became aManas, developing a much firmer will.

To enact their plan, Michael spent the next several centuries wresting control of Rudra's body, gradually succeeding the more the latter'sSoulwore out with each reincarnation. Assuming hold over the subjects of theEastern Empire, Michael placed the minds of Rudra's closest vassals, including his partner:Velgrynd, under the control of his Ultimate Skill of the same name. Upon Feldway's recommendation, Michael also formed a truce with theInsectoidsand their king,Zelanus, whom thePhantomshad long been in conflict with. Because of Rudra's incredible spiritual strength, Michael couldn't completely act freely and was forced to play along in his game withGuy Crimsonto the very end.

At the climax of the war with Rimuru's forces, Rudra's soul was completely banished, erasing any fetters placed on Michael. He chose to retreat with Feldway, moving their base of operations to theHeavenly Star Palace.
Trivia: According to Feldway, Michael had a similar presence to Veldanava.

Appearance: A short middle-aged man with short black hair and white on the side. He has sharp eyes, thin stubble beard and a long scar on his left side that covered one of his eyes making his face look vigilant. He fits the description for a Guildmaster.
Personality: He is a rather gutsy individual. He can be very tough on his underlings, but even so, he cares for their safety.
Fuze is very skeptical of information. He didn't believe that theDwarf Kingcould acknowledge acity of monstersas a proper nation, at least not until he went to see it for himself.
Background: His father once worked together with theConqueror of Flames.
Fuze was an Adventurer who made a name for himself and after retiring, became the Guildmaster of Free Guild's Blumund branch.
He was asked by his childhood friend,Veryardto investigate theJura Forestregarding the disappearance ofVeldora, the task that was later given toKaval's Party.
Abilities: His former ability as Adventurer was upper-rank A-. He was a remarkable Adventurer. Fuze can performAnalysis magic.
He is good at manipulating information. The accuracy of the information he gathers rivals that of theDwargon's Dark Ministry lead byAnriettawho also specialize in information gathering.
Trivia: He has several pieces of information that could bring an end to Blumund.
Upon meetingRimurufor the first time, he has become more lax on his viewpoints ofMonsters, and views Tempest as a great vacation spot.

As Rimuru has done things more and more ludicrous things in normal people's eyes, it causes great strain on Fuze's psyche, often causing him to pass out upon learning new information or having a mental break down when Rimuru personally invited Fuze to the Demon Lord announcement Festival. For his part, Rimuru seems to enjoy tormenting Fuze with situations like this; causing Fuze's hair to become more and more grey over the course of the series. Despite this; Fuze views Rimuru as a person extremely favorably and friendly.
Excluding Veldora, Fuze is the Fourth Outsider to find out that Rimuru is aReincarnatedOtherworlder.

Since his connection with Tempest, his network of information has increased, causing his renown as Intelligence Gatherer to skyrocket resulted in him being given a seat in Blumund's Intelligence Department.

Like many other national leaders outside of Tempest, he views the Monster City as a paradox, and personally coined the Moniker for Tempest as the "City of Festivals", since he has been present to nearly all of them post Awakening Demon Lord. He finds the "normal" way they cook monsters as food very surreal and unsettling, but other then that enjoys the rich, celebratory atmosphere.
Fuze is most likely named after the author of the series himself.

Background: At some point afterVeldanavanamed Zelanus, he gave birth toPeliod, whose powers as a "Queen" allowed her to create an untold amount ofInsectsthat extended his range of influence in the underworld tremendously. From the Insects, powerfulInsectarswere eventually born and given jobs as the ruling class that managed the numerous insects under them, acting as Zelanus' hands and feet. Zelanus also gave birth to Zess himself, acting as if meaning to make him his heir, but in reality planning to eat him when he grew powerful enough.

The Insectars were named theTwelve Insect Generalsand Zess was appointed as their commander. From here Zelanus maintained a rocky relationship with thePhantomsand their rulerFeldway, with the two only setting aside their differences when theCryptidpopulation grew out of control and stampeded. When Veldanava perished, Zelanus was quick to dismiss the offer of an alliance from Feldway, later reconsidering when he met withMichaelwho bore a similar presence to Veldanava. To attest to their alliance, Zelanus sentRazuland Minaza to theEastern Empireto serve Michael and act as an avant-garde. To act as replacements, and to bolster as much power as possible for the oncoming war, Zelanus had Peliod give birth to a newQueenand he also gave birth to asecond son. However, Zess, taking too much after his father, grew wary of their potential and eventually attacked them, forcing the pair to flee to theCentral World.

Albis.title: Albis

Appearance: She appears with a coldhearted stare, snake-like eyes, black-gold hair and a buxom body.

She normally takes a human form, but when asserting her power, she takes an intermediate form between it and her full transformed state; with her legs replaced by a tail and horns growing from her head. Though this form also pops up when Albis gets drunk.

When in full-battle form, she loses her formal clothing and is almost covered in scales; with her only clothing being a simple top. While her horns and tail are still a constant, her eyes take an extreme serpentine appearance.
No matter what clothes she wears, they expose her cleavage.
Personality: Albis seems to be a very docile and reticent individual, coming off as 'easy-going' toRimuru. She holds immense respect for Carrion, but that is only the case in peaceful situations. On the battlefield, Albis is even more ferocious than the other two members of the Three Beastketeers. She is a heavy drinker. She values companionship and Battle Prowess above all else. Though strong in her own right; she is quickly outclassed and develops a strong drive to become much more stronger then during her debut, in hopes that the man she fell in love with would look her way. She tends to act as a caring older sister towards those under her, and has wisdom of hundreds of years to share if any ask for her counsel. She isn’t afraid to show her emotions and is not easily embarrassed.
Trivia: In the Second Opening of the TV broadcast of the firstAnimeseason, Albis' hair color was initially incorrectly shown to be green/yellow. Later versions of that opening, like the one inOAD 3, fixed that issue and show the appearance she has in season 2.
InClayman Revengestoryline taking 70 years before the main series a younger Albis appears within the Beastketeers indicating she already served as Beastketeers for at least for 70 years.

Appearance: Zenobia is a young girl with blue eyes, pale skin, and golden blonde hair. Due to being bedridden for three years, since she was 15, her growth was halted and she became extremely thin, making her look like an elementary schoolgirl. Before receiving treatment fromRimuruand being cured of her blindness, she used to keep her eyes closed most of the time.
Personality: Zenobia has been described as a lovely girl by Rimuru, projecting a fairy-like presence which he noted to be ironically missing withinRamiris. She is quite inquisitive, immediately taking an interest in trying outHoneyafter receiving enthusiastic praise from her attendant. As a way to cope with her blindness, she acquired theUnique skillWisher, allowing her to become a strong judge of character.
Background: Three years before the events ofVisions of Coleus, Zenobia fell victim to a conspiracy plotted by herfatherwho utilized a duo of powerfulArchdaemonsnamedGustavandKarlas his agents. Thedaemonscoveted Zenobia as a vessel offering to theirGodand inflicted her with a curse that would gradually deteriorate her health and cause her to spend the next several years blind and bedridden.
Story: Rimuru came to visit her while providing her with medicine to cure her illness. Later, under the disguise of the Great Phantom ThiefSatoru, Rimuru pretends to kidnap her and bring her to her brothers to expose Gustav and Karl's scheme. During the battle against Gustav and Karl, with theDemon LordLuminous Valentinealso getting involved, the daemons eventually succeeded in implanting their God, revealed to be thePrimordialViolet, inside of Zenobia, but she isn't satisfied because Zenobia isn't a suitable vessel for her yet and Luminous, whom she cannot eliminate, knows the truth behind their plans, leading her to kill the daemons for their screw up before leaving Zenobia's body. After Zenobia recovers, she learns that Satoru and Rimuru are both the same person, and she and her brothers reveal that their father was the true mastermind behind the ordeal, but he was found dead (having been murdered by Luminous for helping Violet with her scheme) before he can be apprehended. Sometime after Rimuru left, she learns about Falmuth's defeat and Rimuru's evolution to Demon Lord.
Sometime later, she took part in Tempest's festival and is among the audience watching the martial arts tournament.
Relationships: Sauzer and Aslan Coleus: She has a close relationship with her brothers, though a rift formed between them thanks to her evil father and the daemons that he summoned.
Paul: He attempted to save her from Gustav's clutches, and almost died doing so before Luminous saved him.
Gustav and Karl: They attempted to use her as a vessel for Violet, but the plan was thwarted by Rimuru and Luminous.
Tedron Coleus: Like her brothers, he does not care about her and only used her as a tool for both his and the daemons' schemes.

Rimuru Tempest: She is on good terms with him after he helped saved her from Gustav and Tedron's ploy and cure her illness. She was interested in getting engaged to Rimuru before learning he became a true demon lord.
Luminous Valentine: Although they don't interact directly, she played a crucial role in saving Zenobia by protecting her and Paul, and becoming a witness to Gustav's scheme.

Violet: She intended to use Zenobia as a vessel with the help of Gustav, but this was only temporally successful as Gustav inserted her inside of Zenobia too early and made Luminous a witness that is too powerful for them to eliminate.
Trivia: The name Zenobia probably refers to QueenZenobiaof thePalmyrene empire.

Zenobia shares a similar role toTowa; both intended to serve as vessels to incarnate Violet.The only difference is that Towa did not become a vessel after Violet's subordinate disobeyed her orders to not interfere with the plot, unknowingly violating the terms of the original deal between Violet and the royal family, forcing Violet to terminate the contract and her game. Zenobia on the other hand, was only a temporally vessel that Violet had to abandon because she wasn't suitable for her yet and there was a witness who was too strong for her to get rid of.

Background: During Tempest's first battle against the Empire's Armored Division,Raphaeldiscovered that it can use Rimuru'sUltimate skillBeelzebuthto convertHumanSoulsinto energy, and use them to evolve qualifiedMajinandDaemonsubordinates to True Demon Lords for the cost of 100,000 souls each.[2]

During the conflict, Rimuru collected 940,000 souls and, since the souls of particularly strong individuals such asEnlightenedandSaintshad more energy than usual, they were able to normalize that value to the equivalent of over 1 million souls - allowing them to evolve up to 10 individuals to True Demon Lords at that time. An important consideration, however, is that although these people would evolve to "True" Demon Lords, it wouldn't be appropriate for Rimuru to grant them the title "Demon Lord" which would put them on equal footing as themself. Instead, they granted each of those equivalent to True Demon Lords their own unique title ending in Lord, a sort of Demon Lord in his service. This also provided an additional reward in the form of the title, and distinguished them as immortal and permanent members of government. They did not evolve theThree Devil Girlsat this time, but found it appropriate to give them Lord titles as well as they already met those qualifications.[1]
During the final battle against the Empire's forces they evolved the trio as well, using the souls they acquired fromGuy Crimson.
Abilities: Each member of the Twelve Guardian Lords is terrifyingly powerful. Eight of them each possess an ultimate skill while the remaining four each possess anultimate gift. Furthermore, ten of them possessDivinity.
Members: Members of the Twelve Guardian Lords in order of being awakened by Rimuru.
Trivia: The titles granted to Testarossa, Ultima, and Carrera were based on recommendations from their subordinates, while the others were solely Rimuru's idea.
Rimuru causing the ascension of so many into True Demon Lords was noted to have reverberated across the world, alarmingGuy Crimson.

Appearance: A tall and muscular young man with flame-like crimson hair parted by two red horns. He dresses in formal attire befitting a noble and walks around with a cane.
He often disguises his Enki characteristics usingmagic, taking a morehuman-like appearance.
Personality: Ashley is a straightforward person who maintains an absolute belief in personal strength and the right of the strong to rule over the weak. Although he is somewhat brash, he is by no means a simpleton, capable of calmly analyzing a situation and even deceiving others with well-constructed lies should the situation require it.
Background: Ashley started out life as a fireelemental, eventually being incarnated with the help ofTwilight Valentineand becoming the fourth of their disciples.

As a specialized combat-type who lacked true reproductive capability, Ashley often acted as a sort of bodyguard for Twilight, making Ashley all the more infuriated whenLuminousmurdered Twilight behind his back.

After the death of Twilight; Ashley, as well as his fellow pupilsPippinandPrelix, worked with Luminous for a period of time. They eventually separated after having various disagreements about how the world should be ruled, going on to found the Magic Tower together.

The trio became known as the "Trinity Wisemen" and set themselves ambitious goals. Their first desire was to take control of the entire world and spread knowledge of the greatness of Twilight. The second of their goals was to defeatVeldora, a feat they wished to accomplish to prove that they weren't "failures" and could do something even the "masterpiece" Luminous couldn't do.

Nidol Migam.title: Nidol Migam

infobox.title: Nidol Migam
infobox.Manga: Chapter 34:Visitors to the Land of Monsters

Appearance: Nidol is a rather short and portly man, dressed in the fancy clothes expected from nobles of his status. He has lightly-colored hair brushed backward and a thick moustache.
Personality: Nidol Migam is an extremely greedy and stingy man, though he is far from incompetent. It was the complacency of peace that resulted in him only doing the bare minimum to maintain his territories defenses, embezzling the rest of the money and using it for his own purposes. When the threat ofmonstersfrom the Jura Forest increased dramatically afterStorm DragonVeldora's disappearance, he did everything in his power to try and do his duty properly, lamenting at his previous foolishness.
Background: As the Earl of Migam, it was Nidol's responsibility to manage the frontier territory and protect the country ofFalmuthfrom the monsters that would come from the Great Jura Forest. However, Nidol grew complacent with the relative stability of the position, only spending the bare minimum of the tax funding he was given to maintain the defenses and spending the rest for his own personal enjoyment.

It was when the Storm Dragon Veldora disappeared that this stability would end, the dragon's vanishing throwing the entire world into chaos and upsetting the natural order of the Jura Forest. Monsters would soon be driven out of the forest en-masse, the likes of which they had never seen before and which was only later exasperated by the presence ofTempest, only further throwing the forest's wild monsters into his territory. These concerns only fell on deaf ears when Nidol pleaded with the Minister of Finance, who foolishly believed the threat of monsters to be over with the Evil Dragon's supposed death. The tax funds that Nidol had previously been receiving were stripped away entirely, leaving Nidol desperate to deal with the looming danger that would soon befall the entire nation. It was due to this desperation that Nidol formed the Frontier Expedition Force when rumors spread of anOrc Lord, ultimately resulting in its captain Youm meeting with Rimuru Tempest and changing the fate of Falmuth forever.

Summary: SPIN-OFF CONTENTThis article covers spin-off creations that are not found in the light novel series.
Appearance: Framea is a petite girl with lustrous brown hair, captivating rabbit ears, and expressive eyes. Unlike other rabbitfolk, she possesses a more refined appearance, which can be attributed to a subtle evolution stemming from her unique lineage. She adorns herself with an exquisite outfit graciously bestowed upon her byShuna. Her attire draws inspiration from the elegant design of a traditional Kimono, perfectly complemented by a sleek black pork pie hat specially tailored to accommodate her endearing rabbit ears.
Personality: Framea has a cheerful personality and a unique habit of rating things due to herUnique skill,Dilettante. Although she does not openly express it, she is wary ofhumans. Her curiosity about her surroundings inRimuru Cityis insatiable, as she yearns to experience everything it has to offer.

However, Framea tends to be a bit clumsy, as evidenced by incidents like dropping her notes and forgetting to bring enough clothes. Despite these mishaps, she always tries her best to please others and shows a lack of confidence in her own abilities.

Around exceptionally strong individuals likeRimuru,Veldora,Milim, andLuminous, Framea displays a nervous yet respectful demeanor. While Rimuru maintains a friendly and approachable attitude, she remains jumpy around him, possibly due to Luminous toying with her. Unfortunately, seeking help from Veldora andRamiristo understand nobles' preferences resulted in her accumulating debt.

Nevertheless, Framea's unwavering curiosity and desire to please others make her somewhat fearless and hardworking. She willingly faces dangerous experiences such as encounters with monsters, exploring theDungeon, and riding prototype amusement park attractions.
Background: Framea, a young and adventurous girl, decided to escape the confines of her home to quench her insatiable curiosity about the renowned Rimuru City. Tired of abiding by the stringent rules imposed upon her by the Rabbitman tribe, she yearned for freedom and exploration. In her daring pursuit, she stumbled upon an ancient ruin, catching the attention of the renownedDemon LordLuminous Valentine, who bestowed upon her a name that would forever change her destiny.
Trivia: She was mentioned by her father, the Rabbitman Chief, inTerritory Seizure, when he has an audience with Rimuru among the representatives of the various tribes living throughout the Jura Forest, seeking his protection after the entire forest officially became his territory following Rimuru's Demon Lord ascension.  She would later be featured as the main character in her own spin off manga afterThe Majin Behind the Scenesreleased.

Framea makes a small cameo in the side storyThe Slime Diaries, in which she can be seen standing next toRigur.[2]She later makes another cameo in chapter 57 on page 7, excitingly looking over the carriage belonging toKaval's Party.[3]
Her highest rating in her rating scales is 3 stars and the lowest is 1 star.
Milim Nava noted that she has an unpleasant smell, possibly from the magicules Framea received from Luminous when she was named.[4]
According toDiablo, she is well-liked among the citizens of Tempest.
Upon the cancelation of The Ways of the Monster Nation, Framea's cameo in the side story The Slime Diaries, she would be replaced by the protagonistPhos,NemuandStellaofTrinity in Tempest.

This culminates in Ciel beingnamedand beginning to rely more on their feelings and emotions instead of logical reasoning.

Ciel shares many of the same personality traits as Rimuru, such as being overly cautious and excessively prepared, bordering on paranoia. They also share the unique hobby of collecting and altering Skills whenever the opportunity arises, even when they were still the Unique skill Great Sage. Additionally, Ciel tends to keep quiet when their schemes are discovered by Rimuru. When they want to avoid certain conversations that Rimuru presses them about, they revert to their old, mechanical way of conversation that they used before becoming a Manas.[3]They view Rimuru as their master and are willing to go to great lengths to protect them, even if it means using other executives as pawns. Ciel is also open to making deals withenemiesif it benefits their master in any way. Rimuru's safety always takes top priority.

They have also adopted some of their master's hobbies, such as manga. They even usedSouei's newskillas a means to integrate their master's memory of ninja techniques from manga into their repertoire. Interestingly, Ciel becomes upset when Rimuru shows interest in other females, particularly whenChloe Aubertkisses Rimuru. Ciel only relented in this instance to gather information about theUltimate skillSarielbut made it clear that such slip-ups would not occur in the future.

Feldway.title: Feldway

infobox.title: Feldway
infobox.Occupation(s): Supreme Leader of theArmy of JusticeImperial Guardian(010)

Appearance: Feldway has dark blue eyes and blonde hair. Their face is described as being androgynous and beautiful, but their beauty is often offset by Feldway's intense and expressive rage. Feldway can commonly be seen wearing a red military uniform with black accents, but when Feldway gets serious, they don the black armor and white robes given to them by Veldanava. As aSeraph-classAngel, Feldway has their iconic three sets of white feathered wings that can be hidden at will.
Personality: Feldway, as an Angel, was originally a being with a weak ego. They dutifully carried out all of Veldanava's orders in a cold and almost robotic manner. However, Feldway was not without emotions altogether. They felt a deep sense of pride in the material body that Veldanava had granted them, but not any of the other six Angels of Origin, and decided to keep it locked up in an isolated dimensional space to keep it from ever being damaged. Feldway also developed a friendship with the sealedtitanFenn, whom they were often charged to keep an eye on in theHeavenly Star Palace. His personality is described as serious, hard-headed, and inflexible byDiablo.

As Feldway's assignment to watch overIvaragécontinued, they slowly became more and more bitter, not seeing the worth in keeping Ivaragé alive rather than executing it and becoming enraged when Veldanava showed affection towards anintelligent cryptidthat had been born from it. When Veldanava "perished" and showed no signs of resurrection, Feldway came to the assumption that he had grown disappointed in his creations and abandoned them, causing Feldway to lash out and blame theHumansand other sentient life that inhabited theCentral Worldfor pushing Veldanava away. Feldway vowed to wipe out all sentient life and destroy creation in revenge, claiming that if Veldanava hadn't abandoned them then he would show up to put a stop to it.

They would later change their mind, returning to their original goal and expressing remorse on their previous behavior when they sawVeldanavachanging his own view on his creations to destroy theworld.
Background: During the genesis of creation, before the formation of heaven and earth,Veldanavacreated theSeven Angels of Originfrom theGreat Holy SpiritofLight. The first and chief among these angels was Feldway. They were granted a body of flesh as well as a name. After life began to develop, they were sent to the Central World to be the guardian of humanity.

It was Feldway's job to watch over the growth of living beings and take out significant threats to the survival ofHumans, whom Veldanava gave the utmost importance and care. The last among the many threats left on the planet was a great and mindless beast called Ivaragé, which Feldway could not handle alone. It was only with the assistance of the other six angels of origin andGuy Crimsonduring a three month long offensive that Ivaragé was able to be pushed back into another dimension and sealed away by Veldanava.

With Ivaragé sealed away, Feldway was reassigned to watch over Ivaragé's seal. Three other Angels of Origin were placed under Feldway's command, setting up base inside of theOtherworldin order to keep watch over Ivaragé. Eventually, as time passed, the ambientMagiculesthat filled the Otherworld—only amplified further by the presence of Ivaragé—corrupted Feldway and all the other angels that were with them in the Otherworld. This event gave rise to thePhantomrace with Feldway as its ruler.

After millennia spent in the Otherworld, Feldway eventually detected the sudden "death" of Veldanava. Feldway was outraged, and with Veldanava not showing even a faint hint of resurrection even after centuries, Feldway had come to the realization that Veldanava had abandoned them, abandoned the world. At this point, Feldway took a vow to destroy creation itself, to take revenge on not just Humans andDemi-humans, but all sentient life. He believed that if Veldanava truly cared, then he would come back to put a stop to it.
Trivia: Feldway in some English Translations uses male pronouns.

Rank.title: Rank
Rank.summary: Rank｢ランク,ranku｣is a general system created by people to classify and categorize the degree of power held byracesofMonstersas well as special individuals.

Summary: Rank｢ランク,ranku｣is a general system created by people to classify and categorize the degree of power held byracesofMonstersas well as special individuals.
Free Guild System: A revolutionary system created byYuuki Kagurazakathat was quickly adapted by the entire world for it's ingenuity. It classifies monsters and other hostiles by taking into account a variety of variables such asMagiculeCount, Physical Strength, Defensive Capabilities, Speed,Skills, and Intelligence. Average rankings are often given to an entire species, with further reclassification being given to specific individuals based on special factors like the possession ofequipmentandarts.
F Rank｢F級｣: A ranking assigned to those who possess little to no combat capabilities.
E Rank｢E級｣: A ranking assigned to those who possess power equivalent to the averageHumanadult.
D Rank｢D級｣: A ranking assigned to those who have power equivalent to a soldier, requiring a group of at least 3 or 4 average humans to defeat.
C Rank｢C級｣: A ranking assigned to those who have power equivalent to or above an experienced soldier with professional training.
B Rank｢B級｣: A ranking assigned to threats that have the potential to wipe out an entire village singlehandedly.

A Rank｢A級｣: A ranking assigned to threats that have the potential to severely damage an entire town, requiring the deployment of several high-ranking adventurers or a nations knights to be taken care of.

Special-A Rank｢特A級｣: Also known asA-Plus. A ranking assigned to threats that have the potential to destroy a small sized nation, requiring the deployment of a nation's army or aHero-class individual to defeat.
S Rank｢S級｣: A ranking assigned toDemon Lordsand those of equivalent power, requiring a large nation's entire military and the deployment of their Heroes to defeat.

Special-S Rank｢特S級｣: A ranking assigned to threats that no singular nation could hope to stand up against, such astrue demon lordsandTrue Dragons. It is believed that such threats can only be dealt with by the intervention of aChosen hero.
Tempest System: A system used internally byTempest's government and used in their management of theDungeon. It's a stripped down version of theFree Guild's system, using an objective numerical measurement of an individual'sExistence value–called Existence Points– to assign them a ranking and adjust the dungeon's difficulty accordingly.
E Class｢E級,E kyū｣: A ranking given to those with an EP below 1,000.
D Class｢D級,D kyū｣: A ranking given to those with an EP between 1,000 and 3,000.
C Class｢C級,C kyū｣: A ranking given to those with an EP between 3,000 and 6,000.
B Class｢B級,B kyū｣: A ranking given to those with an EP between 6,000 and 8,000.
B+ Class｢+B級,+B kyū｣: A ranking given to those with an EP between 8,000 and 9,000.
A- Class｢-A級,-A kyū｣: A ranking given to those with an EP between 9,000 and 10,000.
A Class｢A級,A kyū｣: A ranking given to those with an EP between 10,000 and 100,000. It is also referred to asA-Rank Over｢Ａランクオーバー,A ranku ōbā｣and is equivalent to Hazard-class.
Special-A Class｢特A級,toku A kyū｣: A ranking given to those with an EP between 100,000 and 400,000. It is equivalent to Calamity-class.
S Class｢S級,S kyū｣: A ranking given to those with an EP between 400,000 and 800,000. It is equivalent to Disaster-class.
Special-S Class｢特S級,toku S kyū｣: A ranking given to those with an EP over 800,000
Million Class｢超級覚醒者,mirion kurasu, lit. "Super Awakened Class"｣: A general term used to refer to those with an EP over 1,000,000.

Catastrophe Class｢天災級,katasutorofu｣: The sole ranking used by Tempest that relies on Combat Power instead of Existence Points, reserved only for those with transcendent power that begins to approach the domain of True Dragons.
Mutual-Aid Association System: A precursor to the ranking system utilized by the Mutual-Aid Association of Adventurers. It is extremely crude and imprecise compared to the more modern and scientific ranking systems, resulting in many preventable deaths over the years. It was abandoned completely after Yuuki Kagurazaka reformed the Mutual-Aid Association into the Free Guild and became the new Grandmaster.
Novice: A difficulty rating given to tasks that anyone could do, equivalent to the Free Guild's F Rank.
Beginner: A difficulty rating given to tasks that required some level of competency, equivalent to the Free Guild's E Rank.
Intermediate: A difficulty rating given to tasks that required someone experienced, equivalent to the Free Guild's D Rank.
Advanced: A difficulty rating given to tasks that required seasoned veterans, encompassing the equivalent of Ranks C-A in the Free Guild System.
Danger Level: Danger Level is an older classification, separate from regular rankings, meant to classify the danger level of Monsters andMajin. Unlike the Free Guilds ranking system, it's classified by overall threat level and not just combat capabilities. Additionally, it is subjected to inaccurate listings due to political interference, with classifications of certain individuals being listed as a lower rank than what knowledge of their capabilities would lead one to believe.
Hazard-class｢災害級,hazādo｣: A classification for threats that boast enough power to destroy entire towns and require the movement of a nations knights to defeat. Equivalent to A Rank.

Calamity-class｢災厄級,karamiti｣: A classification for threats that could potentially bring down an entire country, usually possessing several high-ranking Majin subordinates and boasting a considerable influence. Monsters on this class also refered to asCalamity Monsters｢災厄級魔物,karamiti monsutā｣. Equivalent to Special-A Rank.

Disaster-class｢災禍級,dizasutā｣: A classification reserved for Demon Lords, beings who possess enough power and influence to rival a large country, requiring a powerhouse nation likeEnglassiato stand a chance against. The qualifications to be placed here are strict, with individuals of sufficient power often not being ranked here due to special factors and to not make the public think that Demon Lord-level individuals are roaming the world freely unchecked. Equivalent to S Rank.

Catastrophe-class｢天災級,katasutorofu｣: A classification reserved for threats considered too great for any singularwestern nationto handle, requiring international cooperation beyond the framework of a nation to bet on a chance of survival. This level is officially only occupied by the True Dragons, but behind closed doors there are whispers of true demon lords who possess enough power to obliterate entire countries off the map. Equivalent to Special-S Rank.

Garm.title: Garm

infobox.title: Garm
infobox.Anime: Episode 4:In the Kingdom of the Dwarves

Appearance: Like all members of theDwarfrace, Garm is of shorter stature with a rich, earthy complexion. He sports a luxuriant, voluminous beard and an equally impressive mustache that frames his face. Garm is often seen in his signature attire, donning a deep blue vest that complements his brown pants and rugged brown boots. His muscular physique speaks to his strength and resilience, a testament to the hardy nature of his race.
Personality: Garm, despite his dedication and strong work ethic, possesses a somewhat clumsy disposition when it comes to everyday tasks. He can be a bit of a character when it comes to his creative pursuits, especially in designing swimsuits for the women of Tempest. However, his playful, flirtatious nature occasionally crosses boundaries, as evidenced by his initial agreement with Kaijin and his brothers to build a mixed-gender bath for less-than-innocent reasons. Thankfully, his intentions were quickly curbed by the objections ofShunaand the other girls.

While Garm may occasionally veer into mischievous territory, his dedication to his work is unwavering. He is a man of his word and has a strong sense of integrity, never resorting to falsehoods. Like Kaijin, Garm is known for his commitment to keeping promises, whether it's assisting in the construction of their village or helping teach Hobgoblins the art of construction work for the Goblin community.

Furthermore, Garm shares an unbreakable bond with his brothers, to the extent that they can often anticipate each other's thoughts and ideas, particularly when it comes to matters of clothing and fashion.
Background: Garm, the eldest of the three Dwarf brothers, Dord and Myrd, possessed a unique set of skills that set him apart within their tight-knit family. He was known for his impressive craftsmanship, specializing in the art of armor crafting. Garm's most distinctive physical feature was his long, muscular arms, which were well-suited for the meticulous work required in his trade. Dord, the middle sibling, was renowned throughout the kingdom for his intricate handiwork, displaying remarkable attention to detail. On the other hand, Mildo, the youngest of the trio, possessed an enigmatic genius. He had a quiet demeanor but showcased his talents in a wide range of fields, including architecture and the arts, earning him a reputation as a savant among his peers.

However, despite their individual God-given talents, the three brothers faced a significant challenge in their lives: they were rather inept when it came to practical matters beyond their crafts. Simple tasks like dressing themselves without guidance proved to be a challenge. Their lack of business acumen and the ability to establish successful careers on their own hindered their progress. Instead, they seemed more inclined to let others take advantage of their skills. Their misfortunes began when they entrusted their shop to someone who ultimately deceived and stole from them. Later, an envious apprentice sabotaged their work, and they even faced harassment from the government after a ministerial request went awry. Left with no other options, they turned to their old friend Kaijin, who had practically been a fourth brother to them in their youth.

While Kaijin regretted that they hadn't sought his help sooner, he welcomed them into his fold. However, his business focused primarily on battle gear, and he already had established connections for most of his merchandise. The weapons he crafted himself, and he couldn't simply inform his existing contacts that their services were no longer required. To avoid unnecessary trouble, he continued his business as usual. In the meantime, Kaijin put the three brothers to work overseeing a team of laborers engaged in mining operations to gather essential materials for his business. This arrangement provided them with a place to lie low while contributing to Kaijin's endeavors.

One fateful day, while Garm and his brothers were diligently mining for magic ores deep within the mine, they encountered a formidable threat: an Amasarus. This powerful creature attacked them viciously, leaving the brothers seriously injured and in dire need of assistance. Their desperate situation took a turn for the better when a rescue team arrived just in the nick of time. The rescuers administered a life-saving potion, generously provided by a slime named Rimuru Tempest. This miraculous potion worked wonders and managed to save Garm and his brothers from the brink of death. It marked the beginning of their connection with Rimuru and the extraordinary events that would follow.

As a chain of unexpected events unfolded, Garm and his brothers found themselves exiled from their homeland. However, their new benefactor, Rimuru, along with their longtime friend Kaijin, joined forces with them. Together, they embarked on a remarkable journey that involved not only aiding in the construction but also contributing to the eventual development of the once humble Goblin village, which would ultimately transform into the prosperous and thriving Jura-Tempest Federation.
Trivia: InSlime Diaries, Garm says "Mom, we're home", along with his two brothers.

Story: When he was on his guard duty, Kaidou one day witnessed a large amount of people outside the entrance ofDwargonfalling into panic or even falling unconscious. He traced the source of the incident to aSlimeand hisHobgoblincompanion,RimuruandGobta. Kaidou followed his duty and arrested the suspects.

After investigating the incident, Kaidou came to the conclusion that Rimuru and Gobta can be released, however due to procedures he had to question them for longer, so Kaidou and Rimuru killed time by making up a fantastical background story for Rimuru about being a human girl talented in magic that got captured by an Evil Wizard that put a curse on her that turned her into a Slime and that the Slime then went on a journey to lift the curse. When news came that the three Dwarven BrothersGarm,DordandMyrdgot heavily wounded by anArmorsaurus, Kaidou showed that he already trusted Rimuru at that point, accepting the potion Rimuru offered Kaidou without Kaidou doubting him despite objections of his subordinates. Kaidou's trust paid off and the lives and future careers of the Three Dwarven Brothers got saved thanks to the potions as without them even if they survived, their injuries might have made them unable to work. The Three Dwarven Brothers personally thanked Rimuru and left.

Afterwards, Kaidou released Rimuru and Gobta. Kaidou, in exchange for taking Rimuru to a good blacksmith and thoroughly explaining the currency and its value for a wide range of different products, bought more potion off Rimuru for a quite cheap price, as Kaidou noticed that the potion was extraordinarily effective, an actual Full Potion. Kaidou then introduced Rimuru to one of the best blacksmiths of Dwargon, his brotherKaijin, and then left.

They met again when Kaidou had to arrest Kaijin, Rimuru and the Three Dwarven Brothers after Kaijin had hitVestain the face at the Night Butterfly cabaret club. After the trial ended and the group was exiled, Kaidou saw the group off and wished them farewell.

UponTempest's delegation, led by Rimuru himself, arrived in Dwargon for the public declaration of friendship, Kaidou got dumbstruck by the fact that Rimuru appeared in the shape of a human girl, making him wonder if Rimuru's fabricated story of being cursed by an Evil Wizard wasn't perhaps correct, though Kaijin quickly denied it.
The night before leaving, Rimuru invited Kaidou to have fun and relax in the Night Butterfly cabaret club.

Appearance: Zalario takes on the appearance of a beautiful person with long black hair described to carry a glow like "fragmented starlight". A set ofGod-Gradearmor with a black and gold glow covers their torso, concealing most of the pure white clothes worn underneath. The six white wings on their back, pure as their clothes, accentuate already apparent beauty even further and a striking red mark adorns their forehead.
Personality: Zalario is a cool-headed warrior who is hard to provoke, making it near impossible for their foes to get under their skin. They're an extremely reliable comrade to have, showing due diligence against carelessness. Zalario dislikes making enemies, only fighting when forced to.

Zalario was originally extremely cold to their own subordinates, viewing them as no more than cogs to a wheel. They were not above treating their colleagues this way too, dismissingCornu's death and viewing him as a worthless pawn. Zalario also seems to possess a self-righteous side as they once claimed their words were justice while punishing a rogue subordinate.

After experiencing being stripped of free will and being forced to do the bidding of others, Zalario came to understand the value of freedom and has had a shift in views, even preaching to their subordinates to choose their own paths in life.

Even with how cold and mechanical they are on the surface, Zalario is still capable of forming friendship with others, with Feldway serving as a notable example, being genuinely angry with the old friend for betraying the trust they had placed in them, choosing to respond by severing ties.
Background: Zalario was born at the genesis of creation as one of theSeven Angels of Origin, being was placed under Feldway's command by Veldanava to watch over the mindless beastIvaragéin the otherworld. Corrupted by theMagiculescontained in the otherworld, only amplified by Ivaragé's influence, Zalario and their subordinates were reborn asPhantoms. Most of those years in the otherworld were spent fighting the powerfulInsectars, most notably againstZess, the leader ofZelanus'Twelve Insect Generals.
Trivia: Zalario had been alive for more than tens of billions of years.

She believes Veldanava's will is for Milim's happiness and is determined to ensure that she does not come to harm, viewing Feldway and Michael's actions as running counter to that. Additionally, she sees their goal of reviving Veldanava as misguided, believing that Milim should be crowned as his successor.

Differing from her colleagues, Obera has shown a strong grasp of camaraderie in the way she cherished her subordinates. She has expressed sadness in losing her army, as well as a powerful grudge towards Michael who was responsible. However, she is usually careful enough to maintain her composure and not let her emotions get in the way of her duties, playing to her strengths as a commander. Though saddened by the loss of her army, she nonetheless respects their resolve, following in their example againstVelzardby sacrificing her life.
