Appearance: As aharpy, Frey has wings on her back and talons as feet. She has white hair, a red gemstone on her head, as well as a buxom body and is usually seen wearing an off-the-shoulder dress that resembles a red leotard with a plunging neckline that exposes her cleavage.
She can hide her talons to have human like legs in place.
Personality: Frey is careful and cunning. Together with Milim, they easily outwittedClaymanby making him believe he had control over them, and even had him convinced thatCarrionwas dead, with the goal of unraveling the identities of the ones pulling his strings.

Despite having the title of a Demon Lord, Frey is not arrogant and instead she's shown to be humble, admitting she feels not strong enough to be one of the Demon Lords and resigned her position becoming Milim's subordinate. She is also kind and friendly with Milim, showing a maternal side with Milim and deeply cares for her. She even acts like a mother figure to Milim, making sure that she takes responsibility with ruling over her domain properly. She does not like being insulted and may threaten those who make fun of her, such as with Carrion when he thought that Rimuru's unintentional insult towards Frey was funny. She loves high places and is always determined to make those areas a part of her domain.
Background: Unknown to Frey herself, she was born with an Older Twin sister,Nazim, who was a unique mutant among their race. However, unlike her, she was born infertile and as such deemed as unworthy queen candidate by their people despite having the same inborn potential of power like Frey. This resulted in theHarpy Queenof that time banishing Nazim.

As admitted by Frey, during her time growing up she had a somewhat distant relationship with her mother, having never truly felt that she received any motherly love from her. Eventually, Frey herself would end up killing her in order to take her place as the Harpy Queen.

Frey was one of the other survivors of theGreat Tenma War. She became an appointed Demon Lord around the same time as Clayman and Carrion, and as such, was regarded as one of the youngest of the Ten Great Demon Lords. Like the peers of her generation, due to the older Demon Lords not taking much of an active stance, Frey became one of the most active Demon Lords in her efforts to increase her personal power base to bridge the gap between herself and the older generation of Demon Lords, and as such, is one of the most well known Demon Lords across the world for her exploits and power.

Frey herself established her own kingdom and is the queen of Harpies and other winged creatures of the world. She was initially not involved in Clayman's plan of making a new puppet Demon Lord but later on chose to join in order to boost her own influence.
One of Frey's harpy priestesses had prophesized the revival of a long-past calamity, harpies' natural enemy,Charybdis, who was sealed away by aChosen hero.

Frey once tried to take over theTengurealm, which she wanted to use as an outpost in her future plans to conquer Elmine Sarion, the capital of theSorcerous Dynasty of Sarion, located on the giganticDivine Tree, due to her desire to own high places.
Trivia: As a Queen-type among the largely female populated Harpy race, Frey has the ability to reproduce through Parthenogenesis or Virgin Birth, where she is able to have children without the need of a partner.Frey’s three known daughters have been born in this manner. As such,Claire,Luchia, andNemuhave no biological fathers.

Original: During his debut, Zegion appeared to be an extremely large beetle with characteristics of both stag beetles and rhinoceros beetles.
Humanoid: Later he evolved into a humanoid form that looks like a warrior clad in pitch-blackexoskeletonwith visible golden joints. A red-tipped, sword-like horn protrudes from his forehead. The exoskeleton took the form of Rimuru's preference. After undergoing Rimuru’sHarvest Festivalritual theMagisteelgiven to him by Rimuru that had previously evolved intoAdamantitehas evolved intoHihi'irokane.
Personality: Zegion typically maintains a calm and serious demeanor, speaking sparingly and choosing his words carefully. However, his loyalty to Rimuru burns with an intense fire, and any perceived insult directed towards Rimuru swiftly ignites his anger. Zegion possesses a soft spot forApito, viewing her as a cherished sister, and he consistently prioritizes her well-being. Having been saved by Rimuru in the past, Zegion reveres him as a godlike figure who plans meticulously and exudes humility. Grateful for Rimuru's kindness, Zegion is determined to prove his own worth, constantly seeking to enhance his strength, even though he is already formidable.
Background: Zegion was born directly fromZelanusin theOtherworldalongside Apito who was birthed byPeliodto fill in the remaining vacant spots in theTwelve Insect Generals. However,Zess, wary of their potential, eventually attacked them, forcing the pair to flee to theCentral World.

When they arrived, the pair were immediately attacked by aBlade tiger. Zegion fought and defeated the blade tiger but was heavily injured. Fortunately, they were found by Rimuru who was impressed by the small insect's display of strength. Sensing Rimuru coming to him and Apito, he attacked Rimuru recklessly, to serve as bait and allow Apito to flee, only to be stopped by Apito herself when she asked for Rimuru's protection due to her recognizing Rimuru's strength and his intention to help them. Rimuru agreed in exchange for Apito providing him some honey. Due to their injuries, Rimuru patched them up with his ownslimebody to aid the healing process and replaced their missing exoskeleton parts with processedmagisteel. He wasnamedand tasked to guard the treants' settlement.
Trivia: In a recurring gag, Zegion and Apito meetMilim Nava, who scares them to the point of motivating them to become stronger.
Zegion, a disciple ofVeldora Tempest, has been trained in theVeldora-Style Killing Arts.
InThat Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime: ISEKAI ChroniclesZegion and Apito have bigger roles than in theAnime, taking part in the battle againstCharybdisand participating in many hotspring seasons.

Appearance: Mjurran would normally disguise herself to look like a regularhumanexceptionally beautiful with fair skin, bright blue eyes, and long, tied-back mint green hair. But she is actually aMajinand her true form, which has a third eye on her forehead, various tattoos on her body, monstrous claws on her hands and fur growing on some parts of her body, reflects that.
Personality: Mjurran possesses a highly responsible and careful nature, always striving to plan things in her favor. She is known for her meticulous approach to tasks and her strategic mindset. Due to her lack of experience in love and relationships, she can be somewhat naive about people's intentions, as seen in her unfortunate encounter withDemon LordClayman. However, Mjurran's experiences have also made her more cautious and wary of being deceived again. She values her newfound freedom and cherishes the genuine connections she forms, particularly her affection for Youm, the only person to have won her heart in her long existence.
Background: Mjurran was once a witch residing in theJura Forest, where she faced persecution and isolation from others. Seeking solace in her magical research, she distanced herself from human and majin interactions, dedicating her time to studying and advancing her magical abilities. However, as she neared the end of her lifespan, she began to feel regretful about the lack of progress in her research and the absence of a worthy successor. In a vulnerable moment, she was approached by the cunning Demon Lord Clayman, who offered her eternal life and youth in exchange for her allegiance.

Trapped in a desperate desire for more time and fearful of death, Mjurran accepted Clayman's offer, unknowingly falling into his manipulative trap. The cursed spell known as the "Marionette Heart" was placed upon her, rendering her a puppet under Clayman's control. Despite her efforts to find a way out of her enslavement, Mjurran learned that removing the "Marionette Heart" would result in her returning to her aged form and facing certain death. Forced to serve Clayman against her will, Mjurran experienced the loss of her freedom and autonomy.

However, her life took a turn when she encountered Youm, a human who saw through her facade and accepted her true self. Youm became the only person to win her love and trust, bringing newfound hope and joy into Mjurran's existence. With the support and gratitude she feels towardRimuru, theSlimewho granted her freedom, Mjurran dedicates herself to researching her role as queen in Rimuru's plan to covertly make the formerenemy nationa vassal state.
Trivia: Mjurran is one of the few individuals aware ofRaphael's existence.

Despite being a spy and working for Clayman, she was nothing more than a puppet, she personally did not like the idea of causing mayhem or play in political games. She is shown to be a conflicted person.
She has a strong sense of right and wrong, so tries to take in all the blame onto herself despite her being nothing but someone's pawn.

Upon getting her freedom and a new artificial heart, she goes through a similar change that Youm had when he first met Rimuru, going as far to swear fealty to him, to which Rimuru casually passes on, which surprises her and make her reevaluate her views on trusting people.
She has a deep friendship withGrucius, despite thelycanthrope's casual comments about making her his, she humors him as the first true Majin friend she ever made.
Despite disliking politics, and having social anxieties in large groups, she is known to be a kind queen who looks out for her people.
Mjurran tends to try and copy holidays and festivals thatRimuru Cityhas, to show support and continue the festive, fun and accepting ambience she experienced when visiting there.

Concealed Form: She normally looks like a youthful human girl around the age of fourteen to fifteen, making many people confuse her as a child at first. She has glossyplatinum pink｢桜金色,purachina pinku｣hair tied in twin tails and blue eyes. She usually wears a rather bold swimsuit-like outfit consisting of one thigh-high sock, a thigh band, black panties, and a long-sleeve shirt that only covers her chest, with the occasional addition of a large cloak.[3]

In the kid's version of Light Novel, her outfit was toned down. She wears a longer shirt that covers almost all of her midriff, a black skirt, light-colored leggings, and black shoes with a pink bottom.
In the future, she started wearing more casual outfits such as a white-blue dress and a tank top with shorts.
True Form: In this form, Milim looks more like the Dragonoid that she is, having a crimson horn adorning her forehead and large wings. In this state, she usually wears proper battle attire consisting of jet-black armor.[4]
Personality: Milim, by nature, is a rather childish and outspoken individual. She isn't afraid to speak her mind and throws away any pretense of formalities. This, however, shouldn't be mistaken as her having the mind of a child. Those who can look past her childish demeanor will find a fierce, extremely intelligent woman who cannot be tricked or outsmarted even by the brightest minds. Despite this intellect, her tendency to be inconsiderate of other people and do whatever she wants often results in her overlooking the complexity and importance of a situation entirely, in favor of a more straight-forward approach. She is also extremely sensitive to gossip, especially when it relates to her, and anybody that insults or underestimates her often ends up dead or close to it as a result. She also dislikes ruling and constantly neglects her duty to instead find ways to entertain herself. She also likesHoney, which Rimuru used to tame her. Despite her blunt personality, she is a surprisingly good actor when she puts her mind to it, having successfully tricked Clayman, Rimuru, and at leastthreeothermembersof theDemon Lord councilinto thinking that she is under Clayman's full control.

Her jaded, lonely, and violent attitude has been somewhat whittled away after meeting Rimuru and spending time in Tempest. She begins to open up and makes more and more friends across the course of the series, with the revival of her siblingGaia, in particular, filling her with immense happiness.

Sometime afterFreyandCarrionbecame her subordinates, she became somewhat fearful of Frey, demonstrating this by hiding behind Rimuru whenever Frey gets upset with her. This is because Frey has taken responsibility for Milim's education, and she doesn't allow Milim to idle around and play all the time like she did before.
Background: Milim was born millennia ago as a princess of theKingdom of Nasca. She, for a time, lived a happy and peaceful life with her fatherVeldanava, mother Lucia, and pet Gaia.  However, tragedy struck when her father and mother unexpectedly passed away. She was well taken care of by servants, but heruncle, the king, refused to see her. With Gaia the only family member she had left, she grew up unable to remember the faces of her parents and unaware of her relation to the king. Only having each other, Gaia and Milim's bond grew more than ever, with the two never leaving each other's side, even sleeping in the same bed huddled together.

These peaceful times too were not fated to last. A group from the Great Sorcerous Nation Of Soma had infiltrated the Kingdom of Nasca and intended to take Milim and use her power as their own. Gaia stood in the way of their assailants, doing its best to protect Milim, but it was eventually cut down and killed. Milim, having lost everything and everyone close to her, began to lose her sanity. Her mind went blank with rage as the massive power she inherited from her father came bubbling to the surface and she set out to take revenge. She made her way to the capital of the Great Sorcerous Nation Of Soma and began to destroy everything and everyone in sight, starting by wiping out the castle and thekingthat was inside of it with a massive flash of light. In her rampage, having killed hundreds and thousands of people, she became atrue demon lordand the resulting harvest festival brought her beloved Gaia back to life. Gaia, being corrupted by Milim's anger, took on the form of a mindless Chaos Dragon and, following Milim's command, began terrorizing the elves of the Great Sorcerous Nation Of Soma. The death and destruction in Milim's wake was so destructive that the Demon LordGuy Crimsonhad to step in to prevent the damage from spreading to the whole world. Guy and Milim fought each other for seven days and seven nights with no clear winner arising between the two. Eventually, the Elemental Queen,Ramiris, stepped in and managed to pacify Milim's rage at the cost of her purity.

Milim, having come to her senses, was filled with only a deep sadness. She confronted the Chaos Dragon and decided to seal away the last family member she had left. Guy and Ramiris did their best to console the grieving Milim, with the three coming together to form theDemon Lord councilwith the trio as its founding members. Milim, for her part, began to help as many people as she could, perhaps in recompense for her past actions. She slew powerfulmonstersand magical beasts that were attacking towns and cities and became an arbitrator for international disputes. This culminated in her discovery of thedragonewts, a race ofdemi-humansborn from the union ofhumansand thedragonsthat had spawned from Gaia's essence. As the closest thing she had to a family, she took in the dragonewts and protected them, with theCity of the Forgotten Dragoneventually being built by them in her honor.

Over time, Milim eventually grew more and more jaded with the world. The memories of her early days had grown into a blur that she didn't care to remember and she eventually stopped interfering with the world altogether. Instead, she took to the ever-growing members of the Demon Lord council to sate her inevitable boredom. She began to take a keen interest in strong individuals and gave them her support to join the council, with the hope of them eventually offering her a fun fight. It was in one of these plots, the puppet Demon Lord project that culminated in theOrc Disaster, that she discovered the existence of a certainblue silver-haired majinand set out to make it her subordinate.
Trivia: The name "Milim" is an ancient Dalriadan-Scottish nickname for abald person; the name may refer to a member of a religious order. The Gaelic forms of the name areMac MhaolainorMac Ghille Mhaoil, both of which meanson of the bald or tonsured one."Milim" is also  the Hebrew word "מילים" literally meaning words.Her surname,"Nava"｢ナーヴァ,nāva｣, refers to her father, being derived from"Veldanava"｢ヴェルダナーヴァ,verudanāva｣.
"Milim" is also  the Hebrew word "מילים" literally meaning words.
Her surname,"Nava"｢ナーヴァ,nāva｣, refers to her father, being derived from"Veldanava"｢ヴェルダナーヴァ,verudanāva｣.

Appearance: Adalmann appears to be a lich-like being that wears clergy robes. However, he was shown to be very fond of the look, as he remained as a skeleton even when he has the ability to construct a body in the labyrinth.
Personality: As a former follower of Luminous Faith, Adalmann showed extreme reverence towardsLuminous, which allowed him to become the bestHoly magicpractitioner. Even after changing his faith to "Rimuruism," his trait as a fanatical follower hasn't waned one bit – rather, it's gotten even stronger. Due to this,DiabloandShionfeel an affinity towards him, much to Rimuru's annoyance.
During his period of forced servitude to Demon LordsKazalimand Clayman, he was noted to harbor hatred for the Curse Lord due to binding him to serve as the defender of Clayman's castle.

Adalmann was also noted to have insecurities over his own capability to performHoly magic, largely in part due to his resurrection as aWight king. This is largely in part due to him losing his faith in the Luminous Faith as a result of the plot conceived by the Seven Luminaries as well as the fact that he believes that in a Wight king body, he can't perform Holy magic. This insecurity is no longer present once he learns that he actually can perform Holy magic with no issues.

He is noted to hold a great deal of respect forShuna, not only because she proved his beliefs wrong, but also because she was the one who freed him and his comrades from Demon Lord Kazalim's Curse that forcefully bound them toJistav's territory. Initially addressing her by the honorific of "-dono" ("Miss"), he later comes to respect her greatly, addressing her by the Japanese honorific of "-sama" ("Lady") after she freed him from the curse.
All above, Adalmann cares a lot about his comrades, even stating that he couldn't leave them alone even after becoming a Wight king, proving that he had a sense of camaraderie within himself.
Background: Adalmann was once a cardinal in the early days of theWestern Holy Church, when the organization had yet to attain the reputation it has in the story.

He was born a prince of a small nation under the rule ofHoly Empire of Lubelius. He was an exceptional practitioner among the recruits of the church, and with his elder brother occupying the throne and a new heir secured, Adalmann devoted himself into spreading the name of Luminous as a templar knight. He was deeply fascinated by the god Luminous and her works, and even believed her to be real.

His devotion landed him the rank of cardinal (the highest rank in the church) and became the greatest master of holy magic in his era. However, his position in Lubelius' noble hierarchy wasn't very high, so he redoubled his efforts and expanded his magical knowledge to other types. Along the way, he would hold long discussions with his best friendGadraas he continued polishing his skills. Eventually, his efforts paid off, and he became anEnlightened.

As time passed, he was one step away from becoming aSaint, but that never came to be because of the sinister plans of theSeven Luminaries. Fearing his rise in power, they tricked him into setting off to quell a large army of undead threatening their people. Oblivious to their true intentions, he took off with his trusted friend,Albert, along with an expeditionary force that admired him. Awaiting them was a legion of undead led by aDragon zombieat the far edge of theJura Forest, which became their death place.

Adalmann eventually fell in battle, but his close friend Gadra used the secret art he invented, 'Reincarnation', on him. However, because the ambient miasma had tainted his soul, he was reborn as a wight. His newfound appearance caught the attention of the then Demon Lord Kazalim and, ever since, he was bound to the land by her curse, forced to defend it for a thousand years.

Appearance: Before receiving a name, she had a childlike posture, similar to mostgoblins.
Upon Rimuru's recovery, Haruna had already developed a more mature body, akin to a young adult woman.
Background: She was initially a goblin from the first goblin villageRimuruencountered. After Rimuru saved the village, he gave her the name "Haruna." After bestowing names to all of the Goblins and thefirst Direwolf, Rimuru went into Sleep Mode due to using too much of hismagicules, during which Haruna took care of him. Her growth into a Goblina initially confused Rimuru when he awoke, as he had not yet understood the value ofmonstershaving their own name.
Story: Haruna is in charge of sewing and cooking inTempest. Since the Ogres came, she became a disciple ofShunaand studied fabric technology in earnest. Her proficiency in the skill of delicious cooking has further improved, and Haruna's new sweet, Matcha Pudding, becameVeldora's favorite snack. Also, she studied, from the ground up, manners such as tea ceremony, and has now reached a level where she can entertain monarchs.

Appearance: Shizue was a young woman of average height with black eyes and black hair, as well as red burn scars under one of her eyes. After separating herself fromIfritand becominghumanonce more, she slowly became a frail old lady with white hair.
Personality: Shizu was a friendly and kind adventurer who was a good teacher to herOtherworlderstudents. She cared a lot about people close to her and would go to great lengths to protect them. Shizu hated her power comparing it to a curse rather than a gift. Due to killing her friend, she became detached and it wasn't until meeting the hero that she regained her smile.

As Shizu was an Otherworlder who was forcibly summoned she hated the world but at the same time couldn't dislike it either as the bonds she made were also important to her. She was also noted to be a very strict teacher to the point of her earning the nickname "The Demonic Head Instructor". Shizu acted as a mother figure to her students and was constantly worried for their safety and wellbeing particularly,Hinata.
Story: In her original world, she had no relatives and lived alone with her mother. Her father was drafted, and she couldn't recall his face. Feeling neither blessed nor unfortunate, she had no choice but to accept it. She was injured during the Bombing of Tokyo duringWorld War II. She was eight at the time. Although she was summoned to this world during the bombing, it was not before she was badly burned. As she arrived, it was thus revealed thatDemon LordLeon Cromwellwas responsible for summoning her. At first, he considered her existence a waste, a mere loss of a failed summoning attempt ofChloe Aubert. However, her sincere plea for help made him change his mind.

Leon reconsidered her value to him and then called forth the Greater Flame ElementalIfrit. He then had Ifrit possess Shizu's body. In truth, he did this to prevent the collapse of her body under the rampaging magic from the summoning. Thus, this possession enabled her to stay alive from both her burn injuries and her unstablemagiculesfrom being summoned as a child.

As aMajinof flames newly named 'Shizu', she became an aide as well as bodyguard for Leon. At some point she made friends withPirino, though Ifrit forced her to kill her friend against her will. When theChosen hero Chronoainvaded, Leon fled, abandoning his castle. She was left as the rear guard, which Shizu thought to mean she was thrown away by the Demon Lord, but Leon actually hoped, based on the information he gathered, that the Chosen hero would take Shizu along with them. After fighting the Chosen hero for some time despite being outmatched, Shizu ran out of magicules and Ifrit's will fell asleep allowing the Chosen hero, who was actually Hinata in control of Chosen hero Chronoa's body, to take her in and mentor her. To help control Ifrit's will, the Chosen hero handed Shizu theAnti-magic Mask.

However, the Chosen hero left on a journey one day. Since then, Shizue went on to be an adventurer of her own and became a Hero known as the "Conqueror of Flames". Sometimes called one of the founders of theFree Guild, she had worked for the expansion and benefit of the Adventurer Cooperation Union. She also took part in training adventurers and her successors. At one time, she had taught two exceptionally excellent students,Yuuki Kagurazakaand Hinata Sakaguchi.

After the Adventurers Cooperation Union had formally changed its name to Free Guild, Yuuki introduced the currentrankingsystem. As a result of it, casualties during subjugation missions greatly decreased. Shizue began supporting Yuuki behind the scenes. Due to no longer being able to contain Ifrit, she had to retire from being an adventuring and focused on being a teacher instead. Over time Shizu was even less able to contain Ifrit, thus, she decided to set off to find Leon one more time to find out the method with which Leon saved Shizu as a child so that she can apply the same method to save her 5 current students.

In theKingdom of Blumund, via her connection toHeinz, Blumund GuildmasterFuze's father, it got arranged that she'd be traveling together withKaval's Partyinto the Great Forest of Jura. During the trip Ifrit finally managed to take over her consciousness once more due to her weakened state, However, with the last of her Will, Shizu was able to separate herself and Ifrit entirely. Not wanting to live with Ifrit in control of her body and letting her die as a "Human" instead of a "Majin". AfterRimurudefeated Ifrit, Shizu's consciousness returned for a short time. Her last request, as a now frail and white haired woman, was for Rimuru to put her to rest within himself, to make Demon Lord Leon Cromwell acknowledge her existence, and to save the children. Her soul remains inside of Rimuru for the remainder of the story. Devouring Shizu allowed Rimuru to gain a human form, which resembles a younger version of Shizu.
During Hinata's second fight with Rimuru, she saw a vision of Shizu over the monster king, which caused her to remember past memories of her.

Much later, during the fight withGranbellinAwakening of the Chosen Hero, her memories and emotions inherited by Rimuru manifested themselves inside Rimuru's subconscious mind in order to give Hinata and Chloe closure.
Trivia: The nameShizuemeans "quiet" (静) (Shizu) and "bay, inlet" (江) (e).
Shizu's surnameIzawameans "well, mine shaft, pit" (井) (i) and "marsh" (沢) (sawa/zawa).

Appearance: When summoned by Rimuru, Beretta was a Greater daemon, much more muscular compared to aLesser daemon. On both side of it's head horns protruding. With black skin, dressed in expensive clothes.

Adollnecessarily uses spherical joints. But surprisingly, the golem came out just as Rimuru had imagined it. In order to move the golem all that is needed is to direct magical energy into the joints. Rimuru made the face look beautiful and gave it a mask similar in design to his own. The golem was as large as a human, 180cm tall to be precise.

After receiving the name Beretta, it began to evolve. they first formed into a circle, but then chest, head, hips, arms, and legs formed, along with a face. The face was now hidden behind a mask and, instead of the black skin, long black hair now adorned it's body, skin pale, and bloodless with long white hair. The eye slits on the mask glowed crimson.
Personality: Beretta originally aDaemonof the Black lineage, Beretta takes on many characteristics that match or are similar to their progenitor,Diablo, due to the fact that all Daemons take on the basic personality traits of their respective progenitors.

Like Diablo, Beretta holds a high level of etiquette and respect. They are fervently loyal to their master and those they have respect for. They also share their progenitor's trait of curiosity and desire to learn and experience new things. They are rarely shown to be overtly distressed or emotional, instead carrying a relaxed air. Like Diablo, this, however, masks a ruthless and cold nature which they expose to enemies in battle.

In the midst of combat their demeanor is calm even when they brutally dispatches their foes. When it slew another doll,Viola, who had been under the control ofClayman, they only showed a fleeting interest in learning its name after tearing out its core while remarking about how fun it will be to take and study Viola's weapon at their leisure at a later time, making it clear that they felt nothing at its demise nor any hesitation to end it.
They take great pleasure in studying magical artifacts with Ramiris and experimenting with magical spells and devices.
Trivia: The summoning of Beretta is glossed over in episode 23 to be expand upon in a 2 minutes ONA (Sukuwareru Ramiris) released on the Bandai Spirits YouTube channel and region locked.

The alluring witch ofthe mirror. She stalksRimuruas her prey, and will do whatever it takes to fulfill her utmost desire. However after escaping and being saved by Rimuru and Shinsha from her creatorClichéshe eventually makes amends and even allies with them against her creator.
Original form: Izis possesses black hair with two buns and green eyes. She wears a pair of glasses and keeps her full figured concealed by black dress lined with red fur and wears black gloves on both of her hands. The dress also possesses a long slit cut out for her leg which reveals knee length black and white vertically stripped knee socks. A large knot with white stripes is present below her large cleavage that joins the red fur and the slit cut out for her legs. She wears a pair of circular, palm-sized mirrors as earrings, and a necklace shaped like two C's connected at the backs.
Evolved: After assimilatingVeldora Against, and whenever she has enough of his Magicules to transform she dons a skin tight like suit shoving her breasts and shows her belly button and shows panty like pants. She has two bull-like horns on each side of her head and two scar slashes in her eyes, and no longer wears her glasses and necklace. She also have larger longer hands that have black and red in them. She has more straight hair. Her socks a black and white with shoes rembling 3 toe bird/dinosaur. She also has shoulder spikes as well.
Personality: Izis is known to be a cunning, albeit an apathetic individual who does not understand the very concept of emotions itself due to her being isolated in the Mirror World alone for nearly her entire life. Her apathy is shown clearly when she is confused whenHyugaandShinshacall her as their 'mother', with Hyuga even defending her from an attack. She is very cunning and clever, shown how she was easily able to convince Shinsha that she and Rimuru were her parents, and easily manipulated her to perform tasks that were advantageous to her.

Her apathy however, stems from her presence in theMirror Worldsince her birth. Having seen and hearing everyone's desires from the mirrors present in the Mirror World, Izis only knows that people have idealistic versions of themselves and that they do not want the current identity of themselves.

She greatly detests Rimuru and Shinsha, primarily because not only did they ruin her plan to escape using theInfinity Prison, but even foiled her attempts to capture Rimuru. To Izis, Rimuru is her 'prey', as she puts it, and she wishes to hunt him all for the sake of her own freedom.

Having spent many years within the Mirror World, she considers it as a prison, through which she could only see others and interact with the world (albeit partially) and as such, is more than happy to escape from it. As a result of her time spent in the Mirror World, she seemingly has a habit of speaking to herself.

However after escaping the Mirror World and settling in Tempest she starts to slowly gradually gain emotions following a hotspring bath and eating with Rimuru and Shinsha due to her no longer being isolated in the Mirror World.
Background: Izis was created byClichéand several Witches from the Witch Village. She was then sealed in theMirror Worldby her creator to prevent her harm from those of theoutside worldso she can hopefully mature and grow strong enough to escape the Mirror World.
Trivia: Izis and Shinsha were designed by Mitz Vah, the light novel illustrator.

Izis used to greatly hate Rimuru for many reasons. During their first encounter, when Izis attempted to grant Rimuru their wishes, they wished for many modern items including a toilet and other basic amenities in a house, which caused her to trip. To make things worse, they also wished for their past selfSatoru Mikami, which frustrated her since he had no magic or abilities to work off of. The experience left her confused, humiliated and enraged. Moreover, since Rimuru usedPredatoronVeldora, Izis could not analyze the Infinity Prison as she intended, which infuriated her. However, after allying with them against her creator, she no longer harbors those hostile feelings towards them.

Human Form: After being released fromRimuru'sStomach, Veldora was gifted one of hisBody Doublesas a vessel to incarnate within, which Veldora reshaped to his liking. He has blond hair and golden eyes with two black lines under each of them in a zigzag pattern that are also seen on his arms, and is over two meters tall. Veldora's alterations to the body turned the face masculine, though Rimuru's general facial features remained. As Veldora learned to suppress his tremendousaurabefore leaving theSealed Cave, he appears to most people as merely a handsome, albeit slightly intimidating, young man. Veldora wears a black cape that red inside and what looks like gauntlets but nothing else on the upper body and on the lower body he wears black pants and what looks like armored boots.
Dragon Form: His gigantic body is covered in black steel like scales, with his wings and underside taking on a bluish color. His eyes are deep golden and the back of his head is covered with four horns extending backwards.
Personality: Veldora is generally boisterous, excitable, but also fairly easy going. Despite his reputation as a rampaging idiot, Veldora is largely only dangerous if he doesn't get to unwind once in a while or if his loved ones are threatened. He is also quite energetic, prideful, and has no reservation in showing off his strength. Veldora is rather shy and socially awkward but hides it behind boasts of how "great" he is. He also has no social tact, seeming to not understand that a simple request from him is enough to intimidate anyone into compliance regardless of their own personal feelings. Aside from his childish nature, he is quite knowledgeable about many things and has an unquenchable curiosity at his core. Veldora tends to act meek if things don't go his way, resulting in people wondering if Veldora is really as terrifying as the legends say.

After meeting Rimuru and reading the manga stored in his memories, which he refers to as "sacred texts", he began to reconsider some of his more destructive previous behavior. His time spent in Rimuru's Stomach withCharysand his time spent living inTempestresulted in Veldora developing a somewhat more patient, analytical, and less impulsive personality.

Despite his nonchalant personality, he greatly appreciates Rimuru as his sworn friend and trusts him. Because Rimuru cured the loneliness and boredom afflicting him, Veldora feels incredibly proud to have met him. In Veldora's eyes, Rimuru was an equal from the beginning of their relationship despite being a fledglingslimemonster in a new world; Veldora understands and even motivates Rimuru to bring more types of entertainment to the world, because since meeting Rimuru, his life has become filled with family, friends, and new ways to entertain himself.

Veldora is not good at confronting his sisters, believing they view him as their plaything. He has been tormented by them numerous times in the past and consequently suffers emotional trauma. He seems to hold high respect for his older brother,Veldanava, who shielded him from his sisters. He was the youngest True Dragon until Rimuru's ascension, which is ironic considering that Rimuru behaves more like a mature brother than Veldora, even standing up for him against his sisters. To all others, Rimuru appears to have "tamed" Veldora, which is not exactly untrue.
Background: He was born as the incarnation of chaos, having control ofwind,waterandspace. He was the fourth to emerge as aTrue Dragonamong his siblings. From the moment of his birth, Veldora has been plagued by a relentless sense of restlessness, which often leads him to embark on destructive rampages often manifesting in violent storms. His boredom compels him to seek out challenges from his elder sisters,VelzardandVelgrynd, in order to assert his superiority. However, this cycle of reincarnation and rivalry has left an indelible mark on Veldora, instilling within him a perpetual fear of his formidable sisters that persists to this day.
One day about 2,000 years ago, Veldora went and trashed avampirecity ruled byDemon LordLuminous Valentineto relieve his boredom, making him bear the grudges of the Queen of Nightmares since.

When theEastern Empiredispatched an Army to expand their territories 300 years ago, they encountered Veldora inJura Forestand got crushed. Because of that, aHerowas dispatched to defeat him. The Hero imprisoned him with herInfinity Prisonas a result, sentencing him to live his days in monotonous boredom in the Sealed Cave.
One fateful day, a slime bumped into him. Curious, as nothing should be able to get close to him due to the large magic concentration in the area, he started to converse with the small slime.

After befriending Rimuru, Veldora consented to Rimuru's plan to store Veldora in his Stomach while he worked on finding a way to release Veldora from the Infinity Prison. Veldora ultimately spent a year inside Rimuru's Stomach, passing the time by going through Rimuru's memories of his previous life in Japan. He attempted to gather the souls of others that Rimuru consumed with him, resulting in a companion known at the time as Ifrit. Ifrit and Veldora forged a strong friendship during their time spent in Rimuru's Stomach and Ifrit eventually agreed to become Veldora's apprentice, gaining the name "Charys" further down the road.

Veldora was unleashed on the unsuspecting world afterGreat Sageevolved intoRaphael. Raphael boosted Veldora'sInvestigatorskill to 345 times its previous potency. Then, at Raphael's urging, Veldora upgraded theUnique skillInvestigator to theUltimate skillFaust, further boosting Veldora's processing power by a thousand times. These upgrades allowed Veldora and Raphael to finish the process of freeing Veldora'sAstral bodyfrom the Infinity Prison.

Veldora currently inhabits one of Rimuru'sclonesas his own form, and aSoul Corridorwith Rimuru allows the two to share their powers with one another. Thanks to storing his memories within Rimuru, Veldora is functionally immortal. So long as Rimuru lives, Veldora can be summoned again regardless of how much damage he takes.
Trivia: He is one of a handful of individuals aware ofCiel's existence, along with Velgrynd,Charys,Mjurran,Benimaru,Diablo,Grucius,Chloe, and Rimuru himself. Benimaru, Diablo, and Grucius are only aware of Raphael's existence in the manga continuity.
To the surprise of many, he is quite capable as a cook, working a takoyaki stand during the festival and even amazing people with how good they were.

Appearance: Abiru, who was originally quite elderly in appearance, regained his youth after evolving into a Dragonewt. He has long black hair, green eyes, and a metal helmet encrusted with a large blue jewel. As a lizardman he had green scales, but they turned purple after he evolved into a Dragonewt.

As a Dragonewt; Abiru has scales, horns, wings, and a tail. He is capable of using theDragon ScalesSkillto freely hide these features at his disclosure, even being capable of assuming a fullyhumanform.
Personality: Abiru, even as a young man, always had a bold and serious personality; something that only complimented the carefulness and wisdom he gained in his later years, making him revered as a hero-like figure among his people. As a leader, he knows to act as symbol of strength and perseverance, making sure to properly hide his emotions and say only the words his people need to hear.

Abiru's intelligence is considered genius level, able to gauge the entire situation of a war from just a glance and prepare a counter strategy in an instant.  His intellect is so fierce that he's able to remain several steps ahead of other commanders. Even Gabiru, a genius and expert tactician in his own right, admitted complete inferiority in front of his father's strategies.

In his personal life, Abiru is quite stubborn and withdrawn, something that can sometimes drive a wedge between him and his children, particularly Gabiru, whom Abiru had a hard time conveying his deep love for.
Background: Abiru, originally a nameless lizardman, was a man born with many talents. His genius-level intellect and unusual strength in combat resulted in him being branded as a Unique Monster, and allowed him to become a hero-like existence among his people. His leadership skills and charisma were enough to instill a fierce loyalty into each and every lizardman, something that he works tirelessly to maintain.

Abiru, at some point, had two children. Aboyand agirl. The boy showed promise as his successor, having a sharp mind and excellent sense for battle that charmed the younger generation; while the girl had a calm and analytical personality that made her well suited for dealing with internal affairs. He assigned the two the roles of Warrior Captain and Guard Captain respectively.

After the events ofA Disturbance in the Forest, he received hisnamefromRimuru Tempestand joined theJura-Tempest Federation. He sent his two children to the capital, hoping for them to gain experience and achievements as Rimuru's subordinates while he would use his regained youth to maintain his rule over the lizardmen for years to come.

Background: Each one of them had strength surpassing the averageEnlightened. They were legendary figures who had even trainedChosen heroesin the past. They completely masked their presence from the public eye and became legends that were only said to live in fairy tales.
There is only a small group of people who have actually witnessed them, even among the Western Holy Church, only a few high-ranking officials have had the opportunity to meet them.
The "Trials of Seven Luminaries" thatHinataonce went through were created by them. It was a trial used to selectHeroesand Chosen heroes.

They were responsible for overseeing different organizations and training new knights. All of these assignments were given byLuminous. And before Hinata came into her position, theCrusaderswas an organization with only their name but nothing to back it up, due to them secretly sabotaging potential talents.
The Seven Luminaries were actually strongHumanswho had received Luminous' blessing and were given a long lifespan in exchange for their services.
Because they feared that the CardinalAdalmannand PaladinAlbertwould surpass them, they sent them to their death to face aDragon Zombie.

They also tried to pit Hinata Sakaguchi against Demon LordRimuruunder orders from their leaderGranbellas they were afraid of losing Luminous' favor. During the meeting between Hinata and the Ten Great Saints, they provided her with a powerful sword calledDragon Buster(a trap that they have rigged) to help her take down Rimuru after she received a message from him challenging her, which was actually forged by them. They also manipulated one of the Ten Great Saints,Leonard Jester, into attackingTempest, withArsimpersonatingGarde, another one of the Ten Great Saints, after killing the real Garde. After Rimuru and Hinata's fight ended in a draw, the Dragon Buster then unleashed a deadly attack that greatly wounded Hinata. The Luminaries then arrived to deal with Rimuru, Hinata, and their subordinates, but their attempts to eliminate them were unsuccessful thanks to Rimuru's powerful defense abilities.
They met their end when they were killed byNikolaus,Diablo, and Luminous herself, after their plot to eradicate both Hinata and Rimuru was exposed, though their leader survived.

Vega.summary: While banished to the end of time and space byMai Furukihe was later brought back to theCentral WorldbyVeldanavathrough his Grudge Summoning technique, incarnating intoKakeashi. He was ultimately killed byLuminous Twilight Valentineafter his new body was possessed byJahil.

Summary: While banished to the end of time and space byMai Furukihe was later brought back to theCentral WorldbyVeldanavathrough his Grudge Summoning technique, incarnating intoKakeashi. He was ultimately killed byLuminous Twilight Valentineafter his new body was possessed byJahil.
Appearance: Vega appeared as a force of nature, with a body muscular and tenacious like that of a ferocious beast, exuding anauraoppressive enough to kill a person with just a glance.
Personality: Vega was a man loyal solely to his instincts, following only those he perceived as strong. He was considered an idiot by his peers for his irrational way of thinking and impulsive behavior, never once showing remorse or reflecting on his mistakes. He sucked up to the strong and was merciless to the weak, seeing the latter as only food to empower him. His sharp intuition was one of his few noteworthy traits, allowing him to survive many harsh situations and returning alive.

Due to his upbringing, Vega firmly believed that the world is a cruel place and that the one constant truth in it that reigned supreme is "might makes right". For this reason, he believed any ideal without power behind it is worthless. Conversely, as long as one has the power to realize an ideal, any act is justified no matter how ruthless it is. Vega's perception of defeat is death, therefore he believed anything short of it is preferable, even being subjugated by those stronger than him. He had no concept of camaraderie and was willing to quickly turn on his peers when they let their guard down.

After spending an incomprehensible amount of time in the end of time and space, Vega's hunger for power disappeared in the face of incredible loneliness. He came to value his previous relationships and deeply regretted betraying his allies, so much so when he was revived by Veldanava, he risked his life to protect Yuuki and his friends from Jahil.
Background: Vega was originally from the royal capital ofEnglassiaand was born as a heretic due to the influence of his father, who was a formerMagic Inquisitorthat went insane from taking in the power of too manyMonsters, forcing himself on Vega's mother. Most of Vega's early life was spent on the streets scavenging whatever he could eat to survive as his mother, and everyone around him feared him as a monster and tried to have him killed. For years, he lived off eating scraps, rats, and eventually humans. It didn't take long before an order was issued to execute him, which Yuuki was tasked with. WithShizuassisting in the crusade, Vega was successfully apprehended. Thinking it a shame to snuff out promising talent, Yuuki secretly transferred Vega to theEastern Empireto receive an education throughDamrada, and lied to Shizu that he was disposed of.

Appearance: Elmesia is a beautiful but androgynous woman with a youthful appearance that one could mistake for a child.  Her distinctive features are her long pointed ears; snow-like skin; slanted, jade eyes; and long pale blue-silver hair that falls gently over her cheeks.
Personality: Elmesia is a whimsical yet cautious person, never directly giving out her true opinion on matters and enjoying teasing her conversation partner, throwing them for a loop. She holds the belief that monarchs shouldn't be slaves to the people and should be free to bask in the wealth and luxury they hold. Elmesia has a pet peeve for unverified information being brought to her, and is just as annoyed when her free time is interrupted.

However she also got a carefree side as she as disregardedErald Grimwaldpleas of risks of visiting the festival in Tempest and the danger of the strength of it's members. Despite her carefree attitude, is also ruthless, as she stated to Erald that if the elven nobles dare to rebel while she is away she will personally take care of them.
Background: Thousands of years ago, Elmesia was born toSylvia El Ru, with her father having gone missing while still in the womb. Elmesia would come to grow up, rounding up thirteen royal families and forming the foundation for what would be a great dynasty, naming it in honor of her father. Down the line, Elmesia became acquainted with the royalty ofDwargon, meeting a youngGazel Dwargo. She also formed a connection withLeon Cromwellbefore his hero days, when he was still under her mother's tutelage, growing fond of him as a little brother, and eventually helped him kickstart his own nation in the future.

Kagali.title: Kagali

infobox.Former Affiliation(s): Army of JusticeEastern EmpireFree GuildCerberusTen Great Demon Lords
infobox.Light Novel: Volume 2:A Disturbance in the Forest(Mentioned)Volume 6:The Octagram Soars(As Kazalim)Volume 9:Opening of the Monster City(As Kagali)

Appearance: As Kazalim, she was a scarred maleelf. She usually donned in a cloak and wore a mask to cover her face.
As Kagali, she is a beautiful female elf with violet eyes and blonde hair. She usually wears formal attire.
Personality: During her time as one of the Demon Lords, Kagali was infamously known to be a cruel and power-hungry individual. She garnered a lot of infamy due to her utilizing unique curses to create several high-class servants in order to further consolidate power. She was also known to be highly destructive and ill-tempered once set off, having antagonizedRoy Valentinand causing mass destruction in the ensuing battle against him.

Kagali was also known to be a highly cunning and intelligent Demon Lord, having initially gained a reputation from her uncanny ability to gather information and create complex and ingenious schemes. She was known to control things behind the scenes rather than reveal her hand. This is seen during numerous schemes to recruit several Demon Lord potentials as allies by advocating their claims to join the Demon Lord council in order to obtain further political power amongst her peers.

However, despite her violent and manipulative tendencies, Kagali was also shown to have a lighter and more friendly side, seen during her interactions with the members of the Moderate Harlequin Alliance, who are all genuinely loyal to each other and view themselves as family.

Kagali is also shown to possess a very vengeful side to her personality, as seen where she was greatly angered byClayman's death and swore to avenge him, and she still felt immense anger and vengeful hatred for Leon Cromwell due to him having defeated and killing her original body.

It should however be noted that Kagali's ill-tempered personality is also one of her greatest flaws, as unlike her usually composed manner where she would make logical and more tactical decisions, she would usually end up lashing out at her opponents when set off without analyzing the situation and this has costed her dearly on two occasions; the first one being due to her jealousy that erupted from seeing Leon's beauty and thus losing her physical body and the second occasion being enraged upon learning of Clayman being forcefully brainwashed and resulting in his demise, that would in turn lead her to be put under Kondou's brainwashing.

Her power-hungry attitude may have resulted due to the physical and mental abuse she received fromJahil(who possessed her father), as she would have likely lamented over her powerlessness and in turn may have desired more power in order to retaliate later on as well as to ensure she remains strong enough to defend herself.
Background: Centuries ago, Kagali was once the princess of the Great Sorcerous Nation Of Soma, which, at the time, was one of the most prosperous kingdoms in the world. Kagali suffered a great deal of misfortune due to herfather, the King (who had been possessed by Jahil) who stripped her of her powers and experimented on her, leading to her death. She was resurrected by him as aDeathman, albeit with a rotting, twisted and an ugly form due to a curse he placed. Kagali begged him to return to his "peaceful and loving ways" but her plea fell on deaf ears as, in a fit of rage, he lashed out and used the power of his curse to forcibly transform her into a man and changed her name to Kazalim, calling her his son. Ashamed of her once beautiful face gone forever, she began to wear a mask and robes to hide her scarred body, and started referring to her new name, Kazalim. Eventually, her homeland would soon spell its own destruction by foolish acts of its king, who angeredMilim Nava, the daughter of Star King DragonVeldanava, resulting in the nation being completely obliterated as the capital of the elven empire was reduced to nothing by a bright beam of pure destruction.
Kagali was one of the few remaining elves who survived the disaster. Witnessing Milim's wrath firsthand caused the latter to adopt a healthy fear and respect for her power.

Devastated by the loss of the maidservants and the knights who loved her and desperate to see them again, Kagali used the forbidden spell "Birthday". The result was the creation of three beautiful Deathmen: Clayman,FootmanandTear. Upon seeing they didn't appear ugly, Kagali realized that her appearance was the result of a curse that her father had placed on her. These individuals were specifically engineered in order to give them unique traits, where Clayman was engineered to specifically become a Demon Lord while Footman and Tear had formidable combat prowess to make them a match against a Demon Lord. In order to never forget the humiliation of the past, she fell prey to the forbidden art.

As one of the surviving elven royalty, Kagali attempted to rebuild her lost homeland. At some point after establishing a settlement for her fellow elves, theChaos Dragonattacked and contaminated the land, causing the elves to be cursed to live their lives asdark elves. By using the knowledge and technology she preserved from the original fallen elven nation, now known as the great ruin "Soma," she managed to expand on and recreate many of its lost technologies, resulting in the creation of the capital city, Amrita, of thePuppet Nation of Jistav.  She later travelled back to the ruins of her former country to retrieve its treasures. On her journey, she encounteredSarion Grimwald, theChosen herowho had been tasked with eliminating the Chaos Dragon, but was mortally wounded and affected by its cursed attacks. Kagali, who had been observing his battle, offered him the choice of being reborn, but warned him that he would not only become her puppet but would also lose his memories. Sarion agreed, firmly believing he would never forget his memories and his wife Sylvia. With the negotiations concluded, Kagali used the spell, but due to her inexperience, Sarion was reborn as a Deathman but lost all his memories. From there he was given a new name and identity;Laplace, the Wonder Pierrot.

Overcoming persecution during the war between the demi-humans and humans, Kagali emerged as the "Curse Lord" Kazalim. She quickly built up a fearsome reputation as a cunning schemer due to her uncanny ability to gather information.

Kagali lived through threeGreat Tenma Wars. She joined theDemon Lord councilas the seventh member. During her time as one of the Demon Lords, Kagali was known to have battled againstRoy Valentin, who was noted to have power equivalent to her own. Their battle was destructive enough that all the surrounding territories around them were destroyed, resulting in the passing of a certain custom — which has seen use into the present — whereby all disputes between Demon Lords are decided via a majority vote. However, despite having fought him, it was shown that Kagali was oblivious to Demon Lord Valentin's true position as a servant to the actual Demon LordLuminous Valentine, holding her council seat.

Kagali, alongside Milim, would also advocate the claim of Carrion as a Demon Lord and would also back up Frey and Clayman's claims in order to allow them into the council in order to obtain further political pull amongst fellow Demon Lords.

Eventually, Kagali would come across or hear about Leon Cromwell, who had declared himself a Demon Lord. As no one stepped up to support Leon's claim, he was deemed a self-proclaimed Demon Lord, causing Kagali to step in to eliminate Leon for daring to call himself a Demon Lord, leading to the two fighting each other. In actuality, however, Kagali wanted to gain more power and decided to recruit Leon, as she did with Carrion and Frey, hoping to teach Leon a lesson in humility. However, upon reaching Leon's territory and seeing his beautiful face, Kagali was enraged and jealous, reminded of her lost beauty, and attacked him.

Kagali lost the fight and her body was destroyed. However, she had successfully survived their encounter and for over a hundred years, wandered around as a disembodied spirit, with her consciousness and mind slowly dissipating due to lack of a body. It was only until 30 years prior toRimuru's reincarnation that she successfully possessed the body of anOtherworlder, Yuuki Kagurazaka, who agreed to share his body with her so she won't die. Grateful for Yuuki's help, despite originally having tried to snatch his body, she began working closely together with him to reach their shared goals. 30 year later, Yuuki was able to purchase a female elfhomunculusbody fromSarionfor her to possess, allowing her to regain a body of her own, whereupon she took on the identity of Kagali, Yuuki's secretary.
Trivia: It's been stated by Yuuki Kagurazaka that her homunculus body was one of theSorcerous Dynasty of Sarion's specially made products.

Her original body was a female, being the Princess of the Super-Sorcery Kingdom of the elves, but was disfigured and forcibly transformed into a male body. After the death of her original body, she possessed the female Homunculus body.

In Volume 8, she decides to call herself Kagali temporarily, telling Yuuki that she will call herself Kazalim only after taking vengeance on Leon. As of Volume 19, she no longer calls herself Kazalim and prefers being called by her current name, Kagali.

She debuts in Volume 2 of the Light Novel, though only mentioned by her title as the "Curse Lord." Her actual debut is in Volume 6, though there is no mention of her current identity as Kagali and she is only called Kazalim. Her debut as Kagali, however, is in Volume 9.
Her current Mystic angel body is stated to surpass her former body of Demon Lord Kazalim in her prime.

As Demon Lord Kazalim, she held the second most political power and influence in the Demon Lord Council due to her bringing Clayman, Carrion and Frey into the Council, only falling behind Guy, since he was the strongest amongst the Demon Lords and the de facto leader of the Demon Lord council.

She likes cream puffs fromEnglassiaand it is assumed to be her favorite food. One possible reason may be because she might not have tasted various cuisines from all over the world. Another reason could be because it could have been the first food she had ever since she lost and regained a physical body.

It should be noted that Kagali was only pretending to be annoyed by her new female Homunculus body, and even went as far as to behave like her former personality of Kazalim just to hide the fact that she was originally a female. This is likely done out of embarrassment as most knew the Demon Lord Kazalim to be a man. In actuality, she was pleased, as she not only got a body, but even had that body to be made as close as her original female body was.

Kagali seems to have been originally imagined as anelf-turned-deathman; in her debut in the prologue ofvolume 6, it is specifically noted that she was originaly an elf before being transformed into a deathman. It seems that only much later, involume 18, her original species was retconned into ahigh elf. This has produced some confusion among fans, as high elves arespiritual life-forms, and Kagali was previously noted in both volume 6 andvolume 14to not be a spiritual life-form.

As Demon Lord Kazalim, she has taken part in only two mentioned battles; one battle with Roy Valentin that seemingly ended in a draw, and the other battle with Leon Cromwell which was a devastating setback due to losing her physical body at the time.

Appearance: Charys takes on the appearance of a horned, muscular humanoid with dark brown skin, golden eyes, claws, and a tail. As a result of Veldora's influence, his deep red hair turned a darker hue. His attire consists of just pants, leaving his upper body exposed.
Personality: Charys initially had an underdeveloped ego and possessed the disposition of a feral animal. Though he displayed some intelligence in using the environment to his advantage and employing trickery against his opponents, he mostly acted only on instinct and indiscriminately attacked anything he perceived as a threat to himself or Leon. This caused his host Shizu a great deal of anguish as it costed her valuable relationships, resulting in an irreconcilable wall forming between them.

After being imprisoned in Rimuru'sStomach, he had little to do but observe the outside world alongside Veldora who, not countingGreat Sage, served as his only conversation partner. Through this, he gradually developed a sense of self. By watching Rimuru's daily life and taking in Veldora's wisdom, Charys began to sympathize with others and gained a keen understanding of the value of interpersonal relationships, causing him to realize why Shizu was always at odds with him and also feeling a sense of shame and regret over their fall out. By the time he was released from Rimuru's Stomach, he had become a calm and rational individual, reformed and fully loyal to Veldora and Rimuru.

Charys is characterized as a fast learner. This is demonstrated when he nearly won against Veldora in aShogimatch very shortly after learning how to play the game. He is also cautious and extremely flexible in combat, holding his cool against superior opponents while employing various tactics against them and noting their effectiveness. His prudent nature has earned the caution and respect ofZalario.[3]
Background: Charys used to be an inhabitant of theElemental Realm, but was summoned to theDwelling of the Elementalsand "stolen" by the "Platinum Devil" Leon Cromwell.[4]After Shizue Izawa's summoning, he was sealed within her, turning her into ademonoid.
Trivia: "Ifrit" does not count as a name, but rather a name for his species (Greater elemental of Fire). For this particular individual, he was nameless until named by Veldora, although he was constantly addressed as "Ifrit" until then.
He is one of the few individuals aware ofRaphael's existence.

As shown in thisrejected illustrationforDungeon Encroachment, Illustrator and Character Designer Mitz Vah initially drew Charys with a female appearance. According to the writer Fuse, it was a result of a "misunderstanding". It got rejected in the final version on the grounds of potentially confusing the reader, not because the form was unrealistic or outside the character's capabilities.[5]In the final version Charys is depicted in his masculine form.

InVeldora's Slime Observational Journalit is revealed the IfritRimurudeployed againstHinata Sakaguchiwas a copy of him.This would be adapted intoThe Slime Diarieschapter 54 as Ifrit was excited to fight but got disappointed it was a copy of him summoned.

Appearance: True Dragons, as nature itself incarnate, and asSpiritual life-forms, do not have a set singular appearance or form. They can assume the appearance and properties of whatever they wish, with no real attachment to theirbodies. As spiritual beings, whatever form they assume will be affected by their own personal self-image and individuality.

True Dragons typically assume a massive lizard-like form covered in scales and bearing horns and wings calledDragon Mode｢竜形態,doragon mōdo, lit. "Dragon Form"｣, in addition to a secondaryhuman-like form, withRimuru'sSlimeForm being a notable exception. Their Dragon Mode is capable of taking and dealing much more damage, while their human form is far more energy efficient and is better suited for long-term battles.
Birth: True Dragons areNature'sHoly SpiritBearing Will｢自然聖霊の意思的存在,shizen seirei no ishi-teki sonzai, lit. "Will-bearing Existence of Natural Holy Spirit"｣.[4]They areAvatars｢分身,bunshin, lit. "Alter Ego"｣of God[5]and share the sameOrigin｢根源,kongen, lit. "Root"｣as Veldanava himself, although they were born in different eras. Veldanava and Ivaragé were born before the creation of theworld, while the other True Dragons were born during the creation process.[6]

After a True Dragon is born for the first time, it can never be truly killed. Even if the individual itself is killed, another True Dragon of the same natural characteristic will be born anew somewhere else. That new True Dragon will have the memories of the previous but might lose some aspects of its personality, while simply understanding its nature of existence right after birth.[7]
Abilities: True Dragons are the strongest beings to exist, being closer to walking natural disasters that can't be fought rather thanmonsters. They're superior to every other being in existence in every category. It doesn't matter if it's Physical Strength,Mana, Calculation Power,MagiculeQuantity, Defense, Offense, or Speed, they're overwhelmingly superior.[8]

Their nature as the Ultimate existence means they have no need forUltimate skills, as the powers they innately possess are already "Ultimate" in nature. Even beings of comparable power likeGuy Crimsonare unable to affect True Dragons in a significant way with half-heartedSkillsandMagic. In particular, it seems that any abilities that enforce "rules" onto others are completely ineffective, even if they were to consent to it and actively try to be affected.[9]

Even though they're spiritual beings, they possess the rare ability to form a stableMaterial bodyusing the magicules and matter from their environment. This allows them to freely resurrect whenever they wish, without the need of a vessel.
Intrinsic skills: Although each True Dragon is "unique" and has different intrinsic abilities, all share three intrinsic skills in common:
Dragon Spirit Haki｢竜霊覇気,ryū rei haki｣
Magic: True Dragons share a type of intrinsic magic calledTrue Dragon magic｢竜種魔法,ryūshu mahō｣. Each type of True Dragon magic is unique to the respective True Dragon and only shared by theirfactors.
Rimuru Tempest: Rimuru Tempestis a special case, as they fully realize their latent potential and power as a True Dragon during the events ofthe Abyss Unleashedand reincarnate into a fully draconic body with similar physical properties to a slime calledUltimate Slime｢竜魔粘性星神体,arutimetto suraimu, lit. "Dragon Demon Viscous Star Divine Body"｣. Despite having no direct relation to slimes, it is still named as such for the sake of convenience.

Notably, the other True Dragons don't seem to see Rimuru as their sibling the way they see the other publicly recognized True Dragons, nor does Rimuru themself seem to consider themself a "legitimate" True Dragon.[10]
Related Existences: There are multiple existences that are related to True Dragon, with varying similarities. Virtually none of them have the shared intrinsic skills of True Dragons, but may have access to other similar abilities. Their power can vary widely, from being practically insignificant compared to actual True Dragons to being their equals.
Differentiation From Regular Dragons: Dragons are beings born in places with high magicule concentration from the releasedDragonFactor｢竜の因子,ryū no inshi｣ofGaiawhen it became theChaos Dragon. Although they cannot compare in terms of existence or power, and are often even outright called an entirely different lifeform, their appearance is still extremely similar.
Trivia: Inthe first data book, Milim is mislabeled as one of the four True Dragons.
Inthe second data book, Gaia's race was already listed as True Dragon, without any further elaboration.
Despite her connection with Veldanava and titled"World-Destroying Dragon"｢滅界竜,mekkairyū｣, Luvelgé is classified as aCryptid.
As there is no set standard for members of theirraceand because of the circumstances behind their birth, True Dragons are each individually considered "unique monsters."

Although True Dragons normally can't be killed for good, Luvelgé, at the timenamedIvaragé, was able to permanently kill Veldanava inGenesis of Rivalryby devouring him. This was due to their unique circumstances of having originally been the same entity, allowing Ivaragé to fully assimilate Veldanava's essence.

Restructured Armor Corps: These were soldiers who had adopted the otherworldly technology and underwent magical modifications, allowing them to survive 7 days without eating and drinking. Their individual combat capability was at least ranked C+, and the elite among them even reached rank A. There were 700,000 of them.
Magitank Force: This unit possessed 2,000 magitanks, a new weapon they had put into practical use. The magitank, operated by five people, is an unprecedented war machine that revolutionized the concept of battle. The main armament of the tanks, named magic cannon, had a caliber of 120mm and muzzle velocity of 2,000 meters per second. It had a 50-round capacity and could fire five rounds per minute. Its power was tremendous, being able to unleash destruction equivalent to tactical-class super-high explosive magic. Incidentally, although they are fired based on magic principles, the shell itself is a simple lump of iron. It is a formidable kinetic projectile that could easily penetrate both anti-magic barriers and anti-archer defenses. The number of troops, including the maintenance team, was 200,000.
Flying Combat Corps: They had 400 airships and were the pride of the Empire, the fruit of the otherworldly knowledge. Each craft could carry a maximum of 400 passengers. Of them, 50 are vital maintenance crew required to operate the ship, while the remaining crew would be engaged in defensive magic or gunning. The airships are equipped with a large number of magically enhanced guns, making them excellent warships for both offense and defense. They are also useful as a means of transportation, making it possible to transport a large number of troops and catching the enemy off guard with a pincer attack. The division numbered 100,000 troops, most of which belonged to the formerMagic Division.

Child: As a child, Chloe has waist-length black hair and blue eyes. She wears a simple pink frock along with a black cloak commonly worn by students of the Freedom Academy.
Adult: As an adult Chloe dons a white cape dress over a long-sleeved black shirt, and wears a black corset above the dress with a black waist cape attached to it. She also wears white gloves with a gauntlet glove in her left hand, white and blue boots, black spats, and a ruby necklace. In this form Chloe has the features of a beautiful girl with her hair arranged in a side ponytail. However, her face still contains the original essence of a delicate and quiet girl. However, she in the past, she usually wore theAnti-magic Mask, so not many people knew how her face looked like.
Personality: Chloe is an introverted girl who likes to spend her time reading picture books and manga. While she appears rather cold and stoic most of the time, she can also be very emotional. Due to her traveling back in time many times to save her loved ones, she can be considered to have a very strong will and sense of determination, refusing to give up under dire circumstances and always carrying hope in her heart. She is merciless in battle, chasing and dispatching her enemies with brutal efficiency. Chloe has been shown to be very bold in her interactions withRimuruand has snuck a kiss from him in more than a few occasions, tending to act like an adult around him. She has obtained the trust of a huge number of prominent figures over time, from humans to vampires to dragons and demons. As a time traveling hero, she often uses an alias or her manas’ name instead; only a few people know of her abilities and even then she does not brag or act shallow and always seen as someone who is a huge pillar of support to many people in their darkest hour.
Background: Chloe arrived to theCentral Worldthrough a dimensional crack alongside her surrogate older brotherLeon Cromwell, but was immediately called to the present era where the story takes place in through the summoning rituals secretly carried out in the Western nations. As she couldn't manifest aUnique skill, she was doomed to the same fate as many other summoned children due toMagiculeoverflow, and was sent to the Freedom Academy to live out the remainder of her life alongside similar cases.

In the academy'sClass S, she alongside its other students —Kenya Misaki,Ryota Sekiguchi,Gale Gibson, andAlice Rondo— were entrusted in the care of the retired adventurer and legendary championShizuwho was motivated to save them from their fates. After Shizu took off one last time to pursue Leon's whereabouts, the kids were assigned other teachers in the meanwhile but rejected them all, eventually becoming known as a class of troublemakers.

Following Shizu's death, Rimuru became their new teacher and brought them to theDwelling of the Elementalsto bring their raging magicules under control. While the other children took inGreater elementals, Chloe instead merged with the Spiritual Body of her future self. Nonetheless, the outcome remained the same as the other kids and her magicule levels dropped to where it no longer endangered her life. When Rimuru's time with them comes to an end and he leaves to go home, he entrusts Chloe with theAnti-magic Maskand gave her new clothes sewn byShuna.

Sometime later, during the events ofOpening of the Monster City, Chloe and Class S get invited toTempestand participate in nation's Founding Festival, permanently moving there later to continue their education.
Trivia: Chloe's Japanese voice actress,Azusa Tadokoro, also performs theanime's 2nd ending theme "Little Soldier."

From appearances alone he doesn't come off as intimidating at all, even though he's a super olddaemonwho's lived several millennia.
True Form: After gathering all of hisBody Doubles, Moss becomes a beautiful man with silver hair and blue eyes.
Personality: He usually holds a calm and levelheaded disposition in contrast with his appearance, and is fairly intelligent. In the presence of his superiors, Moss gets super timid, to the point his own presence in the room thins out. He is very loyal—attending to Testarossa for several millennia in spite of her personality is proof of that—and he shows extreme humbleness whenever praised. He's quick to rage when his master is insulted in any manner and will proceed to ruthlessly kill the offender unless it goes against his orders.

Laplace's clothing can be described as stuck out clown-like with its rabble of colors and patterns, which consists of colorful robe tied with a bright long ribbon at the waist, fur on the neck, gloves and pointy boots.[1]
Personality: Despite his seemingly laid back attitude, Laplace is actually a strong and cunning individual who cares a lot about his friends and family.

Laplace is known to possess a humorous side to himself as well, given how he mocked his Master and President,Kagali, who was the formerDemon LordKazalim. However, despite such mockery, he deeply cares about her, and was known to act as a mentor figure to his friendClayman, who had lost his mentor figure for a while.

Laplace doesn't prefer direct combat and tries to avoid it by utilizing sneaky and stealthy tactics, even on enemies weaker than himself. He hates prolonging any battle because if it did happen, it would draw unnecessary attention towards him. These traits make him the perfect candidate for an espionage mission.

He deeply loves his family, and hates to show his strength, as he feels it would seem as though he was bullying Clayman. He was also furious on Clayman for rushing his plans too quickly that led to his demise and was heartbroken to learn he was no more. The only way one can actually enrage this calm Pierrot is if someone mocked or bullied  his family or friends. The momentRoy Valentinmocked the late Marionette Master, an enraged Laplace brutally attacked theVampireand killed him, laughing like a madman while actually grieving about his friend's demise.

He set out to slay theChaos Dragonthat drove the elves away from their homeland, but was defeated. On the verge of death,Kazalimreached out to him and turned him into aDeathmanusing the ForbiddenMagic"Birthday". However, in the process, due to Kazalim's inexperience, Sarion lost his memories. This event birthed the Wonder Pierrot, Laplace.
