Appearance: Carrera assumes the appearance of a young woman with shoulder-length blonde hair and blue eyes. She wears a black snow coat with a skull pin over a white shirt and tie. Her appearance gives off the vibe of a high school delinquent. She is slightly taller than Ultima but shorter than Testarossa.[2]
As aDaemon, she has the characteristic horns and wings of her race, but since she usually keeps them hidden it is unknown how they look like.
Personality: Just as her appearance suggests, Carrera possesses the devil-may-care personality of a high school delinquent. She is carefree, energetic, and exhibits a love for engaging in battles, often unleashing herNuclear magicfor sheer enjoyment. Additionally, she tends to be egocentric and has a tendency to become easily angered, rarely taking others' opinions into consideration. While she can be arrogant, Carrera is capable of recognizing formidable opponents, as demonstrated during her encounter withTatsuya Kondou.

While engaging in a fight with Kondou, she realized that she had underestimatedhumansto a significant extent. This realization prompted her to quickly reassess her attitude and confront him seriously. Carrera developed a notable amount of respect for Kondou when he proved capable of holding his ground and matching her power. Despite her lineage being infamous for being unyielding in negotiations, she accepted Kondou'spowersandsoulas part of a deal to fulfill his wish of assassinating thecorrupted emperor.

She is equally perplexed as Testarossa and Ultima regarding Rimuru's intention of granting them a day off for leisurely activities, since, as adaemon, Carrera is unaccustomed to the concept of having time off from her master's assigned tasks.
Background: Jaune, like her other primordial brethren, was born during the dawn of time before the creation of heaven and earth as the demonic counterparts to theSeven Angels of Originsplit from theGreat Holy SpiritofDarkness. She and the other primordials ruled Hell undisturbed for an eternity withRougeas its overlord. WhenBleuandVertwere resurrected completely loyal to Rouge after their attempt to overthrow him, Jaune,Blanc, andVioletagreed to never fight each other directly, instead preferring to outsmart each other in things like games and who could incarnate in thematerial worldfirst.[3]

Hundreds of years ago, she actually managed to create a powerful body to be used as an incarnation medium, in a small country inSorcerous Dynasty of Sarion, but it was destroyed byLeon Cromwell, then still achosen hero. Unaware that it was Violet who led Leon there, she was extremely frustrated and began spending all of her time developing flashy and powerful magic as vengeance for Leon's interference.[4][5]

Leon's knights tried negotiating with her multiple times but were ignored each time. Worse still, she caused them a great deal of trouble by firing nuclear magic upon theircityon a near daily basis as a provocation to Leon so he would challenge her to a fight sinceGuyacknowledged his strength.
Trivia: She was named after thePorsche Carreracar.
She was shown inThe Ways of the Monster Nationspin-off manga in chapter 42 and in short comic by the end Light NovelVolume 13drawn by Taiki Kawakami himself.
Of all the primordials, she has arguably the worst reputation in the eyes of theDemon Lords, due to her unpredictable nature and destructive tendencies.

Properties: Greater daemons possess a great amount of power comparable to that of aGreater Majin's. The appearance of a greater daemon can vary between individual members of the species. At the most basic level, they have a vaguely human-shaped arms, legs, a face, etc. — but this resemblance is only at the surface level. The color of a daemon's sclera will usually match their lineage and, although not always, other parts of their body match this color as well. Examples include, but are not limited to, hair color, iris color, and skin color. The color of their clothing usually also reflects the color of their lineage.

Tatsuya Kondou.title: Tatsuya Kondou

infobox.title: Tatsuya Kondou
infobox.Alias / Epithet / Nickname: Stalker of the Halls of Information
infobox.Web Novel: Chapter 136: Eastern Empire(Mentioned)Chapter 144: Underground Labyrinth Capture -Enforcer Scout Platoon-(Actual)

Appearance: Tatsuya, aSaintblessed with an extraordinary lifespan, appeared perpetually youthful despite having surpassed the age of 90. His ebony hair, neatly trimmed and stylishly short, accentuated his aura of vitality. A palpable intensity emanated from him, as if he held the weight of countless experiences within his being. His eyes, devoid of emotion yet piercingly sharp, seemed to possess an uncanny ability to perceive the deepest truths.
In homage to his past, Tatsuya often adorned himself in the resplendent attire of a former Imperial Japanese Navy uniform—a tangible reminder of his dedicated service to a bygone era.
Personality: He was a cold, calculative pragmatist with a very serious demeanor. He was loyal to no one but the emperor, and would not hesitate to kill for the sake of the empire. That said, he held great pride in his swordsmanship and would respect powerful swordsmen even if they were his enemies.
Background: In a world with lowmagicules, Tatsuya Kondou led a humble existence as a Second Lieutenant in the Royal Guard of Japan. He had served as a pilot in the Japanese Navy, showcasing his courage and commitment to his duty. As a direct disciple of the renownedGensei Araki, alongside his martial brothersMasahiko AmariandSaburo Minamoto, Kondou had honed his skills in swordsmanship and learnedBattlewillandHazy Lifestream Styleswordartsunder Gensei's tutelage.

When thePhantomsinvaded his world, Kondou fearlessly risked his life to gather crucial intelligence on a pair of these otherworldly invaders who had attacked him. Displaying unwavering loyalty and selflessness, he provided the information to his commanders before embarking on a kamikaze mission to eliminate the threat. His plane crashed, but instead of meeting his demise, he found himself unexpectedly transported to a differentworld, specifically Rudra's private garden.

In this new world, vibrant with magicules and inhabited by creatures such asdragonsandmonsters, Kondou's path crossed with Emperor Rudra Nasca. There was an immediate connection between them, a resonance that reminded Kondou of his former liege. Grateful for his survival, Kondou graciously accepted Rudra's friendship, eager to serve his newfound ally.

Emperor Rudra, recognizing Kondou's extraordinary potential, personally tended to his injuries and restored his health. In a show of unwavering trust and friendship, Rudra reinstated Kondou's rank as First Lieutenant and offered him the opportunity to continue his service as a valued member of theImperial Guardians. Inspired by this bond, Kondo vowed to become even stronger, his powers further augmented by the transference from his previous world. He rapidly surpassed the other members of the Royal Knights, eventually surpassing even the ancient members ofDouble 0 Numbersand ascended to the esteemed position of Rank 001, assuming leadership of the Imperial Guardians.

Empowered by his newfound status and exceptional abilities, Kondou spearheaded a transformative era for the Empire. He skillfully navigated the treacherous waters of political intrigue, employing a mixture of diplomatic finesse and discreet eliminations to resolve conflicts. Recognizing the need for comprehensive intelligence gathering, he established the Imperial Intelligence Bureau, an expansive network of spies that extended beyond the empire's borders.
Despite the immeasurable power and influence he wielded, Kondou remained grounded and retained the rank of First Lieutenant, symbolizing his unwavering loyalty as the Emperor's lieutenant.
Trivia: The nameTatsuyameans "accomplished, reach, arrive, attain" (達) (tatsu) and "to be, also" (也) (ya).
Tatsuya's surnameKondoumeans "near, early, akin, tantamount" (近) (kon) and "wisteria" (藤) (tou/dou).

Although it should be noted that the Japan he came from isn't the same asRimuru's former Japan, it's in another universe that just so happens to have a very similar Japan. The implication is thatVelgryndis inadvertently responsible.

Summary: After facing a crushing defeat toSouei, she aligned herself withTempestand was assigned to theKurayamiled bySouka; she later joined theThree Wise Drunksand became a fearsome figure in the Western criminal underworld.
Appearance: Glenda is a young woman with short red hair and dark eyes, and a face with a beauty mark just beneath her right eye. She is a wild beauty who, in the words ofRimuru, resembles a "classic spy-film femme fatale". Her outfit consists of a somewhat revealing dress that exposes her cleavage and has a side slit baring her legs, which her gun holster is visible from. She wears knee-length black boots and thigh-high orange socks, along with a long white cape and a pair of dark gloves.

In her activities within the Three Wise Drunks, Glenda has been shown to wear a dark flamboyant dress paired with equally dark opera gloves. She wears a bracelet on her right hand resembling a coiled snake.
Personality: To the public eye, Glenda was considered a faithful and devout follower ofLuminous. In reality, that was merely a cover. Her true nature was that of a woman obsessed with money. She would constantly look for ways to line her pockets, and would easily lie if she sensed a profit from it. Due to her special circumstances as a pawn of the Rosso's, she was compelled to always achieve good results in her tasks, with failure resulting in her demise. This strong lust for life was the one thingMariabellplaced trust in.

As Glenda was interested in only money, she took on any job, clean or dirty, so long as it placed food on the table and provided a roof over her head. This changed, however, when she was exposed to Tempest's food culture. She developed a strong interest in "merit points" and uses it as a fresh source of motivation in her future tasks, with her goal being to earn enough to purchase all the special dishes unique to the land of monsters.
Background: Glenda, famously known by her title, "Raging Sea", was a mercenary from another world that received military training from a foreign legion of a certain nation. After traveling around the world, her combat skill has become phenomenal.

Brought to theCentral Worldby the Rosso family's summoning ritual, she was bound by their curse and forced to serve them. As part of her orders, she infiltratedLubeliusand joined the Rook Geniuses, eventually becoming one of its highest-ranking members as part of the Three Battlesages. She also carried out the Rosso family's dirty work and was the commander of theBlood Shadow. Rimuru eventually freed her from the curse and in response, she turned against the Rosso family and allied with Tempest.

infobox.title: Fenn
infobox.Light Novel: Volume 19:A Disturbance in the Royal Capital

Appearance: Fenn has the appearance of a tall, rugged, and muscular man with shaggy green hair and jade eyes. He wears a long robe that opens to show off his chest and the Gleipnir chains can be seen wrapped around his arms and waist.
Personality: Fenn, on the surface, has a deceptively calm, composed, and alluring personality. Beneath that mask, however, lies a mind of pure insanity that views itself as superior to all other beings and wants to eradicate the world to prove itself. After being imprisoned for millenia and coming to know true loneliness, Fenn came to appreciate the value of friends and family more than he used to, although this didn't manage to curb his destructive tendencies.

Fenn respects strength more than anything else and in combat he forgoes all composure, only believing in using his raw strength to defeat his opponents rather than relying on techniques, despite being perfectly capable of using them.
Background: A long time ago, in the age of myth, an evil giant born from the earth itself began to rampage. The giant was eventually dealt with byVeldanavaand it split apart into Fenn and his two brothersDagruelandGlassord. His two older brothers eventually reformed and abandoned the ambitions of the wicked god while Fenn kept to them and was sealed as a result. After being subdued, Veldanava bound Fenn with the godly chains Gleipnir and locked him inside theHeavenly Star Palace. As an added measure his brother Dagruel was tasked with guarding the entrance to the star palace and the Watcher,Feldway, was assigned to keep watch over him. While sealed away, Fenn managed to stay roughly informed on the activities of his brothers and the outside world via the soul corridor they shared. At some point he ended up becoming friends with Feldway who, as the leader, could not open up about their grievances to their subordinates.

Appearance: Masayuki used to have black hair and brown eyes[1](though he bleached his hair for a while), but they eventually changed intoRudra's teal-blue eyes and blond hair. While acting as a hero, he wears simplistic outfits that are easy to move around in and while acting as a ruler he wears expensive and ornate clothing interweaved with gold thread.
Personality: Masayuki is at his core a rather timid and reserved individual who could be said to have difficulty communicating his intentions to others. However, despite this timid nature, Masayuki is an extremely honorable person who would rather die than run away from his responsibilities. While deep down doesn't really enjoy being a hero, it doesn't stop him from doing what's right

Masayuki is the type of person to never give up. Be it in his original life where he did his best to be the king and hero that Veldanava and his people expected him to be or in his new one where, even without his memories, he again took on the roles of Chosen Hero and Emperor even if he complained about it.

While his excessive pride is mostly a mask that he wears, he has a strong sense of "doing things the right way" and complained about how easy it was for him to gain anUltimate skillthe second time around. Even after regaining all of his memories his personality remains more or less the same, meaning that his current personality and his original personality were most likely nearly identical to begin with.
Background: Masayuki, known at the time as just Rudra, was born millennia ago as a prince of the Kingdom of Nasca with the ambition to unite the entire world. At some point, he was taken under the tutelage of Veldanava, who trained him to be a Chosen Hero that could rival Guy Crimson. Over the course of the many years of his training, he obtained both the Unique Skill Chosen One and the Ultimate skill Uriel. He was also blessed by the Elementals and their Queen, awakening as a True Chosen Hero sometime after. Before his first confrontation with Guy, Veldanava approached him and proposed that they trade Ultimate skills, his Uriel for Veldanava's Michael. Rudra accepted the offer and received Michael, a skill better suited for his dream of unifying the world.

He set out on an expedition to the Ice Continent, taking his sister Lucia and the woman he fell in love with, Velgrynd, along with him. When they arrived at the Frost Palace, he dropped any pretenses of an honorable duel and promptly demanded Guy to hand over all their valuables. He had no intention of killing Guy, only wishing to deal with him to gain the support of the rest of humanity as well as Guy himself. In the duel that followed he was unable to get an edge in on Guy, even with the Holy Field and Holy Blade spells cast by his sister combined with his immense swordsmanship. Guy simply analyzed his movements and copied his every move, only making the demon lord stronger as their fight went on. Even Michael, and the immense power it possessed, wasn't enough for him to achieve victory. The skill had yet to accept him as its new master and he could only control its power for an extremely short duration.

From there, he frequently undertook expeditions to rematch Guy, with no decisive winner ever arising between the two. Back at home, Lucia and Veldanava's romance blossomed and resulted in the birth of his niece Milim. With Veldanava now bearing a mortal life span and living a normal life, Rudra strived more than ever to unite the world and give their family a life of peace. In this vein, he decided to change the nature of his match with Guy. The two of them directly fighting each other would never go anywhere, so he proposed that they duke it out using their subordinates as a proxy, the winner being able to claim rule over the entire world. However, this ideal wasn't something that was fated to last. The unexpected death of Veldanava and his sister drove him into a deep depression, one that the will residing within Michael was able to exploit to slowly twist Rudra's heart into a cold and heartless puppet. The next two thousand years were a constant internal battle between him and Michael, one that exhausted his physical body and forced him to reincarnate over and over, losing pieces of his soul every time due to the strain. Over time he lost more and more pieces of himself, even his status as a Chosen Hero, until he was eventually taken over and killed by Michael.

His lover, Velgrynd, empowered by Rimuru Tempest and Ciel, set out to gather all of his soul fragments that had spread across time and space in various worlds. She gathered every fragment, piece by piece, living alongside dozens if not hundreds of versions of Rudra until only one remained. In the presence of the young Japanese high-schooler,Masayuki Honjou｢本城正幸,masayuki honjō｣, all of the soul fragments flew toward him of their own will. The instant that the fragments merged with Masayuki, the sudden return of his powers created a counter-force that sent the young boy across time and space, with him returning to the Central World. However, due to him returning before the death of his previous self, large parts of his soul, including his memories, laid dormant. He was left with only the pieces that his past self had lost, namely his status as a Chosen Hero and the unique skill Chosen One.

As Masayuki Honjou, while walking home from school with his multitudes of friends, Masayuki saw a "Nordic Beauty" standing on the street, upon which he suddenly got transferred to a different world where he unexpectedly obtained the Unique Skill, which made all the people in his surroundings spontaneously admire him. Masayuki's only fighting ability is the little bit of hobby-level Kendou he had learned, but the crowd considered him an invincible Hero, due to him being unable to control his Unique Skill's effects. For various reasons, such as fearing the possibility that the crowd could turn against him if they got convinced that he is just a "fake Hero," or that those who lost against him in spars would be dishonored for life if they found out how weak he is, he decided he could only go along with their claims and play the role of Hero.

During those days seemingly the only one up to this point who was unaffected was theFree Guild's GrandmasterYuuki Kagurazakawho he could have a normal discussion with, especially as fellow Otherworlders, however since Yuuki was always busy with his job, opportunities to meet up were fairly rare and Masayuki didn't want to rely on Yuuki too much. But due to these events, Masayuki became an adventurer and obtained two companions—the adventurerJinrai, one of the first people Masayuki met in this world who Masayuki also defeated via his luck in a battle; andBernie, an Otherworlder from the USA who became a Wizard. Thanks to the luck and buffs of Masayuki's Unique Skill, the party easily crushed all adversities they've encountered.

At one point, the flow of events led Masayuki into participating in the Ingrassia Arena tournaments, winning all matches easily, all thanks to the effects of The Chosen One and the party's abilities. This raised his and his party's prestige even further. The party got it's fourth member whenJiwu, a Elementalist, heard the rumors about Masayuki and met him to check the validity of them. At first she voiced that he's a fake, but she eventually came around to accept and later even worship him, and so the party of four was complete. Together they advanced through the ranks until they eventually became a "Team Lightspeed".
Trivia: During Masayuki's introduction, the crowd of people around him deduced that he's the missing legendaryblonde Chosen Heroreturned, foreshadowing his true identity as the first Chosen Hero.
Masayuki is an Otherworlder of Japanese and Russian descent.
In the Anime, Masayuki is shown to already have blue eyes even before his arrival in the Central World. In the LN, his eyes only began to change after he spent a while in the Central World.

Summary: Mark Lauren｢マーク・ローレン,māku rōren｣is an AmericanOtherworlderand a disciple ofGadra. He defected toTempestfrom theEastern Empireand currently acts asRamiris' assistant.
Appearance: He has a large, sturdy build, and brown hair. With his fine, chiseled features, he has a considerably good appearance. He doesn't wear heavy equipment like iron armor, instead, he wears a tank top and jeans.
Personality: He has a short temper. He also dislikes the lavish lifestyle his superiors get to live to the point it gets him very angry. This is due to Mark's jealousy at being forced to live the life of an army dog, not being able to afford any of the luxuries of a higher-ranked officer. He's seemingly not in the habit of keeping up to date on the latest information, as he wasn't aware that the Ten Great Demon Lords reorganized and became theOctagram, to which Gadra severely reprimanded him for, criticizing his lack of diligence.
Background: He was a first lieutenant in the Eastern Empire's army. LikeShinjiandShin, he's an otherworlder. He used to be an avid gamer as he was very familiar with the labyrinth's dungeon-like mechanics. He was one of the three people sent byYuuki Kagurazakaand Gadra to investigate theDungeon. After his first few days in Tempest, he requested asylum along with Shinji and Shin, which they were granted. They now work as Ramiris' assistants in the labyrinth.
Story: Shinji, Shin, and Mark were ordered to do a full sweep of the Dungeon by Gadra and Yuuki to confirm rumors of a research laboratory at the bottom. Mark uses his abilities to defeat a great number of monsters and eventually picks up a battle axe, which to his surprise, turned out to be a Unique weapon. After seeing its effects in battle, he expresses his joy at finding such a high quality weapon, growing strongly fond of it. They were able to advance further than any team officially has, however, after coming to Rimuru's attention, they were easily exposed as spies. Instead of capturing them, Rimuru opted to observe them deeming it an opportunity to identify areas the Dungeon could improve upon (and to a lesser extent) he found watching them to be entertaining. After reaching the 60th floor guarded byAdalmann, they were swiftly defeated byAlbert. After exiting the Dungeon, they reflected on their stay in the country and collectively agreed it was a nice place to live and that it has a lot of the luxuries that they miss from their home world.
Gadra contacted them and they all seeked an audience with Rimuru after which they defected to Tempest. They took up post as researchers for Ramiris in the Dungeon.

Appearance: Hinata has short black hair and violet eyes. She often sweeps her bangs over her right eye while tucking the left side behind her ear. Her eyes are described as cold and calculating, as though they are always looking for the solution to some kind of mathematical proof. In terms of appearances,Rimurudescribed her as "stunningly beautiful."

She usually wears the Holy Knights armor, which is an armor with a white coat draped over it, as well as a monocle. She carries a powerfulLegend-graderapier known asMoonlighton her hip, gifted to her byLuminouspersonally.
For causal wear, she wears a sleeveless minidress.
Personality: Hinata is a cold pragmatist who doesn't shy away from cooperating with anyone as long as it benefitsmankindas a whole, even cooperating willingly withDemon Lordseven though the Western Holy Church believes in killing allmonsters. She is willing to give anyone who asks her advice, but if that advice is ignored then she won't bother repeating herself. She is also extremely stubborn, always refusing to compromise with others, and will not listen to reason unless ordered to by Luminous. She does not like being made fun of, as she angrily glared at four of the Saints when they mocked her sensitive tongue, and even threatened Kenya with her sword when he was about to insult her. She also doesn't seem to enjoy exposing much of herself; she appeared to feel embarrassed of being completely naked in a public bath, despite only being in the presence of women at the time (however, she felt more comfortable when bathing alone), and when her chest is exposed after Luminous healed her, she covered quickly herself up and even scolded Rimuru for being a pervert.

Within the Church, she is an extremely harsh but powerful and efficient leader, who singlehandedly reformed theCrusadersinto a much more efficient and streamlined version of itself within two years of her rise to power. She also established the Ten Great Saints, a group of formidable knights that stood against theTen Great Demon Lordsin public view.

Hinata holdsShizuin high regards, due to her being the one who trained her and showed her what genuine kindness was for the first time. After learning of her death fromYuuki, Hinata set out to kill Rimuru because of his involvement in it, even going so far as to tell him that she would destroyRimuru Citypersonally. However, her stubbornness and determination also sometimes makes it easy for her to be deceived as she completely fell for theBody Doublethat Rimuru created to trick her in her attempt to defeat him.

Despite being headstrong and stubborn, she is willing to admit and make amends for her own fault once she realizes it. InConflict Between Saints and Monsters, she realized her mistake upon seeing how friendly theJura-Tempest Federationis to humans whilst traveling to Rimuru City and thus makes up her mind to apologize and negotiate with Rimuru.

Hinata's biggest dream is to create a world where humanity can live happily in peace with an egalitarian society without conflicts or quarreling, therefore, she will do anything that can make that dream come true.
Background: Hinata's father was a gambling addict. Eventually, her father racked up a massive debt from gambling on horse races when Hinata was a child, which made Hinata decide to murder him for life insurance by throwing him off an cliff. Hinata's mother suffered an emotional breakdown upon witnessing this murder by her daughter's hand and gotten into religion, causing Hinata to plan to kill her as well and thus orphan herself. Just before that could happen, on her first day of high school, she was whisked away by a "strong gale" to theCentral Worldwhen she was just 15 years old. Upon arrival, she was attacked by three bandits. She ended up gaining twoUnique skillsand managed to kill the three bandits.

Not long after her arrival in the new world, Shizue Izawa took her in as a disciple. Hinata claims that Shizue was the only person who had been kind to her during her early years in the new world. Within a month, Hinata had surpassed Shizue in strength after copying multiple of herskillsusingUsurper. Fearing her own attachment, Hinata went on her own way and eventually became the most powerful knight in theHoly Empire of Lubeliusleading both Crusaders andRook Geniuses, as well as becoming the Leader of the "Ten Great Saints".

At one point she discovered that the Western Holy Church was under the control ofvampiresand was conspiring with Demon Lord Valentin. She defeated bothRoyandLouis, suffering fatal injuries during the process. However, she was then confronted by the real Demon Lord, Luminous Valentine herself, who promptly revived both her fallen subordinates and Hinata herself.

After some negotiations, Hinata passed the trial ofSeven Luminariesand earned the rights to challenge Luminous, but was promptly defeated. Hinata then agreed to become Luminous' subordinate as she deemed the Demon Lord's governing methods to be acceptable in the long run. Nonetheless she keeps honing her abilities in case she ever needs to fight the Vampire Princess again.
Trivia: The nameHinatameans "sunny place" (日向).
Hinata's surnameSakaguchimeans "slope, hill" (坂) (saka) and "mouth, entrance" (口) (kuchi/guchi).

Despite being in the first season's first opening “Nameless story”, Hinata doesn’t appear in the first season. She’s mentioned by Shizu in Inherited Will, but she makes her first appearance/cameo near the end of the Saved Souls.
She is actually myopic, but it doesn't hinder her in any way since she can always useMana Perceptionto compensate for it.
She likes Japanese foods such asramenandgyoza, but can't handle high temperature food very well.
Besides being a saint and warrior, she is surprisingly a good teacher too.

Saint.title: Saint

Sainthood: The typical process of becoming a saint involves anenlightenedtocultivateand pushed their mind andbodyto the absolute limit breaking completely through the mental barrier and becoming a spiritual life-form. This isn't something that can be acquired via training for most individuals, instead requiring immense life and death situations to push them past their limit to achieve. Other, more exotic ways require unique qualities and conditions, like acquiring and hatching aHero's egg, or sublimating the body and soul into a higher state by usingspecialskills.

The big drawback of awakening through Cultivation is that the body doesn't sublimate instantly with thesoul; it usually takes a long time for thematerial bodyto fully ascend to a spiritual state.True chosen heroesare an exception to this rule, as they practically bypass the "transition phase" by permanently merging with theirelementals.
Properties: All saints are terrifyingly powerful individuals; however, their strength can vary greatly from person to person and also depends significantly on the state of the body. Asawakenedbeings, they possess an enormous amount ofenergyand power enough to rival that ofTrue demon lordsandTrue chosen heroes. However, during their “transition” period, they are more vulnerable as their material bodies have to sublimate fully to complete the process of sainthood and acquiring all the properties of spiritual lifeforms. As awakened spiritual lifeforms, they possess souls strong enough to potentially hostultimate skills, as well as extremely long-lived and resilient bodies.
Incomplete saints: Incomplete saints are those who have awakened and become spiritual life-forms, but whose flesh has not yet ascended to the same status. Incomplete saints, while possessing greatly boosted energy and abilities, can still said to only beenlightenedphysically and possess the weaknesses inherent to the human race such as needing oxygen. An incomplete saint can temporarily surpass their limits and gain the status of a complete saint if empowered in certain ways, such as bygod-gradeor comparableequipment, via special skills likeMagic Flame TransformationandDivine Berserker, or byunifyingwith anelemental lord.
Complete saints: Complete saints are those whose body has matched their mental awakening and become almost entirely spiritual in composition. The time needed for a saint to complete this process varies depending on the techniques and talent of the individual, ranging from hundreds of years to mere moments like in the case ofYuuki Kagurazaka. They're freed from human limitations such as needing air, food, or rest and have complete and total control over their body and its functions, even the ability to stop their bleeding and close wounds through sheer willpower. Despite their body being "complete," it has not yet transcended the material realm entirely and still bears a mortal life span, albeit an extremely lengthy one.[1]Only the most powerful among saints have the potential to go beyond the flesh entirely by achievingdivinity.

Monster Origins: There are three manners in which a monster may come into existence.
Spawning, where the monster is born out of thefactorand magicules either latent within the surroundings or let off by a "parent" monster.[1]
Procreationthat has either a singular monster or a pair of compatible monsters engage in regular biological reproduction.
Majinization｢魔人化,majin-ka｣orMonsterization｢魔物化,mamono-ka｣[2], by which non-magic life-forms — plants, animals,humans,Demi-humans,elementals, etc. — mutate into magic life-forms.
Magic beasts: The termmagic beast｢魔獣,majū｣refers to a monsterized animal. It makes up the large majority of monsters seen in the series. There is also a sub-category of magic beasts known asmystic beasts｢妖獣,yōjū｣, which unlike regular magic beast possess acorethat act as their mainbodywhile using a vessel made from magicules or animal corpses.[2]

A particularly noteworthy species of magic beasts is theDragons｢竜族,doragon, lit. "Dragon Tribe"｣, a powerul and diverse reptilian species whose origins can be traced back to theElemental Dragoncreated byVeldanavaas a gift to his daughterMilim Nava. Upon the Elemental Dragon's death and subsequent transformation into the Chaos Dragon, itsfactorspread throughout the world, resulting in dragons, a species with similar traits to the Elemental Dragon but much weaker, spawning alongside other monsters.[3]

One unusual species of magic beasts is theCryptids｢幻獣族,kuriputeddo, lit. "Mythical Beast Tribe"｣,demi-spiritualmagic beasts that originate fromanother dimension, born from themagiculesof the World Destroying DragonIvaragé. Cryptids themselves have a subspecies known asInsectoids｢蟲魔族,insekutā, lit. "Insect-Monster Tribe"｣, who specifically resembleinsectsand similararthropods.
Majin: The termmajin｢魔人,majin｣refers to monsters that possess proper intelligence and rational thought similar to humans and demi-humans.[1]A monster can be a majin from birth (such asvampires,giants, anddaemons), become one later in life via evolution, or be born by the monsterization of an already intelligent life-form, i.e humans and demi-humans.[4]
Named Monsters: Named monsters｢名持ちの魔物,nēmudo monsutā｣are monsters who arenamed. Named monsters tend to have a much easier time acquiring skills and, depending on their race and the relative strength of their namer, may evolve into a higher race.
Undead: Undead｢不死系魔物,andeddo｣are demi-spiritual monsters that reside within lifeless and immortal bodies, lacking any life force. They are especially weak toHoly magic, even more so than other monsters.
Unique Monsters: Unique monsters｢特殊変異個体,yunīku monsutā, lit. "special mutant individuals"｣are individuals of a particular race of monster born with certain characteristics, traits, or abilities not found within the typical member of their species. These individuals are usually much stronger and smarter than their ordinary counterparts. Examples include theOrc LordsandRimuru Tempest.
Trivia: While many demi-human races, such asgoblins,orcs,lizardmen, etc. are often called "monsters," the term used for them isdemons｢魔族,mazoku, lit. "devil tribe"｣, which collectively refers to intelligent enemies of humanity regardless of their status as magical beings.
As there is no set standard for members of their race and because of the circumstances behind their birth,True Dragonsare each individually considered unique monsters.[4]

Sprites: Sprites｢半妖精族,han'yōsei-zoku｣are demi-humans who can trace their origins back toelementals. They tend to possess longer life spans and stronger magical force the purer their blood is. Some of the purest members of its races live almost a millennium long just from their innate power.
There are four primary families among the sprites that can each trace their roots back to a specificelement:
Dwarves｢地人族,dowāfu｣representing theearthelement and derived from thehigh dwarves｢地精人,hai dowāfu｣.
Merfolk｢魚人族,māman｣representing thewaterelement and derived from thesirens｢水精人,seirēn｣.
Kijin｢鬼人族,kijin｣representing thefireelement and derived from theenki｢火精人,enki｣.
Elves｢耳長族,erufu｣representing thewindelement and derived from thehigh elves｢風精人,hai erufu｣.
Beastfolk: Beastfolk｢獣人,jūjin｣are demi-humans who can trace their origins back tomagic beasts. The original and predominant member of their family arelycanthropeswho possess extraordinary physical capabilities and the ability to shift from a human form to their inner animal form, as well as a hybrid between the two. Various other races, such askobolds,orcs, andrabbitfolkare degenerated lycanthropes who over time lost their ability to shift between man and beast, resulting in a permanent mix.
While thelizardmananddragonewtraces bare no direct relation to lycanthropes, their part-beast nature is shared and their powers are functionally identical as a result, just with a draconic nature.
Others: While demi-humans are predominantly filled with subspecies that have adapted tomagiculesand gained tremendous powers as a result, there are some races among them that were not so fortunate and are nearly identical to humans in terms of power. This might have historically been seen as a blessing in disguise due to the immense prejudice towards anything magical in any capacity, but the recent era of demi-human rights established during the events ofTerritory Seizureannuls this.
Classification as monsters: Due to the prejudice of early humans, as well as the policies established by theWestern Holy Church, demi-humans were regarded asmonstersfor nearly all of human history. Anything remotely magical, even somemages, were often seen as evil and therefore offered no human rights. Thus, many demi-humans who often wielded fantastical magical abilities that made them resemble monsters were treated with the utmost disdain and classified as monsters on principle.

During the events ofTerritory Seizure, due to the emergence ofTempest, demi-humans were officially recognized as members of humanity and given proper rights by the Western Nations. The dwarf and elf nations had been previouslytoleratedby the church, but even they were not officially recognized until this declaration.
Evolution: There are two mainstream evolutionary paths available to human and demi-human species:enlightenmentandmajinization. There is a third in the form of awakening the power dormant in ones bloodline and returning to a purer form of their subspecies or even becoming afairy, but this is only normally available to certain demi-human subspecies and only during special circumstances.

Appearance: As the name implies, this unit consists ofhobgoblinsridingstar wolves. WhenFusionis activated, Goblin Riders look a lot like the top half of hobgoblins has their torso fused with the bottom half of a wolf.
History: After the battle of the goblin village,Rimuruordered  the goblins and wolves to become pairs and live together.

Before the evolution, the goblins, survived by gathering fruit, edible grass, and hunting edible monsters and creatures. Thanks to coordinating with the Tempest Wolves, their habitat remarkably widened. The shocking thing was when they became a pair they were able to useThought Communication.
Over the course of time, the wolves increased to 100, hence, 100 riders. Amongst them, captainRigurand vice captainGobta, have an overwhelming presence over the others.
As if they were a skilled team, even their breathing is synchronized. This suggests a high level of proficiency.

The Goblin Riders and the Star Wolves acquired the rare extra skillFusion, as a result of theHarvest FestivalGift. They become as if one being, able to move quickly on all fours and get a boost of strength. Their strength puts them at about rank A- (A in Volume 12). Even the worst among them would dominate the B ranked. Surprisingly, all one hundred have this skill.
They would eventually join theGreen Numbersas Tempest'sFirst Corpsunder Gobta ahead of theNasca Namrium Ulmeria United Eastern Empire's invasion of theGreat Jura Forest.

Appearance: He is a tall, muscular man with a mohawk hairstyle. BeforeRimurugifted him a set of armor, he's wearing only minimal gears on his upper torso.
Personality: During his debut in story, he was an ill-tempered delinquent that was infamous for involving in harassments and violent acts, so much that he failed his advancing test due to misconduct. When Masayuki showed up, he was trying to beat him down for (unwillingly) stepping in between him and the barmaid he's trying to harass.

After being defeated by Masayuki and fell under influence ofChosen One, he gradually became a more reasonable and heroic character. He respected Masayuki greatly, even after realizing that he's just a powerless normalhumanaside from hisUnique skill.
Background: Jinrai was a notorious adventurer dwelling in a town in the Kingdom of Englassia, known for his strength and his fiery temper.  He was trying to harass a bar maid to vent his frustration of failing his Rank B advancement test, but was stopped by Masayuki. After being defeated, he fell under the effect of Chosen One and offered to become Masayuki's teammate, mistaking him as a newly revivedHero.

AfterBerniewas introduced to them, they formed a three-man squad and progressed at an overwhelming rate. Although Jinrai was ranked C+, his strength was comparable to that of a Rank B. With the additional aid of Bernie’s magic, they were able to safely handle any quest they attempted. In only about half a year, the squad was already given the nickname “Lightspeed”.

Appearance: The male member of the Silver Wings was a man of above-average build with medium-long hair. The female member was also of above-average build with ragged neck-length hair. Both of them wore typical traveler's clothing and fur-lined coats, similar to thedwarven-made coats worn by theHobgoblinsofRimuru's village in their early days. They were combination of warrior and mage.
History: DuringShizue Izawa's days as a travelingChampion, the Silver Wings were among the first of the many adventurers summoned to thekingdom of Filtwoodunder the pretense of slaying a Daemon threatening the kingdom. Supposedly, this Daemon had been slain in the distant past by a Champion known asOrthosbut had recently been revived.

In reality, the story was all a fabrication—Orthos himselfwasthe Daemon, and secretly controlled the kingdom while posing as one of its knights. He had been using the Daemon slaying request as a ruse to lure in powerful adventurers so that he could kill them, not only to consume theirSoulsand gain more power from them, but also to eliminate said adventurers as potential threats to his continued rule.

The Silver Wings discovered the true identity of the Daemon too late. They failed to stop him, and were both mortally wounded by Orthos in their battle. However, they managed to escape through an Outsider-Repelling Barrier before he could finish them off and take their Souls.

Not long after they had made it out of Filtwood's castle and into the nearby woods, the male Silver Wing soon succumbed to his injuries and died. The surviving female Silver Wing was similarly on the verge of death. However, driven by rage and a thirst for vengeance upon Orthos, she used her own blood to draw a Daemon Summoning circle on the ground, cursing Orthos all the while. Subsequently, she managed to summon thePrimordialDaemon known by the epithetNoir. She begged him to kill Orthos and hisHumanpuppets, offering her and her partner's Souls as payment with her last breath before falling dead on the ground. Amused and delighted by her dying emotions, Noir agreed to her request and took the Silver Wings' Souls, saying that while they were an insufficient payment, he would take the lives of their targets to make up the difference. Upon sealing the contract with them, theirBodiesturned to ashes in the wind, leaving only their clothes behind.

Their garments were later discovered and reported to be all that was left of them by Orthos' Human puppet minister when he addressed the other adventurers (including Shizue) who had responded to the phony Daemon-slaying quest.

Summary: Shinji Tanimura｢谷村真治,shinji tanimura｣is a JapaneseOtherworlderand a disciple ofGadra, formerly employed as a military officer in theEastern Empire. He was granted asylum inTempestand currently works asRamiris' assistant.
Appearance: A young man with black hair and eyes. He wears a lab coat.
Personality: Shinji is a laidback man, his disinterest in the Eastern Empire's rank battles prove that he isn't power craving, and prefers spending his time in the lab. As Ramiris' assistant he's far more at home in his new environment. He's diligent enough to always keep updated on the constant ongoings of the world, unlikeMark. Like the latter, he used to be an avid gamer back when he was still in Japan as he was overly familiar with the dungeon RPG mechanics theDungeonfloor designs took after.
Story: Shinji was a 23-year-old university student who spent most of his days in the lab. One day he fell victim to an unspecified nation's summoning ritual and got transported to the otherworld. He was then taken in by Yuuki, sent to the Eastern Empire, and wound up under Gadra's tutelage as amilitaryofficer. At some point he was dispatched as part of the subjugation force tasked with bringing down thedaemonbehind the Lakeshore Dyed Scarlet Incident. The unit suffered significant losses, leaving less than 30% survivors, including Shinji.
After Yuuki joined the Empire and became  a corps commander, Shinji wanting to pay back his debt to him, left the Armored Division and transferred to the Composite Division led by the youth.

Prior to the Eastern Empire's war declaration, Shinji, Mark andShin, were ordered by Gadra andYuukito investigate the labyrinth to confirm the existence of an underground research facility. They were eventually accepted asylum in Jura-Tempest Federation and placed under Ramiris as her assistants.

The two separated the day after she was conceived as Kaede returned to her travels, at the time still unaware of her pregnancy. The fetus took a very long time to develop, taking a whole three centuries to be born, which sapped much of Kaede's power. When the girl was finally born, Kaede named her "Momiji," which drained nearly all of her remaining energy.
At one point in the past, Frey tried to conquer her village in an attempt to seize control overSarion.

Appearance: Peko is on the shorter side as far as Hobgoblins are concerned, only standing at around 150cm as opposed to the average hobgoblins' 180. They have braided hair, a petite frame, adorable facial features, and an androgynous appearance.
Peko's usual attire is a formal catering outfit consisting of a buttoned shirt, bowtie, and pants, with an apron usually being worn over top.
Personality: Peko is a hard working and earnest individual, always giving their 100% in the kitchen and trying to make their food as delicious as possible. They're extremely soft-hearted and kind, to the point of despising violence entirely.
Background: Peko was among the hundred or so originalgoblinsgathered underRigurdin his days as the goblin elder. Peko was heavily injured in thedirewolfattack, but just when all hope seemed lost,Rigurreturned to the village with a mysterious and powerful monster named Rimuru. Rimuru used powerfulpotionsthat were capable of healing Peko's fatal injuries and gave them a second chance at life. Afterward, Peko received theirnameand purpose from Rimuru, to fill peoples tummies with food so delicious that they can't even think about fighting.

Peko would go on to have a brief stint as aGoblin Rider, even participating in the battle against theOrc Lord Geldand his forces. However, after the battle, upon realizing that the entire conflict could've been avoided if everyone had enough food to eat, Peko swears off fighting entirely, becoming a pacifist. From that day forward, Peko focused all their efforts into cooking meals in the kitchen alongside Gob'ichi andShuna, eventually earning the Unique skill Glutton through his hard effort, and being acknowledged as someone amazing even in the eyes of Rimuru.
Trivia: Peko's name is a play on the Japanese wordpekopeko｢ペコペコ｣, a childish word to express immense hunger "to the point one's stomach collapsing inwards."

Appearance: Deathmen, as high-level beings, possess an appearance based on their own self-image. This results in an appearance that is identical to that of the individual's previous life or otherwise desired form. They sometimes possess a more monstrous second form influenced by their body's essence as an Undead, resulting in a strange zombie-like appearance.
Properties: As undead, they have no apparentego, however, using a special ritual, it is possible to awaken the strongest ego (or egos, if there's multiple egos of similar strength) remaining from the owners of the corpses used to create the body. If multiple egos share a body, one ego will become more dominant than the rest or, in rarer cases, multiple strong egos form a new dominant ego.
Trivia: They are different from most undead, in that they possess full flesh and are equipped with biological functions, the extent of which is still yet to be known. However, it is likely that deathmen cannot reproduce, given their low population and that they can only be created through the "Birthday" spell.

Claymancan transform into his "Crazy Pierrot" form, which is more combat oriented. Given Clayman's weakness compared to other deathmen, which is the result of him having been created specifically for the supportive role of a strategist and leader, this form may have been given to him exclusively for self-defense and offense, should the need for him to fight directly ever arise. It is unknown if others also possess a similar transformation.

Clayman himself has shown to primarily use them as disposable pawns in his schemes, as seen where he had no problem having Mjurran undergo a suicide mission on his behalf and had no problem sacrificing Yamza to kill his enemies should he be overpowered. Clayman himself showcased no other attachment to Pirone, Adalmann and Kumara and was only either annoyed or outraged when they were killed or defeated due to them inconveniencing him and disrupting his plans.

Alvaro was kicked out due to Yamza telling Clayman some poor information that Alvaro was secretly insulting him behind his back.
Adalmann was the only member not directly recruited by Clayman, but rather by the Curse LordKazalim.

Summary: SPIN-OFF CONTENTThis article covers spin-off creations that are not found in the light novel series.
Appearance: Phos is a young girl with wild red hair tied in a ponytail and yellow slit eyes. As a fox Lycanthrope, she has fox-like characteristics which include a fox tail, ears, and a fanged mouth. She wears a sports-based black attire equipped with brown pants, boots, two waist bags, and a belt that is attached to suspenders.
She can transform which further emphasizes her fox traits and gains markings around her eyes and on top of her nose.
Personality: Phos is fiercely loyal to her master, Carrion and wholeheartedly strives to follow his orders while investigating Tempest. As a resident of Eurazania, she has been raised in a culture that values bartering and settling matters through combat. Consequently, she initially finds herself unfamiliar with the customs and standards of Tempest.

However, despite her primary responsibilities, Phos easily becomes captivated by Tempest's numerous attractions. Upon joiningGob'emon's group, she earnestly endeavors to maintain the peace within Tempest's borders.

At the outset, Phos displays a notable lack of experience and naivety in both combat and social interactions upon arriving in Tempest. However, over time, she gradually acclimates herself to these aspects, gaining confidence and proficiency.
All in all, Phos is a kind-hearted and devoted individual who always endeavors to please and protect others. This led her to fall in love with Tempest and its citizens.
Background: Phos, a native of the Beast Kingdom of Eurazania, was raised in its unique customs and traditions. However, significant changes occur when Eurazania forms an alliance with the Jura-Tempest Federation. In light of this alliance, Phos is entrusted by her master Carrion with a covert mission: to discreetly investigate the capital city of Tempest, known asRimuru, and assess whether it would be beneficial for their kingdom to establish further ties with Tempest.

Despite her initial unfamiliarity with Tempest's culture and standards, Phos remains committed to carrying out her duties diligently. Her loyalty to Carrion and her devotion to Eurazania drive her to put forth her best effort in fulfilling her mission.

However, as Phos joins Gob'emon's group and experiences the diverse wonders of Tempest, she becomes easily enchanted by the city's vibrant highlights. Her inherent naivety and lack of combat and social experience initially pose challenges, but Phos gradually adapts and acclimates herself to the new environment.

Appearance: Gustav had the appearance of a gauntly-faced man of average build and stature. He had light grey-purple hair which was elegantly slicked backwards. He wore a graceful western-style outfit with various pieces of jewelry, with an expensive purple-gem laden necklace being the most eye-catching among them.
Personality: Gustav, like manyDaemons, is extremely twisted and sadistic, enjoying the "taste" of those who have fallen into the depths of hopelessness and despair more than anything. He is an extremely cunning man, capable of manipulating even close siblings into being at each other's throats. He was extremely proud of his abilities as anArchdaemonand held an extreme reverence towards Violet, to the point of viewing her as his God.
Background: Gustav, as merely an early modern species Daemon, had no means to get into the good graces of Violet, who he idolized and worshipped as a God. Thus, when he felt theSummoningofTedron Coleus, he was eager to answer the call and gained a name and body in the process. Inhabiting the now deceased Court Physician, he quickly got to work in manipulating Crown PrinceSauzerwhile his comrade-in-arms and fellow ArchdaemonKarltargeted Second PrinceAslan. The two were quickly at each others throats, with Gustav lending his power to Sauzer to make the previously weak and sickly crown prince more than a match for his heroic younger brother.

With the plans of Tedron successfully implemented, Gustav took to work creating a vessel for his God, preparing PrincessZenobiaas an offering towards her. He planted a curse upon her that would tempter her body and soul to become a compatible vessel and in exchange it left her blinded and bedridden. When his plans were eventually foiled byRimuru Tempest, he became desperate and used a forbidden art to merge with Karl, temporarily increasing his power dramatically.

Gustav, confident in his success, was abruptly stopped by a strange young girl. The young girl dispelled his Dark Magic and quickly overpowered him. Desperate and backed into a corner, Gustav summoned his God inside of the incomplete Princess Zenobia and hoped that she would deal with the mysteriousMajinthat stood before him, as she saw the truth behind his plans. Violet, on the other hand, was extremely annoyed at being incarnated into Zenobia before she was a proper vessel and leaving a witness to their plan. She proceeded to fight the young girl without a care, but they proved to be equally matched. From the words that were exchanged in the otherworldly battle that took place before him, he was able to deduce the identity of the young girl asLuminous Valentine(the master ofDemon LordRoy Valentine, who he intended to use as a scapegoat for his plan) misinterpreting the words of his God and thinking that the "trash that had to be disposed of" was Luminous and not himself. Thus, Gustav was exterminated by the very God that he had idolized for messing up their plan and met an uneventful end.

High orc: Geld's original appearance that doesn't stray far from the appearance of a normal Orc. He had the appearance of a burly but not overly large Orc with extremely light colored fur and red lines along his cheeks.
Orc Lord: Geld's form after becoming the Orc Lord and taking in the power andSkillsof many different races. He's a towering beast of a man with large muscles and a massive pot-belly. His armor has merged into his skin and his long, rigid, and pointy ears along with the large red jewel on his forehead make him appear to be wearing some sort of crown.
Orc Disaster: Geld's form after eating Gelmud and becoming aDemon lord seed. His height and build have increased several times over from his previous appearance and his massive pot-belly has been significantly flattened, leaving him as a hulking tower of muscles closer to aGiantin appearance than an Orc.
Personality: Geld was a benevolent and caring ruler who put the needs of his people above his own. When they were starving, he offered them his own flesh to eat, and when they could no longer bear the famine, he was willing to become a monstrous and depraved Demon Lord all for the sake of offering his people a new home. Geld's immense guilt over the sins he committed for the sake of his people were what drove him to never stop in his quest for power. Even when his mental capabilities were reduced to an almost animalistic level, he kept moving forward for their sake. It was his loss against Rimuru and their promise to devour the sins of him and his people which allowed Geld to finally find peace and move on.
Background: Geld was born as a prince of theOrc Kingdom of Orbic, a nation comprised solely of orcs near theBeast Kingdom of Eurazania. Some time into Geld's life, a great famine swept across the nation. With even the royal family struggling to put food on their table, Geld's father, the king of Orbic, offered up his own flesh and blood to sustain his son.

Upon feasting on his father’s body, Geld took in his power and evolved into the legendaryOrc Lordthat was said to awaken once every few centuries, obtainingStarvedas anIntrinsicUniqueSkill in the process. However, even the mighty power of an Orc Lord was unable to restore their now barren and dry land into a place hospitable for his people. He could only offer his own flesh and blood which regenerated near-endlessly to his starving people. Geld, running out of steam and on the verge of death, was approached by aMajinnamedGelmudwho took him under his wing and gave him hisName.

Upon hearing of theStorm DragonVeldora's disappearance, and at the behest of his father-figure Gelmud, Geld set his sights on invading and settling the fertile and plentiful land that made up theGreat Jura Forest. Using Gelmud's connections to a certainbenefactor, Geld was able to procure enough quality armor, weapons, and rations to supply an army of over 200,000 Orcs for use in his campaign in Jura. In order to manage his army and make them obedient, Geld used the powers of his Unique skill Starved to place all of his subjects' minds under his direct control and inflicting them with a never-ending hunger in the process. He also appointed several generals from among the elite of his people, chief among them being hisown son.

With his army fully equipped, organized, and under his control, Geld began his campaign into the Jura Forest. The majority of his forces were sent straight north following theGreat Ameld Riverto take out the large population ofLizardmenthat made the swamps around Lake Siss their home while Geld personally lead a much smaller detachment that took a detour to seek out and devour as many strong races as possible. Geld and his detachment eventually arrived at the doorstep of a large village ofOgreswell renowned for their strength and martial ability. The Ogres Geld faced were extremely formidable, perhaps capable of ending him and his campaign had the mercenaryFootmanhired by Gelmud not been there to assist Geld in defeating their chieftain. After devouring all of the Ogre corpses, Geld's power was beyond what his body could handle, causing his mental capabilities to decline to an almost animalistic level. Geld and his detachment eventually rejoined with the main bulk of their army that were engaged in a prolonged siege against the Lizardmen forces that holed up in their network of caves like a fortress. Eventually the Lizardmen, led byGabiru, sortied into the open swamp to confront the orcs directly. The Lizardmen held strong and put up a valiant effort against the Orc forces… but once they faced casualties, their capabilities were absorbed by Geld's Starved and shared across the entire Orc army, giving them a decisive advantage. The Lizardmen forces were pushed into a corner, with their leader engaged in desperate one versus one combat with an Orc General when suddenly strange and delicious looking reinforcements arrived.
Trivia: InVeldora's Slime Observational Journal,Veldoraattempted to save Geld like he didIfrit, but Geld refused his offer wanting to pass on peacefully.

In Seven Deadly Sins Grand Cross Geld appears as the Orc Lord as a boss in the TenSura Collab event campaign mode where he is revived byLilliadue to her magic effecting space-time when she summoned Rimuru Tempest to Britannia but meets his end a second time by Rimuru Tempest, Benimaru, Milim and the Seven Deadly Sins excluding Escanor, but is revived by Lillia a third time as the Orc Disaster only to die a third time, this was secretly an trick to have Lillia steal their energy from fighting him so she can transform into her Awakened State.

Appearance: Goblins have a quite quirky look. They are green-skinned, very short—no taller than an averagehumanchild orhalfling—and have coarse features with sharp ears and teeth.
Background: Goblins are one of the races that populate theGreat Jura Forest, with many different tribes dotting around the forest. Although there are many different tribes of goblins, they will usually stand together in the face of great danger.
Many of the goblins revere theStorm Dragonas their God and protector of the forest.
For goblins, deaths are very common, to the point they have evolved to reproduce as much as possible to maintain their population.
Characteristics: Goblins are the weakest of the demi-human species. As a species, they have degraded so far from their oni and dwarf ancestors that they have become even weaker than humans, both physically and mentally. However, in exchange for such weakness, they gained highreproductive capabilitiescomparable to those oforcs; they can rapidly become hyper-fertile in response to environmental stress, capable of producing entire litters of children from a single pregnancy. Another notable trait is their rapid life cycle; goblins age quickly and have very short lifespans (around 10 years)[3]even by human standards.
Trivia: InAttack of the Demon Lord, goblins were stated to be Rank F, but they were retconned to be Rank E by the time thefirst data bookwas released.

Background: Several decades before the birth ofRimuru Tempest, a space-time crack formed in a cave within the Orc Kingdom of Orbic. Soon,Aggressorinsectsbegan to spill out of the crack and they brought with them a destructive amount of the otherworld'smagicules. Though the Insects were eventually defeated by theDemon LordCarrionand the space-time crack sealed, the damage had already been done and the otherworld’s magicules began infecting Orbic's land like a plague. The plants began to wither and the water started to dry up as the land was slowly becoming an inhospitable desert similar to Barren Lands to the far west.

The desertification of Orbic’s land naturally resulted in a massive famine that made food scarce. The survival instincts of the Orcs weren’t helping matters either, with their numbers only increasing in an effort to preserve the species and making the food situation even worse. Even the Royal Family was unable to provide food for its family, with the Orc King deciding to break ancient taboo and offer up himself as nourishment for hisYoung Son. The king knew not why it was taboo and inadvertently triggered his son’s evolution into anOrc Lordin his act of selfless desperation. Thus the Orc Lord was born, carrying on his father’s legacy as the new Orc King.

However, even with all the power afforded to him as an Orc Lord, the King could not do anything for his people but offer up his infinitely regenerating flesh to the starving orcs in-front of him. Despite the protests of his ownSon, the King continued this act until he could no longer carry on, collapsing in the desert on the verge of death. It was then that the King was approached byGelmud, a GreaterMajinwith power beyond even his and many connections. Gelmud offered to adopt the King and become a father-like figure, granting him the name 'Geld' and with it hope for his people. Among Gelmud’s connections was a particularly powerful one, the Demon LordClayman. Clayman was more than willing to supply the Orcs with armor, weapons, and rations that would allow them to form a cohesive military force. The Orcs were no longer powerless and they soon set their sights on invading the Great Jura Forest to make a new home for themselves in the bountiful forest that now lacked the protection of theStorm DragonVeldora.

The entire population of Orbic, now under the effect of Geld'sStarved, all mobilized and marched towards the forest as a starving horde of barely coherent soldiers. The skill dominated their spirits and allowed their minds and bodies to go far beyond their limits, with any succumbing to exhaustion and hunger being consumed by their brethren. The Orcs consumed anything and anyone that got in their way as they began marching towards the home of the lizardmen Lake Siss. The Orc Lord Geld, meanwhile, personally led a detachment of some of their most elite knights to take down the largest Ogre Village in the forest, both a threat to their invasion and a great source of power for Geld. The assault was reinforced by a member of theModerate Harlequin Alliancehired by Gelmud, a large man namedFootmanthat assisted Geld in taking down many of the more troublesome Ogres that wouldn’t fall to numbers alone.

It was around this time that theLizardman Chieftainwas informed of the Orcish army by his scouts and he soon made preparations for their arrival. He dispatched Warrior CaptainGabiruand a squad of Knights all mounted on Hover Lizards to gather as many Goblins from the nearby villages as possible to reinforce their numbers and food supplies. Meanwhile, the Lizardmen at home all bunkered down inside the limestone caves that served as their capital and prepared for a drawn-out siege. The chieftain was wary of the possibility of an Orc Lord, knowing the terror of Starved from stories based down from his ancestors and hoping not to allow any Lizardmen corpses to be eaten.

While Gabiru was away recruiting the Goblins, The Chieftain was approached by a mysterious Greater Majin who introduced himself asSouei. Souei claimed to be the envoy of an even greater master by the name ofRimuru, confirming to the chieftain that there was indeed an Orc Lord leading the orcs and that the legendaryDryadshad personally requested they slay the Orc Lord. Relieved by this news, the Chieftain agreed to a meeting with Rimuru in seven days time to form a military alliance with them.

Gabiru, meanwhile, returned home three and a half days after the meeting with Souei. Upon seeing the state of affairs–the proud lizardmen on the defensive–Gabiru, who was desperate for recognition and impatient, decided to stage a Coup. He and his men were able to enter the throne room completely unnoticed thanks to theassistanceof a man namedLaplace, a mercenary hired by Gabiru's namer Gelmud. Those still loyal to his father, as well as his father himself, were quickly detained while Gabiru gathered their forces and prepared to stage an all-out assault against the Orcs.

Sitting in his cell alongside his daughter theGuard Captain, the chieftain regretted not explaining more things to Gabiru and lamented that the Lizardmen were doomed. Wanting to spare at least his daughter, he broke free of his bindings and created a distraction for her to escape. The Guard Captain was quick to leave the caves of the lizardmen, following her father's wishes and heading deep into the forest to seek out Souei and inform him that the alliance fell through. However, a small detachment of the Orc Army was soon on her trail and it was led by a mighty Orc General. Mortally injured and believing it to be the end, the Guard Captain was unexpectedly saved at the last minute by Souei.

Her injuries quickly healed by aFull Potiongiven to her by Rimuru Tempest, the Guard Captain was accepted as a suitable proxy for the Chieftain and the military alliance was officially formed. Rimuru brought with them a squadron ofGoblin Ridersas well as a group of powerfulKijin, a force that could more than rival the Orc Army in might despite its small size and they headed for the battlefield at full speed.

Soon the Orc Lord Geld arrived on the battlefield, his detachment finally regrouping with the advance force and shifting the atmosphere of the lizardman battlefield. Gabiru forces were engaged with a thirty-thousand strong group of orcs from the main force as well as a group of two-thousand Orc Knights led by an Orc General. Geld and his Knights gathered ten-thousand from the advance force and were quick to move around the Lizardman-Goblin Army, maneuvering to flank them from the rear.

Rimuru's reinforcements arrived at the battlefield to find a large force of Lizardmen and Goblins engaged with the Orbic Forces. Souei and the Guard Captain rushed to the aid of the Chieftain while the Goblin Riders and Kijin intervened on the battlefield, saving the flanked Gabiru in the process and defeating another Orc General. Rimuru, meanwhile, was in the skies observing the entire battlefield, identifying officers and relaying their position toBenimaruon the ground.

Meanwhile, Gelmud was observing the war from a distance alongside Laplace. The two were interrupted by the DryadTreyni, and Gelmud was quick to flee while Laplace held her off. Gelmud was enraged at the status of the war and decided to go against Clayman's orders and enter the war personally.

Having arrived on the battlefield from above, the Majin Gelmud appeared and was soon confronted by Rimuru Tempest. All of Gelmud's attacks were useless against the strange Majin while their attacks were unexpected and strange. After suffering various injuries and being rendered immobilized, Gelmud quickly called out for Geld to assist him, only to be killed and eaten by his own adoptive son. With the Gelmud absorbed, Geld received a massive power increase and subsequently evolved into anOrc Disaster, bringing the war to its climax.

Even the might of the four Kijin andRangacombined were unable to deal decisive damage to Geld, who resisted the bulk of their attacks with hisAuraand made up for the damage he did take with his formidable regenerative abilities. Thus the battle came down to a one-versus-one duel between The Orc Disaster Geld and Rimuru Tempest, the slime ultimately coming out on top due to theirDevourerUnique Skill outperforming Starved.

Following the defeat of the Orc Disaster, the effects of Starved quickly began to wear off. The last remaining Orc General and son of Geld was quick to surrender and thus the war came to a close. A meeting to discuss the aftermath was soon held. The orcs were represented by Geld's son–their defacto new king–and the leaders of the 10 Great Tribes; The Lizardmen were represented by their Chieftain, The Guard Captain, and the Guard Vice-Captain; The Goblins were represented by the chiefs of their various tribes; The Treants were represented by the Dryad Treyni; and the fledgling town that would soon becomeTempestwas represented by Rimuru Tempest and the Kijin survivors of the Ogre Village. The Chairman of the meeting was elected and Rimuru Tempest was unanimously chosen.

During the meeting, the situation of Orbic had come to light and led the peoples of the forest into deep contemplation. The orcs had no home to return to and almost nothing to offer in reparations. If left alone, the survivors would aimlessly scatter all over the forest and it wouldn't take long for bandit cells to form and attack Goblin and Lizardmen caravans. Rimuru Tempest, wishing to keep the promise they made to Geld in his last moments, made a proposal that would see the entirety of the Jura Forest west of the Ameld River form one massive federation, with the Treants and Lizardmen providing temporary rations to the Orcs in exchange for labor. Rimuru's people would then provide logistical and technological support to the orcs, allowing them to eventually establish their own properly built settlements.

Rimuru Tempest, being both the strongest individual there and the overall winner of the war, was elected as the Chancellor of theJura-Tempest Federationand ruler of the forest, much to their own dismay. All of the roughly 160,000 Orc Survivors were granted names and thirty days worth of rations, being seperated into eleven different groups based on which Orbic Tribe they belonged to. The Ten Great Tribes were each escorted to new areas of the forest by a squad of ten Goblin Riders, while the Orc Elite and the new Orc King who represented the Orcish Capital were taken in by Rimuru personally.
Primary Objective: The primary objective of the war was for Orbic to annex large swaths of fertile land within the Jura Forest and establish a new homeland for the Orc Race. Their previous land was rendered uninhabitable due to drought and famine created by energy that leaked out from the otherworld.
Secondary Objective: The secondary objective of the war was for the Orc Lord Geld to consume the powerful races of the forest and evolve into a being that could become aDemon Lord. This was the wish of Geld's adoptive fatherGelmud, who was promised an executive position serving underClaymanif it could be achieved. This was part of a larger plot devised by the Demon Lords Clayman,Carrion, andMilimto create a puppet on the Demon Lord Council that they could easily use to their benefit.
Orc Forces: The entirety of the Orbic Orc Horde consisted of roughly 200,000 orcs, though this number includes a great deal of non-combatants such as women and children. Even within the large horde of combat-ready orcs, only around 10,000 of them were properly trained and equipped asOrc Knights｢豚頭騎士団,ōku naitsu｣, with only 2,000 of them being powerful enough to be calledOrc Elites｢豚頭親衛隊,ōku erīto｣. The Knights were broken up evenly into divisions of 2,000 and were each put under the command of anOrc General｢豚頭将軍,ōku jeneraru｣.

Each of the Orc Generals ranked A-minus, with Geld's son–the general commanding the Orc Elite–breaking through the barrier and reaching A-rank. The Orc Knights they commanded all hovered somewhere between C and B-minus, while the Orc Elite ranged from B to B-plus.

The Orc Lord himself ranked well into the upper echelons of A-rank and possessed enough power to rival Gelmud after consuming many of the forest-dwellers. His Unique Skill Starved granted him the ability to take the skills and traits of those that he ate, as well as granting him access to a powerful Corrosion that he could imbue into his aura.

The rest of the orc horde, while untrained and not as well equipped, possessed a ferocious attitude due to being under the influence of Starved. Part of the power and characteristics gained through Starved had been shared with them, including theStrengthenpossessed by Ogres as well as theScale Armorand webbed toes possessed by Lizardmen. This allowed each of them to rank at least D-plus, with many of the stronger among them ranking C.
