Ogre Village Battle: The first known conflict in the Orcish Invasion of Jura. The Orc Lord Geld, along with his five Orc Generals and their ten-thousand Orc Knights, detached from the main Orbic horde and set out for the most powerful village of Ogres in the forest.

The Ogre Village was made up of around three-hundred Ogres, all of which ranked at least a B, with many of their stronger members hovering between B-plus and A. They were all highly trained in both Martial andBattlewillArtsfrom a young age, being equipped with high quality armor and weapons produced by their bestBlacksmith. Under normal circumstances, they perhaps would have beaten the Orc Lord and his Knights, but the flow of the battle was altered due to the presence of a masked majin named Footman. With his assistance, the Ogres soon fell, with only a group of six survivors managing to escape due to the sacrifice of the village's chief.
Siege of the Lizardmen: The second known conflict of the Orcish Invasion of Jura. When the Advance Force from Orbic reached the marshes that the majority of the Lizardmen called home, the Lizardman Chieftain had already prepared for their arrival and made countermeasures to prevent Starved from coming into play. The Lizardmen fortified themselves in the Limestone caves that served as their capital, with each entrance being guarded by a squad of Lizardmen.

For three days these squads rotated in and out of their posts, replacing a member if they got exhausted or injured and doing their utmost to avoid any casualties that could fuel Starved. This strategy employed by the Lizardman Chieftain was flawlessly executed and seemed to be more than successful. Though their resources had become limited by turning the conflict into a prolonged siege, they only had to wait out a total of seven days before Rimuru Tempest and their reinforcements arrived to change the tide of the war.

However, the state of the war took an abrupt change when Gabiru and his men returned to the caves. Gabiru, goaded on by his subordinates and Laplace had staged a Coup against his father. He used his popularity among the younger generations and his promise of an offensive solution to the war to sway the people to his side while his men detained his father and those still loyal to him.

Having given up all hope of the Lizardmen's survival, the Chieftain could only lament his foolishness in not better educating his son on the danger an Orc Lord posed. In an act of desperation, he broke free from his bindings and set the Guard Captain free, tasking her with informing Souei that the Lizardmen were doomed and that the alliance would no longer be possible.
Guard Captain's Ambush: While the Guard Captain wandered almost aimlessly into the forest following the traces of Souei's Aura, she was ambushed by an Orc General and his small escort of 50 Orc Knights. The General had been tracking her movements and soon engaged her in combat. The Guard Captain might've ranked a respectable B-plus, but with the power given to him by the Orc Lord Geld, the Orc General boasted an immense force that would earn him a firm A-minus. He continued to toy with the captain until his men demanded he finish her off. Just as his blade swung down, however, he was intercepted by Souei who was secretly observing the entire encounter.

Souei used his threads to catch the General unaware and was quick to immobilize him with a vicious series of cuts. Meanwhile, his group of accompanying Knights were swiftly dealt with by Benimaru and Hakurou. Rimuru Tempest supplied the Guard Captain with a Full Potion while Souei prepared to interrogate the Orc General for intel. However, an unpredictable variable existed in the form of Shion, who slew the wounded Orc General after he insulted Rimuru.

With the Guard Captain quickly explaining Gabiru's Coup and the dire situation the Lizardmen now faced, she broke the promise she made to her father and pleaded for the Majin in-front of her to help the Lizardmen. Rimuru Tempest was eager to accept the Guard Captain as a representative of the Chieftain and thus their alliance with the Lizardmen was officially formed.
Lizardmen's Sally: Spurred by Gabiru after he took control over the Lizardmen, a force of eight-thousand Lizardmen and seven-thousand Goblins launched an assault on the unsuspecting Orcs. The Orbic Advance force they faced was composed of thirty-thousand orc warriors and the Lizardmen took full advantage of the marshes terrain to outmaneuver them and its tall grass to sneak up on them.

They employed tactics similar to guerilla warfare, sneaking up on a small group of orcs and attacking only briefly before retreating. Sometimes they would surround them and block their escape, while a force of Goblins overwhelmed them with superior numbers. The Lizardmen were at a complete advantage by employing this tactic, and their goal of muddying the chain of command to force the orcs to retreat from the marshes and regroup seemed to be an eventuality. However, Gabiru was unaware of Starved's existence, which is why his otherwise flawless strategy fell through.

It didn't take long for one of the orcs to catch a lizardman off-guard, the young soldier stunned by the Orc's acts of cannibalism. And as they consumed his flesh, the effects of Starved soon kicked in. The orcs all began to grow scales and webbed toes, stealing the traits and thus the mobility of the Lizardmen for themselves. To make matters even worse, the Orc Lord and his ten-thousand Orc Knights had finally regrouped with the Advance Force. The Orc Lord and his Orc Generals deftly took control of the entire battlefield, separating ten-thousand from the advance force to join with their force of Knights and flank the Lizardmen forces from all sides.

The Lizardmen had noticed the enhanced mobility of the Orc's far too late. They now had a force of twenty-thousand engaging them from in-front and a force of twenty-thousand flanking their rear. The Goblins were quick to perish in the chaos, with four-thousand of them biting the dust and leaving them at less than half their original number. The Lizardmen hardly fared much better, suffering over sixteen-hundred casualties that reduced their number by a fifth. And as if things couldn't get any worse, a group of Orc Knights wearing Black Armor led by a mighty Orc General soon rose from among the orcish ranks to face the Lizardmen.

Gabiru was unable to push through the ranks of the orcs and stage a retreat. Being completely encased from all sides and with the overwhelmingly powerful Orc General soon upon them, he made a last ditch effort to go down with pride. He challenged the Orc General–which was so powerful he had mistaken it for the Orc Lord–to a one-versus-one duel, during which neither side's soldiers would engage the other. And though it at first seemed like Gabiru might be able to emerge victorious by the skin of his teeth—he was unable to deal with the Orc General'sChaos Eater. Gabiru believed all hope was lost, until reinforcements from Rimuru intervened at the last moment and saved the day.
Rimuru's Counterattack: The penultimate conflict of the Orcish Invasion was two-fold, containing two separate battles with the ultimate goal of drawing out the Orc Lord.

Firstly, Souei and the Guard Captain infiltrated the limestone caves of the Lizardmen that were now overrun by Orcs. One of the Orc Generals and his Knights had detached from the Orc Lord's force and infiltrated the caves in the hopes of empowering their King even further with the deaths of the Lizardmen inside. The Chieftain was in a desperate bout against the General, putting up an admirable effort despite being well past his physical prime. Just when all hope seemed lost, Souei and his daughter arrived in the nick of time to the complete surprise of the chieftain. Souei was quick to deal with the General and slaughter the knights under his command, freeing the Chieftain and those loyal to him that were imprisoned by Gabiru.

Secondly, the Goblin Riders and Kijin engaged the Advance Force and Knight Corps, backing up the Lizardmen. The Orc General engaged with Gabiru was swiftly taken care of by Gobta and Ranga, the latter evolving into a Tempest Star Wolf as he showcased his newDeath Stormtechnique on the Orcish Army. Meanwhile, the Kijin were plowing through the orcs with a seemingly unstoppable rhythm. The locations of the officers dishing out orders were being relayed to them by Rimuru–who was watching the battlefield from above–and they were swift in taking them out, upsetting the chain of command and plunging the orbic forces into chaos. The battle only continued to get worse for the Orcs, as Benimaru showcased hisHell Flaretechnique that was capable of effortlessly killing thousands of orcs in mere seconds.
With the Orbic forces plunged into utter chaos, it didn't take long for King Geld to make himself known on the battlefield, deciding to clean things up himself.
Final Battle: The final battle of the war, one that should've been as simple as Rimuru Tempest slaying the Orc Lord, was made all the more complicated by the presence of a Greater Majin by the name of Gelmud.

Gelmud was the one who first sowed the seeds of chaos within the forest, naming several people–including Gabiru and Geld–with potential in the hopes of creating a new demon lord when the Storm Dragon inevitably kicked the bucket. Distraught with the war's situation, Gelmud disobeyed the orders he received from the Demon Lord Clayman and personally intervened in battle. He attempted to kill Gabiru withDeath-March Danceand have him be eaten by Geld, but was interrupted by Rimuru Tempest at the last second. The two of them briefly exchanged blows, but it soon became clear that Gelmud was at an overwhelming disadvantage. None of his attacks worked on the mysterious Majin, while they only used strange and unconventional attacks that bypassed his defenses.

Soon, the battered Gelmud was immobilized by threads and in an act of desperation ordered Geld to "Hurry up and become a Demon Lord so you can beat these guys". However, Geld fulfilled the order in a way that Gelmud didn't expect, taking full advantage of his immobilization to decapitate and eat his adoptive father. By taking in the immense power of Gelmud–one that rivaled or even exceeded his own–Geld was able to fulfill Gelmud's wishes and evolve into an Orc Disaster.

The Kijin and Ranga were quick to attack the newly born Demon Lord Seed, with Shion and Hakurou slashing at him at full force to decapitate him to no avail, he simply reattached his head. Next Souei bound Geld withMystic Thread Bindingand Benimaru unleashed a Hell Flare with the smallest radius he could muster, but this too was not enough, Geld sustained serious injuries but his Aura allowed him to resist the bulk of the damage. Still not giving up, Benimaru ordered Ranga to unleash a Death Storm on top of him before he could regenerate, which still didn't manage to finish Geld off.

With no other options left, Rimuru Tempest engaged with the Orc Disaster Geld personally in one-versus-one combat. Though their assault at first consisted of merely dodging Geld's Death-March Dances and shallow sword slashes, Rimuru soon got serious and appliedBlack Flameto their sword. With their superior speed, Geld's arm was gone in a flash, Black Flame sealing the wound shut. The two continued to do battle for a brief period of time, with Rimuru melting Geld's Meat Cleaver with their flames while Geld managed to capture them with his arm that should've been lost. He had eaten the remainder of his missing arm from the stump to the shoulder–black flame and all–and regenerated his missing arm in mere moments. With Rimuru seemingly done for–melting away from Geld's corrosive aura in his grasp–the battle appeared to be finished. But it was at this moment that Rimuru revealed their true nature as aSlime, using their liquid form to latch onto Geld's body and melt him away by "eating" him first with their Devourer Unique Skill. The two remained locked in a contest of who could eat the other first, much likeOuroboros｢自之尾喰蛇,uroborosu｣, but Rimuru ultimately came out on top due to Devourer's ability to copy an opponent's power while they were still alive, while Starved could only steal power by eating corpses.

As the sun rose on a new day, the Orc Disaster Geld was slain and only Rimuru Tempest remained, with a silent promise between the two that the Orcs wouldn't be punished for his actions. At the end of the conflict, only one Orc General and his two-thousand Orc Elite remained alive on the battlefield, the rest having all perished for a total of nearly fifty-thousand orc casualties.

Eventually, the battle concluded. Milim regained her consciousness and the battle ended. The one who returned her sanity was Ramiris. Without a single clue, he had managed to summon a high-levelfire elementalout of pure anger and then sealed the elemental away. Then, he made an absurd request, to summon a specificotherworlder. She told him it was impossible.

After the magic soldiers that thedwarvesandelveshad researched together went wild after they failed to use the heart, theElemental magiccircuits from that research were thrown out. So, the fairies picked up the shell that they threw out to modify and improve their golem.

Characteristics: High orcs are smarter and less aggressive than orcs while preserving the orc race's special characteristics, with appearance virtually identical to regular orcs. They are less fertile than orcs, but have a longer lifespan, living anywhere from 50 to 70 years on average.[1]
Yellow Numbers: They were high orc warriors who followed Geld from the start. Their individual strength was considerably high at rank B+, allowing them to create an iron wall defense by uniting with Geld. Furthermore, they also took the role of platoon leaders that commanded the new troops.
Orange Numbers: The newer high orcs that had joined as enlisted soldiers. They were a unit around C-rank in strength, but only 15,000 veterans would be involved in combat. The remaining 20,000 would serve as logistical support or military engineers.
Orc community: The community was divided into 10 different tribes: Mountain, Valley, Hill, Cavern, Ocean, River, Lake, Forest, Grassland, and Desert. Each individuals are named after their tribe, plus a number and an alphabet indicating their gender. For example, males and females from the Mountain tribe will be named "Mountain 1M," "Mountain 2F" and so on.

Personality: She possesses remarkable intelligence, displaying a clever and even devious nature that enabled her to outwit Rimuru, coaxing him into bestowing upon her a name and eight distinct aspects of herself. Described as cold and calculated, she finds it challenging to connect with individuals who are naive and impulsive. Nevertheless, she retains certain childlike qualities, becoming frustrated when faced with situations beyond her complete control. Over time, she develops a deep appreciation for her newfound home and the companionship of her newfound friends—a sense of belonging that had long been absent from her life.
Background: Kumara was born as the daughter ofQuoand lived with her in a territory called Specter Village that bordered between theEastern Empireand thePuppet Nation of Jistav, living peacefully until soldiers of the Eastern Empire, led byKanzis, attacked and wiped them out, with the young unnamed Kumara being the only survivor. She was later captured and sold to Clayman by Kanzis. Seeing potential in the young Cryptid, Clayman made her one of his Five Fingers, serving as his pet and bodyguard. However in a strange twist of fate, Clayman was defeated and Kumara was picked up by Rimuru Tempest. With her curse removed by Rimuru, she was saved and taken into protection in Tempest.

It was there that she remembered what happiness was, and her emotional wounds were healed through contact with the children. Rimuru later brought her into the Dungeon to help manage the forest there and put her on the 90th floor and also named her Kumara, making her grow all her tails up to nine.

When she asked Rimuru to name some of her friends he could not refuse a little girl. It turned out that her eight friends (Mouse, Tiger, Rabbit, Snake, Sheep, Ape, Bird and Hound) were other parts of her – and they came to be known as theEight Legions, each beast aCalamity-levelthreat – giving her a tremendous boost in strength and magical energy when she received eight additional names.

After getting away from Angelus, she's devoted herself to self-improvement and growing ever stronger by surpassing her limits in battle.
Background: She was originally an office worker in a top company in Tokyo before hersoulwas summoned to the Heavenly Nation of Angelus where she was experimented on and incarnated into golem made of the remains of anarchangel.

As ahumansoul cannot handle the power of an archangel her body began to break down in less than a day, leaving her swaying the line between life and death. Just when she was on the brink she managed to obtain theunique skillAwakener, turning her into a kind ofSpiritual life-formand saving her life.
Afterwards she left Angelus and began to roam from place to place, deciding that she would set her sights on becoming the most powerful fighter andmajinin the world.

Summary: NON-CANON CONTENTThis article covers non-canon creations that might not have been produced by the author of the light novel series.
Slime: Her slime form resembles Rimuru's, but colored pink with two strands of slime coming out of the top of her head resembling antennae.
Human: Her physical appearance is extremely similar to Rimuru's human form, possessing a similar height and face as well as the same silver-blue hair color (bright pink in her evolved form). Unlike Rimuru, her hair is only cut to her shoulders and her eyes are bright red. She also possesses notable breasts, giving her secondary sex characteristics that Rimuru lacks. She wears a blue, sleeveless crop top that only covers her upper torso, cream-colored genie pants with a vertical brown line pattern that reach her mid-thigh, a golden, metallic-looking belt, and flat brown shoes.
Serpent slime: When she evolves toSerpent slime, she takes on a more teenager body shape and her hair is blue with two of it sticking out that resemble the slime like antennae now larger. She has a pair of draconic wings, similar to the ones Rimuru has in theirUltimate slimebody they would later on achieve. Her fingers are now tipped with claws. Her outfit has also changed, with her crop top now being white with a black four point star over her chest and a black collar, her genie pants now being dark purple pants with a vertical red line pattern, and she wears red and white high boots. She wears a strange claw-like object around her waistline. She also wears gauntlet-like bracelets, with dark purple gloves and sleeves with the same color scheme as her pants. She has at least three symmetrical black markings that vertically and ends diagonally pointing down on her exposed midriff that seems to go around, she potentially has more markings that are hidden under her clothing.
Serpent zinnia slime: She has about same appearance as a Serpent slime except she has some of evolved pink hair with a segmented mask and bone-like wings that resemble those of the Anime depiction of asky dragon. She also has a draconic tail and her antennae now resemble rabbit ears with segmented white outsides and red insides. Her outfit has changed again into a more arabic style; her white crop tank looks more like a vest, with thick golden edges, and a translucent red skintight part covering her midriff. Her genie pants are now a solid blue and reach her ankles, and she wears flat white shoes with red soles, whose design resembles rabbit feet. She wears a wide black belt with a large four point star buckle that has a red gem affixed to it. Her white bracelets now look like fabric, with three bristles extending from the back of the wrist, with black sleeves that connect to her vest but leave her shoulders bear, and her gloves are now segmented golden gauntlets.
Personality: Shinsha possesses a kind and sweet personality and has a deep longing to be with her father, Rimuru. However, she often struggles to fully comprehend certain situations and is easily swayed by others' influence. Nonetheless, she does possess a basic understanding of right and wrong, as evidenced by her feeling guilt when her mother,Izis, used theSpiegel maidento cause the deaths of tens of thousands of people to initiate theHarvest Festival.

Her greatest dream is to be united with both her mother and father, forming a loving family with them. This strong desire led to the development of herUnique skill,Sentient Being, which reflects her caring nature.

Even after Rimuru officially acknowledged Shinsha as his daughter, she still desired for Izis to be part of their lives, despite the terrible things her mother had done to her, including attempting to kill her on more than one occasion. Despite these difficulties, Shinsha's bond with her father grew stronger, and she chose to stay with him in his nation, Tempest, after her mother's release from theMirror World.

As time passed, Shinsha came to appreciate her stay inTempestand even embraced her father's ideology that all members of the nation are like a big family. Moreover, she has developed her culinary skills underShuna's guidance and can now prepare delicious meals without relying solely on herGreat Sage.

During battle againstClichéshe refused to kill members of theFake King Brigadedue to her pacifist nature and innocence  until Izis was severely injured by Cliché, Shinsha matured more and even started to show a darker side saying to Rimuru not to witness what she was about to do, described as "I'm going to be a bad girl" showing she lost some of innocence due to the experience of it. This is shown when she killed aZombieDwarfand ruthlessly took down members of the Fake King Brigade, even saying she wouldn't let Cliché get away and striking her withTepes, though she held back, not attacking her heart and regretted it after, saying it showed some of her innocence still exists and she doesn't want to become a cold blooded killer.
Background: Shinsha was born as a result of Shuna's wish who she wished for a cuter Rimuru, Izis was the one who granted it and created her used Unique SkillMegalomaniaand named her "Shinsha" (later re-named by Rimuru).
Trivia: Shinsha and Izis were designed by Mitz Vah, the light novel illustrator.
Shinsha's first appearance in theTenSuraseries is in the mobile game "That Time I got Reincarnated as a Slime: Isekai Memories".
According to the game files, Shinsha's name is roughly translated as "Cynthia".

In the Isekai Memories event "Halloween Night Harbingers" it seems she can switch her hair between her normal form blue and evolved form pink at will. However it seems to no longer be the case when she evolved to a Serpent Slime.In the event "Despair Mirror of Awakening" she can only don her evolved Serpent slime human form when she suffers from a traumatic experience of seeing someone she cares get seriously harmed or when she has a strong desire to protect.

infobox.Relative(s): Geilo Rita(Father)Unnamed MotherTwo Unnamed Half BrothersUnnamed Step Mother

Appearance: Fritz is a handsome young man with medium-length white hair and emerald green eyes. He can typically be seen wearing his Paladin uniform, which he wears improperly with the jacket tied around his waist.
Personality: Compared to the more strict and formal members of the Crusaders, Fritz has an comparatively playful and loose personality, earning him something of a reputation as a trickster and delinquent. Despite this reputation, he is the single most dedicatedHoly Knightin the entire order when it comes to following Hinata, who is his idol. Underneath his nonchalant attitude is a calculative and realistic mind that can calmly understand combat situations, but, when it comes to talking with women, he's completely hopeless.
Background: Fritz was the third son of a wealthy businessman, being a bastard son born between the affair of his father and a maid. His father agreed to raise him as a son, but their relationship was always strained due to interference from his father's wife. His eldest brother looked down on him as a bastard son and treated him poorly, while the second son was envious of Fritz's genius and felt his position as the second heir threatened. With this strained relationship between the brothers, any future involving the family business was out of the question.

When Fritz was 12, his mother passed away due to falling ill from the winter cold, leaving Fritz without a reason to stay with his family any longer. He threw away his last name and decided to run away to the royal capital to make it on his own. He was able to survive the journey despite the harsh winter due to being loved by the WindElementalssince birth–a fact he kept hidden even from his mother–allowing him to find food and shelter. Using the guiding voices of the Elementals he was able to trek most of the journey, but reality is often a cruel mistress. Fritz was attacked by a wildMonsterand would've lost his life had he not been saved at the last moment by a Holy Knight.

Being rescued and taken to safety by the Holy Knight, the young Fritz joined theWestern Holy Church, passing their entrance examination to become a soldier and setting his eyes on becoming a Holy Knight one day. Fritz's genius and his close connection to the Wind Elementals allowed him to become an expert fighter in the span of just three years, mastering swordsmanship andElemental magicin addition toHoly magic. His reputation as a prodigy was enough to catch the eye of Hinata Sakaguchi, the Chief of the Holy Knights, who Fritz arrogantly challenged to a duel to test his strength.

The young Fritz was utterly defeated by Hinata without even being able to make her draw her sword. That day was the day that Fritz learned the distance between himself and the top, eternally respecting Hinata from that day forward for teaching him humility. It was due to the humility that Hinata showed him that Fritz was able to not fall into the same bad habit as his second brother when the two super-geniusesArnaud BaumanandLeonard Jesterjoined the Crusaders. Instead of falling into envy he came to respect the two of them for their strength, while also knowing from his own experiences that one cannot survive off of talent alone. In short time, Fritz was able to rise through the ranks and become a Holy Knight among theTen Great Saints, the loftiest position a Holy Knights could hope for.[1]

Trivia: All three of them were shown in the first opening, despite the fact thatHinatawouldn't have a role aside from a cameo inSaved SoulsuntilSeason 2, with the rest not appearing until even later on.

Appearance: Masahiko is a young Japanese man with slicked black hair and thin narrow eyes that gleam with intelligence from behind his glasses. He wears a mahogany-brown military uniform and carries a Japanese-style sword at his waist.
Personality: Masahiko is a fiercely intelligent and calculating person, called one of the brightest minds on his entire planet. He prioritizes information over strength and always comes up with a perfect strategy to fit the situation. He found the idea of being a king to be extremely tiresome, preferring to handle things from behind the scenes.
Background: Masahiko was originally a member of the Imperial Japanese Military and a disciple ofGensei Araki. He was one of Gensei's top three disciples alongsideTatsuya KondouandSaburo Minamoto. He was defeated byPhantomswhen he and Tatsuya were deployed as part of military aid to China and subsequently used as a vessel for incarnation. The Phantom that had possessed Masahiko was aStaff officerandCornu's second-in-command, its ego slowly being worn away by Masahiko until he ultimately regained his freedom. AfterPulcinellaand the rest of the Phantoms were dealt with, Masahiko took full responsibility for their actions and retired from the army, going on to join the Emile Entertainment Agency in the United States of Azalea and taking control of a massive portion of the criminal underworld to support it.

Personality: Reyhiem is an opportunistic coward who always curries favor with authoritative individuals, even going as far as to talk aboutMonsterextermination being a matter of course one moment, then offering himself as a lobbyist for the interests ofTempest's Monsters right after. However he is also earnest in fulfilling his current role as long as he isn't inclined to change his allegiance.
Background: Reyhiem helped KingEdmarisin hisHoly Warand invasion of the Jura Tempest Federation by providingTemple Knightsalongside setting up aPrison Field, a barrier that weakens monsters within the barrier, aroundRimuru City. However, he severely underestimatesRimuru's forces, who ultimately proved much stronger than Falmuth's army.
He was captured by Rimuru alongside King Edmaris andRazenand was interrogated and tortured for weeks in Tempest.
He then pledged loyalty toDiabloin exchange for his life and was sent to give a message toHinata Sakaguchifrom Rimuru.
Unfortunately for him, he was killed by theClerics of the Seven Luminarieswho were aiming to alter Rimuru's message to incite further conflict.

Goblin: Rigurd was originally unsteady and wrinkled with the short stature of a goblin. His manner of speech was slow and stuttering and he always needed his walking stick to move around or even just stand straight. He had trouble keeping his eyes fully open most of the time.
Hobgoblin: After evolving into aHobgoblinupon being named, Rigurd's lifespan increased and he developed a robust muscular body. His height increased to that of a large adult human and he often flexes his muscles, expressing his gratefulness and love towards this new younger-looking body. He no longer needs his walking stick and he can now keep his deep-set eyes open with ease.
Personality: Rigurd is usually a stoic individual, but he gets easily overexcited when interacting with Rimuru. He also loves to organize festivals and feasts as much as possible. However, despite these personality quirks, he is a competent Prime Minister. As a father, he is shown to be emotional and proud of his second son; Rigur, often breaking down in tears much to the exasperation of the people around. He has has a natural charisma that many find very welcoming, which Rimuru has encouraged, making him very diplomatically sound. He has a great sense of humor, and understanding of dire situations, often making sure others understand how to best handle the situation.
Background: The nameless Rigurd used to govern his goblin village peacefully thanks to the protection of the aura of the sealedVeldorawho the goblins treated as their god. One dayGelmudappeared and named Rigurd's nameless eldest son "Rigur."

Over time the goblin village managed to loot the corpses of dead adventurers who died to stronger monsters and eventually the village agreed that they needed to make use of it, so a namelessGobtagot sent toDwargonon his own to sell a cart filled with dead adventurers' equipment. The nameless Gobta's journey succeeds and craftsmen from Dwargon appear to fix the Goblin's houses in exchange for the adventurer's equipment, leading to a time of prosperity for the village.

However, one day Veldora's aura disappeared and a month later the Goblins got attacked by a pack ofdirewolvesled by theDirewolf Boss. In order to protect the village, the nameless Rigurd's first-born son Rigur stepped up to protect the village by ambushing the approaching Direwolves, but it ended in failure and the first-born Rigur succumbed to his wounds while ensuring that information about the Direwolves reached the Goblin village.

In this moment of crisis, the Goblins felt a strong aura approaching from a different direction than the Direwolves, so they tried to appeal to this individual who turned out to be Rimuru, to save their village in crisis against the Direwolves.
After defeating the Direwolf Boss, the goblins were able to tame the direwolves, were givennamesand evolved intohobgoblins, giving Rigurd a much younger and muscled body. He now serves Rimuru.
Trivia: Though Rigurd has no named abilities of any kind nor any noteworthyequipment, he is noted to have combat capabilities equivalent to A-Rank. In the anime, he was even shown to be able to lift and throw a 20-meter longMegalodonalong withGeldwith no visible effort, showcasing tremendous strength for aHobgoblin. Rigurd himself, however, is seemingly unaware of just how immense his natural strength is, even lamenting that his busy schedule does not afford him time to train and become strong like others.

Rogurd.title: Rogurd

infobox.title: Rogurd
infobox.Manga: Chapter 12:Mighty Foes in the Forest of Jura

Appearance: Standing slightly taller then all of the other goblin lords, he has a street thug like demeanor, which contrasts his often serious and calm nature. He talks in the same kind of lingo that Lilina sometimes uses when she has to discipline lazy or rambunctious goblins working under her.  Despite the way he talks or carries himself, he's shown to be very passionate artist, working with clay and teaching kids Art in the School.
Personality: Despite his appearance, he is a very kind, passionate artist with a love for creativity. He is a minister, and specifically tries to focus on civilian life and how to make it more fun day to day.
Story: Rogurd was originally a nameless Goblin that migrated to Rimuru's goblin village in the hopes for protection from stronger monsters. After meeting Rimuru he named him Rogurd and made his supervisor to handle Tempest's Internal Government.
Relationships: Rimuru Tempest: As one of the leaders of the second group of goblins looking for safe refuge, he along with three other goblins were promoted to "Goblin Lord", later they formed a ministry, working with each other to help the new nation of Tempest grow. He has grown to respect the slime, who took his people in without any hesitation.

Rigurd: Has knowledge of Rigurd before the Goblin King evolved, and was impressed with how he went from a shriveled, shaky old coot, to a muscular, energetic elder. Is proud to have been invited by Rigurd to the new nation, and works hard to make sure Rigurd is aware of him pulling his weight.
Lilina: Has a slight crush on Lilina, and often seen trying to talk with her, before he starts bragging about his work ethic, much to Lilina's annoyance.
Trivia: He often wears suits and close cut shirts and dress pants, giving him the look of a Yakuza thug, but despite this, he is known to be an extremely shy person who struggles with meeting new people. Often walks with his hands in his pockets.

Demon lord seeds: Demon lord seed｢魔王種,maō shu｣refers to individuals who have met the necessary qualifications to be able to undergo the Harvest Festival and become demon lords. In terms of puremagiculesalone, they are at leastSpecial A, with anexistence valueof at least 200,000 being required as one of the qualifications. Another qualification is that the user must not be a recognized subordinate to another individual, though those who become recognized subordinates after acquiring the seed retain it.[2][3]
True demon lords: "True demon lord" — sometimes referred to as "awakened demon lord" — is a term created to distinguish the social status of those on theDemon Lord councilfrom those who have undergone the Harvest Festival and become actual demon lords. They are beings of monstrous power; some even have the potential to stand on even footing withTrue Dragons.
Harvest Festival: TheHarvest Festival｢魔王への進化,hābesuto fesutibaru｣is a phenomenon that occurs once all the requirements to become a demon lord have been met. In order to meet the base requirements, an individual has to fulfill certain conditions, at which point they become a demon lord seed. To become a full-fledged demon lord, they're required to "germinate the seed" using the equivalent of 10,000humansouls.

Appearance: He has a verydwarf-like, tough-looking body, with the height of ahumancovered in an armor of muscle that hides surging energy beneath. His skin is tanned brown as characteristic of his race, and his jet black hair is slicked back all the way.
Personality: Gazel is a free-willed individual with a surprisingly open personality, is stubborn, calculating and possesses a lot of charisma. He follows the philosophy of "peace through strength" to a great extent. He is extremely perceptive and values truth and honor at his core.  He takes an interest inRimuruduring his visit, being overly cautious and knowing that Rimuru was ridiculously strong for a mereslime.
Background: When he was young, he wandered through theJura Forestand learned sword techniques from theSword Oni. Gazel ruled for three hundred years and had many achievements to his name, being even treated as a hero. His strength is at the same level ofHinata Sakaguchiand is comparable to ademon lord.
Trivia: Gazel tends to accept gifts from Rimuru, even a full Santa Claus outfit. He tends to look exasperated at wearing it though; but is proud to wear it.

Gazel is shown to admit that despite getting along with Rimuru, the things Rimuru has done in the short amount of time he's been in the world has been enough to cause all sorts of headaches in the political world, though defends his junior's actions nonetheless.
Upon realizingVeldorawas back and in human form, Gazel was infuriated at Rimuru not informing him, it's one of the few times Gazel has shown emotion on his face.
Gazel has a love of alcohol. His new favorite is Apple Brandy and asks Rimuru to make sure he can get a ready supply.
Upon experiencing a festival in Rimuru City for the first time, it left Gazel wondering why in the world are theMonstersin Great Forest of Jura always so happy.

InSeason Oneof the Dub, he has an appropriately deep voice that gives him a commanding presence and clout. His second voice gives off a tired, exasperated vibe; appropriate for how he reacts to Rimuru.

Government: Eurazania is a country that embraces the ideology of "might makes right" and takes it to the extreme, as evidenced by its class system. Individuals below a certain threshold of strength are automatically relegated to low-class citizenship and are prohibited from entering the capital, while those who surpass that power threshold enjoy numerous privileges. Merely one percent of the nation's population belong to the high-class elite, with the remaining 99% residing in vassal states and vast tracts of farmland maintained by enslaved individuals.

A significant portion of each territory's resources is extracted as taxes, which are then delivered to the capital. Those who are unable to pay these taxes receive no support from the government and are left to fend for themselves. The ruler of Eurazania, known as theBeast Master, is de facto the strongest person in the entire nation. Residing in a luxurious palace in the capital city of Laura, the Beast Master appears to be disconnected from the day-to-day management of the territories, aside from dispatching military aid and collecting taxes.
Military Strength: Eurazania is one of the continent's superpowers, with a formidable army that rivals the likes ofEnglassiaorLubelius. Over half of the total population in the capital possesses enough fighting skills to be considered warriors if the need arises, although their standing military forces in times of peace are relatively small. A healthy adultLycanthropein Eurazania is alreadyrankedas A-minus in power when unleashing their full power, and the kingdom further strengthens its military might by taming powerful magic beasts, with Thunder Tigers being a prime example.

TheBeast Master's Brigadeis the strongest military organization in Eurazania and is led by theThree Beastketeers. Each member of this elite group is extensively trained in combat, and even the weakest among them holds a ranking of well into A-rank. The brigade consists of just under a hundred members, all of whom have unwavering respect and loyalty to Carrion, dedicating their lives to safeguarding Eurazania from threats such asmonstersand wild beasts.
Economy: Eurazania is an agricultural state that maximizes its fertile soil and tropical climate to produce high-quality crops on a large scale. The majority of the nation's population resides in small villages and operates large plantations, which are tended to by slaves. The country is renowned for its specially cultivated fruits, known for their exceptional sweetness. While Eurazania has access to a significant gold supply near the capital, it holds little value beyond ornamental purposes for the king and is occasionally used for bartering during rare trade negotiations with foreign nations.

The concept of money does not exist within Eurazania's territories. Instead, trade occurs through the barter system, exchanging goods and services rather than usingcoins. The capital enforces a strict annual tax on the amount of goods offered, and territories that fail to meet the tax requirements are left to deal with monsters and other issues independently, without receiving any military support from the capital.

Appearance: While her material body was originally that of a pair of ornate silver earrings, she later incarnated into a golem that bore the same appearance as her magical corpus. She takes the form of a youthful woman with long blonde hair and green eyes. She wears a simple outfit consisting of a pink dress with a white undershirt and a leather belt. She has her long hair tied up with a green ribbon.
Personality: Information to be added.
Background: Carbuncle is anElementalthat obtained anameand a "body" through unknown circumstances. She was incarnated into a pair of enchanted silver earrings, removing her freedom entirely. After passing hands from owner to owner, she was unexpectedly set with a pair of particular magical gems. The power of the gems granted her enough power to temporarily detach her spiritual body from the earrings and roam the world freely as a magical corpus. From here, she hatched a scheme that involved using her newfound power to "cut" the stress from humans and crystalize it into new magical gems, but, as her form was only temporary, she lacked the power to do so herself. In order to enact out her plan, she needed to be "worn" by a powerful individual, allowing them to use her power in order to produce the stress crystals.

While posing as the merchantTiahier｢チアヒア,chiahia｣, she managed to stumble upon and trickChloe AubertandAlice Rondointo wearing her. While she was being worn, her power physically manifested as a special armor and sword, resembling something worn by stereotypical "magical girls". By using the power of the stress crystals, she was able to overwhelm the emotions of humans, sending them on a stress-induced rampage. Chloe and Alice, in kind, would defeat the rampaging humans by using Carbuncle in sword form to "cut" away their stress. After their stress was "cut" it would crystalize into a new stress crystal and the cycle would start anew.

While in the process of collecting the stress crystals, she was eventually found out and defeated byRimuru Tempest. After hearing her story, Rimuru decided to incarnate her into a "Golem" of his creation in exchange for taking ownership of all the stress crystals that she'd gathered.
Trivia: Carbunclesare a type of mythical creature common inSouth-American folklore. They're usually depicted as bunnies with a precious gemstone embedded into their forehead.

Ogre: As an Ogre, Shion had a wild appearance with a thick black horn protruding from the center of her forehead and a small fang like tooth coming out of her mouth, the base of which had skin folded in a way where she appeared to be angry. She had large purple eyes and light purple hair tied into a ponytail, as well as a noticeably curvaceous figure with massive breasts. Her outfit consisted of a brown robe with thick woolen borders and a collar that revealed much of her cleavage. She also wore a necklace with a green stone in the center, between two white stones that looked like teeth, which in turn were also between two other green stones.
In the anime, her skin had a purple tint matching her purple color scheme, as well as a sharp tooth peeking out from the corner of her mouth.
Kijin: Similar to the evolution of her brethren, Shion's horn became narrower, and she overall lost her vicious appearance in her transition to a Kijin as she no longer has a fanglike tooth sticking out. She became a beautiful woman with a slender and voluptuous body, reaching a height of 170 centimeters. Her hair grew much longer, and her skin also lost its purple tint. In some instances of the Anime, she has two fanglike teeth in her mouth when speaking.

She received a custom set of Western formal attire fromShuna; a skintight purple business suit and light green shirt. She leaves the jacket unbuttoned, allowing a generous portion of her cleavage to spill out.
Her appearance mostly remains the same for her subsequent evolutions.
Personality: Shion appears as a cool, professional beauty at first glance, but is actually very clumsy and simple-minded. Despite her calling herself Rimuru's first secretary, she has no actual secretarial skills and serves as no more than a bodyguard, leaving Shuna to assume the duties of her purported job in her stead. She is strongly passionate about her interests, particularly cooking, and does not grasp the concept of restraint, putting her all into everything she does – be it good or bad – without considering the ramifications of her actions and those she burdens with the aftermath.

Being very emotional and hot-headed is another prominent trait of hers. When she claims to show patience in situations that irritate her, it only means her restraining herself for what amounts to little more than a handful of seconds, earning the exasperation of her master and colleagues. Shion takes pride in all of Rimuru's actions and accomplishments as though they were her own and boldly shows it on her face, yet another strange trait of hers that draws eyebrows from others. She is very competitive, constantly challenging Shuna and her junior secretary,Diablo, for Rimuru's attention.

Since the time she came under Rimuru's wing, she used to be very insecure about her value to him and worried about being abandoned and forgotten. For this reason, she always envied those who were better than her in certain aspects and saw them as rivals. Constantly tormented by these dark emotions, it took several life-to-death experiences and actually dying and being brought back to life, for her way of thinking to turn around. Deeply touched by the actions of Rimuru bringing her back to life, she found that her previous fears were unfounded and learned to believe in herself more. She stopped seeing others as rivals to affirm her own value, instead finding meaning in facing and overcoming her own limits.

After her resurrection, while she still tends to make impulsive decisions and tries to solve things with excessive violence, occasionally an uncharacteristic wisdom of hers shines through. WhenDagruel's three sons challenged Rimuru, instead of outright killing them, she tamed them all by herself and turned them into her students, impressing even Rimuru. Her intuition also improved as a result of her deepened connection to Rimuru following her resurrection. She's able to reach the truth behind virtually any matter given enough information due to bits of Rimuru's computational power being shared with her.
Due to the size of her big breasts, which makes her female rivals envious, she finds wearing a kimono uncomfortable, due to its tightness around them.
Background: Shion was originally a survivor of the Ogre tribe, accompanying a small party of six that included thelate chief'ssonanddaughterthrough the forest. While searching for refuge, she came across a maskedmajin, Rimuru, who she assumed was associated with theperpetratorsthat engineered the genocide of her people, and immediately attacked him. Contrary to her expectations, she was quickly overpowered and left in awe by his power. The ogre princess, sensing their mistake, mediated between the two parties and brought an end to their conflict. After many twists and turns, Shion was eventually taken in by Rimuru along with her brethren and received aname, becoming his first secretary.
Trivia: In Japanese, 紫苑 (Shion) meansAster tataricusor Tatarinow's aster flower. The flower has a meaning inHanakotoba, the Japanese language of flowers, which corresponds to "I won't forget you."
Shion went through her Harvest Festival without needing to go into a deep sleep.[1]

Appearance: Yamza is a striking figure with a unique and somewhat mismatched aesthetic. His dark, almost black hair is streaked with a patch of stark white on one side, adding a touch of rebellious flair to his appearance. A dark cloth covers the lower half of his face,  His left arm is encased in a segmented, dark metal gauntlet, adorned with golden, geometric embellishments, in contrast, his right arm is bare, revealing a blue undergarment beneath a white, flowing sash that drapes around his waist. He wears loose-fitting blue pants tucked into dark, segmented greaves that echo the design of his gauntlet.
Personality: Yamza was an ambitious person who once held unwavering loyalty to Clayman. Initially motivated and willing to serve, he gained favor from his master, which led him to imitate Clayman's vociferous character. His aggressive and dangerous demeanor often clouded his judgment, making it challenging for him to view situations objectively. Over time, his ambitions waned, and he lost faith in his master, becoming a shadow of his former self.

Despite his initial loyalty, Yamza's character took a darker turn as he grew more cunning and opportunistic. He learned to utilize dirty tricks and amoral tactics, showing a willingness to provoke others for his own gain. While not inherently rude or brutal by nature, his pursuit of power drove him to adopt such qualities.

However, as he lost faith in Clayman, Yamza's loyalty eroded, and he became disloyal to his master. His desire for self-preservation led him to plan abandoning Clayman's army during a critical battle, seeking shelter and protection by working for anotherDemon Lord. Despite his negative traits, he possesses skills in assessing threats, making him valuable in strategic planning.
Background: Yamza was an ambitiousmajinthat caught the attention of Demon Lord Clayman, due to his unwavering motivation and deep desire to serve him. Unlike the other members of Clayman's Five Fingers, Yamza willingly chose to join Clayman's ranks as a loyal subordinate. His voluntary allegiance, unmarred by any heart-stealing coercion, earned him special favor from Clayman, who trusted and treated him better than the other fingers.

In his pursuit to become one of the most valuable individuals in Clayman's forces, Yamza started emulating his master's iconic vociferous character. He developed an aggressive and dangerous side that made it difficult for him to view information objectively and rationally. Yamza was not inherently rude or brutal, but he learned to employ Clayman's tactics, including dirty tricks and amoral strategies such as gossiping and cheating during duels.

As time went on, Yamza's character took a darker turn. His once strong ambitions dwindled, and his faith in Clayman began to fade, transforming him into a "сrooked mirror" of his former self. Despite receiving his favorite Ice Blade, he neglected personal swordsmanship training in favor of relying heavily on the sword's magic abilities.
Trivia: His position as the Middle Finger was quite appropriate. Said finger is used to "flip the bird" as a rude gesture; Yamza himself is rude.

InClayman's Revenge-  spin-off manga of main series, we can observe Yamza's true and caring nature in comparison with his dangerous and aggressive role, that he tries to imitate in order to show Clayman his capabilities and powers. Clayman sees Yamza's motivation and potential, but unlike in his previous lives, Clayman is not gonna let him get loose and replicate his bad qualities and traits referencing himself in his young years, when at this time Clayman's master -"Curse Lord" Kazalimwarned to not imitate his bad qualities

Yamza resembles a reflection of Clayman's character growth or degradation as we seen in original timeline where Clayman was underTatsuya Kondou's brainwashing - Yamza was an arrogant scumbag, while in Clayman's Revenge where Clayman tries to avoid his mistakes and constantly improves and cares about his subordinates, Yamza also has begun to train and improve his swordsmanship skills and personality growth can be also seen.

Appearance: A middle-aged man with white hair speckled with gold, brushed back and tied up in a knot. He has a long white beard and a thin, wrinkled face. However, his sharp eyes and straight, clean posture showed no signs of aging. He also has a distinctive scar on his forehead, starting right above his right eyebrow and rising diagonally left towards his hairline. In the LN illustrations and manga, he has black hair and a stubble. He was said to have looked exactly the same in his human life. In the anime, when he was old as a human, his hair was gray.
Personality: Agera acts as the voice of reason for Carrera, as well as for his fellow lieutenantEsprit, who also serves under Carrera. Therefore, for someone in his position, Agera is calm most of the time. However, since he, like all ofRimuru's subordinates, is extremely loyal and devoted to him, a single insult towards his master is enough to drive him into a rage for a short time.
He also gets angry if anyone insults him or his boss Carrera due to his prideful nature as adaemon, though to a lesser degree.
Background: 400 years ago, he wandered into the ogre village. The villagers were suspicious, but the chief warmly welcomed him. Around the same time, alesser dragonwas rampaging in the forest. After expressing his gratitude, Araki defeated the dragon. The villagers hallowed his name and passed down his praise to the later generations. They soon began imitating the lad's attire. He had taught them various techniques, and through trial and error, they learned them.

He later married anogrein the village and had a daughter. His daughter eventually had a son who had great talent for swordsmanship, and Araki decided to take his talented grandson as his disciple, teaching him everything he knew about the way of the sword. He often lamented that he could not give his grandson aname, since he was ahumanwith littlelife forceto spare.

Around 300 years ago, after he died, hissoulwas reincarnated as a Daemon and taken underPrimordialDaemonJaune. Along with his master and peers, he's given abodyand name Agera by Rimuru. After he and his master became Rimuru's subordinates, Agera was recruited as an officer in theBlack Numbers.
Araki's younger brother laid the foundation of "Hazy Lifestream Style" in the otherworld and is the ancestor ofGensei Araki, the master ofTatsuya Kondou,Masahiko AmariandSaburo Minamoto.
Trivia: Named afterKoenigsegg Ageraa mid-engine sports car and a successor to the CCX/CCXR, produced by Swedish car manufacturer Koenigsegg. The name comes from the Swedish verb 'agera' which means "to act" or in imperative form "(You) act!".

Properties: Undead are a type of demi-spiritual life-forms that reside within lifeless and immortal bodies; as a result, they lack life force. They tend to possess little to no physical strength, but their potentmanaand wicked miasma more than make up for it.
They have a weakness or at least aversion to sunlight and are thus almost never seen outside during the day. They are also especially weak toholy magic, even more so than regular monsters.

Summary: SPIN-OFF CONTENTThis article covers spin-off creations that are not found in the light novel series.
Background: A war chimeras is the result of splicing the genes of various differentmonsterstogether to create a powerful chimera. After the chimera is complete, alesser daemonis summoned and allowed to incarnate inside of it, completing the process. The end result is a powerful weapon that reaches A-rank.

Appearance: Orthos had the appearance of a youthful and handsome man with long golden hair and blue eyes. He was seen wearing a purple knight uniform with a striking pauldron on his left shoulder.
When he revealed his true nature, his sclera donned a deep red glow, and he also sprouted large bat-like wings and curved goat-like horns.
Personality: Orthos was a man who was filled with an ambition to conquer from the moment he gained a firm will. Every action that he took was in service to his desires to gain power and rule over others, being the perfect archetypal Red Daemon that closely followed in the footsteps ofRouge, a being that Orthos held in great reverence and respect.
Background: When he first arrived at theCentral World, Orthos was a mereLesser daemon, a fragile existence without a firm sense of self. However this changed when he managed to incarnate into physical flesh and gain a firm will.

Blessed with opportunity, the Lesser daemon sought to pursue the desires that welled up within his newly-born mind. Working alongsideMonster-Kind, he gained power and experience, evolving into aGreater daemonwith time. However this was not enough to quell the raging ambition distinct to those with redSouls. The Daemon set his sights on the Kingdom of Filtwood–a relatively small kingdom–and infiltrated it by posing as an ordinaryHuman.

Cooperating with his allies, the Daemon managed to take control over the small kingdom and forged the false narrative of "Orthos the Hero". The story goes that a man named Orthos–a soldier of no background or prior achievement–rose up and sealed an evil Daemon that was loose within the kingdom underneath the castle, with the seal said to come undone in a hundred-years time. The reality is that both the Rampaging Daemon and the Knight Orthos were in-fact the same person, with the Daemon using the collective will of the people that believed in the story to inscribe the name 'Orthos' onto his Soul.

Now a named individual, Orthos spent the next hundred years biding his time and gaining strength, evolving into anArchdaemonand posing as the Commander of the nation's Knights. With the King and Prime Minister similarly replaced with his allies, Orthos hatched a plot to further increase his strength. Using the authority of the king, he called upon various adventurers from the Mutual-Aid Association to gather in Filtwood in order to "slay the resurrected Daemon", where he then planned to consume their flesh and steal their possessions.

This plan was–unfortunately for Orthos–a complete and total failure. Due to his own arrogance, he underestimated theSilver Wingsand allowed them to escape. The woman was a powerfulmage, one that was willing to break any and all taboos to get revenge on the man who fatally wounded her fiancé. Using the last of her strength, she managed to call uponNoirand he agreed to a contract to kill Orthos. It was at the hands of this most ancient and regal Daemon that Orthos met his end, his Soul shattered by Noir to the point of being incapable of reincarnation.

Appearance: Pippin has the deceptive appearance of an emotionless young girl with silky blonde hair. Both of her eyes are covered with eyepatches and a hood covers most of her head.
Personality: Similar to her creatorTwilight Valentine, and her brother,Jahil; Pippin has a personality that could best be described as a "Mad Scientist". She's an individual completely obsessed with research and experimentation, with little regard for ethics.
Although she doesn't particularly dislikehumans, she finds them to be the best test subjects for her experiments, somethingLuminousdidn't agree with.
Background: Pippin is aHigh humancreated directly by Twilight Valentine, being the thirteenth of their disciples.

As a specialized calculation-type who lacked true reproductive capability, Pippin's only purpose was to act as a research assistant for Twilight, a task she never got to properly fulfill due to Twilight's death at the hands of Luminous.

After the death of Twilight; Pippin, as well as her fellow pupilsAshleyandPrelix, worked with Luminous for a period of time. They eventually separated after having various disagreements about how the world should be ruled, going on to found the Magic Tower together.

The trio became known as the "Trinity Wisemen" and set themselves ambitious goals. Their first goal was to take control of the entire world and spread knowledge of the greatness of Twilight. The second of their goals was to defeatVeldora, a feat they wished to accomplish to prove that they weren't "failures" and could do something even the "masterpiece" Luminous couldn't do.

infobox.title: Gabiru
infobox.Affiliation(s): Twelve Guardian LordsThird CorpsHiryuuWyvern RidersBlue Numbers

Lizardman: Gabiru had the appearance of a green anthropomorphic Lizard with two horns. In all adaptations, he wore a wear armor that consists of a cape, baggy pants, and furry neck warmer. In the manga and anime, he is shown to have black hair.
Dragonewt: Although he didn't look much different from the average lizardmen. Gabiru grew dragon-like wings and noticeably bigger horns and firmer scales. The biggest difference was the color of his scales which changed from greenish-black to purple​​​​​. In the manga and anime, as well as more recent LN illustrations, he also has black hair.
True dragonewt: After undergoing Rimuru'sHarvest Festivalritual, Gabiru's scales acquired more of a reddish hue and magnificent horns sprouted from his temples. In the LN illustrations, he does not have horns on his temples.
Personality: Gabiru first appears to be a young and overconfident lizardman who is proud to be the first-named warrior in his tribe as he expresses annoyance at hisfatherfor not addressing him with it.

Despite this, however, Gabiru holds his father in high regard and sees him as a proud and noble chieftain of the lizardmen and actually inherited quite a few qualities from him. Like Abiru, he is brave, loyal to his followers and kinsmen, as well as a natural leader gaining loyal subordinates who hold him in higher regard than Abiru himself.

Despite his natural talents, however, his ego is swelled and easily manipulated, as both the honest praise from his subordinates as well as Laplace's manipulations, he was led to believe that he had no choice but to take over the tribe from his aging father in order to save the lizardmen.

After he realized he had put his people in jeopardy during the battle with the Orc Lord, and thatGelmudwas only using him, Gabiru was humbled and took the full blame for his treason and was willing to accept execution with grace, only pleading to spare his men. He is shown to continue to grow, to become cooler headed, and understand that though he is strong, he still had to work on his immaturity. He has a variety of eccentric quirks but this side of him is very endearing to Rimuru. Over time his ego is all but gone. He has a more open mind, no longer looking down on others, and has become very knightly towards allies and worthy opponents. He is awestruck towards his sister's training. When visited by his father, his father is struck by how much he had changed since his exile.

Despite his ego causing him to act foolish, Gabiru is actually very intelligent with good working knowledge of magical and scientific theory and application befitting his role as a high ranking member of the Jura-Tempest Federation's department of science.
Background: Gabiru was the captain of the lizardmen warriors which resides in the marshes. He was named by Gelmud sometime before the start of the stories. He is seen as a spoiled child, who has a poor sense of superiority over others in his tribe since he is the sole named lizardman. Because he is surrounded by Yes men, his ego is over inflated. Seen as a doofus by Rimuru, but over time seeing him as endearing, if a bit eccentric. His exile and joining of the Federation is the start of his change from a spoiled child to a knightly Dragonewt, he befriends Vesta and works alongside him.
Trivia: Gabiru is one of the few individuals to have their name overwritten.

In theKonoSubacollab original story inThat Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime: ISEKAI Memories, Gabiru andKazuma Satoufelt like they had a strange interdimensional connection. Most likely because they both have the same Japanese voice actor,Jun Fukushima.

Appearance: Kakushin is one of the dragonewts that has little care for a human form, instead choosing to remain in a lizard-like form at all times. He has blue colored scales and orange eyes. His typical attire consists of simple and maneuverable cloth, with a hood covering his hair and horns.
Personality: Kakushin, likeSukerouandYashichi, admires Gabiru immensely, constantly cheering him on from the sidelines as a cheerleader of sorts. He seems to be the most solemn of the three cheerleaders, and like the other two, he is willing to die if it's to help Gabiru.
Background: Kakushin was originally aLizardman, serving in Gabiru's elite hundred-man-squad and acting as his hype-man alongside Sukerou and Yashichi. After the war with the orcs, when Gabiru was exiled from their homeland, Kakushin, along with the rest of Gabiru's subordinates, chose to follow him and joinTempest. After receiving their names fromRimuru Tempest, they formed theHiryuuand began helping the researchers in theSealed Cave.

Personality: Kenya is shown to have a highly energetic, mischievous and aggressive personality, as seen during his first interactions with his new teacherRimuru Tempest, where he attempted to constantly get a rise out of the latter by acting impious and rebellious towards him. This behavior having landed him to be branded as "troublesome" by his teachers and leading him to be placed in a separate class for troublemakers.

Kenya like many of his fellow Summoned, is shown to be actively frustrated by him being forced to be transported into another world against his will and has shown active frustration on the fact that he was branded a "failure" and was even more upset by the fact that his lifespan was shortened due to the Summoning's side effects on his childbody.
Appearance: He is a young boy with spiky orange hair and black eyes.
Background: Kenya like many of the other Summoned Otherworlders was one of the many of the "failed" victims of the many Summoning Rituals to summonOtherworldersby various kingdom and countries around the world and forcibly enlist their power into the various military's of the world. to help counter the variousDaemons,Monstersand other beings that pose a threat toHumanity. And due to Kenya being nothing more than a child during his summoning, the excessMagiculesin his body did not cause him to develop a unique skill or power but instead severely shorten his life expectancy. Causing him to be then deemed a failure by his summoners and put aside.

Demi-spiritual life-form.title: Demi-spiritual life-form

Properties: Demi-spiritual life-forms are beings that exist in a framework beyond that of any material life-form and aren't bound to amaterial bodyif they even possess one.[1]They can broadly be split into two categories: those who have becomeenlightenedamongdemi-material life-formsand those that are naturally born with this status, typically within spiritual worlds.

Being unbound to flesh and not requiring a material body to function naturally means that demi-spiritual life-forms have their memory storage and thoughts located within theirspiritual bodyor even deeper within. For those that possess a material body, it becomes almost unbound by a life span, having its physical structure reconstructed over time to surpass the limits of organic life. Even if their brains are destroyed, they can regenerate it without any issues.

Though demi-spiritual life-forms are extremely close to spiritual life-forms in nature they remain inferior in one key aspect, their mortality. If the spiritual body of a demi-spiritual life-form is destroyed, then they die for good, having been unable to escape the constraints of theirbodyand cheat death.[2]

Story: They planned to eliminate Tempest using theClerics of the Seven Luminaries, theTen Great Saints, andHinata(whom they also plan to kill), receiving help fromDamradaandYuukiin this scheme. The plan failed thanks toLuminous,Diablo,Nikolaus, andRimuru's new defensiveskill:Absolute Guard.

They made another attempt to take down the monster nation by making Rimuru indebted toMuese, who organized a large number of merchants during Tempest' founder's festival to demand only specificdwarven currencyas payment. This would leave Tempest unable to meet their demands and Muese would step in to provide the money and put Tempest into his debt, but this also failed thanks toElmesiagiving Rimuru the money he needed. Furthermore, Muese's scheme would backfire on him when the very reporters he brought to pressure Tempest would end up spreading the news of his failed scheme. Muese's failure cost him the trust of the Five Elders and was later assassinated to silence him.

Their next plot against Tempest was to prevent them from joining the Council of the West and damage their reputation. Multiple plans were enacted bysubtly manipulatingthe majority of representees to make outrageous demands for Tempest' joining, deceiving princeElric von Englassiato lead an attempt to takecontrolof Rimuru, and attempting to frame Rimuru for assassinating the prince when he failed. All of these attempts were overcome and not only did Tempest join the council,Count Gabanwas also exposed and arrested while their enslaved assassin Glenda was captured and defected to Tempest after they removed her controlling curse.

Velzard.title: Velzard

infobox.title: Velzard
infobox.Relative(s): True Dragons(siblings)Lucia Nasca(Sister-In-Law)Milim Nava(Niece)Rudra Nam Ul Nasca(Brother-In-Law)

Human Form: Velzard generally assumes an immature appearance for the purpose of leaking heraurato keep the surroundings of theFrost Palacefrozen and gridlocked. She appears no older than a girl in high school, with fair skin, eyes the color of blue diamonds, and long, glossy pearl-white hair tied into twin-tails reaching her waist.[1]Most notably, her facial features are reminiscent of her niece,Milim Nava. Her attire consists of an off-shoulder white and blue dress and blue boots. She also wears detached white sleeves, a blue star-shaped pendant and a gold headband.

When Velzard gets serious in battle, her human form takes on a more mature look. The stark contrast from her usual appearance include her taking on gold eyes along with a pronounced voluptuous figure. She wears a two toned black and white dress, exposing a generous portion of cleavage. The dress has a slit by her left thigh, revealing her legs which she wears black tights over. She also wears long blue gloves  With black fingers and white heels, both adorned with gold.
Dragon Form: Her dragon form is similar toVeldora's in shape, covered in snow white scales with black spikes covering her back. Her eyes are deep golden and the same color as the large scale covering the top of her head. On each side of her forehead is a white forward facing horn. Her jaw is black and her mouth is covered in red teeth.
Personality: Velzard is a prideful, haughty, and excessively possessive person. She is also childish and capricious, much like her younger brotherVeldora, but with some semblance of right and wrong and a careful consideration for the impact her actions can have on the world as a member of the strongest race. Furthermore, unlike Veldora, she does not openly show her feelings and conceals it beneath a polite and graceful exterior, only letting a glimpse of her true self slip out when overexcited. She refers to Guy's colleagues with formal honorifics, with Guy himself being the only exception.

She is the polar opposite to her younger sisterVelgrynd, and lacks the same compassion she is known for. In the past, she meted out cruel punishments to Veldora in what she perceived as educating him, and despite having all the best intentions in mind, this only served to traumatize and instill in him a fear for his sisters. She remained clueless on Veldora's true feelings until being confronted byRimuruin which she began to reconsider her treatment of him.

Though rare, her possessive nature can sometimes lead her to rampage against others. Her jealousy at Guy earningVeldanava's respect was a major factor behind their first encounter which began as a fight but led to her developing an appreciation for thedaemon. UnderFeldway's control, she rebels against Guy — who she spent many years with as partners and developed unrequited feelings for — but as Feldway's control over her still leaves her some free will, she takes the opportunity to monopolize Guy's attention and unload her pent up feelings on him.
Background: Velzard is the manifestation of the concept of deceleration and has control overtime. She is uninterested in most worldly matters and rarely leaves her residence in the Frost Palace, only choosing to do so when something catches her curiosity.

infobox.title: Orbic
infobox.Japanese: 豚頭族の王国オービック
infobox.Light Novel: Volume 2:A Disturbance in the ForestVolume 6:The Octagram Soars(Named)
infobox.Anime: Episode 8:Inherited WillEpisode 43:The Signal to Begin the Banquet(Named)

Government: Orbic, despite having a royal family and a king, did not utilize a feudal system of government but rather a tribal one closer in essence to a federation. In addition to the royal capital ruled by the king, there existed the ten great tribes each governed over by their own chieftain.[1]
Economy: Just like most of the nations in theDemon Lordruled lands, Orbic lacked any sort of currency culture and generally didn't trade with coins, instead exchanging goods and services. The kingdom specialized in performing hard labor such as mining, logging, and farming, often outsourcing this Labor to the nearby countries of Eurazania, Fulbrosia, andJistav. They served as vital members of the Demon Lords' work forces and offered them a large portion of their own bounty as taxes in exchange for protection frommonsters.

The beer produced from their cultivated grains is noted to have been rather exceptional in quality and it could've become a staple of their exports had the lands not been turned barren by rampagingaggressors.[2]
Military Strength: Though best known for their massive 200,000 strong army displayed in the Orc War, Orbic originally didn't have a large military force. Most of its healthy adults were laborers, with only a small portion of them being trained as knights and equipped with spears. They largely relied on the three demon lords in their vicinity to deal with any serious threats, a benefit they paid a hefty sum of labor and goods for every year.
Royal Family: The Orbic Royal Family were a group that led the 10 great tribes and acted as a representative of the entire Orc species. Its members are noted to have all beenHigh orcsfrom birth,[3]with their naturally superior intelligence likely contributing greatly to their status.

The other factor that established their rule was the fact that it was only from their bloodline that anOrc Lordcould be born, something that only happened once every couple of centuries. It would seem that an Orc Lord was born only when a member of the royal family broke taboo and ate the flesh and blood of another member of the royal family.[4]
Famine: Due to the appearance of a space-time crack between Orbic and theOtherworld, the orc nation was assaulted byinsectsand their land was ravaged by the energy that leaked from the dimensional rift. The damage caused by their assault was evidently too severe for their land to recover from any time soon, with it slowly beginning to deteriorate more and more over the course of 60 years to the point of being inhospitable.[5]It was the intense famine and drought brought about by these circumstances that drove the orc kingGeldto desperation and led to the Orc War.
