Dord.title: Dord

infobox.title: Dord
infobox.Anime: Episode 4:In the Kingdom of the Dwarves

Appearance: Dord, like most dwarfs, has a short stature and brown skin. However, he stands out with a plump build, in contrast to the typical muscular dwarfs. His distinguishing features include a bushy brown beard and mustache, along with brown hair. He is often spotted in a white shirt that accentuates his rounded figure, featuring detached brown sleeves. When engrossed in his projects, Dord consistently dons carpenter gloves and brown boots.
Personality: Dord, like his brothers, isn't known for being deceptive. He's straightforward and doesn't have much skill in telling lies. He's somewhat clumsy when it comes to everyday tasks. Dord has strong opinions about dyes and clothing, and he particularly enjoys crafting garments for beautiful women. He often collaborates withShuna, primarily because he has a crush on her due to her cute appearance. He takes great pride in his work and never hesitates to compliment himself when he completes an attire.
Background: Dord, the middle child of the three dwarf brothers, played a vital role in their family dynamic. While Garm, the eldest, was known for his skill in crafting armor, and Mildo, the youngest, was a versatile savant in various fields, Dord distinguished himself with his intricate handiwork. His craftsmanship was respected throughout the kingdom, earning him a reputation for precision and attention to detail. However, despite their exceptional individual talents, the trio faced a significant challenge in their lives. None of them possessed the business acumen or the ability to lay the foundation for a successful career. They struggled with basic tasks and often found themselves in situations where others took advantage of their skills.

Their unfortunate experiences included entrusting their shop to an unscrupulous apprentice who stole it from them and facing mistreatment from the government after mishandling a ministerial request. In desperate circumstances, they turned to Kaijin, an old friend who had been like a fourth brother to them in their youth. Kaijin, despite wishing they had sought his help sooner, welcomed them and offered them a safe haven. Kaijin, however, had limited work opportunities for the brothers in his battle gear merchant business. He manufactured weapons himself and couldn't immediately terminate his existing contacts. To keep them occupied, he had Dord and his brothers direct a team of laborers in mining for ore and other essential materials.

One fateful day, while Dord and his brothers were diligently mining for magic ores deep within the mine, they encountered a formidable threat: anArmorsaurus. This powerful creature attacked them viciously, leaving the brothers seriously injured and in dire need of assistance. Their desperate situation took a turn for the better when a rescue team arrived just in the nick of time. The rescuers administered a life-saving potion, generously provided by a slime named Rimuru Tempest. This miraculous potion worked wonders and managed to save Dord and his brothers from the brink of death. It marked the beginning of their connection with Rimuru and the extraordinary events that would follow.

As a chain of unexpected events unfolded, Dord and his brothers found themselves exiled from their homeland. However, their new benefactor,Rimuru, along with their longtime friend Kaijin, joined forces with them. Together, they embarked on a remarkable journey that involved not only aiding in the construction but also contributing to the eventual development of the once humble Goblin village, which would ultimately transform into the prosperous and thriving Jura-Tempest Federation.
Trivia: InSlime Diaries, Myrd says "Mom we're home" along with his 2 brothers.

Appearance: Gadra was introduced as an old man with long, white hair and a matching beard. Following hisreincarnationas ametal daemon, Gadra's new appearance, based on his young self from his first life, has waist-length black hair, dark brown skin, and black eyes; his entire body has a metallic luster.
Personality: He has been described byRimuruas a born egotist that has no relation to things like loyalty. However, he appears to value people close to him a lot, so much that avengingAdalmann's death more than a thousand years ago is the sole reason that he allied himself with the Eastern Empire.

He is also an opportunist that's quick to adapt to changes. When he learned that theClerics of the Seven Luminaries, his targets of revenge, were eliminated, andTempestturned out to be a much greater threat than expected, he defected to the nation ofmonsterswithout hesitation.

His other defining trait is his fascination withmagic. Every time he reincarnated, he would read the treasured books of each royal palace library and build up his knowledge. He held grudges against the Eastern Empire for phasing out hisMagic Divisionin favor of theArmored Division. Despite this, he is very open-minded and is always keen to listen to ideas raised byOtherworlders.
Background: Gadra was a close friend of Adalmann when he was alive. As Adalmann was killed due to nefarious schemes concocted by the Seven Luminaries, Gadra performed his Reincarnation magic in an attempt to revive him. However, because the ambient miasma had tainted hissoul, Adalmann was reborn as aWight. As a result, Gadra swore revenge against Luminism and the Seven Luminaries, and allied himself with the Eastern Empire.

Throughout his few hundreds years of service in the Eastern Empire, Gadra had been ushering the Empire to wage war against the west. He is one of the survivors of the previousVeldorasubjugation operation.

He is also the one who appealed to theEmperorabout the practical use of otherworlders. As a result, otherworlders have been receiving special treatment in the Empire, and far more had gathered there than any other nation. Research upon theirskillsand knowledge raised the Empire's military technology to a level that surpassed all the other nations in theworld.
Trivia: He is a Reincarnator, but rather than being ahumanwho died in another world and reincarnated in the current one, he is a native to his world and has instead reincarnated numerous times in order to extend his lifespan using magic.

Appearance: Ogres resemble humans for the most part, but tend to be very muscular and tall, averaging at two meters. They have either one or two horns sprouting from their foreheads. They have very pronounced canine teeth that usually protrude from their mouth, and their skin is usually tinted with some color.
Lifestyle: Most ogres in the Great Jura Forest were said to be uncivilized creatures living in the wild. The ogre villageBenimaruand co used to live in, which was civilized, constituted a minority among the species, only housing around 300 ogres.

The ogres in the village had a militaristic culture and were notoriously skilled warriors. Some of the stronger warriors in the village even hired themselves out as mercenaries. If one was planning on subjugating the village with B- rank knights, one would need about 3,000 of them.
History: 400 years ago, a group of wounded armored warriors wandered into their village. The ogres decided to take care of them. To express their gratitude, the warriors taught the ogres their techniques and gifted them their armor. One of the warriors knew how to forge katana-styled weapons and eventually succeeded in producing large numbers of them.[1]The Ogre Tribe was attacked by 10,000orcs. And each one, like the humans, were fully armored in plate mail. Nearly every villager was slaughtered. The village chief and a small group opened up a path for theiryoung masterand theprincessto escape, with four other subordinates. After the six surviving Ogres were named byRimuruthey evolved intoKijin.
During Rimuru'sascensionto aTrue demon lord, some of theHobgoblinsandGoblinasevolved into Ogres, thus restoring the race's prominence in the Jura Forest.
Abilities: The ogre race has extremely high vitality. They have an average lifespan of about a hundred years, though at leastone individualwas able to live for more than three hundred years.[2]
They are B-rank on average; however, with training, they can advance to B+ or even A- rank.
The Ogres from Benimaru's village mastered martial arts andBattlewillthanks to the teachings ofByakuya Arakiand his compatriot Samurai fromanother world, which were passed down.
Other Ogre Tribes tend to favor combat focusing on raw strength. They slaughter their enemies by wielding heavy weapons with their brute strength.

Appearance: Pulcinella had the appearance of a large and muscular middle-aged man. He had dark skin, slicked-back blonde hair, and piercing eyes. His usual attire consisted of large white robes adorned with a long necklace. After fully assimilating the power of the Phantom, he gained its two sets of angelic white wings, his skin became blue and his eyes became red.
Personality: Pulcinella, despite being a holy man renowned across the world as a saint, was a truly wicked person at heart. He was an extremely cunning and ruthless man who had no concept of honorable combat and desired power above all else. When he was taken over by aStaff officer-class phantom, his domineering spirit easily consumed the ego of his possessor and allowed him free rein over the Phantom's power. His newly obtained god-like capabilities made him go drunk with power, with him proceeding to use the rest of the invading phantoms who still believed him to be their superior in order to take over the world and rule it for himself. Ultimately, his arrogance was his undoing, he focused all of his efforts into making the power of the phantom his own, completely neglecting its memories and causing him to believe he could provoke and killVelgrynd.
Background: Pulcinella was originally a monk in the Great Roziam Dynasty. Across his life, he gained an immense reputation as a strong person and his priestly actions made many call him a saint. When the phantoms invaded and turned all of the major powers against each other, he was one of the first to sense that something was amiss and set out to search for the masterminds. He eventually found the phantoms but was ganged up on and quickly defeated, his body becoming the vessel for a Staff Officer-class phantom. However, Pulcinella's immense will and drive for dominance was able to overpower and consume the fragile ego of the nameless phantom, taking its power for himself. He used the phantom's position as a top-ranked officer and quietly manipulated the rest of them behind the scenes, deciding to not declare allegiance toCornuand wanting to rule theworldhimself. With his great strength and the brilliant mind ofMasahiko Amariassisting him, Pulcinella's plans were almost assured to succeed… until Velgrynd appeared in the world.

Appearance: Charybdis had the appearance of a massive shark-likedragonover 50 meters in length with a singular ominous eye. She had thick dragon scales covering her entirebodyin addition to wings and horns, with a prominent tail and dorsal fin giving her a fish-like atmosphere. Though she had clawed limbs they were frail and appeared almost as decorations rather than having any sort of practical use.[2]

The anime took several liberties with her design, taking more inspiration from the mythological Charybdis and overall increasing her size. In this depiction she has extremely large and straight wings reminiscent of an airplane, as well as a large open mouth filled with teeth on her rear end in reference to the mythological monster's ability to swallow large amounts of water and create whirlpools. She also had small stubbly legs that served no purpose.
Background: Born from the malice and violence ofHumans, and a cloud of Veldora’s Magicules, Charybdis entered a cycle of spreading widespread destruction and death to whatever caught her interest, before being subdued and killed, and eventually resurrecting a few centuries later. Seeking to end the cycle, aChosen herosealed Charybdis away inside adimensional sealhidden in a cave somewhere in theJura Forest, whose location being only known to the Hero and theDryads.
Trivia: Her name comes from a sea monster in Greek and Italian myth,Charybdis.
Charybdis in all technicalities can be considered as something akin to a sister to Rimuru Tempest, as they were both born of Veldora's Magicules.
In the English translations for theLight novel,Manga,Anime, andISEKAI MemoriesCharybids was referred to with male or "it" pronouns.

infobox.title: Guy Crimson
infobox.Title(s): Lord of DarknessTrue demon lordAncient Demon LordMediatorPrimordial Red
infobox.Manga: Chapter 9:Majin of Flames(Mentioned)Chapter 76:Demon Lord and True Dragon
infobox.Anime: Episode 24:Extra: Black and a Mask(Cameo)Episode 42:The Demon Lords

Male Form: Guy is portrayed as handsome man with blood red eyes as "stars of gold and silver dancing in them", with two black stripes under each of them. His wavy, burning like hair is a deep shade of rouge that is around waist-length. He's about as tall asLeonand his beauty is prideful and distant. He looks like someone born to lead and conquer.  He typically wears a dark-colored, open jacket or coat that  revealing his  very muscular chest , Around his waist, he sports a red sash or cloth belt. His pants are usually loose-fitting and dark
Female Form: He also has a female form with unknown characteristics, but it can be assumed that it shares many traits with the male form.
Daemon Form: As aDaemon, he has the characteristic horns, wings and claws of his race, but since he usually keeps them hidden it is unknown how they look like.
Personality: He is typically characterized as prideful and relaxed yet still intimidating. He doesn't usually pay much attention to others, but if someone catches his interest, he will attempt to get closer to them. He displays a forward approach in his relationships, often making suggestive and openly sexual advances towards Leon Cromwell while in his male form, despite Leon's clear preference for women. In response to Leon's rejection, Guy repeatedly offers to transform into a woman, only to be turned down.

However, Guy can also exhibit a caring side towards individuals he recognizes and acknowledges. For example, he continues to engage with Rudra in order to prevent his friend from falling apart emotionally, and he even threatens to become Leon's enemy if Leon harmsRamiris. Additionally, Guy demonstrates a level of respect for those who show no fear towards him, becoming more casual in their interactions. He takes his role as a mediator seriously, and he displays noticeable anger whenRimurudisrupts the balance of power that Guy had maintained for thousands of years. Guy is particularly interested in strong individuals, especially those who possessUltimate skills.
Background: Guy was born during the dawn of time, before the creation of heaven and earth. He was one of the demonic counterparts to theSeven Angels of Origin, having split from theGreat Holy SpiritofDarkness. As the first among them to be born, he ruled the Daemon Realm as its king and commanded the daemons at will. From his perspective, even the other primordials were mere dependents. However, whenBleuandVertchallenged him in a bid for supremacy, he easily defeated them but discovered that the primordials were immortal. No matter how crushed they were, they would resurrect under the victor's command. This realization led to a stalemate among the remaining four primordials.
Among the daemons, the Black PrimordialNoirpersistently troubled Guy. They fought for supremacy, resulting in a draw. Recognizing Noir's strength, Guy acknowledged him as a rival.

With the passage of time, Guy was summoned to theCentral WorldbyHigh humanEmperorJahilof the Super-Magic Empire. He was summoned as anarchdaemonand tasked with destroying an enemy nation. Using a million corpses, Guy successfully incarnated and ascended to the rank oftrue demon lord, acquiring the souls of numerous people. In addition to destroying the enemy nation, he summoned Primordial Vert and Blue, ordering them to slaughter Jahil and all the residents of the Super-Magic Empire while avoiding mass destruction magic to prolong their suffering.

As Guy crushed his enemies, he relished in their doomed pleas and found it to be a pleasant sound. He named himself Guy, realizing his awakened state was needless since he already considered himself the strongest. He named his companions Misery and Rain, reflecting the misery of mankind and the rain of blood that fell wherever he went.

Guy and his maids traveled from place to place, enjoying the world. Eventually, he encounteredVeldanavaand challenged him to a fight but was easily defeated. Instead of becoming Veldanava's servant, he was given the role of Mediator. It was at this moment that Guy's heart materialized, and he gained theUnique skillPride. To alleviate his boredom, he monitored human civilization and destroyed any country engaged in warfare.

Guy joined forces with the Seven Angels of Origin in a three-month assault against theWorld-destroying Dragon, Ivaragé. However, Ivaragé managed to escape to the otherworld, leaving substantial damage in its wake.

After the battle, Guy surveyed the continent from above and spotted the Imperial Castle of the Super-Magic Empire, where he had been summoned. He decided to make the castle his home, believing it to be fate. TheFrost Dragon,Velzard, appeared and attacked Guy out of jealousy for his interaction with her brother. Their battle ended in a draw, and during the fight, Guy's power evolved further, granting him the Ultimate skill Lord of Pride,Lucifer. Intrigued by Guy, Velzard decided to observe him from that day forward.

Thousands of years passed, and Guy, bored to the core, received visitors:Rudra,Velgrynd, and Lucia. Rudra, dropping any pretense of an honorable duel, demanded Guy to hand over all his valuables. Amused by the request, Guy accepted the challenge. Despite Rudra's immense swordsmanship and the support of his sister's Holy Field and Holy Blade spells, Guy analyzed and replicated his every move, becoming stronger as the fight continued. However, Rudra halted the challenge and named Guy, as he didn't want to fight a Demon Lord with a funny name. Thus, Guy was renamed Guy Crimson based on his red hair color. From that point on, the two engaged in daily fights with no clear winner emerging.

One day, Rudra proposed a change in their matches. Realizing that their direct battles would never lead to a resolution, Rudra suggested using their subordinates as proxies, with the winner claiming dominion over the entire world. Unfortunately, this ideal was not meant to last. Tragedies unfolded since the inception of the game between Guy and Rudra. Shortly after Veldanava and Lucia had their child,Milim, a terrorist attack occurred in theKingdom of Nasca, taking advantage of Rudra's absence. The attack, orchestrated by a warring enemy, resulted in the deaths of Lucia and Veldanava. Another tragedy befell Milim when herpet dragonwas killed by a foolish kingdom. Enraged, Milim destroyed the country and awakened in the process. Guy intervened and battled Milim for seven days and nights, turning the once-bountiful fields into a wasteland. In the end, there was no clear winner, but with Ramiris' assistance, Guy managed to calm Milim down. These events plunged Rudra into deep depression, forcing Guy to continue the game to keep his friend from falling apart.

infobox.title: Shuna

Ogre: In her Ogre stage, Shuna was a petite girl with the appearance of aHumangirl with the exception of her two large porcelain horns protruding from her forehead.

She has long, wavy, pink hair, coupled with large deep crimson eyes under very light, barely existing eyebrows. She wore a simple pink kimono, covered by a similarly simple white robe that covered her arms in excess. She also had a thin, low-ponytail that was tied using a single small white ribbon.

Her fair skin has a slightly pink tint alongside a couple of tear-like face markings similar to Benimaru, supposedly, to go along with her pink colour scheme, with the addition of two fangs that are long enough to slightly protrude out her lips to add to the "ferocious" theme of the Ogres.
Kijin: After her evolution, she took on the appearance akin to a human girl with a height of 145 centimetres, looking more refined and beautiful compared to her former cute self. Her horns also became narrower as with all Ogre to Kijin evolutions.
The slight pink tint on her skin is gone, as well as the face markings, and fangs that are small to be only visible when she speaks.
Excelling at weaving, she made herself a new white kimono with simple but graceful red embroidery and red kimono skirt that's held in place with a red ribbon, causing Shuna to be mistaken for amiko.
Her appearance mostly stays the same after evolving into an Oni.
Personality: Shuna is a gentle and forgiving girl with keen senses. Being raised as a princess, she also possesses a refined and graceful personality. Rimuru often relies on her regal disposition when it comes to diplomacy with leaders of other nations. Initially, during her introduction, Shuna appeared to be shy and fearful, staying behind Benimaru andHakurouwhile they confronted Rimuru. However, once they realized that Rimuru was not responsible for the attack and destruction of their village, they quickly allied with him. Shuna adapted to her new home and developed positive relationships with its inhabitants, showcasing her excellent social skills.

Moreover, Shuna is known for her compassion and empathy. When Rimuru discovered the extent of the tragedy caused by theKingdom of Falmuth's attack, including the deaths ofShionandGobzo, he felt guilty. In that moment, Shuna approached him, offering a hug and her unwavering support. She assured Rimuru that she would be there for him whenever he needed anything. As someone who is happy to be depended upon, Shuna finds contentment in her role under Rimuru, given her sheltered upbringing in the Ogre tribe. Even a little responsibility brings her joy.

However, it is important not to underestimate Shuna, as she can be remarkably competitive in certain areas. For instance, when appointed as Rimuru's close aide and tasked with personally taking care of him, her determination is evident. Shuna, along with Shion, unintentionally pulls on Rimuru to the point of tearing him in half due to their eagerness. Similar to Shion, she takes every opportunity to cuddle with Rimuru in his blob form. Additionally, Shuna showcases her femininity and skill in weaving silk on a loom. She assumes the responsibility of clothing everyone in their fledgling village and has already woven several rolls of silk.

It should be noted that despite her lack of obvious physical ability likeShionor the fighting experience of her compatriots, Shuna can be surprisingly intimidating when she wants to be, even to the likes of Rimuru.
Trivia: Her dub voice,Tia Ballard, also played the voice of Zero Two from "Darling in the Franxx" who has a similar appearance of a young girl with sakura pink hair and two oni-like horns.
Shuna is Rimuru's True Secretary despite the title being held byShionand laterDiablo.

Appearance: Damrada had the appearance of an aged man with blond hair and a goatee. His long hair was tied into a single low ponytail draped down his back. Personality: Damrada was a cold, calculating and pragmatic person who, in his efforts to expand Cerberus, pursued any means to turn a profit. Caring only for money, he welcomed fraud and betrayal and was unsympathetic to the pleas of those he deceived and trampled over, hence the reason he was always said to bring back dead man's loot. He was insightful and possessed a keen enough intuition to identify uniquely charismatic individuals likeYuukiandRimuru, being very drawn to such people. He also knew when to cut his losses and run, a vital requirement for any man in his line of work.

In ancient times he was a more honest and light-hearted person who held a good rapport with his comrades. He was particularly noted to have been close withGranbell– a comrade-in-arms he frequently bantered with who also served under the same master – but with the passage of time and a switch of affiliation the two grew distant, with their relationship devolving into petty disputes and each trying to outwit the other.
Background: Damrada was the former prime minister of the Kingdom of Nasca and a close friend of Emperor Rudra. He was originally the head of the Imperial Guardians beforeTatsuya Kondoutook over his position and was hailed as aChampionin the east as a Fist Saint and also held a bitter rivalry withMoss.

As part of his promise to Rudra, he roamed the land looking for a suitable candidate to kill the emperor who worried the day ofMichaelfully taking over him would arrive. Through that journey he came across a youth with a unique bodily composition that nullified the effect ofSkillsandMagic. That boy wasYuuki Kagurazaka, an aspiring young man who held grand ambitions of ruling the world. Damrada was seduced by his charisma and chose to wholeheartedly follow him, eventually becoming a close friend and partner-in-crime.

Damrada made great efforts building up the underground organization Cerberus which was founded by Yuuki on top of its predecessor Echidna, expanding it to hold great influence and power in the east. He took a spot as one of its leaders and became Yuuki's point man in the east. At some point he took inVegawho was fated to be executed byEnglassia's authorities and arranged an education for him, shaping him to be one of the organization's leaders. He also welcomedMisha, an old acquaintance he's known for decades and a skilled femme fatale.

One day Damrada came acrossMasayuki, an up-and-coming hero who caught his attention, most likely because of the rumors of him being the Hero of Beginning reborn, and found that he had a very keen resemblance to Emperor Rudra. He assigned two of the Double 0 Numbers —BernieandJiwu— to guard him.

Under his disguise as a lowly eastern merchant, Damrada nestled up toHinata Sakaguchi— captain of the Crusaders — and fed her malicious information onRimuruto get her to attack theslime. He also offeredTempest's silk products to theKingofFalmuth, drawing his eyes to the developing nation as a potential target of his greed. Near the night of theWalpurgiswhereClaymanmet his end, he attempted to call Hinata away from the defense ofLubelius' inner sanctum but failed to do so and lost the trust of the holy knight when she learned of his intention to remove her as an obstacle toLaplace's second invasion of the holy grounds.

Council of the West.title: Council of the West

Background: The Council of the West was originally established as a collaborative initiative aimed at addressing the looming menace of monstrous threats. Over time, its role evolved into a formidable organization primarily designed to serve as a check on theEastern Empire's influence. Gradually, it assumed a central role in arbitrating international affairs among its member nations.

Situated at the very heart of this council was theKingdom of Englassia. Geographically, Englassia's location made it the most convenient focal point for council members to convene. Consequently, it became the natural choice for the headquarters of theFree Guild, an organization closely intertwined with the council. It is worth noting that while theKingdom of Falmuthheld considerable power within the council's ranks, a deliberate decision was made to prevent any single nation from wielding excessive influence over the assembly.

Englassia, as the designated headquarters, possessed a unique advantage. Unlike its fellow council member nations, it did not share a border with the Jura Forest, thus affording it an added layer of stability and protection from the menacing threat posed by monsters. This advantageous geographic positioning played a pivotal role in Englassia's selection as the headquarters of the Council.[1]
Political Power: The Council acted as a mediator between nations, weighing each member's interests against the others’ and managing them to prevent conflict. It held power in both economic and political circles, making it a strikingly influential group in the region.

The council had no standing military force as it didn't need one. That's because, in a way, the Council formed the higher bureaucracy of the Free Guild itself. The money paid to adventurers for slaying monsters came from Council funding—and in exchange, the council had the right to give orders to the guild.

This funding came from contributions provided by each member nation, which varied depending on how much speaking rights each one had. Refusing to pay these meant leaving the council. It was a way for the council to gain a louder voice in local affairs, using the shield of security it offered members. Many nations relied almost wholly upon the guild for monster management, and that meant there was no choice for them but to support the council.[1]
War Policies: Within the Western Nations, the member countries of the Council of the West generally maintained a remarkable peace among themselves. Even in the rare instances where conflicts did arise, they strictly adhered to formal declarations of war and a set of stringent rules governing warfare. Deviation from these rules would trigger a collective response from the Council, with all member nations rallying against the transgressor.

For situations where non-member nations were engaged in disputes, the Council maintained a policy of non-interference, regardless of the victor or loser. However, if one of the parties involved in such conflicts engaged in exceptionally cruel and inhumane conduct beyond reason, it would undoubtedly tarnish that nation's standing within the Council's ranks.

The dynamics shifted significantly when a member nation of the Council found itself under invasion by an external force. In such cases, member nations possessed the right to request assistance and support from the Council. This principle formed a pivotal rationale behind the Council's inclusion of numerous small kingdoms among its membership, as it ensured collective defense and solidarity in times of peril.[2]

Trivia: The Council of the West was founded byGranbell Rosso.

Following the events ofAwakening of the Chosen Hero, it became evident that the Council had effectively fallen under the control of Tempest, primarily through the influence ofTestarossa. Many of the council members began to regard Tempest with a mixture of fear and respect, eventually leadingsometo resign from their positions due to the overwhelming influence exerted by Testarossa.

It is possible for an intelligent Slime to naturally come into existence as a Unique Monster, though there hasn't been any such occurrence as of yet. Abilities: Slimebodiesare a composition of identical cells that can each serve as both a neuron and a muscle cell at the same time. Thus, as the thought process is undertaken by different cells at different times, sleep is unnecessary.

Slime bodies move and are sustained with magicules. Since oxygen is unnecessary, no form of breathing occurs. They lack hunger and thus have no need for physical nourishment under normal circumstances, though if they lack the magicules they need they can substitute it with meat and plants.

Appearance: Roy Valentin appears to be a tall man with blond hair with regal clothing befitting a Demon Lord. When he was in the inner sanctum of Lubelius, he would wear a white clergy robe similar to Louis', so that people would not know he's actually the Demon Lord.
Personality: Roy is a prideful individual who sees many others as below him. Despite this, he's actually very loyal towards his master, Luminous.
Background: Originally there was a powerfulVampireknown as "Valentin," who was known for being highly bloodthirsty and battle crazed. As revealed, "Valentin", was one of the manycreationsofTwilight Valentine, the creator and progenitor of the many races in theCentral World. Valentin himself was a byproduct of Twilight’s research and experimentation after successfully populating the worlds and dimensions with intelligent life in accordance to theircreator's wishes. Valentin was noted to be one of their most troublesome creations, frequently breaking out and causing problems and needing to be dealt with by theMediator.

Even after being subjugated and taken in as a subordinate by Luminous, he continued to antagonize her other subordinates. This caused Luminous to then use her powers to divide this vampire into two separate beings, creating two separate entities to act as her body doubles. In this way, she could stay hidden out of sight of both the other Demon Lords and her human empires. "Roy" was assigned to act as her stand-in as a member of theTen Great Demon Lords, while his twin brother "Louis" was to act as her stand-in as the Holy Emperor of Lubelius. Both of them have continued to loyally serve Luminous for a very long time since then, even before Lubelius came into existence.
The twins have served as some of Luminous’s oldest subordinates, having been working for her when she founded her first country, Night Rose.
After the founding of Lubelius, he acted as the Demon Lord to terrorize people into joining the religion of Luminism, while his brother acted as the pope to lead the religion.

Sometime while pretending to be the "Demon Lord Valentin" hundreds of years ago (prior to the formation of the "Ten Great Demon Lords" and the council only consisted of merely seven members), Roy had apparently gotten into an argument and battled against "Curse Lord"Kazalimand had fought him to a standstill. Despite no clear winner being made from their battle, their fight had caused massive collateral damage and a large number of civilian casualties. It's been stated that due to the result of this battle being triggered by a disagreement between two Demon Lords, a "tradition" of the Council agreeing to the vote or motion supported by four members was set in place in order to avoid another incident like this. These rules were seemingly established when the group itself originally consisted of seven members.
Trivia: Both Roy's and Louis' first names, as well as their surname, are pronounced in French.

During his battle against Laplace, the backstory and true identity of Roy and Louis being once a single being divided into two is revealed. And upon Roy's death, he was then re-absorbed into Louis. As such Roy can still technically be "alive" through Louis.

Principles: The Church recognizes One GodLuminousas their sole and absolute deity, not recognizing the existence of any other gods.

Their central dogma is thatmonstersare evil and should be exterminated, hence the existence ofTemple KnightsandCrusaderstasked with monster slaying. However, practitioners of other religions were not protected.

Faith alone could not ensure the safety of missionaries, hence the Holy Emperor’s Ministry made demands to the nations under their protection and formed the Temple Knights. The nations welcomed the idea of a Ministry-funded knight order, and so they agreed to assist. However, disputes began to emerge between Lubelius and other nations, thus theHoly Emperor's Imperial Guardswere given the authority to command the Temple Knights.

During the present time, the Church has become much more powerful due to the addition of the Crusaders. Moreover, the role of archon in the Ministry, a position formerly held by theClerics of the Seven Luminaries, is now given to a selected cardinal from the Church.

Appearance: The Count is a man with long gray hair and a thin gray mustache. He usually wears noble clothes with a green coat.

Story: The Count sits next to his bedridden wife. He had arranged she to get a medicine for her illness, but thieves had stolen the caravan carrying the medicine. He apologizes that he is still not able to capture the thieves.

A bit later,Gesdarbrings him a letter from Freedom Academy reminding him that the students training is coming up. He asks Gesdar if there are any news on the thieves, but Gesdar declines. The Count then orders him to inspect the caves and arrange their lodging.

Class S arrives a day earlier than expected and as their rooms are not ready, he suggests they to check the caves. Later he learns of the events with the thieves andPhantomin the caves and that the medicine was used by them. Learning thatRimuruhas such medicine, which is one of hispotions, he begs Rimuru to give him one and Rimuru agrees on the condition he treats his wife. Rimuru operates onUlamuth, removing the affected organ and then uses his potion to heal her. As Ulamuth makes full recovery, the Count is happy that his wife is alive and can walk again.
Sometime later, he and Ulamuth take part in Tempest's festival.

Physiology: Harpies resemble humans overall, but have a pair of large feathered wings sprouting from their backs and avian feet with four taloned toes. They can, however, retract their wings into their bodies as well as transform their avian feet into human feet at will, allowing them to pass as human with ease. Some experienced harpies can transform their hands into avian talons similar to their feet, except they retain their basic hand configuration of five fingers with an opposable thumb.[1][2][3]
Harpy Queen: The Harpy Queen, or aQueen Species｢女王種,joō shu｣, is immune to all attacks performed by other harpies. The only exception would be another Harpy Queen with superior power.

Queen-type Harpies among the largely female populated race have the ability to reproduce through Parthenogenesis or Virgin Birth, where the queen is able to have children without the need of a partner. As noted by Frey, the ability to reproduce, both with and without the need of a partner, is integral to Harpy society, especially for its rulers. As shown where Frey's twin sister,Nazim, despite having equal potential to her sister and being a rare mutant among the harpies, was exiled by theirmotherand their people due to her being born infertile and therefore deemed unfit to rule.

infobox.title: Jahil
infobox.Light Novel: Volume 6:The Octagram Soars(Cameo)Volume 18:The End of Ambitions

True Form: Jahil's original and true appearance is that of a somewhat average looking man with a large nose and long light colored hair worn in a ponytail. He typically wears a simple white robe and sandals.
Footman: After the events ofThe End of Ambitions, Jahil has taken over the body ofFootmanand has chosen to keep his appearance, albeit with a few modifications. Footman's signature mask is nowhere to be found and his light orange colored suit has been changed to a dark purple one with yellow and green accents.
Personality: Jahil is extremely arrogant and self-centered, believing himself to be the pinnacle of power and the rightful ruler of the world. He holds little to no morality and is willing to kill thousands of people just for the sake of experimentation.
Background: Jahil was created by the divine ancestor Twilight Valentine eons ago to fulfillVeldanava's wish of a world populated with sentient life. The first of these experiments was Jahil, the "ancestor" of the entire human race. However, Jahil's behaviour was erratic and unsuited for Veldanava's desires, resulting in him and his fellow High humans being deemed failures and Twilight moving on to create more races.

Once the various races had spread across the earth and various nations had begun to form, Jahil and his scientifically advanced nation of High humans set out to conquer the world and become its sole ruler. This eventually resulted in Jahil summoning the lord of theDaemonraceGuy Crimson. Jahil arrogantly believed that so long as Guy was within the material world that he could be controlled by the magic that was forced upon him during summoning. Guy proceeded to destroy not only the nation he was fighting against but to also summon and then incarnateRainandMisery, ordering them to slaughter Jahil and all the residents of his Super-Sorcery Empire while avoiding the use of mass destruction magic to increase their suffering.

While he was killed by the fruits of his own stupidity, Jahil was actually able to survive the attack. Forever paranoid about his own death, he had devised asecret artthat would turn him into aspiritual life-formunbound by lifespan. In this spiritual state, Jahil came to wander the earth for eons, eventually finding an unknown host. Eventually, he had heard that Veldanava had become mortal after Milim's birth, and saw it as the perfect opportunity to become a God Killer, proceeding to carry out a terrorist attack against the Kingdom of Nasca where Veldanava lived with his family, and killed both Veldanava and his wife Lucia. This, however, backfired, asDino, one of Veldavana's subordinates, avenged his master's death by destroying the nation to which Jahil's host belonged, mistakenly believing that Jahil's attack was initiated by that nation. Jahil was presumably killed in this attack as well, as he is known to have taken another host shortly afterwards.

This host was theking of the elven kingdom. The wise and kind king had built his city over the ruins over the Super-Sorcery Empire and made use of the technological secrets that laid within to create a prosperous nation called the 'Great Sorcerous Nation Of Soma' for his entire race. After Jahil made the king's body his own he proceeded to use the once peaceful kingdom as both a launchpad for the rebirth of the Super-Magic Empire and a testing grounds for his magical experiments. He became abusive and cold towards the king's daughterKagaliand began massacring people in order to use their corpses for his experiments with the "Birthday" spell.

Jahil's experiments culminated in him murdering Kagali and bringing her back to life as aDeathman. He had placed a curse upon her that would leave her appearance rotting, twisted, and ugly. When Kagali spoke back to her perceived father, begging him to return to his "peaceful and loving ways" Jahil lashed out in anger and used the power of his curse to force Kagali to become a male, changing her name to Kazalim and calling her his son.

Once more Jahil's arrogance and stupidity resulted in his doom. He had secretly infiltrated the Kingdom of Nasca and attempted to bring its Dragon Princess,Milim Nava, under his control. He killed the girl's pet dragon using mystical arts to bypass itsAnti-skilland sent the girl into a mindless rampage of unbridled rage. The power the Dragon Princess inherited from Veldanava proved to be too much for Jahil to handle and he once again perished as the capital of the Soma was reduced to nothing by a bright beam of pure destruction. His spirit once more roamed the earth, treading the line between life and death before being unexpectedly saved by the angel of originFeldway. Feldway safe-guarded Jahil's spirit and Jahil in turn owed them a great debt. When the time came, Jahil's spirit was secretly implanted into the body ofFootmanin order to spy on the demon lordClaymanand his compatriots.
Trivia: Jahil's name can mean "ignorant", "fool", and "rude" inArabic.

As revealed, despite his actions, Jahil nevertheless left a great mark on the history of the world. As shown whereBarak Jahil’s ancestor, one of the oldest and most powerful noble houses of theKingdom of Coleus, had named his house after the “Great Jahil”.[1]
